This omission, as we will see later, was to have profound—and negative—consequences during the remainder of the post-Mao period. Another noteworthy loophole in the mandatory retirement system was that the age limit could be waived if continuing service by the official was "needed."

尽管20世纪80年代初的体制改革是朝着使党国政治生活不那么残酷、不那么专断迈出的切实而积极的一步，但这些改革也存在严重的局限性。在年龄和任期限制方面，值得注意的是，邓小平及其同僚有意豁免了最高级别的领导人。例如，中央委员会委员、政治局委员、国家公共安全委员会委员以及中央军委主席等均不受此类限制。正如我们稍后将看到的，这一疏漏在后毛泽东时代产生了深远的负面影响。强制退休制度的另一个值得注意的漏洞是，如果官员“需要”继续任职，则可以豁免其年龄限制。

The most critical flaw of all the institutional reforms, whether in terms of the political norms within the party or the age and term limits, is the lack of credible enforcement mechanisms. For any rules or norms to be binding, the most effective institutional arrangement is the designation of a third party, in this case an organization independent of the CCP, to enforce them. However, none of the reforms implemented in the early 1980s contained provisions on third-party enforcement. Instructively, when the National People's Congress (NPC) was discussing a major overhaul of the constitution between September 1980 and October 1982, a key issue was whether to establish an institution to ensure compliance with the constitution. One proposal was to form a specialized constitutional committee within the NPC. However, Deng vetoed the idea. As a result, the Chinese constitution has no provisions for ensuring compliance.16

所有制度改革，无论是党内政治规范还是年龄和任期限制，其最关键的缺陷在于缺乏可信的执行机制。任何规则或规范要具有约束力，最有效的制度安排是指定第三方（在本例中为独立于中共的组织）来执行。然而，20世纪80年代初实施的所有改革均未包含关于第三方执行的规定。值得注意的是，1980年9月至1982年10月全国人民代表大会讨论对宪法进行重大修订时，一个关键问题是是否设立一个机构来确保宪法得到遵守。其中一项提议是在全国人大内部设立一个专门的宪法委员会。然而，邓小平否决了这一提议。因此，中国宪法没有关于确保宪法得到遵守的规定。

Two factors lay behind the limitations of the institutional reforms undertaken by the CCP in the early 1980s. Politically, Deng and the other aging leaders did not want to be bound by any rules in their own exercise of power. They not only wielded power behind the scenes but also openly violated the key provisions laid out in the "Guiding Principles for Inner-Party Political Life." For example, instead of convening meetings of the PSC, Deng spoke directly to key leaders to issue instructions, thus bypassing his archrival, Chen Yun. Important personnel decisions were made by party elders, not by the general secretary. Zhao Ziyang revealed that "leaders at my level could not make important personnel decisions. That was true when Yaobang was the general secretary. Sometimes we did not even have the opportunity to participate in discussing such decisions. Only a small number of elders were consulted. Such decisions could be made only when Xiaoping and Chen Yun reached an agreement between them.17 Even though the guiding principles ostensibly permitted party members to voice different opinions and prohibited their persecution, after the start of the anti-bourgeois liberalization campaign in January 1987, Deng himself named several liberal party members who would be slated for punishment. It was only stalling by Zhao that allowed most of the people on Deng's list to be saved.18

中共在20世纪80年代初推行的体制改革存在局限性，其背后有两个因素。在政治上，邓小平和其他老一辈领导人不愿在行使权力时受到任何规则的约束。他们不仅在幕后操纵权力，还公开违反了《党内政治生活指导原则》中的关键规定。例如，邓小平不召开党政委会议，而是直接向关键领导人下达指示，从而绕过了他的宿敌陈云。重要的人事决策也由党内元老而非总书记做出。赵紫阳透露：“我们这个级别的领导不能做重要的人事决定。姚邦当总书记的时候就是这样。有时候我们甚至没有机会参与讨论这类决定，只有少数元老才能参与。这类决定只有在小平、陈云达成一致后才能做出。”尽管指导原则表面上允许党员发表不同意见，禁止迫害，但在1987年1月反资产阶级自由化运动开始后，邓小平本人也点名批评了几位自由派党员。多亏赵紫阳的拖延，邓小平名单上的大多数人才得以幸免。

An even more critical factor is the impossibility of enforcing any rules and norms in an autocracy. As many theorists have noted, institutions function only when the rulers' commitments to uphold them are enforceable.19 Normally, the most effective mechanisms of enforcement are those that rely on third parties, such as independent courts, a free press, and civil society. Such third-party enforcers do not exist in autocratic regimes. Counting on autocrats to self-enforce their commitments is unreliable because the temptations to gain political advantage and power by violating the rules and norms are often too great to resist. Rules and norms may be enforceable in an autocracy only when the balance of power is equally distributed among dueling factions, making it costly for any one faction to violate them.

更为关键的因素在于，在专制政体中，任何规则和规范都无法得到有效执行。正如许多理论家所指出的，只有当统治者履行其维护制度的承诺能够得到执行时，制度才能发挥作用。通常，最有效的执行机制依赖于第三方，例如独立的法院、新闻自由和公民社会。然而，在专制政体中，这些第三方执行者并不存在。指望专制者自我约束、履行承诺是不可靠的，因为通过违反规则和规范来获取政治利益和权力的诱惑往往难以抵挡。只有当权力在相互对立的派系之间势均力敌，使得任何一个派系都难以承受违反规则和规范的代价时，规则和规范才有可能在专制政体中得到有效执行。

In the Chinese case, due to Deng's determination to suppress prodemocracy forces that could undermine the party's monopoly of power, it was impossible for third parties to emerge and help enforce the very rules and norms that Deng thought would help make political life inside the CCP more stable and predictable. The contradictions between Deng's goals of institutionalizing the CCP and his aversion to any reforms that might weaken CCP power ultimately would render his reforms partial, ineffective, and short-lived.

在中国，由于邓小平决心压制可能动摇党的权力垄断地位的民主力量，第三方政党根本无法出现，也就无法帮助维护邓小平认为有助于中共内部政治生活更加稳定和可预测的规则和规范。邓小平致力于将中共制度化的目标与他反对任何可能削弱中共权力的改革之间的矛盾，最终导致他的改革是局部性的、无效的，并且昙花一现。





Clashing Visions of Economic Reform





经济改革的不同愿景


Two fundamentally different visions of the future of the Chinese economy divided the conservatives, led by Chen Yun, and the Deng-liberal coalition. The reform agenda of the latter emphasized opening to the outside world and implementing market reforms, while the conservatives tried to preserve the command economy that had been established in the 1950s and maintained a skeptical attitude toward market reforms and integration with the West-dominated global economy.20 In terms of policy, the two groups differed on the pace and scope of rural reform, domestic economic liberalization (such as development of a private sector), and economic growth rates.21 Chen and Deng also disagreed on foreign policy (Chen liked the Soviet Union and did not trust the United States, whereas Deng favored good ties with the United States and took a hard line toward the Soviet Union).22

对中国经济未来截然不同的两种愿景，将以陈云为首的保守派与邓小平领导的自由派联盟分裂开来。后者强调对外开放和市场改革，而保守派则试图维护20世纪50年代建立的计划经济体制，并对市场改革和融入西方主导的全球经济持怀疑态度。在政策方面，两派在农村改革的速度和范围、国内经济自由化（例如发展私营部门）以及经济增长速度等方面存在分歧。陈云和邓小平在外交政策上也存在分歧（陈云亲苏，不信任美国；而邓小平则主张与美国保持良好关系，对苏联采取强硬立场）。

Ideologically, Chen consistently advocated that central planning must determine economic activities, with the market playing only a secondary role. To use his famous analogy, the planned economy was the cage and the market was the bird living inside the cage. The market could operate freely—but only within the confines of the planned economy.23 In contrast, Deng and the liberals saw a market-oriented economy as China's future.24

在思想上，陈一鸣始终主张中央计划经济必须主导经济活动，市场只能扮演辅助角色。他曾用一个著名的比喻来形容计划经济：计划经济是笼子，市场是笼中鸟。市场可以自由运作，但只能在计划经济的框架内进行。与此相反，邓小平和自由派人士则认为市场经济才是中国的未来。

At the beginning of the 1980s, Chen's opposition to the economic reforms was more measured, even nuanced. As a fiscal hawk who preferred lower growth to deficit-spending, he repeatedly gave speeches affirming the dominant role of the planned economy, urging fiscal conservatism, and cautioning against hasty reforms.25 But on occasion, he would show support for Zhao's reformist policies. Nevertheless, despite the early achievements of the economic reforms, Chen continued to insist on maintaining the dominant role of planning. Consequently, his opposition to the economic reforms—and his policy differences with the reformers—intensified.26

20世纪80年代初，陈对经济改革的反对态度更为谨慎，甚至有些微妙。作为一位财政鹰派，他倾向于低增长而非赤字支出，多次发表讲话，重申计划经济的主导地位，敦促财政保守主义，并告诫不要仓促改革。但有时，他也会表示支持赵的改革政策。然而，尽管经济改革初期取得了一些成就，陈仍然坚持维持计划经济的主导地位。因此，他对经济改革的反对——以及他与改革派的政策分歧——愈演愈烈。

The area where Deng and Chen diverged and clashed the most was opening China to the capitalist West. As opening was key to the success of the domestic reforms, Deng strongly advocated policies welcoming foreign investment. He enthusiastically supported the proposal to establish special economic zones (SEZs) in Guangdong and Fujian in April 1979, and within a year he fast-tracked a package of policies granting Shenzhen, Xiamen, Shantou, and Zhu-hai autonomy to attract foreign investment and trade.27 In 1984 he visited some of the SEZs to show his support. As Deng said to Zhao and Hu in February 1982, "The SEZs are a window through which [we can] bring in technology, management, and knowledge."28 In October 1984 Deng countered the conservatives' criticisms of his policy of opening, declaring, "Some of our comrades are always worried that if we open up, undesirable things may be brought into China. Above all, they worry that the country might go capitalist.... Of course, some negative elements will come in, and we must be aware of that. But it will not be difficult for us to overcome them.... If we isolate ourselves and close our doors again, it will be absolutely impossible for us to approach the level of the developed countries in fifty years."29 Although Deng did not name Chen, he most likely was referring to him.

邓小平和陈德贤分歧和冲突最大的领域是向西方资本主义开放中国。由于开放是国内改革成功的关键，邓小平大力倡导欢迎外资的政策。1979年4月，他热情支持在广东和福建设立经济特区的提议，并在一年内迅速出台一系列政策，赋予深圳、厦门、汕头和珠海吸引外资和贸易的自主权。1984年，他亲自考察了部分经济特区，以示支持。正如邓小平在1982年2月对赵立坚和胡锦涛所说：“经济特区是引进技术、管理和知识的窗口。”28 1984年10月，邓小平反驳了保守派对其改革开放政策的批评，他宣称：“我们的一些同志总是担心，如果我们开放，不好的东西就会被引进中国。他们最担心的是，国家会走向资本主义……当然，会有一些负面因素进来，我们必须意识到这一点。但是，克服这些因素并不难……如果我们再次封闭自己，关闭国门，五十年内绝对不可能赶上发达国家的水平。”29 虽然邓小平没有点名陈，但他很可能指的是陈。

On the issue of opening, as Zhao observed, Chen Yun "was completely at odds with [Deng] Xiaoping. . . . Chen Yun was very cautious about foreign investments. The case file for the Shanghai-Volkswagen joint venture remained in his office for a long time before he finally gave his consent.30 As reflected in his speeches on foreign trade and investment, Chen was consistently skeptical about, if not hostile to, the idea of economic engagement with the capitalist West. In December 1980 he opposed borrowing from the West or from the World Bank to finance imports of capital goods, and he called for "vigilance in welcoming foreign capitalists." On foreign trade, Chen had a zero-sum mindset, continuing to worry that competition among Chinese exporters would allow foreign trade partners to benefit. He therefore advocated retreating to a centralized foreign trade system to avoid "losses." Chen was especially skeptical about the SEZs. In 1982 he warned that if more SEZs were allowed, "foreign capitalists and domestic speculators will come out in droves, and speculation will be rampant. That must not be allowed."31 Instead of promoting the SEZs, Chen urged a pause and, to show his opposition, never set foot in any of the SEZs. In all likelihood, Chen's opposition to opening arose from his fears of the ideological influence of the West, not just its economic clout. He called on the party to "pay attention to the negative things brought in by opening to the outside." In particular he worried that exposure to the developed capitalist West could lead people to believe that socialism is inferior to capitalism.32

正如赵所观察到的，在对外开放问题上，陈云“与邓小平完全对立……陈云对外国投资非常谨慎。上海大众合资企业的案卷在他办公室搁置了很久，他才最终同意。”正如他在对外贸易和投资方面的讲话所反映的那样，陈云始终对与西方资本主义国家进行经济接触持怀疑态度，甚至可以说是敌视。1980年12月，他反对向西方或世界银行借款来资助资本货物进口，并呼吁“警惕外国资本家”。在对外贸易问题上，陈云持有零和博弈的思维模式，他始终担心中国出口商之间的竞争会让外国贸易伙伴从中获利。因此，他主张回归集中式的对外贸易体制，以避免“损失”。陈云尤其对经济特区持怀疑态度。1982年，他警告说，如果允许设立更多经济特区，“外国资本家和国内投机者”将会有大量人员涌入，投机活动也会猖獗。这绝不能允许。”31 陈没有推动经济特区建设，而是敦促暂停，并且为了表示反对，他从未踏足过任何经济特区。很可能，陈反对对外开放的根源在于他对西方意识形态影响的担忧，而不仅仅是其经济实力。他呼吁党“关注对外开放带来的负面影响”。他尤其担心，接触发达的资本主义西方可能会使人们认为社会主义不如资本主义。32

Yet, despite Chen's consistent opposition to market reforms, he was constantly outmaneuvered by Deng and the liberals in the early 1980s because Zhao Ziyang was in direct charge of economic policy at the State Council and generally implemented Deng's policies, even though he would also consult with Chen out of deference.33 Because of their sharp differences over the economic reforms, Deng developed a strategy to undercut Chen's role in economic policy making. He rarely held PSC meetings (which would have given Chen an opportunity to present his opposing views and potentially to force Deng to water down his reformist policies). Instead, Deng would approach Zhao and Hu Yaobang directly and give them instructions. At one point, a frustrated Chen asked Zhao why no PSC meetings were being held. Zhao, then serving as CCP acting general secretary, replied "I am only a big secretary. If you want to have meetings, you should first reach an agreement with Comrade Xiaoping."34

然而，尽管陈志远一贯反对市场改革，但在20世纪80年代初，他却屡屡被邓小平及其自由派人士牵着鼻子走，因为赵紫阳在国务院直接负责经济政策，并总体上执行邓小平的政策，即便出于尊重，他也会与陈志远商议。由于两人在经济改革问题上存在严重分歧，邓小平制定了一项削弱陈志远在经济政策制定中作用的策略。他很少召开国务院政治局常委会会议（这本应让陈志远有机会表达反对意见，并有可能迫使邓小平淡化其改革政策）。相反，邓小平会直接与赵紫阳和胡耀邦沟通，并向他们下达指示。有一次，沮丧的陈志远问赵紫阳为何不召开国务院政治局常委会会议。时任中共代总书记的赵紫阳回答说：“我只是个大书记。如果你想开会，应该先和肖平同志达成一致。”





Partial Political Reforms





部分政治改革


In addition to the institutional reforms focusing on party leadership, Deng also promoted two important reforms to modernize the legal system and restore the function of the NPC. He supported these reforms not because he intended to promote the rule of law and multiparty democracy but because he saw instrumental value in them. Specifically, restoring the legislative function of the NPC could give party policies a veneer of popular and procedural legitimacy. After all, CCP Central Committee resolutions were, strictly speaking, documents issued by a political party that lacked the same legal force as the national legislature. Much dearer to Deng's heart was the use of law to create a friendlier legal environment to attract foreign investment.

除了着重于党的领导层改革之外，邓小平还推动了两项重要改革，即法律体系现代化和恢复全国人大职能。他支持这些改革并非出于推进法治和多党民主的目的，而是因为他看到了这些改革的工具性价值。具体而言，恢复全国人大立法职能可以赋予党的政策以民意和程序上的合法性。毕竟，严格来说，中共中央决议是由一个政党发布的，并不具备全国人大的法律效力。邓小平更看重的是利用法律创造一个更有利于吸引外资的法律环境。

Therefore, from the very beginning, party efforts to introduce legal reforms were focused on passage of the essential commercial laws that underpinned a market economy, such as a contract law, foreign investment law, and company law.35 Additionally, the legal profession, abolished during the Maoist era, was rebuilt. Law schools were reopened to train legal professionals. Courts and procuratorates, previously heavily staffed by discharged military officers with little legal training, were gradually filled with more qualified personnel. Citizens enjoyed better legal protections as the state was forced to observe some form of legal procedures.36 Despite progress toward establishing a modern legal system, the party-sanctioned legal reforms in the 1980s were inherently limited. The supremacy of the CCP meant that the party continued to remain above the law and maintained tight control over the courts and procuratorates. Protection of human rights and property rights was spotty. Fragmented authoritarianism, a unique feature of the Chinese regime, meant that the implementation of law and the enforceability of judgments could not be ensured at local levels or across different jurisdictions.37 To be sure, the reforms that took place in the legal arena during the 1980s marked a significant improvement over the lawlessness of the Mao era, but they made only modest progress toward establishing rule of law.38

因此，从一开始，党推行法律改革的努力就集中在通过支撑市场经济的基本商法，例如合同法、外商投资法和公司法。此外，在毛泽东时代被废除的法律职业也得以重建。法学院重新开放，以培养法律专业人才。此前主要由缺乏法律培训的退伍军官组成的法院和检察机关，也逐渐配备了更多合格的人员。由于国家被迫遵守某种形式的法律程序，公民享有更好的法律保护。尽管在建立现代法律体系方面取得了进展，但20世纪80年代党推行的法律改革本质上是有限的。中共的至高无上地位意味着党仍然凌驾于法律之上，并对法院和检察机关保持着严格的控制。人权和财产权的保护并不完善。中国政权的独特之处在于其碎片化的威权主义，这意味着法律的实施和判决的执行无法在地方层面或不同司法管辖区得到保障。诚然，20世纪80年代法律领域的改革相比毛泽东时代的无法无天有了显著改善，但在建立法治方面进展甚微。

In addition to these legal reforms, the party also gave the NPC a more prominent procedural role in policymaking. Institutionally, the NPC was strengthened by the formation of specialized committees, the establishment of formal legislative procedures, and the recruitment of a more professional staff. Politically, the NPC gained status with the appointment of heavyweight political figures as chairs of its Standing Committee. On occasion, delegates to the annual NPC sessions could voice their views on public policy and even register symbolic disapproval of government performance with "no" votes or abstentions to the work reports of the premier and the presidents of the People's Supreme Court and the People's Supreme Procuratorate. Similar institutional developments, albeit to a lesser degree, also occurred at the local levels.39 Although these modest reforms made the NPC a more important actor in Chinese politics, they fell far short of establishing functional constraints on the power of the party, which controlled all key appointments to the NPC, set its legislative agenda, and used it mainly as an instrument to legitimize its policies.

除了这些法律改革之外，党还赋予全国人大在政策制定中更为突出的程序性作用。在制度上，全国人大通过设立专门委员会、建立正式的立法程序以及招募更多专业人员而得到加强。在政治上，全国人大通过任命重量级政治人物担任常务委员会主席而提升了其地位。在全国人大年会上，代表们有时可以就公共政策发表意见，甚至可以通过对总理、最高人民法院院长和最高人民检察院院长的工作报告投反对票或弃权票来象征性地表达对政府工作的不满。尽管程度较轻，但类似的制度发展也发生在地方层面。尽管这些温和的改革使全国人大在中国政治中扮演了更重要的角色，但它们远未对党的权力建立起有效的制约。党控制着全国人大的所有关键任命，制定了全国人大立法议程，并主要将其作为使其政策合法化的工具。





Attempt at Comprehensive Political Reform, 1986-1987





1986-1987年全面政治改革尝试


If there were one brief window of opportunity for the party to implement genuine political reforms to dismantle its totalitarian institutional foundations, it was an attempt undertaken by Zhao Ziyang in 1986-1987 with Deng's support. The paramount leader unexpectedly put political reform on the agenda in the summer of 1986 mainly because he was frustrated by the slow pace of reform in urban areas, which he attributed to obstruction by an inefficient party-dominated administrative apparatus, an assessment shared by Zhao as well.40 In June 1986 Deng told leading members of the Central Committee: "Early in 1980 it was suggested that we reform the political structure, but no concrete measures to do so were worked out. Now it is time for us to place political reform on the agenda . . . to create the necessary conditions for sustained economic growth," warning that "otherwise economic restructuring and economic growth will be retarded."41

如果说党曾有过一次短暂的良机，可以真正推行政治改革，拆除其极权主义的制度基础，那就是赵紫阳在1986-1987年间，在邓小平的支持下所做的尝试。这位最高领导人在1986年夏天出人意料地将政治改革提上日程，主要是因为他对城市改革进展缓慢感到失望，他认为这是由于效率低下的党控行政机构的阻挠造成的，赵紫阳也持相同看法。1986年6月，邓小平对中央委员会主要成员说：“1980年初就有人建议我们改革政治体制，但没有制定具体的措施。现在是时候把政治改革提上日程了……为经济持续增长创造必要条件。”他警告说，“否则经济结构调整和经济增长将会受阻。”

However, Deng's definition and objective of "political system reform" differed fundamentally from Zhao's. As Zhao pointed out, Deng's "political system reform was no more than a form of administrative reform." His idea of such a reform was not "real political modernization or democratization." As his goal of undertaking such reform was "to solidify further the CCP's one-party dictatorship," Deng resolutely rejected "any reform that could affect or weaken the CCP's one-party dictatorship."42 By contrast, Zhao believed that the ultimate objective of political system reform was to "change the party's complete monopoly of power . . . so as to establish gradually a democratic and accountable system with the CCP as the ruling party." (Zhao also believed that Hu Yaobang shared the same vision even though Hu had not said much about political reform publicly.)43 Even though Zhao's concept of political system reform fell short of full democratization, it was much more comprehensive and radical than anything Deng entertained. In Zhao's judgment, Deng's framing of political system reform represented a retreat from his famous speech of 1980 on the same subject because it narrowly confined reform to "separating the party from the government, decentralizing power, streamlining bureaucracy, and improving efficiency."44

然而，邓小平对“政治体制改革”的定义和目标与赵立坚的截然不同。正如赵立坚所指出的，邓小平的“政治体制改革不过是一种行政改革”。他所设想的改革并非“真正的政治现代化或民主化”。由于他推行此类改革的目标是“进一步巩固中共的一党专政”，邓小平坚决反对“任何可能影响或削弱中共一党专政的改革”。相比之下，赵立坚认为政治体制改革的最终目标是“改变党对权力的完全垄断……从而逐步建立以中共为执政党的民主问责制”。 （赵也认为胡耀邦与他有着相同的愿景，尽管胡耀邦很少公开谈论政治改革。）尽管赵的政治体制改革构想未能达到完全民主化，但它比邓小平的任何设想都更加全面和激进。在赵看来，邓小平对政治体制改革的阐述是对其1980年就同一主题发表的著名演讲的退缩，因为它将改革狭隘地局限于“党政分离、权力下放、精简机构、提高效率”。

Because Deng had lost trust in Hu Yaobang by the summer of 1986, he assigned Zhao the task of drawing up a comprehensive political system reform plan. In September Zhao formed a small group, innocuously called the "Central Research Small Group on Political System Reform," and chaired it himself. To carry out research and to draft the reform program, Zhao appointed his top aide, Bao Tong, to direct the special office supporting the "Small Group." Bao recruited a team of liberal intellectuals to staff this office.45

由于邓小平在1986年夏天对胡耀邦失去了信任，他指派赵承熙负责制定一套全面的政治体制改革方案。9月，赵承熙组建了一个小组，名为“中央政治体制改革研究小组”，并亲自担任组长。为了开展研究和起草改革方案，赵承熙任命他的得力助手包彤领导支持该小组的特别办公室。包彤招募了一批自由派知识分子来负责这个办公室的工作。

For the next twelve months, Bao's team labored in secrecy to produce a blueprint of a comprehensive reform that would be acceptable to Deng but would also accomplish Zhao's goal of introducing modest reforms that, in totality, could help the party-state make the transition from totalitarianism to authoritarianism. Despite Deng's restrictive remit, Zhao supported Bao's team in its exploration of a broad range of sensitive topics beyond the priorities laid out by Deng, in particular the "separation of the party from the government."

在接下来的十二个月里，鲍的团队秘密地制定了一份全面的改革方案，既要让邓小平接受，又要实现赵的目标，即推行适度的改革，最终帮助党国从极权主义过渡到威权主义。尽管邓小平的授权范围很窄，赵仍然支持鲍的团队探索邓小平设定的优先事项之外的一系列敏感议题，特别是“党政分离”问题。

Ironically, Zhao's group had more freedom than it appeared mainly because Deng did not define what he meant by "separating the party from the government." For example, the group determined that "the party's supervision of cadres" did not mean that the party should make specific appointments. Instead, a civil service system needed to be established as soon as possible, a first step toward extricating the party from the state.46 Besides defining the scope of "separating the party from the government" more broadly, Zhao's task force also veered off in more sensitive directions. It discussed how to institute "inner-party democracy," a topic not on Deng's list of reforms. In addition, the group explored the most sensitive issue of democratization by convening seminars on establishing channels through which various interest groups could engage in dialogue and consult with one another, and on the holding of competitive local elections to select delegates to local people's congresses.47

具有讽刺意味的是，赵的小组比表面看起来拥有更大的自由度，这主要是因为邓小平没有明确定义“党政分离”的含义。例如，该小组认为“党对干部的监督”并不意味着党应该进行具体的任命。相反，他们需要尽快建立公务员制度，这是党与国家分离的第一步。除了更广泛地界定“党政分离”的范围外，赵的特别工作组还转向了更为敏感的方向。他们讨论了如何建立“党内民主”，而这并非邓小平改革计划中的议题。此外，该小组还探讨了民主化中最敏感的问题，召开研讨会，讨论如何建立各利益集团之间进行对话和协商的渠道，以及如何举行竞争性的地方选举来选拔地方人民代表大会的代表。

After Zhao delivered to Deng the blueprint of the reform, titled "Overall Design for Political System Reform," in late May 1987, Deng immediately spotted the potential in the plan to establish mechanisms of checks and balances that could undermine the party's monopoly of power. Reiterating his opposition to a "separation of powers," Deng chided Zhao for "introducing some separation of powers," even though the plan did not explicitly state this concept. Deng again emphasized that the Chinese system was superior because it did not have to face interference from interest groups and because decisions made by the leaders could be implemented immediately. Deng warned that this superiority must not be abandoned just to appease "sentiments for democracy."48

1987年5月下旬，赵立坚向邓小平提交了题为《政治体制改革总体设计》的改革蓝图。邓小平立即意识到该方案中可能存在建立权力制衡机制的潜力，从而削弱党的权力垄断。邓小平重申了他反对“权力分立”的立场，并斥责赵立坚“引入某种权力分立”，尽管该方案并未明确提出这一概念。邓小平再次强调，中国体制的优势在于它不受利益集团的干预，领导人做出的决定可以立即执行。邓小平警告说，绝不能为了迎合“民主情绪”而放弃这一优势。

Deng's veiled but unmistakable criticism forced Zhao's group to scramble to revise the blueprint so that it could win his support. Two months later, Deng approved the revised draft of the "Overall Design"—but only after instructing Zhao to insert the following sentence: "[We] will never institute the Western practice of a tripartite separation of powers and rotation of powers among multiple parties."49 In September 1987 the Politburo approved the final draft of the Overall Design "in principle." But even Deng's support failed to produce a resounding endorsement by the party (most likely because Deng did not actively promote the plan). When Zhao tabled the Overall Design for discussion at a Central Committee meeting in mid-October 1987, many members expressed reservations or different views. As a result, he decided not to have the plenum vote on the document because he feared a potential setback. Instead of "approving" it, the plenum's communiqué stated that the Central Committee "discussed and agreed in principle with the 'Overall Design.'"50

邓小平含蓄却又明确的批评迫使赵立坚的团队紧急修改方案，以期获得他的支持。两个月后，邓小平批准了修改后的《总体设计》草案，但前提是他指示赵立坚在草案中加入以下句子：“我们绝不实行西方的三权分立和多党轮流执政。”1987年9月，政治局“原则上”批准了《总体设计》的最终草案。但即便有邓小平的支持，也未能获得党的广泛认可（很可能是因为邓小平没有积极推动该方案）。1987年10月中旬，赵立坚将《总体设计》提交中央委员会会议讨论时，许多委员表示保留意见或持有不同看法。因此，他担心可能遭遇挫折，决定不就该文件进行全会表决。全会公报并未“批准”该方案，而是指出中央委员会“讨论并原则上同意了‘总体设计’”。

The text of the Overall Design was never made public. Based on the recollections of one of the drafters, this document likely stated the guiding principles for political reform and established its objectives in general terms.51 After the Central Committee "agreed in principle" with the Overall Design in late October 1987, Zhao implemented several modest but substantive reforms. To promote inner-party democracy, he made the selection of members of the Central Committee at the Thirteenth Party Congress slightly more competitive. As a result, 185 candidates competed for the 175 slots on the committee. The archconservative Deng Liquun suffered a humiliating defeat when he was among the ten candidates who failed to get enough votes to serve. Competitive elections for provincial governors and the presidents of the provincial high courts and procuratorates were also introduced in some provinces, resulting in the defeat of a small number of CCP-nominated candidates.52

《总体设计》文本从未公开。根据一位起草者的回忆，这份文件很可能阐述了政治改革的指导原则，并概括地确立了改革目标。1987年10月下旬，中央委员会“原则上同意”《总体设计》后，赵立坚推行了几项虽不大但意义重大的改革。为了促进党内民主，他在十三大上略微提高了中央委员的选举竞争性。结果，185名候选人角逐175个中央委员席位。保守派的邓立群遭遇惨败，他是十名未能获得足够选票当选的候选人之一。一些省份也开始实行省长、省高级法院院长和省检察院院长的竞争性选举，导致少数中共提名的候选人落选。

In an attempt to institutionalize the decision-making process, the Politburo supported Zhao's proposal to regularize meetings of the party's Central Committee, Politburo, and the PSC (two plenums of the Central Committee per year; a monthly Politburo meeting; and a weekly PSC meeting). Additionally, again at Zhao's suggestion, the Politburo formalized the procedural rules for voting in the Politburo, the PSC, and the Central Secretariat, and it mandated that the decisions of each Central Committee plenum and every meeting of the Politburo be made public via the media. (Remarkably, the party still follows some of these rules established by Zhao.)53

为了使决策过程制度化，政治局支持赵立坚提出的将党的中央委员会、政治局和公共秘书处会议定期化的提议（中央委员会每年召开两次全会；政治局每月召开一次会议；公共秘书处每周召开一次会议）。此外，同样在赵立坚的建议下，政治局正式制定了政治局、公共秘书处和中央书记处的表决程序规则，并规定每次中央全会和每次政治局会议的决定都必须通过媒体公开。（值得注意的是，党至今仍在遵循赵立坚制定的一些规则。）

Unsurprisingly, the reform to "separate the party from the government" encountered strong opposition because it threatened both the power and the job security of a large number of apparatchiks. Nevertheless, local authorities began to carry out the leadership's guidelines on restructuring the party's role in government, such as reducing the number of party secretaries and full-time cadres and abolishing local party departments that were functionally redundant to their government counterparts. Zhao made only marginal progress in the central government. The party's "small groups" in finance, propaganda, foreign affairs, and political-legal work were kept intact, but they could no longer directly intervene or supervise the administrative tasks of the government. About half of the party groups in the State Council had been abolished by early 1989. Of all the measures to "separate the party from the government," the most important implemented by Zhao was abolition of the Central Political-Legal Committee, which oversaw law enforcement and the courts. To prevent this powerful body from interfering in the legal system, in 1988 Zhao downgraded it to a "small group." He also instituted an administrative leadership responsibility system by giving managers, presidents, and directors of state-owned enterprises (SOEs), universities, and public institutions sole administrative responsibilities, thus downsizing the role of the party chiefs.54

不出所料，“党政分离”改革遭遇了强烈反对，因为它威胁到了大量党员干部的权力和职位保障。尽管如此，地方政府还是开始执行中央关于调整党政角色的指示，例如减少党委书记和专职干部人数，以及撤销与中央政府职能重叠的地方党政部门。赵立坚在中央政府的改革进展甚微。党的财政、宣传、外交和政法等“小组”得以保留，但它们不再能够直接干预或监督政府的行政事务。到1989年初，国务院大约一半的党政小组已被撤销。在所有“党政分离”措施中，赵立坚实施的最重要的一项是撤销中央政法委员会，该委员会负责监督执法和法院运作。为了防止这个权力强大的机构干预司法系统，赵立坚在1988年将其降级为“小组”。他还建立了行政领导责任制，赋予国有企业、高校和公共机构的经理、总裁和董事单一的行政责任，从而削弱了党的领导作用。





Liberalization and Backlash





自由化与反弹


Between 1978 and the Tiananmen crackdown in June 1989, Chinese writers, artists, and intellectuals experienced freedom unprecedented in the post-1949 period, like their counterparts in the former Soviet bloc after the beginning of the "thaw" that followed Nikita Khrushchev's denunciation of Joseph Stalin in 1956. This wave of liberalization in the literary, artistic, and ideological spheres occurred mainly because of the spontaneous efforts of China's long-repressed writers, artists, and intellectuals to seek freedom of expression, expose unspeakable suffering and trauma of the Chinese people under the Maoist regime, and challenge orthodox Communist ideology. Importantly, liberal leaders, in particular Hu Yaobang, provided political protection and helped sustain liberalization despite constant conservative backlash.

从1978年到1989年6月天安门事件，中国作家、艺术家和知识分子经历了1949年以来前所未有的自由，如同前苏联集团国家在1956年赫鲁晓夫谴责斯大林后“解冻”时期所经历的那样。这场文学、艺术和思想领域的自由化浪潮，主要源于长期遭受压制的中国作家、艺术家和知识分子自发地争取言论自由，揭露毛泽东统治下中国人民难以言喻的苦难和创伤，并挑战正统的共产主义意识形态。尤其重要的是，自由派领导人，特别是胡耀邦，提供了政治保护，并在保守派的持续反扑下，帮助维持了自由化的进程。

The awakening of Chinese society in the post-Mao period began with the emergence and popularity of the so-called scar literature—short stories, novellas, plays, and films based on fictional characters who were victimized during the Maoist period. This genre gets its name because one of its classics is a short story titled "Scar" (Shanghen), published in 1978 in a major Shanghai newspaper. Its heroine was a young woman who, brainwashed by party propaganda, broke off relations with her mother, who was wrongfully persecuted by the party as a "traitor" and "spy." But doubt, guilt, and pain tormented the heroine, who was sent to the countryside like many of her contemporaries during the Cultural Revolution. She finally sought reconciliation with her mother, who was exonerated after the Cultural Revolution. But before she could get home, her mother suddenly died. "Scar" became an overnight best-seller and inspired an entirely new genre of works exploring the collective trauma of Chinese society.55

后毛泽东时代中国社会的觉醒始于所谓“伤痕文学”的兴起和流行——这类文学作品包括短篇小说、中篇小说、戏剧和电影，其主角是毛泽东时代遭受迫害的虚构人物。这一文学流派得名于其经典之作——1978年发表于上海一家主流报纸的短篇小说《伤痕》。小说的主人公是一位年轻女子，她被党的宣传洗脑，与被党错误地指控为“叛徒”和“间谍”的母亲断绝了关系。然而，怀疑、愧疚和痛苦折磨着这位女主人公，她像许多同龄人在文化大革命期间一样被下放到农村。最终，她试图与在文革后被平反的母亲和解，但还没来得及回家，母亲就突然去世了。《伤痕》一夜之间成为畅销书，并启发了一种全新的文学流派，探索中国社会的集体创伤。

The ostensibly philosophical debate over humanism and alienation under socialism in the early 1980s was another manifestation of the relative freedom of the period. Unlike the scar literature that sought to help a traumatized nation confront its darkest days, the discussion of humanism and alienation in socialist societies undermined the ideological legitimacy of Chinese communism. By emphasizing the humanism in Karl Marx's writings, participants in this debate—exclusively writers, journalists, and social scientists—attacked the brutal rule under Mao as an egregious deviation from Marxism. Even more important, the article launching this debate argued that alienation existed under socialism because the lack of democracy, economic mismanagement, and personality cult resulted in “alienation of power”—the abuse of the power by “the servants of the people.”56

20世纪80年代初，围绕社会主义下的人道主义与异化展开的看似哲学性的辩论，实则是当时相对自由的又一体现。与旨在帮助饱受创伤的国家直面其最黑暗时期的“伤痕文学”不同，这场关于社会主义社会中人道主义与异化的讨论，实际上动摇了中国共产主义的意识形态合法性。通过强调马克思著作中的人道主义思想，这场辩论的参与者——清一色是作家、记者和社会科学家——抨击毛泽东的残酷统治是对马克思主义的严重背离。更重要的是，引发这场辩论的文章认为，社会主义下存在异化，是因为缺乏民主、经济管理不善以及个人崇拜导致了“权力异化”——即“人民公仆”滥用权力。

Even after the fall of Hu Yaobang in January 1987, the space for Chinese writers and social scientists did not disappear. Between early 1985 and the Tiananmen crackdown in June 1989, a "culture fever" swept over China. During this period, Chinese intellectuals explored a diverse set of topics, such as existentialism, the modernization theory, and contrasts between Chinese and Western cultures. On the whole, the culture fever consisted of a self-critical exploration of the reasons behind China's economic backwardness and displayed an eagerness to learn from the West even though one topic that emerged during this period was "neo-authoritarianism," the theory of successful economic development under autocratic rule.57 The culture fever reached its peak with the airing of a six-part documentary, River Elegy (Heshang), in June 1988. Written by a leading liberal writer, this series critically examined the factors of China's failure to modernize and blamed its traditional inward-looking mindset. China Central Television (CCTV), the country's primary official media outlet, broadcast River Elegy, which became an instant success but also infuriated hard-liners because of its liberal tone and themes.58

即使在1987年1月胡耀邦下台之后，中国作家和社会科学家的空间也并未消失。从1985年初到1989年6月天安门事件，一股“文化热潮”席卷中国。在此期间，中国知识分子探讨了诸多议题，例如存在主义、现代化理论以及中西文化的对比。总体而言，这股文化热潮是对中国经济落后原因的自我批判式探究，并展现出向西方学习的渴望，尽管这一时期也出现了“新威权主义”——即在专制统治下实现经济成功的理论。这股文化热潮在1988年6月六集纪录片《河上挽歌》的播出后达到顶峰。该系列纪录片由一位著名的自由派作家撰写，批判性地审视了中国现代化失败的因素，并将矛头指向了其传统的内向型思维。中国中央电视台（CCTV）作为该国的主要官方媒体，播出了《江河挽歌》，该片一经播出便大获成功，但其自由主义的基调和主题也激怒了强硬派。

These literary, ideological, and artistic efforts in the 1980s had the most profound impact on Chinese intellectuals and university students. Some even called this movement "enlightenment" because, collectively, the ideas and values promoted by these works were generally humanistic, cosmopolitan, and liberal.59 In all likelihood, relative intellectual freedom in the 1980s allowed prodemocracy values to influence a generation of students to press for political openness and democracy, a struggle that would end in the tragic confrontation with the party in June 1989.60

20世纪80年代的这些文学、思想和艺术活动对中国知识分子和大学生产生了最为深远的影响。有些人甚至将这场运动称为“启蒙运动”，因为这些作品所宣扬的思想和价值观总体上是人文主义的、世界主义的和自由主义的。很可能，20世纪80年代相对的思想自由使得亲民主价值观影响了一代学生，促使他们争取政治开放和民主，而这场斗争最终以1989年6月与党的悲剧性对抗而告终。

Most accounts of the conservative backlash against liberalization in the 1980s focus on the role of two hard-liners in charge of the party's ideology and propaganda. One was Hu Qiaomu, a Politburo member (1982-1987) and Mao's former speech writer. The other was Deng Liqun (no relation to Deng Xiaoping), director of the CCP propaganda department between 1982 and 1987. On the surface, the backing by Chen Yun, their political patron, emboldened Hu Qiaomu and Deng Liqun to take the lead in attacking liberals, in particular Hu Yaobang.61 In reality, they shared nearly identical views with Deng Xiaoping on the party's imperative to contain the trends of liberalization in the 1980s. A review of the key episodes of conservative backlash against liberalization in this decade shows that Deng Xiaoping, in fact, played a more prominent and direct role in launching the counterattacks on liberalization. Hu Qiaomu and Deng Liqun often acted with Deng Xiaoping's instructions and endorsement.

大多数关于20世纪80年代保守派对自由化的反扑的论述都集中在两位负责党内意识形态和宣传的强硬派人物身上。一位是胡巧木，曾任政治局委员（1982-1987），也是毛泽东的演讲稿撰写人。另一位是邓力群（与邓小平无关），1982年至1987年担任中共中央宣传部部长。表面上看，在他们的政治靠山陈云的支持下，胡巧木和邓力群更加大胆地带头攻击自由派，尤其是胡耀邦。但实际上，在党必须遏制20世纪80年代自由化趋势的问题上，他们的观点与邓小平几乎完全一致。回顾这十年保守派对自由化的反扑关键事件，可以发现邓小平实际上在发起反攻自由化运动中扮演了更为突出和直接的角色。胡巧木和邓立群的行动往往是在邓小平的指示和支持下进行的。

Deng Xiaoping demonstrated his staunch opposition to liberalization as soon as he gained political dominance at the end of 1978. When the Democracy Wall, the first major mass prodemocracy movement in the post-Mao era, emerged in Beijing in late 1978, he expressed some support, apparently because this movement could weaken Hua Guofeng, then the party leader. But Deng revealed his true stance on democracy after he dethroned Hua in December 1978. In March 1979 he not only shut down the Democracy Wall and sentenced its most prominent leader, Wei Jingsheng, to fifteen years in jail, but also announced his "four cardinal principles" reaffirming that the party's monopoly and its official ideology must not be challenged.62

邓小平在1978年底掌握政治权力后，立即展现出对自由化的坚定反对。1978年底，后毛泽东时代第一次大规模群众民主运动“民主墙”在北京兴起，邓小平当时表示支持，显然是因为这场运动可能会削弱时任党主席华国锋的权力。但邓小平在1978年12月罢黜华国锋后，才真正暴露了他对民主的真实立场。1979年3月，他不仅取缔了“民主墙”，判处其主要领导人魏京生15年有期徒刑，还宣布了“四项基本原则”，重申党的垄断及其官方意识形态不容挑战。

As the trends of liberalization gathered pace in the 1980s, Deng either took the lead or backed the hard-liners in trying to suppressing them. Apparently alarmed by signs of liberalization at the end of 1980, he delivered a tough talk at a conference attended by all senior leaders. He lamented that the party had not put up a vigorous effort to "struggle against erroneous ideas that opposed the four cardinal principles." After warning against these trends, Deng emphasized the need to reaffirm the accomplishments and positive aspects of the Maoist era.63 A month after Deng's speech, the party issued a document demanding stricter control of the media. Some of the words of the document were verbatim quotations from Deng's speech.64

20世纪80年代，随着自由化趋势的加速发展，邓小平要么带头，要么支持强硬派试图压制这些趋势。显然，他对1980年底出现的自由化迹象感到担忧，在一次所有高级领导人出席的会议上发表了措辞强硬的讲话。他感叹党没有大力“反对与四大基本原则相悖的错误思想”。在警告这些趋势之后，邓小平强调需要重申毛泽东时代的成就和积极方面。邓小平讲话一个月后，党发布了一份文件，要求加强对媒体的控制。该文件中的一些措辞直接引用了邓小平的讲话。

In some instances, Deng would personally intervene to fight "bourgeois liberalization." The censorship of the movie The Sun and the Man [Taiyang yuren] in 1981 was one such example. This movie was based on a script, Unrequited Love [Kulian], published in September 1979. Its hero is an accomplished artist who returned to China from the West in 1950, only to suffer incessant political persecution during the Maoist period. He later froze to death in the wilderness while on the run. When Unrequited Love was turned into a movie in 1980, it enraged the hard-liners, including Deng Xiaoping. After watching the movie during its prescreening, Deng declared that "the movie smeared the socialist system.... Someone said its artistic achievement was high. But precisely because of this, its poisonous harm is all the greater.... Could you imagine the consequences if 'The Sun and the Man' were to be shown in public?"65 Fortunately, resistance from the liberals prevented a full-scale crackdown on the intelligentsia in the wake of this incident.66

在某些情况下，邓小平会亲自干预以对抗“资产阶级自由化”。1981年电影《太阳与人》的审查就是一个例子。这部电影改编自1979年9月发表的剧本《单恋》。故事的主人公是一位才华横溢的艺术家，1950年从西方回到中国，却在毛泽东时代遭受了持续不断的政治迫害。后来，他在逃亡途中冻死在荒野。1980年，《单恋》被改编成电影，激怒了包括邓小平在内的强硬派。邓小平在观看影片的预映后宣称：“这部电影抹黑了社会主义制度……有人说它的艺术成就很高。但正因为如此，它的毒害才更大……你们能想象《太阳与人》如果公映会造成什么后果吗？”65 所幸，自由派人士的抵制阻止了此次事件后对知识分子的全面镇压。66

Deng Xiaoping's intervention during the debate on alienation would eventually result in the party's "anti-spiritual pollution" campaign in 1983, the first nationwide crackdown on liberalization in the post-Mao era. After liberal intellectuals launched the debate on alienation under socialism, the hard-liners, led by Hu Qiaomu and Deng Liquun, tried to suppress the debate and punish the proponents of "alienation under socialism." After Hu Yaobang thwarted their attempts, the two hard-liners went directly to Deng Xiaoping and apparently obtained his support to punish the liberals who started this debate in September 1983.67

邓小平在关于异化的辩论中的介入，最终导致了1983年党的“反精神污染”运动，这是后毛泽东时代第一次全国性的反自由化运动。在自由派知识分子发起关于社会主义异化的辩论后，以胡巧木和邓力群为首的强硬派试图压制这场辩论，并惩罚“社会主义异化”的倡导者。在胡耀邦挫败他们的企图后，这两位强硬派直接去找邓小平，显然得到了他的支持，从而惩罚了在1983年9月发起这场辩论的自由派人士。

The most important fallout from the controversy over "alienation under socialism" was the anti-spiritual pollution campaign. Backing the stance of the hard-liners on the debate in September 1983, Deng Xiaoping said "we must not do (bugao) spiritual pollution." At a Central Committee plenum on October 12, 1983, he reiterated his resolve, declaring that "spiritual pollution must not be allowed on the ideological front."68 Deng's public stance instantly changed the political dynamics. The party's propaganda machine went into overdrive and launched a nationwide campaign against spiritual pollution. Although the conservatives initially targeted the liberal intelligentsia, they quickly expanded the scope of the campaign to crack down on pop culture, entertainment, and people's lifestyles, thus fanning fears of another Cultural Revolution.69 Aware of the consequences of the conservative counterattack, Hu Yaobang and Zhao Ziyang formed a united front to put the brakes on the campaign. After realizing the harmful effects of the campaign on his economic reform drive, Deng reversed course. As a result, the campaign died a quiet death within a month.70

“社会主义异化”争议最重要的后果是反精神污染运动。1983年9月，邓小平支持强硬派在辩论中的立场，指出“我们绝不能搞精神污染”。1983年10月12日，在中央全会上，他重申了这一决心，宣布“思想战线上绝不能搞精神污染”。邓小平的公开表态立即改变了政治格局。党的宣传机器火力全开，在全国范围内发起了一场反精神污染运动。尽管保守派最初的目标是自由派知识分子，但他们很快扩大了运动范围，开始打压流行文化、娱乐和人们的生活方式，从而加剧了人们对再次发生文化大革命的恐惧。意识到保守派反击的后果，胡耀邦和赵紫阳结成统一战线，试图阻止这场运动。邓小平在意识到这场运动对其经济改革的负面影响后，改变了策略。结果，这场运动在一个月内悄然消亡。





The Road to Tiananmen





通往天安门之路


For the first half of the 1980s, Deng appeared to be successful in playing a role as the pivotal player. Economically, his alliance with the liberals achieved critical breakthroughs in the decollectivization of agriculture, liberalization of the economy, and opening to the West. Although he also aligned with the hardliners during this period in suppressing liberalizing trends, he would quickly reverse course once he realized that political retrogression would threaten economic reform, as shown in the short-lived campaign against spiritual pollution in 1983. Politically, he succeeded in containing the liberals with periodic crackdowns on prominent members of the intelligentsia and the causes they advocated without fatally undermining his alliance with them.

在20世纪80年代上半叶，邓小平似乎成功地扮演了关键人物的角色。在经济方面，他与自由派的联盟在农业非集体化、经济自由化和对外开放等方面取得了重大突破。尽管在此期间，他也曾与强硬派结盟，压制自由化趋势，但一旦意识到政治倒退会威胁经济改革，他便迅速改变策略，正如1983年短暂的“精神污染”运动所表明的那样。在政治方面，他通过定期打压知识分子及其所倡导的事业，成功地遏制了自由派，同时又没有彻底破坏与他们的联盟。

But starting in 1986 Deng began to find it increasingly difficult to perform this balancing act. As economic reforms in the urban areas turned out to be much tougher than those in the rural areas, Deng began to toy with the idea of endorsing limited political reforms to increase efficiency, but without introducing democracy or undermining the party's monopoly. His dalliance with political reforms occurred at a time when the intelligentsia and university students were growing more vocal in agitating for political liberalization. The result was that Deng's rhetoric on political reform unintentionally encouraged university students to take to the streets in several Chinese cities in late 1986 to demand democratic changes, thus triggering the first of the two major political crises facing Deng in the post-Mao era.

但从1986年开始，邓小平发现越来越难以维持这种平衡。由于城市地区的经济改革远比农村地区艰难，邓小平开始考虑在不引入民主或削弱党的垄断地位的前提下，推行有限的政治改革以提高效率。他涉足政治改革之际，知识分子和大学生正日益高涨地呼吁政治自由化。结果，邓小平关于政治改革的言论无意中刺激了大学生在1986年底走上中国多个城市的街头，要求民主变革，从而引发了后毛泽东时代邓小平面临的两大政治危机中的第一次。

But the greatest mistake Deng made, and the one that fatally weakened his effectiveness as the pivotal player, was his decision to sack Hu Yaobang, who consistently resisted pressure from him to crack down on "bourgeois liberalization" in the early 1980s. When Deng removed Hu as party chief following the outbreak of the prodemocracy demonstrations in late 1986, he lost a capable ally. Even though Deng managed to appoint Zhao Ziyang, who was at that time a liberal economic reformer, the fall of Hu Yaobang shifted the balance of power decisively in favor of the conservatives.

但邓小平犯下的最大错误，也是致命地削弱了他作为核心人物效力的罪魁祸首，是他决定罢免胡耀邦。胡耀邦在20世纪80年代初一直抵制邓小平镇压“资产阶级自由化”的压力。1986年底民主运动爆发后，邓小平解除了胡耀邦的党总书记职务，失去了一位得力的盟友。尽管邓小平后来任命了当时的自由派经济改革家赵紫阳接任，但胡耀邦的下台彻底改变了权力平衡，使保守派占据了上风。

The resultant unfavorable balance of power was likely the cause of the growing resistance Deng faced between 1987 and 1988 to his efforts to accelerate reforms in the urban areas and to open China's doors even wider to the West. Even though agricultural decollectivization and liberalization unleashed private entrepreneurs and gave birth to the "township and village enterprises" (TVEs), private firms disguised as collective firms, Deng could claim no progress in restructuring the unprofitable state-owned enterprises.71 An ambitious but ill-timed effort to ram through price reforms in the summer of 1988 led to panic buying and run-away inflation, forcing Deng to retreat and leading to a weakening of Zhao's position.72 Starting in the second half of the 1980s, the pace of opening up to the West also slowed down. Establishment of the Hainan Administrative District, with its expanded foreign trade authority, resulted in a smuggling scandal that the conservatives exploited to block Deng from creating a much larger SEZ.73 In terms of economic reforms, Deng had little to show between 1987 and the outbreak of the Tiananmen protests in April 1989.

由此产生的不利权力平衡很可能是邓小平在1987年至1988年间，在加快城市改革和进一步扩大对外开放方面遭遇日益增长的阻力的原因。尽管农业非集体化和自由化释放了私人企业家，催生了“乡镇企业”（伪装成集体企业的私人企业），但邓小平在重组无利可图的国有企业方面却毫无进展。1988年夏季，一项雄心勃勃但时机不当的价格改革举措引发了恐慌性抢购和恶性通货膨胀，迫使邓小平退让，并导致赵立坚的地位削弱。从20世纪80年代后半期开始，对外开放的步伐也放缓了。海南行政区的设立及其扩大的对外贸易权限导致了一起走私丑闻，保守派利用这起丑闻阻止邓小平建立规模更大的经济特区。在经济改革方面，从1987年到1989年4月天安门事件爆发，邓小平几乎没有取得任何成就。





The Fall of Hu Yaobang and the Anti-Bourgeois Liberalization Campaign





胡耀邦的垮台与反资产阶级自由化运动


The surprise dismissal of Hu Yaobang as CCP general secretary in January 1987 marked a political turning point in Chinese politics in the post-Mao era.74 This event not only signaled Deng's resolve to defend the party's monopoly on power even at the cost of sacrificing a longtime ally but also foreshadowed his purge of Zhao Ziyang, another trusted supporter, nearly two and half years later. The fall of Hu Yaobang decisively strengthened the hard-liners and weakened both Deng and the liberals. The immediate political consequences of Hu's downfall consisted of a short-lived crackdown on "bourgeois liberalization" and the stalling of the economic reforms.

1987年1月，胡耀邦被意外免去中共中央总书记职务，这标志着后毛泽东时代中国政治的一个转折点。这一事件不仅表明邓小平决心捍卫党的权力垄断，即使这意味着牺牲一位长期盟友也在所不惜，而且也预示着近两年半后，他将清洗另一位亲信赵紫阳。胡耀邦的下台极大地增强了强硬派的力量，削弱了邓小平及其自由派的势力。胡耀邦下台的直接政治后果是对“资产阶级自由化”的短暂镇压以及经济改革的停滞。

Given Hu's liberal political views, it may be difficult to understand why Deng, a staunch Leninist despite his pragmatist streaks, picked him for the position of CCP general secretary. One obvious explanation is their close personal relationship. After Deng returned to power in 1973, he appointed Hu to lead the Chinese Academy of Sciences. During Mao's campaign against Deng in late 1975, Hu refused to denounce Deng, thus proving his loyalty. Hu's contributions were also considerable during Deng's power play against Hua Guofeng in 1978, in particular his instrumental role in leading the debate on the criterion of truth and in rehabilitating many senior leaders whom Mao had persecuted during the Cultural Revolution.75

鉴于胡锦涛的自由派政治观点，人们或许难以理解，尽管邓小平本人也具有务实的一面，但他却是一位坚定的列宁主义者，为何会选择胡锦涛担任中共中央总书记。一个显而易见的解释是他们之间密切的私人关系。1973年邓小平重返政坛后，任命胡锦涛为中国科学院院长。1975年末毛泽东对邓小平发起攻势期间，胡锦涛拒绝谴责邓小平，以此证明了他对邓小平的忠诚。1978年邓小平与华国锋的权力斗争中，胡锦涛也发挥了重要作用，尤其是在领导关于真理标准的辩论以及平反许多在文化大革命期间被毛泽东迫害的高级领导人方面，他做出了关键贡献。

Despite their personal friendship and Hu's proven leadership abilities, the relationship between Deng and Hu began to fray over the issue of "bourgeois liberalization." Unlike Deng, who sought to restore CCP legitimacy through economic reforms, Hu envisioned reform as a more comprehensive process that entailed a high degree of democracy.76 During his tenure, he was credited with a dramatic relaxation of the party's harsh policy toward ethnic minorities, and, in the case of Tibet, he almost single-handedly pushed through a policy that resulted in the withdrawal of many Han Chinese officials and improvements in the living conditions of Tibetans.77 On foreign policy, Hu advocated improving ties with Japan. But as a politician in the CCP's Hobbesian world, Hu's integrity, tolerance, and openness that endeared him to the liberal intelligentsia turned out to be fatal political liabilities. After he was forced to resign, Hu painfully admitted his naivete. "[I did] not know how duplicitous people could be," he told another senior liberal official. "I realized my folly only when I was dismissed at the beginning of 1987."78

尽管邓小平与胡锦涛私交甚笃，且胡锦涛的领导才能也已得到证实，但两人关系却因“资产阶级自由化”问题而开始出现裂痕。与邓小平寻求通过经济改革恢复中共合法性不同，胡锦涛设想的改革是一个更为全面的过程，其中包含高度民主。在他任职期间，胡锦涛因大幅放松党对少数民族的严苛政策而备受赞誉，尤其是在西藏问题上，他几乎凭借一己之力推动了一项政策，该政策导致许多汉族官员撤离西藏，并改善了藏人的生活条件。在外交政策方面，胡锦涛主张改善与日本的关系。然而，作为中共“霍布斯式世界”中的一名政治家，胡锦涛的正直、宽容和开放的性格虽然赢得了自由派知识分子的喜爱，却最终成为致命的政治包袱。被迫辞职后，胡锦涛痛苦地承认了自己的天真。 “我当时不知道人可以如此虚伪，”他告诉另一位自由派高级官员。“直到1987年初被解职，我才意识到自己的愚蠢。”

According to Zhao Ziyang, Deng's erosion of trust in Hu grew gradually in the 1980s because Deng thought Hu was too weak to deal with the emerging liberalizing trends. Zhao believed that Deng and Hu held "genuinely different views" on "bourgeois liberalization," and the breakdown of their relationship was "unavoidable."79 As early as July 1981, Deng revealed his dissatisfaction with Hu's resistance to cracking down on the liberal intelligentsia with his criticism that party work on the "theoretical front," an area for which Hu was responsible, was "lax and weak." Their rift widened further even before Deng launched the anti-spiritual pollution campaign in October 1983. Deng blamed Hu for tolerating the growing liberalizing trends among the intelligentsia.80 Although Deng reluctantly called off the anti-spiritual pollution campaign at the end of 1983, Zhao believed that Hu's apparent resistance to the campaign "aggravated the conflict between them a great deal."81 Based on Zhao's observation, Deng had made up his mind to remove Hu in 1986, if not earlier. In the summer of 1986, he privately told a group of veteran revolutionaries that he had made a big mistake in selecting Hu Yaobang and that Hu would not continue to serve as party chief when the Thirteenth Party Congress was convened in 1987. In other words, Hu's political fate had already been sealed several months before his formal ouster.82

据赵紫阳所述，邓小平对胡锦涛的信任在20世纪80年代逐渐瓦解，因为邓小平认为胡锦涛无力应对新兴的自由化趋势。赵紫阳认为，邓小平和胡锦涛在“资产阶级自由化”问题上持有“截然不同的观点”，两人关系的破裂“不可避免”。早在1981年7月，邓小平就对胡锦涛不愿镇压自由派知识分子表示不满，批评党在“理论战线”（胡锦涛负责的领域）的工作“松懈无力”。早在邓小平1983年10月发起“反精神污染”运动之前，他和胡耀邦的裂痕就已经进一步加深。邓小平指责胡耀邦容忍知识分子日益增长的自由化倾向。尽管邓小平在1983年底不情愿地叫停了“反精神污染”运动，但赵认为，胡耀邦对这场运动的明显抵制“大大加剧了他们之间的冲突”。根据赵的观察，邓小平早在1986年，甚至更早，就已下定决心要除掉胡耀邦。1986年夏天，他私下告诉一群老革命者，他选择胡耀邦是个大错，胡耀邦不会在1987年召开的中共十三大上继续担任党的总书记。换句话说，胡耀邦的政治命运早在正式被罢免几个月前就已经注定了。

Although Deng made his own decision to dismiss Hu without manipulation or pressure by the conservatives, his action could only have delighted the hard-liners who had been seeking Hu Yaobang's removal.83 Deng launched a nationwide "anti-bourgeois liberalization" campaign after Hu's dismissal in January 1987, creating another golden opportunity for the conservatives to roll back economic reforms. Even though Deng wanted to limit the backlash against liberalism to the ideological sphere, the conservatives tried to expand the crackdown to culture, education, science, and the lifestyles of ordinary people. The crackdown had an immediate chilling effect on economic reform. The experiment to empower managers of SOEs ground to a halt, and foreign direct investment plummeted in the first half of 1987.84

尽管邓小平在没有受到保守派操纵或施压的情况下，自主决定解除胡耀邦的职务，但他的举动无疑令那些一直寻求胡耀邦下台的强硬派欣喜不已。1987年1月胡耀邦被解职后，邓小平随即在全国范围内发起了一场“反资产阶级自由化”运动，这为保守派提供了又一次阻碍经济改革的绝佳机会。尽管邓小平希望将反自由主义的浪潮限制在意识形态领域，但保守派却试图将镇压范围扩大到文化、教育、科学以及普通民众的生活方式。这场镇压立即对经济改革产生了寒蝉效应。赋予国有企业管理者更多权力的实验陷入停滞，1987年上半年外国直接投资大幅下降。

To counter the conservative backlash and salvage economic reform, Zhao not only declared to senior officials in January 1987 that the party would not change its policy on comprehensive reform and opening but also warned against "leftist" excesses and another witch hunt.85 Privately, he lobbied Deng in late April, warning him that "some people are trying to use the anti-bourgeois liberalization campaign to undermine reform and opening." An alarmed Deng immediately gave his personal support to Zhao's proposal to deliver a major speech that would constitute a counterattack against the conservatives. Shortly thereafter Zhao delivered his famous "May 13 speech" at a conference for high-level officials that effectively ended the anti-bourgeois liberalization campaign.86

为了应对保守派的反扑，挽救经济改革，赵立坚不仅在1987年1月向高级官员宣布党不会改变全面改革开放的方针，还警告不要出现“左倾”极端行为和再次进行政治迫害。85 私下里，他在4月下旬游说邓小平，警告他“有人企图利用反资产阶级自由化运动破坏改革开放”。邓小平对此感到震惊，立即亲自支持赵立坚的提议，发表重要讲话，对保守派进行反击。不久之后，赵立坚在一次高级官员会议上发表了著名的“五一三报告”，有效地结束了反资产阶级自由化运动。86

The fall of Hu Yaobang in January 1987 dealt the liberals a near-fatal blow. They lost a powerful advocate for liberalization, and, more important, Hu's departure greatly strengthened the hard-liners. Because there were no suitable candidates to take over the position of party chief, Deng appointed Zhao to replace Hu, a move that entailed the promotion of Li Peng to the position of premier of the State Council and Yao Yilin to executive vice premier. Now wielding enormous influence over the economy, the two hard-liners were also elevated to the PSC at the party's Thirteenth Party Congress in fall of that year.

1987年1月胡耀邦的下台对自由派造成了近乎致命的打击。他们失去了一位强有力的自由化倡导者，更重要的是，胡耀邦的离任极大地增强了强硬派的力量。由于没有合适的人选接任党总书记一职，邓小平任命赵立坚接替胡耀邦，此举意味着李鹏升任国务院总理，姚益林升任国务院常务副总理。如今，这两位强硬派人士对经济拥有了巨大的影响力，并在同年秋季召开的党的十三大上被提拔为国家政治保卫委员会委员。

The emboldened conservatives soon set their sights on Zhao because he had used Deng's support to thwart the conservative counterattack against reform. Zhao further enraged the hard-liners by abolishing the Central Secretariat's Research Office, controlled by the hard-liner Deng Liquin, depriving him of the institutional base that had served as his platform for organizing ideological campaigns against reform. The relationship between the dwindling liberal forces represented by Zhao and the conservatives became so tense that, when Zhao was delivering his keynote speech at the Thirteenth Party Congress in October 1987, Chen Yun, the arch conservative and patron of Deng Liquin, stood up and left the stage, in a very public and calculated display of disapproval.87

胆子越来越大的保守派很快将矛头指向赵立坚，因为他曾利用邓立坚的支持挫败保守派对改革的反击。赵立坚解散了由强硬派邓立坚控制的中央书记处研究办公室，进一步激怒了强硬派，使邓立坚失去了组织反对改革意识形态运动的制度基础。赵立坚所代表的日渐式微的自由派力量与保守派之间的关系变得异常紧张。1987年10月，赵立坚在中共十三大上发表主旨演讲时，邓立坚的支持者、保守派领袖陈云起身离席，公开表达了他对赵立坚的不满。

But the fall of Hu Yaobang also weakened Deng politically because he could be a pivotal player only if the liberal wing in the party on which he had to rely to push through his economic agenda remained strong. Now Deng had a weaker ally to help him counter the conservatives. Between January 1987 and the outbreak of the Tiananmen prodemocracy movement in April 1989, Deng was unable to advance any ambitious economic reforms. The strategy of focusing on developing an export-oriented economy on China's coast, which Zhao proposed, did not become actual policy despite Deng's backing. The price reform Deng tried to rush through in the late summer of 1988 only succeeded in triggering an inflation crisis, which undercut Zhao's authority and enabled the conservatives to mount a retrenchment campaign to roll back the economic reforms.

但胡耀邦的倒台也削弱了邓小平的政治影响力，因为只有党内自由派保持强大，邓小平才能继续发挥关键作用，而自由派正是他推行经济政策的支柱。如今，邓小平的盟友实力下降，难以对抗保守派。从1987年1月到1989年4月天安门民主运动爆发，邓小平未能推进任何雄心勃勃的经济改革。赵立坚提出的以沿海地区为中心发展出口导向型经济的战略，尽管得到了邓小平的支持，最终也未能成为实际政策。1988年夏末，邓小平试图仓促推行的价格改革，结果却引发了通货膨胀危机，削弱了赵立坚的权威，也让保守派得以发起反攻，试图推翻经济改革。





The Tiananmen Crisis and the Fall of Zhao Ziyang





天安门事件与赵紫阳的陨落


Before the fall of Hu Yaobang in January 1987, Zhao was not the primary target of the conservatives, who saw Hu, party general secretary responsible for day-to-day party affairs, as a much greater threat than Zhao. Zhao avoided direct attacks by the conservatives also because he seldom spoke out on sensitive ideological issues, and his effective implementation of reformist policies had earned Deng's strong support. However, after Deng replaced Hu with Zhao as party chief in January 1987, it did not take long for the conservatives to start trying to topple him. The campaign against Zhao gathered momentum in the summer of 1988 when a poorly timed proposal by Deng to implement price reform triggered a spike in inflation. Although Zhao had not proposed the idea, he took responsibility to avoid placing the blame on Deng.88 The conservatives in charge of the State Council, Li Peng and Yao Yilin, seized this opportunity to sideline Zhao in economic policymaking. A group of retired leaders reportedly wrote a joint letter to Deng calling for Zhao's dismissal. However, Deng stood by Zhao, telling him that he wanted him to serve a second term as the party chief and even offering him the position of chairman of the CMC at one point.89 Although Deng's support helped Zhao retain his job, his position had become increasingly untenable by early 1989.

在胡耀邦于1987年1月下台之前，赵立坚并非保守派的主要目标。保守派认为，负责党内日常事务的胡耀邦总书记比赵立坚更具威胁性。赵立坚之所以没有受到保守派的直接攻击，部分原因在于他很少在敏感的意识形态问题上发表意见，而且他有效推行改革政策赢得了邓小平的强力支持。然而，1987年1月邓小平用赵立坚取代胡耀邦担任党的总书记后不久，保守派就开始试图扳倒赵立坚。1988年夏天，邓小平提出的一项不合时宜的价格改革方案引发了通货膨胀飙升，这场针对赵立坚的攻势也随之愈演愈烈。尽管赵立坚并非该方案的提出者，但他为了避免将责任推卸给邓小平而承担了责任。国务院的保守派领导人李鹏和姚一林抓住这一机会，在经济政策制定中边缘化赵立坚。据报道，一群退休领导人联名致信邓小平，要求解除赵的职务。然而，邓小平力挺赵，表示希望他连任党总书记，甚至一度提出让他担任中央军委主席。尽管邓小平的支持帮助赵保住了职位，但到1989年初，他的处境已变得越来越岌岌可危。

After college students in Beijing went to Tiananmen Square to mourn the death of Hu Yaobang on April 15, 1989, the conservatives finally got their opportunity. By pure coincidence, Zhao Ziyang was scheduled to leave Beijing for an official visit to North Korea on April 24. Before Zhao left Beijing, however, he went to see Deng and obtained support for his proposal to take moderate measures to deal with the demonstrations. But immediately after Zhao left Beijing, the conservatives called a PSC meeting to discuss the situation in Beijing, even though the student-led demonstrations had all but died down by then. In Zhao's absence, the conservatives could turn Deng, a hard-line authoritarian, into an ally. Indeed, on April 25 Li Peng went to Deng's house to report on the discussions during the PSC meeting the previous night. Deng's reaction was predictable: He immediately declared that the events in the square were "not an ordinary student movement but a turmoil," and he called for a speedy and tough reaction, which completely contradicted his prior support for Zhao's proposed moderate approach.

1989年4月15日，北京大学生前往天安门广场悼念胡耀邦逝世后，保守派终于迎来了机会。巧合的是，赵紫阳原定于4月24日离开北京前往朝鲜进行正式访问。然而，在离开北京之前，赵紫阳拜访了邓小平，并获得了邓小平对其温和应对示威活动的提议的支持。但赵紫阳离开北京后，保守派立即召开了国家政治事务委员会（简称“政治局”）会议，讨论北京局势，尽管当时学生领导的示威活动几乎已经平息。趁着赵紫阳不在，保守派有机会将强硬派领导人邓小平拉拢为盟友。事实上，4月25日，李鹏前往邓小平的住所，汇报了前一天晚上政治局会议的讨论情况。邓小平的反应在意料之中：他立即宣称广场上的事件“不是普通的学生运动，而是一场骚乱”，并呼吁迅速采取强硬措施予以应对，这与他之前支持赵立坚提出的温和路线完全矛盾。

Even though Deng's speech was not supposed to be publicized, Li Peng circulated it among senior party officials and then turned it into the infamous People's Daily editorial published on April 26, apparently without consulting Deng. Publication of this editorial, which was known to reflect Deng's hard-line stance, instantly fueled anger among the students and turned them against Deng. The next day, hundreds of thousands of students again took to the streets of Beijing, calling on the party to retract the editorial, an impossible demand because that would be a public humiliation for Deng. After Zhao's return from North Korea on April 30, he tried in vain to de-escalate the confrontation. By that time, however, Deng was no longer open to suggestions for a moderate solution. He refused to grant Zhao an audience, an indication of his loss of confidence in Zhao.

尽管邓小平的讲话原本不打算公开，但李鹏却将其传阅给党内高层，并最终将其改编成臭名昭著的《人民日报》社论，于4月26日发表，显然并未事先征求邓小平的意见。这篇社论反映了邓小平的强硬立场，其发表立即激起了学生的愤怒，使他们转而反对邓小平。第二天，数十万学生再次走上北京街头，要求党撤回社论，但这几乎是不可能实现的，因为这将是对邓小平的公开羞辱。4月30日赵立坚从朝鲜返回后，他试图缓和局势，但徒劳无功。此时，邓小平已不再愿意接受任何温和的解决方案。他拒绝接见赵立坚，这表明他对赵立坚失去了信心。

The final break between Deng and Zhao occurred on May 16, when Zhao disclosed at a meeting with visiting Soviet leader Mikhail Gorbachev that Deng remained the party's ultimate decision-maker. According to Zhao, he had made similar statements earlier to other Communist leaders, and, in this particular case, his intent was to affirm Deng's authority and prestige, not to undermine him. However, Deng apparently thought Zhao was trying to shift the blame to him, thus further enraging him, as Zhao later wrote. Deng must have viewed Zhao's action as treachery. The next day, May 17, Deng decided to impose martial law and fired Zhao.90 On June 4, more than two weeks later, PLA tanks rolled into Beijing and crushed the Tiananmen prodemocracy movement, killing at least hundreds of students and ordinary citizens in both the capital and the provinces.91

邓小平与赵立坚的最终决裂发生在5月16日。当天，赵立坚在会见来访的苏联领导人戈尔巴乔夫时透露，邓小平仍然是党的最终决策者。据赵立坚称，他此前也曾对其他共产党领导人发表过类似的言论，而这一次，他的目的是为了维护邓小平的权威和威望，而非削弱他的地位。然而，邓小平显然认为赵立坚试图将责任推卸给他，这更加激怒了他，正如赵立坚后来所写的那样。邓小平必定将赵立坚的行为视为背叛。第二天，即5月17日，邓小平决定实施戒严，并解除了赵立坚的职务。两周多后的6月4日，解放军坦克开进北京，镇压了天安门民主运动，造成首都及周边地区至少数百名学生和普通民众丧生。

In retrospect, the Tiananmen massacre and the fall of Zhao, a turning point in post-Mao history, appear to have been entirely avoidable. Obviously, had Zhao postponed or canceled his scheduled visit to North Korea, the conservatives could not have outmaneuvered him and turned Deng into their ally. Gorbachev's untimely visit to Beijing was another factor. The student movement had lost momentum by early May, but Gorbachev's scheduled visit on May 15-16 gave the sagging movement a second wind, as students took advantage of the international media spotlight to stage a mass hunger strike on Tiananmen Square to pressure Deng.

事后看来，天安门事件和赵立坚的下台——后毛泽东时代历史的转折点——似乎完全可以避免。显然，如果赵立坚推迟或取消原定的访朝行程，保守派就无法智胜他，也无法将邓小平拉拢到自己阵营。戈尔巴乔夫不合时宜的访华也是一个重要因素。学生运动在五月初已略显疲软，但戈尔巴乔夫5月15日至16日的访华却为这场低迷的运动注入了新的活力。学生们利用国际媒体的关注，在天安门广场举行了大规模绝食抗议，向邓小平施压。

Historical contingencies, in this case, may not have played as critical a role as one might have wished. Today, one can make the case that by early 1989 Deng's reform and opening was in deep trouble, largely due to Deng's own mistakes. His hostility to democracy and liberalism led him to sack Hu Yaobang, fatally weakening the liberal wing that he had to rely on to prevail against the hard-liners. Although he managed to replace Hu with another reformer, Zhao Ziyang, the emboldened and strengthened conservatives took over the State Council and wasted no time in waging a campaign to topple Zhao. They succeeded all too soon, again thanks to help from Deng Xiaoping.

在这种情况下，历史偶然因素或许并未发挥人们所期望的那般关键作用。如今，我们可以说，到1989年初，邓小平的改革开放已陷入困境，这很大程度上是由于他自身的失误。他对民主和自由主义的敌视导致他罢免了胡耀邦，这严重削弱了他赖以对抗强硬派的自由派力量。尽管他设法用另一位改革派人士赵紫阳取代了胡耀邦，但胆子更大、势力更强的保守派掌控了国务院，并迅速发动了一场推翻赵紫阳的运动。他们很快就得逞了，而这再次要归功于邓小平的帮助。





Reflections





反思


The reforms undertaken by the party in the 1980s constituted a comprehensive political institutionalization effort aimed mainly at stabilizing a regime ravaged by the radicalism and brutality of the Cultural Revolution. On the whole, the party's reforms to reinstitute collective leadership, improve elite security, and establish rules on term and age limits marked an important step in the transition away from totalitarianism. Additional reforms, such as building a legal system and relaxing social control, helped create a more friendly business environment and greater space for personal freedom. However, these restorative reforms had serious limitations. The self-interests of the top leaders, especially Deng himself, diluted the application and effectiveness of the reforms. In practice, as these top leaders were exempt from the rules, the reforms failed to constrain them from violating the very rules and norms they were trying to enshrine. Most critically, the reforms were not backed by effective mechanisms of enforcement. This might not have been a problem when there was a rough balance of power among competing factions, as was the case in the 1980s and in the post-Tiananmen period (1992-2012). But when this balance of power broke down and a strongman re-emerged, the institutional reforms Deng had put in place crumbled quickly.

20世纪80年代，党推行的改革是一项全面的政治制度化努力，其主要目的是稳定一个饱受文化大革命的激进主义和残酷暴行摧残的政权。总体而言，党的改革，包括重建集体领导、加强精英安全保障以及制定任期和年龄限制等，标志着党从极权主义过渡的重要一步。其他改革，例如建立法律体系和放松社会管制，有助于营造更加友好的营商环境和更大的个人自由空间。然而，这些恢复性改革存在严重的局限性。最高领导人，特别是邓小平本人的私利削弱了改革的实施和成效。实际上，由于这些最高领导人不受规则约束，改革未能约束他们违反自己试图维护的规则和规范。最关键的是，这些改革缺乏有效的执行机制。如果各派势力之间大致势均力敌，这或许不是问题，就像上世纪80年代和后天安门时期（1992-2012年）那样。但当这种权力平衡被打破，强人再次出现时，邓小平推行的制度改革也迅速瓦解。

A feasible solution is to establish genuine institutional constraints within the regime, such as by introducing inner-party democracy, reducing the power of the Leninist party-state, and creating more political space for other autonomous social forces. Indeed, the political reform blueprint Zhao and his advisers conceived in 1986-1987 was intended to accomplish these objectives. In this sense, Zhao's attempted institutional reforms were transformative, not restorative. They were far more radical than the relatively modest steps Deng had taken earlier in the decade to repair the damage inflicted on the party by Mao. If Deng's reforms were designed to preserve the core features of Leninism and make party rule more stable and durable, Zhao's reforms sought to turn a post-totalitarian regime into a looser and more pluralistic authoritarian regime dominated by one party. Sadly, Zhao's efforts did not succeed. After making some real, although modest, initial progress, Zhao's reforms stalled. As he later admitted, "in reality, after the Thirteenth Party Congress, it became very difficult to implement or sustain political system reform."92 When the PLA tanks rolled into Tiananmen Square on June 4, 1989, the party not only crushed the prodemocracy movement but also extinguished any hopes of a regime-initiated gradual transition.

一个可行的解决方案是在政权内部建立真正的制度约束，例如引入党内民主、削弱列宁主义党国权力，并为其他自主的社会力量创造更多政治空间。事实上，赵立坚及其顾问在1986-1987年构思的政治改革蓝图正是为了实现这些目标。从这个意义上讲，赵立坚的制度改革尝试是变革性的，而非修复性的。这些改革远比邓小平在十年前为修复毛泽东对党造成的损害而采取的相对温和的措施更为激进。如果说邓小平的改革旨在保留列宁主义的核心特征，并使党的统治更加稳定和持久，那么赵立坚的改革则力图将一个后极权主义政权转变为一个由一党主导的、更加松散和多元化的威权政权。遗憾的是，赵立坚的努力并未成功。在取得一些实质性的、尽管幅度不大的初步进展后，赵立坚的改革便停滞不前。正如他后来承认的那样，“实际上，在党的十三大之后，政治体制改革的实施和维持变得非常困难。”1989年6月4日，解放军坦克开进天安门广场，党不仅镇压了民主运动，也扼杀了政权发起渐进式过渡的任何希望。

In retrospect, however, the pathway to democracy via a party-sanctioned program of reform was too narrow to be viable. Regime-initiated reform, or "transformation," according to Samuel Huntington, requires that the reformers in the regime maintain political dominance.93 But with Deng firmly aligned with the hard-liners in opposing any change that could undermine party power, the balance of power decisively favored the hard-liners. This balance grew even more lopsided after the dismissal of Hu Yaobang in January 1987.

然而，事后看来，通过党批准的改革方案实现民主的道路过于狭窄，难以行得通。根据塞缪尔·亨廷顿的说法，政权主导的改革，或者说“转型”，要求政权内部的改革派保持政治主导地位。但由于邓小平坚定地与强硬派站在一起，反对任何可能削弱党权力的变革，权力平衡明显向强硬派倾斜。1987年1月胡耀邦被解职后，这种权力平衡更加失衡。

The greatest negative legacy of the 1980s is the preservation of the core institutions of a totalitarian regime. The tenacious opposition to political liberalization by Deng and his hard-line allies shielded these institutions from even the moderate reforms envisioned by Zhao's task force in 1987. Throughout the 1980s, as would be the case in the post-Tiananmen period as well as in the Xi Jinping era, the CCP maintained a monopoly on violence through its direct control of the military and other coercive forces. It was the military that saved the party from the nationwide popular prodemocracy movement in the spring of 1989. The modest steps Zhao took to "separate the party from the government," most of which were reversed after his purge, hardly made a dent in the party's tight grip on the Chinese state. Throughout the post-Mao period, the party remained as deeply entrenched in the state as ever.

20世纪80年代最大的负面遗产是极权政权核心制度的保存。邓小平及其强硬派盟友对政治自由化的顽固抵制，使得这些制度甚至免于赵立坚1987年工作组提出的温和改革。整个80年代，正如后天安门时代以及习近平时代一样，中共通过对军队和其他强制力量的直接控制，维持了对暴力的垄断。正是军队在1989年春季席卷全国的民主运动中拯救了中共。赵立坚为“党政分离”所采取的温和措施（其中大部分在其清洗后被撤销）几乎没有撼动中共对中国国家的牢牢控制。在后毛泽东时代，中共对国家的控制力依然根深蒂固。

The party's control of information in the 1980s was weakened moderately, due partly to protection of the liberals by reformers such as Hu and Zhao, and partly to the impact of an increasingly commercially oriented media market.94 But the mechanisms that enabled the party to limit access to information, such as state-owned television networks, newspapers, and publishing companies, the prohibitions against private ownership of media outlets, and the party's nationwide propaganda networks that censor news, were kept, allowing the party to tighten the control whenever needed. The use of terror, a hallmark of totalitarianism, declined significantly throughout the 1980s. However, the party retained its capacity to deploy terror against certain segments of the population (as during Deng's draconian anticrime drive in 1983) or to crush prodemocracy forces (as in the Tiananmen crackdown in 1989).

20世纪80年代，党对信息的控制有所削弱，部分原因是胡锦涛和赵立坚等改革派对自由派的保护，部分原因是日益商业化的媒体市场的影响。但党限制信息获取的机制，例如国有电视台、报纸和出版社，禁止媒体私有化，以及党在全国范围内审查新闻的宣传网络，仍然保留了下来，这使得党能够在必要时加强控制。作为极权主义标志的恐怖手段在整个80年代显著减少。然而，党仍然保留着对特定群体使用恐怖手段（例如邓小平1983年严厉的反犯罪运动）或镇压民主力量（例如1989年的天安门事件）的能力。

The only area in which the reforms of the 1980s substantially undermined party control was the economy. The rapid growth of the private sector broke the party-state's monopolistic control of the economy and fueled hopes that the growth and consolidation of a market economy would not only spur modernization but also deconcentrate vital resources away from the state. Yet, the experience of the post-Tiananmen decades reveals the limits of capitalist economic modernization in promoting political change. Despite sustained double-digit growth over a period of twenty years (1992-2012) and the emergence of the private sector as the largest contributor to economic output, the party's hold on power showed no signs of weakening. If anything, the party not only gained legitimacy from the ever-rising living standards but also acquired greater capabilities of control and coercion to defend its political monopoly.

20世纪80年代的改革唯一实质性削弱党控制的领域是经济。私营部门的快速增长打破了党国对经济的垄断，并燃起了人们的希望：市场经济的增长和巩固不仅能促进现代化，还能使重要资源不再集中于国家。然而，后天安门时代的经验表明，资本主义经济现代化在推动政治变革方面存在局限性。尽管在20年间（1992-2012年）经济持续保持两位数增长，私营部门也成为经济产出的最大贡献者，但党的权力却丝毫没有减弱的迹象。相反，党不仅从不断提高的生活水平中获得了合法性，而且还获得了更强大的控制和强制能力来捍卫其政治垄断地位。





2 Reform and Growth in the 1980s





20世纪80年代的改革与增长


MOST ACCOUNTS OF China's post-Mao economic history characterize gradualism as a deliberate decision made by its leaders to avoid initial costly mistakes.1 As with most conventional wisdom, this observation is partly true. This narrative, however, obviously downplays the fact that the party decided to pursue a cautious and incremental course of reform because opposition by hard-liners made it impossible to undertake more radical reforms. More critically, once Deng Xiaoping decided to rely on capitalist tools to save the CCP, the actual range of choices for economic reform strategy was limited. Stated simply, a full and unconditional embrace of a market economy was out of the question politically because this would entail the demolition of the economic foundations of one-party rule. This danger did not deter Deng from courting capitalism in the 1980s because he was willing to try anything to salvage a regime devastated by three decades of Maoist misrule, but the threat of a decentralized market economy to one-party rule would mushroom decades later as the private sector overtook the state sector as the most dynamic economic force.

大多数关于中国后毛泽东时代经济史的论述都将渐进主义描述为领导人为避免初期代价高昂的错误而做出的深思熟虑的决定。1 与大多数传统观点一样，这种说法有一定道理。然而，这种叙述显然淡化了一个事实：中共之所以决定采取谨慎渐进的改革路线，是因为强硬派的反对使得更激进的改革成为不可能。更重要的是，一旦邓小平决定依靠资本主义工具来挽救中共，经济改革战略的实际选择范围就受到了限制。简而言之，全面无条件地拥抱市场经济在政治上是不可行的，因为这将意味着摧毁一党专政的经济基础。这种危险并没有阻止邓小平在 20 世纪 80 年代拥抱资本主义，因为他愿意尝试任何方法来挽救一个被毛泽东时代三十年错误统治摧毁的政权，但分散的市场经济对一党专政的威胁在几十年后才会迅速增长，因为私营部门取代了国有部门，成为最具活力的经济力量。

In the 1980s, fortunately, the prospect of a capitalist subversion of the CCP's political monopoly seemed so unreal that, despite staunch conservative opposition, the party went along with Deng and opened the door for domestic private entrepreneurs and foreign investors. What the party did not foresee was how fast capitalism would grow and thrive in a semihostile environment. Unfortunately, the logic of path dependence also means that the party's half-hearted embrace of capitalism would set firm boundaries for the reach of the market and preserve the regime's control of what Vladimir Lenin called the "commanding heights" of the economy. The resultant hybrid economy would eventually exhaust its initial dynamism and begin to ossify and stagnate.

幸运的是，在20世纪80年代，资本主义颠覆中共政治垄断的前景似乎遥不可及，因此，尽管保守派强烈反对，中共还是顺应了邓小平的指示，向国内私营企业家和外国投资者敞开了大门。然而，中共没有预料到的是，资本主义在这种半敌对的环境下会发展得如此迅速。不幸的是，路径依赖的逻辑也意味着，中共对资本主义的半心半意的接纳，将为市场的发展范围设定严格的界限，并维护政权对列宁所说的经济“制高点”的控制。由此产生的混合经济最终会耗尽其最初的活力，开始僵化和停滞。

The emergence of China's hybrid economic system in the 1980s can be divided into two phases. The most important achievement in first phase, 1979-1983, was the rapid decollectivization of agriculture. This breakthrough not only raised rural productivity and output dramatically but also paved the way for the rise of a dynamic private sector and established the foundations of China's dual-track economy: a highly efficient private sector alongside an inefficient state-owned sector. Reform of the urban sector, where the economy was dominated by the state-owned enterprises, began tentatively in this period and made no meaningful progress. In this phase, reformers led by Deng Xiaoping also launched "opening"—integration with the global economy through attracting foreign direct investment and promoting foreign trade. Compared with the successes of rural reform and the opening to the outside world achieved in the first phase, the second phase, 1984-1989, delivered far less impressive reform outcomes mainly because of the complex challenges of reforming SOEs, growing conservative resistance, and Deng Xiaoping's dismissal of the party's general secretary Hu Yaobang in January 1987, a move that seriously weakened the reformist camp at the top.

20世纪80年代中国混合经济体制的形成可以分为两个阶段。第一阶段（1979-1983年）最重要的成就是农业的快速非集体化。这一突破不仅大幅提高了农村生产率和产出，而且为充满活力的私营经济的崛起铺平了道路，奠定了中国双轨经济的基础：高效的私营经济与效率较低的国有经济并存。在此期间，以国有企业为主导的城镇经济改革开始试探性地进行，但并未取得实质性进展。在这一阶段，以邓小平为首的改革派还启动了“对外开放”——通过吸引外商直接投资和促进对外贸易，融入全球经济。与第一阶段农村改革和对外开放取得的成功相比，第二阶段（1984-1989 年）的改革成果远不如第一阶段显著，这主要是由于国有企业改革面临诸多复杂挑战、保守势力日益增长的阻力，以及邓小平在 1987 年 1 月解除中共中央总书记胡耀邦的职务，这一举动严重削弱了高层改革派的力量。

In spite of China's failure to reform its large and inefficient state-owned sector in the second phase, it built the foundations of sustained rapid growth in the 1980s, thanks to the rapid growth of the private sector and foreign-invested firms. Ironically, this development, especially the rise of a vibrant domestic private sector, was not the planned outcome of Deng's reform. Due to political opposition and the technical difficulties in reforming SOEs, reformers wisely opted for the path of least resistance: liberalizing the economy to bring into the marketplace far more efficient nonstate firms as the new engines of growth. Political expediency aside, this pragmatic approach to reform was also made possible by, paradoxically, the absence of a clear and comprehensive strategy to transform a state-socialist economy into a market-oriented one. Instead of following a rigid approach, Chinese reformers relied on learning-by-doing and avoided making costly mistakes in the early phase of the transition that could doom the entire enterprise.

尽管中国在第二阶段未能成功改革其庞大而低效的国有部门，但得益于私营企业和外商投资企业的快速发展，中国在20世纪80年代奠定了持续快速增长的基础。具有讽刺意味的是，这一发展，尤其是充满活力的国内私营企业的崛起，并非邓小平改革的预期结果。由于政治阻力和国有企业改革的技术难题，改革者明智地选择了阻力最小的道路：开放经济，将效率更高的非国有企业引入市场，作为新的增长引擎。撇开政治权宜之计不谈，这种务实的改革方式之所以成为可能，也恰恰是因为缺乏将国家社会主义经济转型为市场经济的清晰全面的战略。中国改革者没有采取僵化的方式，而是依靠实践经验，避免在转型初期犯下可能危及整个改革进程的代价高昂的错误。





Origins of Chinese Experimentalism





中国实验主义的起源


When China began to reform its economic system in the early 1980s, its leaders were in unchartered territory as they could not draw much guidance from economic theory or real-world examples.2 The neoclassical economic literature was irrelevant for a country embarked on a transition from a nonmarket economy to another system. The experience of limited economic reform in Eastern Europe (mainly Hungary and Yugoslavia) in the 1960s and 1970s was only marginally useful because these efforts focused on SOEs and ultimately failed to produce meaningful economic improvements.

20世纪80年代初，中国开始改革经济体制时，其领导人面临着前所未有的挑战，因为他们既无法从经济理论中汲取太多经验，也无法从现实案例中借鉴太多。新古典经济学的理论对于一个正从非市场经济向市场经济转型的国家而言已不再适用。20世纪60年代和70年代东欧（主要是匈牙利和南斯拉夫）有限的经济改革经验也仅有微弱的借鉴意义，因为这些改革主要集中在国有企业，最终未能带来实质性的经济改善。

However, what Chinese policymakers lacked in theory was more than compensated for by their overriding political imperatives and pragmatic instincts. Politically, the top leaders knew they must produce higher growth to bolster CCP legitimacy after decades of economic mismanagement under Mao. Deng Xiaoping put it bluntly in October 1979: "Economic work is the greatest politics today. The economic issue is the overwhelming political issue."3 As for how to achieve this objective, Deng's answer was straightforward, though it lacked specifics: "The goal of our revolution is to liberate and develop productivity."4

然而，中国决策者在理论上的不足，被其迫切的政治需要和务实的本能所弥补。在政治上，最高领导人深知，在毛泽东时代数十年的经济管理不善之后，他们必须实现更高的经济增长，以巩固中共的合法性。邓小平在1979年10月直言不讳地指出：“经济工作是当今最大的政治，经济问题是压倒一切的政治问题。”至于如何实现这一目标，邓小平的回答虽然缺乏具体细节，但却十分直接：“我们革命的目标是解放和发展生产力。”

To "liberate productivity," China's initial efforts were focused on making the existing system more efficient mainly through decentralization, instead of replacing it altogether. Starting in 1979, decentralization consisted of granting local governments more autonomy in economic management and incentivizing them with "fiscal contracting." This allowed provincial governments to retain surplus revenues after they met the quota of tax revenues to be paid to the central government.5 The pragmatic instincts of the Chinese leaders led them to prefer experimental measures to decisive but risky steps. This cautious approach was necessitated by both opposition from conservatives resisting full liberalization and a lack of the requisite knowledge or theoretical guidance. Consequently, reform measures were rolled out gradually, typically first in a small number of localities to gain valuable knowledge and avoid pitfalls.6 One such example was the economic opening to the West, which occurred through a series of cautious reforms, such as the establishment of four SEZs in Guangdong and Fujian in the early 1980s, the gradual extension of policies to key coastal cities, and piecemeal reforms of the foreign trade regime. Another example is the price reform of the 1980s, which started with a unique "dual-track" pricing system featuring both government-mandated prices and market-determined prices.7 The only big-bang reform breakthrough—in agriculture—occurred not because of a deliberate strategy by the top leadership but because of a combination of bottom-up peasant initiatives and support by reformers in a few key provinces in 1979.8
