为了“解放生产力”，中国最初的努力重点在于通过权力下放来提高现有体制的效率，而不是彻底取代它。从1979年开始，权力下放体现在赋予地方政府更大的经济管理自主权，并通过“财政契约”激励它们。这使得省级政府在达到上缴中央的税收配额后，可以保留剩余财政收入。中国领导人的务实精神使他们倾向于采取试验性措施，而不是果断但风险较高的举措。这种谨慎的做法既是由于保守派反对全面自由化，也是由于缺乏必要的知识或理论指导。因此，改革措施逐步推行，通常先在少数地区试点，以积累宝贵经验并避免失误。6 其中一个例子是对外开放经济，这是通过一系列谨慎的改革实现的，例如20世纪80年代初在广东和福建设立四个经济特区，逐步将政策扩展到沿海重点城市，以及对对外贸易体制进行分阶段改革。另一个例子是20世纪80年代的价格改革，其开端是独特的“双轨制”定价体系，既有政府规定的价格，也有市场决定的价格。7 唯一一次重大改革突破——农业改革——并非源于最高领导层的深思熟虑，而是1979年几个重点省份自下而上的农民倡议和改革者支持共同作用的结果。8

Although it is common to credit China's "learn-by-doing" strategy of the 1980s for the initial success of its economic reform, it would be unfair to dismiss the influence of ideas and lessons from Eastern Europe and the West in helping Chinese policymakers and economists gain a deeper and more sophisticated understanding of the nature, scope, and challenges of their tasks. If anything, one of China's initial moves was to dispatch a number of senior officials and economists to visit countries in Eastern Europe, Western Europe, and East Asia to gain useful lessons, insights, and knowledge about economic reform.9 The World Bank, eager to help chart China's course, provided invaluable technical assistance. The head of the bank's office in Beijing organized seminars for technocrats and rising economists in the Chinese government. The most influential event was a seven-day seminar on a cruise along the Yangtze in September 1985 attended by prominent economists from Eastern Europe and the West. Many of the Chinese participants in the seminar later became influential players in the Chinese reform, such as Wu Jinglian, Gao Shangquan, Guo Shuqing, and Lou Jiwei. Impressed by the value of the World Bank's technical assistance, in 1983 Deng invited the bank to conduct a comprehensive study of the Chinese economy and identify the policy choices it faced. This led to a milestone study by the World Bank, published in 1985 and titled "Issues and Choices for Long-Term Development," which drew heavily on the bank's knowledge of developing economies.10

尽管人们普遍认为中国20世纪80年代的“边做边学”战略是其经济改革初期取得成功的关键，但如果忽视东欧和西方的思想和经验对中国决策者和经济学家理解其任务的性质、范围和挑战所产生的影响，那就太不公平了。事实上，中国最初的举措之一就是派遣多位高级官员和经济学家访问东欧、西欧和东亚国家，以获取有关经济改革的宝贵经验、见解和知识。世界银行积极帮助中国规划发展方向，提供了宝贵的技术援助。世界银行驻北京办事处主任为中国政府的技术官僚和新兴经济学家组织了研讨会。其中最具影响力的活动是1985年9月在长江游轮上举行的为期七天的研讨会，来自东欧和西方的著名经济学家出席了此次研讨会。研讨会上的许多中国与会者后来都成为了中国改革开放的重要人物，例如吴敬莲、高尚泉、郭树清和楼继伟。邓小平对世界银行的技术援助印象深刻，于1983年邀请世界银行对中国经济进行全面研究，并确定其面临的政策选择。这促成了世界银行一项里程碑式的研究成果的诞生，该研究于1985年出版，题为《长期发展的议题与选择》，其中大量借鉴了世界银行在发展中经济体方面的知识。

Gradually and cumulatively, these intellectual interactions, especially those with Eastern European economists (the most influential were Janos Kornai from Hungary, Włodzimierz Brus from Poland, and Ota Šik from Czechoslovakia), led some Chinese reformers to conclude that economic reform was "not a collection of random policies" but a "systemic transition."

逐渐地，这些思想交流，特别是与东欧经济学家（其中最有影响力的是匈牙利的亚诺什·科尔奈、波兰的弗沃齐米日·布鲁斯和捷克斯洛伐克的奥塔·希克）的交流，使一些中国改革者得出结论：经济改革“不是一系列随机政策的集合”，而是一个“系统性转型”。

Decentralization and liberalization, hallmarks of the gradualist reform in the 1980s, were too limited to achieve a transition to a different economic system. Consequently, Chinese reformers began to look elsewhere for insights and inspirations. Two models—the Western liberal model and the East Asian developmental state model—began to gain influence. For Deng, the East Asian model held stronger appeal because of the leading role played by an authoritarian state.11

20世纪80年代渐进式改革的标志——权力下放和自由化——过于局限，不足以实现向不同经济体制的转型。因此，中国改革者开始从其他地方寻求借鉴和灵感。西方自由主义模式和东亚发展型国家模式开始受到关注。对邓小平而言，东亚模式更具吸引力，因为其中存在一个威权国家发挥主导作用。

This brief account of the evolution of China's economic reform strategy shows that in the 1980s China mainly followed an experimental and improvisational approach, appropriately captured by the idiom, "crossing the river by feeling for the stones." But Chinese leaders adopted this largely successful strategy out of necessity. The top leaders were divided about the goal and pace of reform, and even those committed to reform lacked the necessary intellectual tools or real-world models. Fortunately, interactions with their counterparts in the West and Eastern Europe helped Chinese economists realize the limits of piecemeal experiments and administrative decentralization and led them to gravitate toward a far more comprehensive and coherent strategy of transition. Because of the post-Tiananmen political turmoil and the brief conservative backlash against reform during 1990-1991, China would have to wait until after Deng's historic southern tour in 1992 to implement a full package of institutional reforms that marked the beginning of a qualitatively different phase of its transition.

这段对中国经济改革战略演变的简要回顾表明，20世纪80年代，中国主要采取的是一种实验性和摸索性的方式，正如“摸着石头过河”这句成语所贴切地概括的那样。但中国领导人采取这种在很大程度上成功的战略是出于无奈。高层领导人在改革的目标和步伐上存在分歧，即使是那些致力于改革的人也缺乏必要的理论工具或现实案例。幸运的是，与东西欧同行的交流帮助中国经济学家认识到零散实验和行政权力下放的局限性，并促使他们转向一种更为全面和连贯的转型战略。由于天安门事件后的政治动荡以及1990-1991年间保守派对改革的短暂反弹，中国不得不等到1992年邓小平历史性的南巡之后，才得以实施一整套制度改革，这标志着中国转型进入了一个截然不同的阶段。





Rural Breakthroughs





乡村突破


When CCP leaders pivoted away from Maoist class struggle to economic modernization in 1979, one of the strategic choices they faced was where economic reform should begin. At that time, the Chinese economic structure was severely distorted in terms of population and output. The countryside contained 82 percent of the population in 1978, but the rural sector accounted for only 28 percent of economic output. In other words, China was both under-urbanized and highly industrialized (with industry producing 48 percent of output in 1978).12 Economically, it might appear that reforming the industrial sector, the largest contributor to economic output, could deliver faster and better results.

1979年，中共领导人将重心从毛泽东时代的阶级斗争转向经济现代化时，他们面临的战略选择之一就是经济改革应该从何处着手。当时，中国的经济结构在人口和产出方面严重失衡。1978年，农村人口占全国总人口的82%，但农村经济产出仅占28%。换言之，当时的中国既是城镇化程度低的，又是高度工业化的（1978年工业产出占全国总产出的48%）。从经济角度来看，改革对经济产出贡献最大的工业部门似乎能够更快、更好地取得成效。

However, reform in China started not in the urban industrial sector but in the impoverished countryside. Reforming the industrial sector based in urban areas might have appeared to be a promising way to improve performance and produce a bigger bang, but political resistance to reform in the SOE-dominated industrial sector was strong. Technically, industrial reform was also far more complex, entailing not only changes in firm management and ownership but also a whole set of complementary institutional reforms involving prices, financial markets, and social safety nets.

然而，中国的改革并非始于城市工业部门，而是始于贫困的农村。改革以城市工业部门为主导的产业部门，看似是提升绩效、产生更大效益的有效途径，但国有企业主导的工业部门改革却面临着强大的政治阻力。从技术层面来看，产业改革也更为复杂，不仅涉及企业管理和所有权的变革，还包括一系列配套的制度改革，涵盖价格、金融市场和社会保障体系等领域。

If political opposition and technical challenges made rural reform more attractive than industrial reform, one might have expected the top party leaders to proactively pursue this route in 1979 or the early 1980s. But they did not. Rural reform began mainly as a bottom-up revolution waged by long-suffering peasants who received, in its early days, the support of only a small number of provincial party leaders, most notably Wan Li in Anhui and Zhao Ziyang in Sichuan. In fact, the CCP Central Committee issued a rural policy directive in September 1979 that explicitly discouraged decollectivization.13 Opponents to rural reform included Hua Guofeng, who was still nominal party chairman, Li Xiannian and Hu Qiaomu, two hard-liners who consistently opposed economic reform in the 1980s, and a large number of provincial party chiefs. Chen Yun, the conservative standard bearer, was neutral, however. From the very beginning, Hu Yaobang was the most enthusiastic supporter of rural reform among the top leaders. Deng supported the "household responsibility system," the rural reform that effectively decollectivized agriculture, but he did not publicly endorse the reform until May 1980.14 According to Zhao Ziyang, Deng's tacit support was critical to the success of the rural reform because it prevented the emergence of unified opposition among the party's top echelon.15 The party did not formally approve the household responsibility system until the beginning of 1982.16

如果政治阻力和技术挑战使得农村改革比产业改革更具吸引力，人们或许会预期中共高层领导人在1979年或20世纪80年代初会积极推行产业改革。但事实并非如此。农村改革最初主要是一场自下而上的革命，由长期遭受苦难的农民发起，早期仅得到少数省级党政领导人的支持，其中最著名的是安徽省的万里和四川省的赵紫阳。事实上，中共中央在1979年9月发布的农村政策指示中明确反对去集体化。反对农村改革的人包括当时名义上仍是中共中央主席的华国锋、李先念和胡巧木这两位在20世纪80年代一直反对经济改革的强硬派，以及众多省级党政干部。然而，保守派领军人物陈云则保持中立。从一开始，胡耀邦就是高层领导人中最热衷于农村改革的人。邓小平支持“家庭联产承包责任制”，这项农村改革有效地实现了农业的非集体化，但他直到1980年5月才公开支持这项改革。赵紫阳认为，邓小平的默许对农村改革的成功至关重要，因为它阻止了党内高层出现统一的反对声音。直到1982年初，党才正式批准家庭联产承包责任制。

Judging by the speed and scope of agricultural decollectivization, which began in 1978 and was completed throughout the country by 1982, rural reform should be considered a radical big bang in one of the most important economic sectors.17 Although China's post-Mao economic reform is often characterized as a case of "gradualism," in reality the country experienced both a "big bang" and a gradualist course of reform. China's big-bang approach to agricultural reform was feasible and successful mostly because the state-socialist system was less deeply entrenched in the countryside, and collectivized agriculture had victimized almost the entire rural population. By comparison, strong political opposition at the top, groups benefiting from a command economy (planners, managers, and workers in SOEs), and genuine technical difficulties of industrial reform compelled China to adopt a more cautious step-by-step approach in this area.

从1978年开始、1982年全国范围内完成的农业非集体化的速度和范围来看，农村改革应被视为最重要的经济部门之一的一次彻底变革。尽管中国后毛泽东时代的经济改革常被描述为“渐进主义”，但实际上，中国经历了“大爆炸”式和渐进式的双重改革路径。中国农业改革的“大爆炸”式路径之所以可行且成功，主要是因为国家社会主义制度在农村的根基较浅，而且集体化农业几乎使全体农村人口都深受其害。相比之下，来自高层的强大政治阻力、从计划经济中获益的群体（国有企业的计划者、管理者和工人）以及工业改革中存在的切实技术难题，迫使中国在该领域采取更为谨慎的循序渐进的方式。

The end of collectivized agriculture produced an instant increase in productivity. Agricultural output, measured in constant prices, rose an average of 8.7 percent annually between 1979 and 1984.18 Academic studies show that a radical institutional change—replacing the Maoist people's communes with private household farming—contributed at least half of output growth in the agricultural sector during this period.19 The rural breakthrough in the early 1980s had vast—and positive—implications for Deng's reform. The rapid gains in productivity and standard of living due to agricultural decollectivization generated valuable political capital for the reformers as rural per capita income grew threefold from 1978 to 1985 in real terms.20 Few appreciated the political benefits of the early success of reform in the rural sector as acutely as Deng, who said in 1985, "To make our domestic economy dynamic, we must start with the countryside. Eighty percent of the Chinese population is in the countryside. Whether Chinese society can be stable and the Chinese economy can develop depends on whether the countryside can develop and the life of peasants can improve."21

集体化农业的终结带来了生产力的立竿见影的提升。1979年至1984年间，按不变价格计算的农业产出年均增长8.7%。学术研究表明，这一时期农业产出增长的至少一半是由一项根本性的制度变革——以私人家庭农场取代毛泽东时代的人民公社——所贡献的。20世纪80年代初的农村突破对邓小平的改革产生了深远而积极的影响。农业非集体化带来的生产力和生活水平的快速提高，为改革者积累了宝贵的政治资本，1978年至1985年间，农村人均收入实际增长了三倍。邓小平对农村改革早期成功所带来的政治利益有着极其深刻的认识，他在1985年指出：“要使国内经济充满活力，必须从农村做起。中国80%的人口在农村。中国社会能否稳定、中国经济能否发展，取决于农村能否发展、农民生活能否改善。”

More important, liberation of the peasantry from the yokes of the people's communes was the first step in creating a private sector, which later became the most dynamic engine of growth. The connection between decollectivization and the private sector became obvious only in hindsight. In reality, the emergence of the private sector in the countryside during the post-Mao era was an inevitable outcome of the successful rural reform. Increased productivity and output freed up a huge amount of labor and allowed peasants to accumulate savings to finance nonagricultural activities, thus creating two necessary conditions for a nascent private sector: entrepreneurs and capital.

更重要的是，农民从人民公社的枷锁中解放出来，是建立私营部门的第一步，而私营部门后来成为经济增长最强劲的引擎。去集体化与私营部门之间的联系，只有在事后看来才显而易见。事实上，后毛泽东时代农村私营部门的出现，是农村改革成功的必然结果。生产力和产量的提高释放了大量劳动力，使农民能够积累储蓄，用于非农活动，从而为新兴的私营部门创造了两个必要条件：企业家和资本。

The dismantling of the communes opened up an unanticipated opportunity for rural entrepreneurs because the communes had accumulated considerable industrial assets during the Great Leap Forward (1958-1959) and the agricultural mechanization campaign in the Cultural Revolution. After the communes disappeared, some of these assets were effectively privatized (usually in the form of leasing), while others were transferred to newly formed collective firms that were nominally owned by township and village governments. This development laid the early foundations for China's township and village enterprises.22

人民公社的解散为农村企业家带来了意想不到的机遇，因为人民公社在大跃进（1958-1959）和文化大革命的农业机械化运动中积累了大量工业资产。公社解散后，部分资产实际上被私有化（通常以租赁的形式），而其他资产则被转移到新成立的集体企业中，这些企业名义上由乡镇和村政府所有。这一发展为中国乡镇和村级企业的早期发展奠定了基础。

Several other factors also contributed to the rapid growth of the TVEs. Due to fiscal decentralization in the early 1980s, local authorities had strong incentives to support industrial growth in their respective areas because nonagricultural activities generated more tax revenues.23 The neglect of light industry and the service sector in favor of defense-related heavy industry during the Maoist period also meant that there was a severe shortage of consumer goods and services, which presented a huge opportunity to be exploited by rural entrepreneurs. Consequently, the market-oriented TVEs quickly gained a competitive edge over the SOEs in supplying consumer goods and services. They also began to contribute a rising share of Chinese exports.24

其他几个因素也促成了乡镇企业的快速发展。由于20世纪80年代初的财政分权，地方政府更有动力支持本地区的工业发展，因为非农活动能带来更多税收。毛泽东时代，轻工业和服务业被忽视，而国防相关重工业则被优先发展，这导致消费品和服务严重短缺，为农村企业家提供了巨大的发展机遇。因此，以市场为导向的乡镇企业在消费品和服务供应方面迅速获得了相对于国有企业的竞争优势，并且在中国出口中所占的份额也越来越大。

Policy support from Beijing mainly consisted of allowing rural entrepreneurs access to rural credit co-ops and informal financing.25 The dual-track price reform, however imperfect, allowed TVEs to purchase vital inputs legally because this reform encouraged SOEs, which monopolized the production of steel, aluminum, chemicals, and other upstream materials used for the manufacturing of consumer goods, to sell their products to TVEs at higher, market-based prices.26

北京的政策支持主要体现在允许农村企业家获得农村信贷合作社和非正规融资渠道。尽管双轨价格改革并不完善，但它使乡镇企业能够合法地购买关键投入品，因为这项改革鼓励垄断钢铁、铝、化工产品和其他消费品制造上游原材料生产的国有企业以更高的市场价格向乡镇企业出售产品。

The explosive growth of TVEs in the 1980s (table 2.1) was a positive development totally unanticipated by even the most ardent reformers. Deng admitted in 1987 that "our greatest success—and it is one we had by no means anticipated—has been the emergence of a large number of enterprises run by villages and townships. They were like a new force that just came into being spontaneously. . . . The Central Committee takes no credit.27

20世纪80年代乡镇企业的爆炸式增长（表2.1）是一个积极的发展，即使是最热忱的改革者也始料未及。邓小平在1987年承认：“我们最大的成就——也是我们始料未及的——是大量乡镇企业涌现。它们就像一股自发形成的新力量……中央委员会不居功。”

Because the TVEs were officially designated as "collective" firms owned not by the state or private individuals but by a local collective entity, such as a village or township, one may have the impression that they were not genuine private firms. In fact, however, many were bona fide private firms despite the designation of "collective firms" because the latter provided more political protection in an era when private ownership of property was not officially endorsed by the party or legally protected by the Chinese constitution (the constitution was not amended until 2004 to protect private property). Research by Yasheng Huang shows that by 1987, private TVEs accounted for half of the output of all TVEs in eight provinces and 30-50 percent of the output of TVEs in fifteen provinces. In 1989 private TVEs contributed 58 percent of after-tax profits of all TVEs and accounted for 45 percent of the wage bill of all TVEs.28

由于乡镇企业被官方认定为“集体所有制”企业，其所有权并非归国家或私人所有，而是由村、乡等地方集体实体所有，因此人们可能会误以为它们并非真正的私营企业。然而，事实上，尽管被冠以“集体所有制”之名，许多乡镇企业仍是名副其实的私营企业，因为在当时私有财产所有权尚未得到党的正式认可或宪法保护的年代（直到2004年宪法才进行修订以保护私有财产），后者能提供更多的政治保障。黄亚生的研究表明，到1987年，私营乡镇企业在八个省份的乡镇企业总产值中占比达一半，在十五个省份则占比达30%至50%。1989年，私营乡镇企业贡献了所有乡镇企业税后利润的58%，并占所有乡镇企业工资总额的45%。

Another far-reaching consequence of the TVEs is that they gave rise to a new generation of private entrepreneurs.29 Those who leased the assets of TVEs or later assumed managerial responsibilities in them built thriving private businesses. The most successful became tycoons who led globally competitive firms, such as Fuyao Industrial Glass Group (a global leader of auto glass founded by Cao Dewang) and Wang Xiang Group (an auto parts maker founded by Lu Guanqiu). Entrepreneurs who did not lease or manage TVEs but were able to scrape together enough capital also started businesses that grew into thriving private companies, such as New Hope Group, which began as a small Sichuan company producing animal feed. A government-sponsored study of rural entrepreneurs in 1991 found that 19 percent were the heads of TVEs and 13 percent had at one time worked in TVEs. In other words, roughly one-third of all rural entrepreneurs were connected with the TVEs. Other studies show that between 17 percent and 47 percent of private entrepreneurs had been senior executives or workers in TVEs.30

乡镇企业带来的另一个深远影响是，它们催生了新一代的私营企业家。那些租赁乡镇企业资产或后来接管其管理工作的人，建立了蓬勃发展的私营企业。其中最成功的几位成为了商业巨头，领导着具有全球竞争力的公司，例如曹德旺创立的福耀工业玻璃集团（全球领先的汽车玻璃企业）和陆冠秋创立的王翔集团（汽车零部件制造商）。那些没有租赁或管理乡镇企业，但能够筹集到足够资金的企业家，也创办了企业，并发展成为蓬勃发展的私营公司，例如新希望集团，它最初是一家四川小型饲料生产企业。1991年一项政府资助的农村企业家调查发现，19%的农村企业家是乡镇企业的负责人，13%的农村企业家曾经在乡镇企业工作过。换句话说，大约三分之一的农村企业家与乡镇企业有着联系。其他研究表明，17%至47%的私营企业家曾是传统小型企业的高级管理人员或员工。





Opening to the World





向世界敞开大门


China's economic engagement with the world was miniscule relative to its size due to Mao's policy of "self-reliance." In 1978 total foreign trade was only $20.6 billion, or 10 percent of China's GDP.31 But economic reintegration into the global trading system was crucial to the success of the country's modernization. Deng, who likely acquired a cosmopolitan outlook during his five-year sojourn in France (December 1920 to January 1926), viewed opening as a top priority and subsequently invested enormous political capital to push for reforms to attract foreign capital.32 More than any other Chinese leader at the end of the 1970s, Deng recognized that a favorable external environment, in particular warming ties between China and the West, would provide a window of opportunity. In May 1979, shortly after he reached political supremacy, Deng told a French delegation that "now we enjoy relatively favorable international conditions and can introduce advanced technology, research products, and considerable international capital from the U.S., Europe and Japan. In the first twenty years of the [PRC] we did not have such international conditions. . . . We must adopt a policy of opening."33

由于毛泽东的“自力更生”政策，中国与世界的经济联系相对于其庞大的体量而言微乎其微。1978年，中国对外贸易总额仅为206亿美元，占国内生产总值的10%。但经济重新融入全球贸易体系对于中国现代化的成功至关重要。邓小平在法国的五年旅居生活（1920年12月至1926年1月）很可能培养了国际视野，他将对外开放视为重中之重，并随后投入巨额政治资本推动改革以吸引外资。在20世纪70年代末，邓小平比任何其他中国领导人都更清楚地认识到，有利的外部环境，特别是中西方关系的升温，将为中国带来机遇。 1979年5月，邓小平在掌握政治权力后不久，对一个法国代表团说：“现在我们享有相对有利的国际条件，可以从美国、欧洲和日本引进先进技术、科研成果和大量国际资本。中华人民共和国成立后的前二十年，我们没有这样的国际条件……我们必须采取对外开放的政策。”

In the early years of reform, Deng effectively made himself China's chief salesman to the West. His visits to the United States (in early 1979) and Japan (in October 1978 and February 1979) cemented diplomatic foundations with the two countries that were most critical to Chinese modernization. Deng also carried out a tireless campaign with visiting foreign dignitaries and businessmen to promote his policy of opening. The official chronology of Deng's activities in 1978 shows that during that single year he spoke to thirty-one visiting delegations of foreign businessmen and politicians about his policy of opening. In 1979 he delivered the same message to thirty-five visiting delegations.34

在改革开放初期，邓小平实际上把自己塑造成了中国对外的主要推销员。他于1979年初访问美国，并于1978年10月和1979年2月访问日本，巩固了与这两个对中国现代化至关重要的国家的外交基础。邓小平还孜孜不倦地接待来访的外国政要和商人，宣传他的对外开放政策。1978年官方记录显示，仅这一年，他就接见了31个来访的外国商人和政要代表团，阐述了他的对外开放政策。1979年，他又向35个来访代表团传达了同样的信息。

At the same time, Deng made it clear to the party that opening to the West was integral to his reform agenda, and he repeatedly emphasized that China had to seize this window of opportunity. Speaking to provincial party chiefs in October 1979, Deng devoted an entire section of his talk to foreign investment and trade. "We must utilize foreign capital in whatever form," he stressed. "This is such a rare opportunity and it would be a shame to pass it up. Utilizing foreign capital is a major policy. . . . I believe we should persist. . . . We must encourage exports."35 He was even more explicit a month later: "Achieving the four modernizations requires a correct policy of opening to the outside. Although we will rely mainly on our own efforts, resources, and foundations, [the four modernizations] would not be possible without international cooperation.36 An important reason why China had remained backward economically, according to Deng, was "its policy of closing the country to outside contact. Our experience shows that China cannot rebuild itself behind closed doors."37

与此同时，邓小平向党内明确表示，对外开放是其改革议程的重要组成部分，并反复强调中国必须抓住这一机遇。1979年10月，邓小平在与各省委书记的讲话中，专门用一个章节论述了对外投资和贸易。“我们必须以各种形式利用外资，”他强调说，“这是一个千载难逢的机会，错过实在可惜。利用外资是一项重大政策……我认为我们应该坚持下去……我们必须鼓励出口。”一个月后，他的表态更加明确：“实现四个现代化需要正确的对外开放政策。虽然我们将主要依靠自身的努力、资源和基础，但没有国际合作，（四个现代化）是不可能实现的。”邓小平认为，中国经济落后的一个重要原因是“其闭关锁国的政策”。我们的经验表明，中国无法闭门重建。

Politically, it is not difficult to see why Deng prioritized opening. He was more directly involved personally in promoting policies to attract foreign investment and increase exports than he was in pushing for domestic reform. Also, domestic economic reform faced greater political resistance because it threatened entrenched interest groups, such as those in the state-owned sector. Outside the agricultural sector, which was quickly privatized, radical reform in urban areas would also encounter more practical difficulties and entail greater political risks. For example, restructuring the money-losing SOEs through bankruptcy or privatization would need new legal tools and a functioning capital market, which China still lacked in the early 1980s.38 In the meantime, price reform, which could unleash temporary inflation, was politically risky. As an astute practitioner of geopolitics, Deng took full advantage of China's crucial role as a counterweight to the Soviet Union during the Cold War to reap substantive economic benefits from the West, in particular capital, technology, and access to markets. Given the overwhelming political logic for opening, Deng lent his support to a series of reforms to attract foreign investment and increase Chinese exports.

从政治角度来看，不难理解邓小平为何优先考虑对外开放。他本人更多地参与推动吸引外资和增加出口的政策，而非推动国内改革。此外，国内经济改革面临更大的政治阻力，因为它威胁到根深蒂固的利益集团，例如国有企业。除了迅速私有化的农业部门外，城市地区的激进改革也会遇到更多实际困难，并带来更大的政治风险。例如，通过破产或私有化重组亏损的国有企业需要新的法律工具和运转良好的资本市场，而中国在20世纪80年代初仍然缺乏这些。与此同时，可能引发暂时性通货膨胀的价格改革在政治上也存在风险。作为一位精明的地缘政治家，邓小平充分利用了中国在冷战期间作为制衡苏联的关键作用，从西方获得了实质性的经济利益，特别是资本、技术和市场准入。鉴于对外开放的压倒性政治逻辑，邓小平支持了一系列旨在吸引外资、增加中国出口的改革。





Legislation to Attract Foreign Direct Investment





吸引外国直接投资的立法


Topping Deng's agenda to attract foreign capital was establishment of a legal framework. In May 1979 he told a delegation of Japanese legislators that China was considering setting up joint ventures with foreign investors and passing a law on foreign investment to underscore its policy of opening. He listed a set of laws on patents and international trade that would also need to be enacted.39 In July 1979 the NPC passed the historic "Chinese-Foreign Equity Joint Ventures Law" to create a legal framework for allowing foreign investors to operate in China. Among other things, the law stipulated that a foreign partner had to put up at least 25 percent of the equity in a joint venture. Although the law did not limit the total amount of equity the foreign partners could invest, the practice was that their total contribution was not to exceed 50 percent of the equity. (The draft of the law sought to explicitly limit the amount of equity of foreign investors to 49 percent, thus making the foreign investors minority owners, but Deng quashed the idea after learning that such a provision was not an international norm.)40

邓小平吸引外资的首要任务是建立法律框架。1979年5月，他告诉日本议员代表团，中国正在考虑与外国投资者成立合资企业，并制定外商投资法，以强调其对外开放政策。他还列举了一系列关于专利和国际贸易的法律，这些法律也需要制定。1979年7月，全国人大通过了具有里程碑意义的《中外合资企业法》，为外国投资者在中国经营创造了法律框架。该法规定，外国合伙人在合资企业中至少要出资25%的股权。虽然该法没有限制外国合伙人可以投资的股权总额，但实践中，他们的出资总额通常不超过股权的50%。 （该法律草案试图明确限制外国投资者的股权比例为49%，从而使外国投资者成为少数股东，但邓小平在得知此类规定并非国际惯例后否决了这一想法。）

Foreign joint ventures were encouraged to source local materials, bring in advanced technology, and export their products in exchange for tax benefits. The Chinese partners could contribute land as part of their equity (the law would later be revised on three occasions before it was annulled in 2020).41

鼓励外国合资企业采购本地原材料、引进先进技术并出口产品，以换取税收优惠。中国合作伙伴可以出资土地作为股权的一部分（该法律后来经过三次修订，最终于2020年被废止）。

Although it did not offer substantial benefits to foreign investors, who often found the law's provisions restrictive and vague, it nevertheless signaled China's desire to welcome foreign capital and opened the door slightly for foreign investors to enter a potentially huge market that had long been closed to the outside world. (Deng said that, despite its flaws, the law was a statement of "our political desires and goals.")42

尽管该法并未给外国投资者带来实质性好处（他们往往觉得该法的条款限制性强且含糊不清），但它仍然表明了中国欢迎外资的意愿，并为外国投资者进入一个长期以来对外界封闭的潜在巨大市场打开了一扇大门。（邓小平表示，尽管存在缺陷，但该法体现了“我们的政治愿望和目标”。）

The second law, promulgated by the NPC in 1986, most likely to make foreign investment even more attractive than joint ventures, was the "Foreign-Capital Enterprises Law," which allowed foreign investors to set up wholly owned firms in China. The law included only a small number of general provisions, but, like the law on joint ventures, it encouraged wholly owned foreign firms to introduce advanced technology, source locally, and export their products in exchange for tax benefits.43 The State Council issued a far more detailed regulation on wholly owned foreign firms in 1990, with more specific, but also restrictive, provisions. Most important, foreign investors were allowed to set up wholly owned firms only if (1) they brought in advanced technology and equipment; (2) they could manufacture products to substitute imports; or (3) they could earn enough hard currency to cover their foreign exchange expenses.

第二部法律是全国人大于1986年颁布的《外商投资企业法》，这部法律很可能使外商投资比合资企业更具吸引力。该法允许外国投资者在中国设立独资企业。该法仅包含少量一般性规定，但与合资企业法一样，鼓励外商独资企业引进先进技术、本地采购并出口产品，以换取税收优惠。1990年，国务院颁布了更为详细的关于外商独资企业的规定，其中包含更具体但也更具限制性的规定。最重要的是，外国投资者只有在满足以下条件时才能设立独资企业：（1）引进先进技术和设备；（2）生产可替代进口产品；或（3）赚取足够的硬通货以支付外汇支出。

China also kept many sectors—media, broadcasting, films, domestic retail, foreign trade, insurance, and telecommunications—off-limits to wholly owned foreign firms. Other sectors, such as public utilities, transportation, and real estate, were open to foreign investment but only with severe restrictions. Furthermore, all wholly owned foreign investment was subject to a national security review.44

中国还禁止外商独资企业进入许多行业，例如媒体、广播、电影、国内零售、对外贸易、保险和电信。其他行业，例如公共事业、交通运输和房地产，虽然对外国投资开放，但也受到严格限制。此外，所有外商独资企业都必须接受国家安全审查。

In the late 1980s the Chinese government passed another law, the "Chinese-Foreign Contractual Joint Ventures Law," making it attractive for foreign companies to bring intellectual property rights and management know-how to China in lieu of capital.45 These three laws, which were later revised several times to make them more liberal, laid a legal foundation to attract foreign capital and technology. But based on their still relatively restrictive provisions, which likely reflected both conservative opposition and lingering distrust of foreign capital, it is doubtful that these three laws on their own played a pivotal role in persuading foreign investors to bring their capital to a country that had yet to establish a record as a safe and welcoming place for outsiders. Despite Deng's heroic efforts to welcome foreign investment, only a modest amount of foreign capital actually flowed into China in the 1980s.

20世纪80年代末，中国政府颁布了另一部法律——《中外合资企业法》，旨在吸引外国公司以知识产权和管理经验代替资金投入中国。这三部法律后来经过多次修订，变得更加宽松，为吸引外资和技术奠定了法律基础。但由于其条款仍然相对严格，这可能反映了保守派的反对和对外国资本挥之不去的不信任，因此，这三部法律本身是否在说服外国投资者将资金投入中国方面发挥了关键作用，令人怀疑。毕竟，当时中国尚未树立起安全友好的形象。尽管邓小平为吸引外资做出了巨大努力，但20世纪80年代实际流入中国的外国资本数量仍然有限。





Special Economic Zones





经济特区


A tentative but politically bold step taken by Deng and fellow reformers in the late 1970s was the establishment of SEZs. To be sure, the idea of attracting foreign investors by providing tax benefits and other privileges to set up shop in a designated jurisdiction for export-processing was not a Chinese invention. Taiwan, South Korea, Malaysia, and other countries in Asia had pioneered export-processing zones (EPZs) in the 1960s to promote labor-intensive exports.46 However, for a country with fresh memories of Western "concessions" (areas within China where Westerners had exercised quasi-sovereign control) during the pre-1949 era, the creation of zones that would grant foreign investors privileges that were denied to Chinese people was fraught with political risks.

20世纪70年代末，邓小平及其改革伙伴采取了一项试探性但政治上大胆的举措——设立经济特区。诚然，通过提供税收优惠和其他特权吸引外国投资者在指定区域设立出口加工企业，这种做法并非中国首创。早在20世纪60年代，台湾、韩国、马来西亚和其他亚洲国家就已率先设立出口加工区，以促进劳动密集型出口。然而，对于一个对1949年以前西方“租界”（西方人在中国境内行使准主权控制权的区域）记忆犹新的国家而言，设立给予外国投资者特权而中国公民却无法享受的特区，无疑充满了政治风险。

But the potential ideological and nationalist backlash did not deter Deng. In April 1979 he responded enthusiastically to a proposal made by Xi Zhongxun (then the party chief of Guangdong) and Yang Shangkun (a close ally of Deng) to set up EPZs in Shenzhen, Zhuhai, and Shantou, three underdeveloped areas close to Hong Kong. The only twist was Deng's suggestion that they be called "special zones" (tequ). According to him, the central government would give policy preferences instead of money to attract foreign businesses to these zones. Due to his intervention, in July 1979 the central leadership approved requests from Guangdong and Fujian for special policy treatment and flexibility, and by May 1980 the central government formally approved the establishment of four SEZs—in Shenzhen, Zhuhai, Shantou, and Xiamen.47 Shenzhen was by far the largest: Even though at the time it was only a small fishing village with a population of thirty thousand, the entire territory of over 327 square kilometers was allocated for the SEZ. China made Shenzhen the largest SEZ because it bordered Hong Kong and could attract investment from the then-British colony. The other three SEZs were much smaller: Zhuhai, which bordered Macao, consisted of only 14 square kilometers, and Shantou was only 6 square kilometers. Initially, only one district in Xiamen was designated as an SEZ, but in 1985 the central government expanded the Xiamen SEZ to include the entire city, with 131 square kilometers of land.48

但潜在的意识形态和民族主义反弹并未阻止邓小平。1979年4月，他积极响应了时任广东省委书记习近平和邓小平的亲密盟友杨尚坤提出的在深圳、珠海和汕头这三个靠近香港的欠发达地区设立出口加工区的提议。唯一的不同之处在于，邓小平建议将这些地区称为“特区”。他认为，中央政府将以政策优惠而非资金来吸引外国企业入驻这些特区。由于他的斡旋，1979年7月，中央领导批准了广东和福建提出的特殊政策待遇和灵活性请求。到1980年5月，中央政府正式批准设立四个经济特区——深圳、珠海、汕头和厦门。深圳是其中规模最大的：尽管当时它只是一个拥有三万人口的小渔村，但超过327平方公里的整个区域都被划为经济特区。中国之所以将深圳设立为最大的经济特区，是因为它毗邻香港，可以吸引来自当时英国殖民地香港的投资。其他三个经济特区规模小得多：与澳门接壤的珠海仅有14平方公里，汕头只有6平方公里。最初，厦门只有一个区被划为经济特区，但1985年，中央政府扩大了厦门经济特区的范围，将整个厦门市纳入其中，面积达131平方公里。

The primary objective in establishing the SEZs was to attract FDI and to set up export-processing factories to earn foreign exchange.49 The NPC passed special legislation in August 1980 on Guangdong's SEZs that offered foreign investors favorable tax treatment and operational autonomy. For example, such investors could form wholly owned firms in the SEZs so as to retain full management control, a privilege denied to foreign investors elsewhere in the country. Those firms operating in the SEZs could import their equipment and materials duty-free. Furthermore, their profits would be taxed at only 15 percent, and additional tax subsidies would be made available for firms that invested more than $5 million or reinvested their profits in the SEZs. In return, firms in the SEZs were required to export their products.50

设立经济特区的主要目标是吸引外商直接投资，并建立出口加工厂以赚取外汇。1980年8月，全国人大通过了关于广东省经济特区的特别立法，为外国投资者提供优惠的税收待遇和经营自主权。例如，这些投资者可以在经济特区内设立全资子公司，从而保留完全的管理控制权，这是外国投资者在全国其他地区无法享有的特权。在经济特区内经营的企业可以免税进口设备和原材料。此外，其利润税率仅为15%，对于在经济特区内投资超过500万美元或将利润再投资的企业，还将提供额外的税收补贴。作为回报，经济特区内的企业必须出口其产品。

Despite the enormous attention given to the SEZs, their direct contribution to China's economic development in the 1980s was modest because they were established in underdeveloped jurisdictions (except for Xiamen). In 1980 the four SEZs accounted for only 0.2 percent of China's industrial output. In 1989, although their contribution had grown sixfold, it was still only 1.3 percent of the country's total industrial output. But in many ways the SEZs were stunning economic successes. Their growth was much higher than the national average at the time (Shenzhen's industrial output grew, on average, 20 percent per year between 1981 and 1992, compared with 14 percent for the national average). The SEZs also attracted $4.1 billion in utilized FDI between 1980 and 1989, roughly 26 percent of China's total utilized FDI during the same period.51 Exports from the four SEZs recorded explosive growth in the 1980s. Between 1983 and 1989, exports from these areas rose seventeenfold. Their share of China's total exports grew from 1 percent in 1983 to 6.4 percent in 1989.52 Of all the SEZs, Shenzhen is undoubtedly the greatest success story. Within three decades, it was transformed into a mega-city (with a population of over twelve million in 2020), a manufacturing center of electronics, and a high-tech cluster.53

尽管经济特区备受关注，但由于它们大多设立在欠发达地区（厦门除外），因此在20世纪80年代，它们对中国经济发展的直接贡献有限。1980年，四个经济特区的工业产值仅占中国工业总产值的0.2%。1989年，尽管其贡献增长了六倍，但仍仅占全国工业总产值的1.3%。然而，在许多方面，经济特区都取得了令人瞩目的经济成就。它们的增长速度远高于当时的全国平均水平（1981年至1992年间，深圳的工业产值年均增长20%，而全国平均水平为14%）。 1980年至1989年间，经济特区吸引了41亿美元的外商直接投资，约占同期中国外商直接投资总额的26%。51 20世纪80年代，四个经济特区的出口实现了爆炸式增长。1983年至1989年间，这些地区的出口增长了17倍。它们占中国出口总额的份额从1983年的1%增长到1989年的6.4%。52 在所有经济特区中，深圳无疑是最成功的。短短三十年间，深圳就发展成为一座超级大都市（2020年人口超过1200万）、电子产品制造中心和高科技产业集群。53

Several factors, such as the preferential treatment of foreign capital, local autonomy, and proximity and historical ties to Hong Kong (in the case of Shenzhen) and Taiwan (in the case of Xiamen), lay behind the success of the SEZs. But perhaps the single most important favorable factor was the invisible institutional factor. Specifically, the institutions of the Leninist party-state, in particular the command economy, were the least embedded in the most successful SEZ. (In Shenzhen, the private sector accounted for more than three-quarters of economic output in 1992.) The private sector could flourish without the stifling control of the state, as illustrated by the contrast between two successful SEZs, Shenzhen and Xiamen. In 1980 Shenzhen's industrial output was only 84 million yuan, less than 10 percent of Xiamen's 943 million yuan. But by 1989 Shenzhen's industrial output had risen to 11.6 billion yuan, twice that of Xiamen's industrial output.54

经济特区的成功背后有诸多因素，例如对外国资本的优惠待遇、地方自治以及与香港（深圳）和台湾（厦门）的地理邻近性和历史渊源。但或许最重要的有利因素是无形的制度因素。具体而言，列宁主义党国体制，尤其是计划经济体制，在最成功的经济特区中根深蒂固程度最低。（1992年，深圳私营部门的经济产出占比超过四分之三。）私营部门能够在摆脱国家严密控制的情况下蓬勃发展，深圳和厦门这两个成功的经济特区的对比便是最好的例证。1980年，深圳的工业产值仅为8400万元，不到厦门9.43亿元的10%。但到1989年，深圳的工业产值已增长至116亿元，是厦门的两倍。

In addition to FDI and exports, the SEZs generated substantial intangible and indirect benefits for China. This experiment in opening to the outside world yielded valuable lessons about how to integrate with the global economy via investment and trade. The knowledge gained from this learn-by-doing process gave the reformers, led by Zhao Ziyang, the confidence to turn the entire coastal area into de facto SEZs in the late 1980s (the plan was fully implemented in the 1990s, even after the ouster of Zhao in 1989).55

除了吸引外商直接投资和出口外，经济特区还为中国带来了大量的无形和间接收益。这一对外开放的尝试，为中国如何通过投资和贸易融入全球经济积累了宝贵的经验。从这一实践中汲取的知识，使赵紫阳领导的改革派在20世纪80年代末更有信心将整个沿海地区改造成事实上的经济特区（该计划在20世纪90年代得到全面实施，即便赵紫阳在1989年被罢黜）。





Foreign Trade Reform





对外贸易改革


Integration with the international economy—Deng's "opening"—meant a dramatic rise in China's foreign trade. The country's economic growth could be increased substantially if it took advantage of its comparative advantage in cheap labor and export labor-intensive manufactures.56 During the Maoist era, however, China had pursued a development strategy that favored heavy industry and sought import substitution, contrary to its comparative advantage. More important, China's self-imposed isolation and hostility to both the capitalist West and the Soviet bloc isolated its economy from international trade. In 1978, on the eve of reform, China's foreign trade was only 10 percent of its GDP.57 Even this figure exaggerated China's trade openness because of the significant overvaluation of the Chinese currency. In addition, China's GDP itself was undervalued. If both the GDP and the exchange rates were adjusted using market-based measures, China's trade openness at the start of the reform would have been 5–6 percent of GDP, nearly half of the nominal figure.58

与国际经济一体化——邓小平所说的“开放”——意味着中国对外贸易的大幅增长。如果中国能够利用其廉价劳动力方面的比较优势，出口劳动密集型制成品，其经济增长就能显著提升。然而，在毛泽东时代，中国奉行的发展战略却偏重重工业，并寻求进口替代，这与自身的比较优势背道而驰。更重要的是，中国自我封闭，对资本主义西方和苏联集团都抱有敌意，这使得中国经济与国际贸易隔绝。1978年，改革开放前夕，中国的对外贸易额仅占其GDP的10%。即使是这个数字，由于人民币被严重高估，也夸大了中国的贸易开放程度。此外，中国的GDP本身也被低估了。如果采用市场化方法调整国内生产总值和汇率，中国改革之初的贸易开放度将占国内生产总值的5%至6%，几乎是名义数字的一半。

Ironically, the closed nature of the Chinese economy and its inefficient development strategy that favored capital-intensive heavy industry implied that the country could boost its foreign trade and reap dramatic productivity gains if it reformed its foreign trade system. Parallel to the efforts to attract FDI, Chinese leaders also launched a series of reforms to promote exports and make the foreign trade system more efficient.

具有讽刺意味的是，中国经济的封闭性和其偏重资本密集型重工业的低效发展战略意味着，如果中国改革其对外贸易体制，就能促进对外贸易并取得显著的生产力提升。在努力吸引外商直接投资的同时，中国领导人也启动了一系列改革，以促进出口并提高对外贸易体制的效率。

Because the state monopolized foreign trade through specialized central foreign trade organizations (FTOs), firms could conduct trade only through these monopolies. The first step was to dismantle these monopolies through administrative decentralization. Provincial governments and their FTOs were thus allowed to directly engage in foreign trade. Once the central monopoly was broken, the impact of decentralization was instant and dramatic, as shown by the rapid increase in Chinese foreign trade (table 2.2).59

由于国家通过专门的中央外贸组织（FTO）垄断了对外贸易，企业只能通过这些垄断机构进行贸易。第一步是通过行政权力下放来打破这些垄断。省级政府及其下属的外贸组织由此被允许直接从事对外贸易。中央垄断被打破后，权力下放的影响立竿见影且十分显著，中国对外贸易的快速增长便证明了这一点（表2.2）。

However, foreign trade reform was no smooth sailing. During the economic retrenchment campaign launched by Chen Yun in 1981-1983, foreign trade was recentralized with a permit system, ostensibly to regulate it and avoid excessive competition among provincial foreign trade firms that depressed the prices of Chinese exports.60 But the conservative backlash fizzled out quickly, and a far more market-oriented round of foreign trade reforms took place in 1984-1986. New measures allowed large firms to directly engage in foreign trade by bypassing the state foreign trade organizations. Additionally, the Ministry of Foreign Economic Relations and Trade (MOFERT) was stripped of its authority to supervise the business activities of local FTOs, which could then become the real middlemen in foreign trade.

然而，外贸改革并非一帆风顺。在陈云于1981年至1983年发起的经济紧缩运动期间，外贸实行了许可证制度，表面上是为了规范外贸，避免省级外贸企业之间过度竞争压低中国出口商品价格。但保守派的反弹很快平息，1984年至1986年，一轮更加市场化的外贸改革接踵而至。新措施允许大型企业绕过国家外贸机构直接从事外贸活动。此外，对外经济贸易部也被剥夺了对地方外贸企业经营活动的监管权，这些企业由此成为外贸中真正的中间商。

The number of FTOs therefore rose rapidly to about eight hundred in the country. Incentives for exports were enhanced by allowing firms to retain a larger share of their hard currency earnings and to swap their retained hard currency at designated foreign exchange swap centers at market rates instead of at the overvalued official rate, thus converting their hard currency at more favorable rates. In the second half of the 1980s, China restricted state planning of foreign trade to major commodities (such as crude oil, rice, minerals, poultry, and steel), allowing all other goods (mostly manufactures) to be traded without administrative controls. Even though the government set general export targets, MOFERT stopped making and issuing specific export plans.61 Complementary market-oriented reforms were implemented as well. The (overvalued) Chinese currency was devalued repeatedly. Subsidies for foreign trade were reduced. A system of tax rebates was introduced to encourage processing trade (which involved the import of components without tariffs for assembly and re-export).62 These initial reforms led to an instant and rapid increase in foreign trade (see table 2.2). Total foreign trade rose fivefold, from $20 billion to $102 billion between 1978 and 1988. Exports registered an increase of similar magnitude. As manufactured goods began to account for a growing share of exports, China's foreign trade structure improved significantly. In 1980 manufactured goods accounted for about one-half of total exports; by 1989 manufactured goods constituted 71 percent of total exports.63

因此，全国的自由贸易组织数量迅速增长至约八百家。为了鼓励出口，政府允许企业保留更多外汇收入，并允许企业在指定的外汇兑换中心按市场汇率而非高估的官方汇率兑换外汇，从而以更优惠的汇率兑换外汇。20世纪80年代后半期，中国将对外贸易的国家计划限制在主要商品（如原油、大米、矿产、家禽和钢铁）上，允许所有其他商品（主要是制成品）在不受行政管制的情况下进行贸易。尽管政府设定了总体出口目标，但经济和贸易部停止制定和发布具体的出口计划。此外，政府还实施了一系列配套的市场化改革。人民币（此前被高估）多次贬值，对外贸易补贴也相应减少。为了鼓励加工贸易（即免税进口零部件进行组装后再出口），政府引入了退税制度。这些初期改革使对外贸易迅速增长（见表2.2）。1978年至1988年间，对外贸易总额增长了五倍，从200亿美元增至1020亿美元。出口额也实现了类似的增长。随着制成品在出口中所占份额不断增加，中国的对外贸易结构显著改善。1980年，制成品约占出口总额的一半；到1989年，制成品占出口总额的71%。

As a whole, after one decade of reform, the Chinese economy had become much more open. In 1978 foreign trade accounted for only about 10 percent of the economy based on the exchange rate; by 1988 it had risen to 27 percent.64 Greater openness allowed the economy to grow faster. One study estimates that exports increased China's economic growth by one percentage point per year between 1981 and 1988.65 Research on the benefits of China's opening to the world has also yielded evidence that the growth of foreign trade after 1979 led to the emergence of dynamic regional manufacturing clusters, technological upgrading, and improvements in productivity.66

总体而言，经过十年的改革，中国经济的开放程度显著提高。1978年，按汇率计算，外贸仅占经济总量的约10%；到1988年，这一比例上升至27%。64 开放程度的提高促进了经济增长。一项研究估计，1981年至1988年间，出口使中国经济增长率每年提高一个百分点。65 关于中国对外开放益处的研究也表明，1979年后外贸的增长促进了充满活力的区域制造业集群的出现、技术升级和生产率的提高。66

However, China's reform of its foreign trade regime was far from complete. It maintained a dual-exchange-rate system that distorted prices (unification of exchange rates did not occur until 1994). Most firms still could not engage directly in foreign trade, hampering competition and efficiency. Nominal tariff rates remained high, although the effective tariff rate was lower because many imports—machinery and inputs for export processing—were tax exempt. Licenses and nontariff barriers were widely used to protect domestic industries (mainly SOEs).67

然而，中国的对外贸易体制改革远未完成。它仍然维持着双重汇率制度，扭曲了物价（汇率统一直到1994年才实现）。大多数企业仍然无法直接从事对外贸易，阻碍了竞争和效率的提升。名义关税税率仍然很高，尽管由于许多进口商品——例如机械和出口加工所需的投入品——免税，实际关税税率较低。许可证制度和非关税壁垒被广泛用于保护国内产业（主要是国有企业）。





Rise of the Private Sector





私营部门的崛起


The rapid emergence and expansion of the private sector in the 1980s was not the result of a planned or concerted effort by the party. In fact, the party did not anticipate the rise of the private sector, nor did it actively promote the sector, due to conservative opposition. Instead, reformers took tentative steps to enable the private sector gradually to gain legal status and economic freedom. Unlike in the former Soviet bloc, where the private sector emerged mostly as the result of the privatization of SOEs after the fall of communism, the emergence of the private sector in China was marked by the entry of a huge number of small firms and "creeping privatization" of state-owned assets.68 Throughout the 1980s the dynamism of the private sector, which was practically nonexistent on the eve of reform, created a new engine of economic growth that fundamentally reshaped the Chinese economy and contributed to its long-term success, arguably more than any other policy or reform. As a result, it is reasonable to claim that China's economic success was more one of "growing out of the plan" than of reforming inefficient SOEs.69

20世纪80年代私营经济的迅速崛起和扩张并非党的计划或协调努力的结果。事实上，由于保守派的反对，党既没有预料到私营经济的崛起，也没有积极推动私营经济的发展。相反，改革者采取了试探性的措施，逐步赋予私营经济法律地位和经济自由。与前苏联集团国家私营经济的兴起主要源于共产主义垮台后国有企业的私有化不同，中国私营经济的兴起以大量小型企业的涌入和国有资产的“渐进式私有化”为标志。在整个80年代，私营经济的蓬勃发展——在改革前夕几乎不存在——创造了新的经济增长引擎，从根本上重塑了中国经济，并对其长期成功做出了贡献，其作用或许超过了任何其他政策或改革。因此，可以说中国的经济成功更多地源于“计划的逐步实现”，而非对低效国有企业的改革。

The best summary of this process of growing out of the plan was provided by Zhao Ziyang, the premier in charge of the economy during most of the 1980s. According to Zhao, one of the most important aspects of China's economic reform in the decade was the gradual growth and strengthening of a new market economy that consisted of TVEs, private firms, and foreign-invested firms. The new market economy existed outside the planned economy and operated according to market rules. Due to their efficiency and dynamism, such firms grew much faster than the state-owned firms. Consequently, even as the planned economy remained fundamentally unreformed, the share of the market economy continued to rise, and over time this development changed the nature of the Chinese economy.70

对这一摆脱计划经济体制的过程，最精辟的总结来自赵紫阳，他在20世纪80年代的大部分时间里担任中国经济总理。赵紫阳认为，中国在80年代经济改革中最重要的方面之一，是新兴市场经济的逐步发展壮大。新兴市场经济由乡镇企业、民营企业和外商投资企业组成。这种新兴市场经济独立于计划经济之外，并按照市场规则运行。由于其高效性和活力，这类企业的增长速度远超国有企业。因此，尽管计划经济的根本改革尚未完成，但市场经济的份额却持续上升，随着时间的推移，这一发展改变了中国经济的性质。

In hindsight, the benefits of growing out of the plan are self-evident. The dynamics are simple but powerful. Because private firms are more efficient, they grow faster and can, over time, take market share away from state firms and account for a higher proportion of economic output.71 The growth of the private sector and the commensurate decline of the state sector—the defining characteristic of growing out of the plan—can be seen in the economic statistics of the 1980s (and subsequent decades). In absolute terms, the state sector grew in the 1980s, but because the nonstate sector (mostly private firms) grew much faster, the latter gained a greater share of economic output. Official data show that the industrial output of SOEs rose from 367 billion to 1.234 trillion yuan from 1979 to 1989, while the nonstate sector grew from 100 billion yuan to 967 billion yuan.72 As a result, the share of industrial output attributed to SOEs declined from nearly 78 percent to 56 percent between 1979 and 1989 (table 2.3).

事后看来，摆脱计划经济的益处显而易见。其背后的逻辑简单却意义深远。由于私营企业效率更高，它们增长更快，随着时间的推移，能够从国有企业手中夺取市场份额，并在经济产出中占据更高的比例。私营部门的增长和国有部门的相应萎缩——这是摆脱计划经济的显著特征——可以从20世纪80年代（以及随后几十年）的经济统计数据中看出。从绝对值来看，国有部门在20世纪80年代有所增长，但由于非国有部门（主要是私营企业）的增长速度更快，后者在经济产出中所占的份额更大。官方数据显示，1979年至1989年，国有企业的工业产值从3670亿元人民币增长到1.234万亿元人民币，而非国有企业的工业产值从1000亿元人民币增长到9670亿元人民币。因此，1979年至1989年，国有企业工业产值占工业总产值的比重从近78%下降到56%（表2.3）。

Economically, growing out of the plan helped sustain growth and avoid the decline in economic output that had characterized the transition experience in the former Soviet bloc. The superior economic efficiency of the private sector also created competitive pressures on the state sector and accelerated its relative decline in the post-Mao era. Politically, growing out of the plan allowed Chinese reformers in the 1980s to build up political capital quickly while shelving the more difficult task of reforming the SOEs, a step almost certain to precipitate a confrontation with conservatives opposed to dismantling the economic foundation of the party-state. At the same time, it created winners and avoided making powerful groups losers, at least at the crucial initial stage of reform.73

从经济角度来看，摆脱计划经济体制有助于维持增长，避免像前苏联集团转型时期那样出现经济产出下滑。私营部门更高的经济效率也对国有部门构成竞争压力，加速了其在后毛泽东时代相对衰落的进程。从政治角度来看，摆脱计划经济体制使20世纪80年代的中国改革者得以迅速积累政治资本，同时搁置了更为艰巨的国有企业改革任务——这一举措几乎必然会引发与反对拆除党国经济基础的保守派之间的冲突。与此同时，这种模式也造就了赢家，避免了某些强大的利益集团成为输家，至少在改革的关键初期阶段是如此。

However, growing out of the plan had serious limitations. Because the party continued to favor inefficient SOEs and failed to provide secure property rights and a level playing field for the private sector, China's private entrepreneurs operated in an unfavorable regulatory and institutional environment that severely constrained their potential. The economic benefits generated by the rapid growth of the private sector reduced pressures to reform the inefficient SOEs until the end of the 1990s, resulting in ever-increasing subsidies to SOEs that ultimately contributed to an accumulation of bad loans in the state-owned banking system. China's hybrid economy also generated abundant opportunities for rent-seeking because the resources under the control of the state sector, such as the regulatory approvals, land, and bank credits, could be allocated through administrative means to well-connected private entrepreneurs and families of officials.74 As Zhao Ziyang observed after his downfall, the coexistence of two fundamentally different economic systems—a favored state sector and a dynamic private sector—produced significant negative effects on the economy. Although it was wise to adopt growing out of the plan as a transitional strategy, it would stop working in the long term.75

然而，按照既定计划发展存在严重的局限性。由于党继续偏袒效率低下的国有企业，未能为私营部门提供安全的产权保障和公平的竞争环境，中国的私营企业家在不利的监管和制度环境下经营，其潜力受到严重制约。私营部门快速增长带来的经济效益降低了改革效率低下的国有企业的压力，这种情况一直持续到20世纪90年代末，导致对国有企业的补贴不断增加，最终造成国有银行体系不良贷款的累积。中国的混合经济也为寻租提供了大量机会，因为国有部门控制的资源，例如监管审批、土地和银行信贷，可以通过行政手段分配给关系密切的私营企业家和官员家族。正如赵紫阳在下台后所观察到的，两种截然不同的经济体系——一个受优待的国有部门和一个充满活力的私营部门——的并存，对经济产生了显著的负面影响。虽然采用逐步退出原计划的过渡策略是明智的，但从长远来看，这种策略将不再奏效。





Emergence of the Private Sector





私营部门的兴起


The party's primary focus of economic reform in urban areas in the 1980s was on the SOEs. Ironically, the private sector thrived during the decade, even though the party did not provide meaningful economic incentives to promote it. The most the party did was to create the minimal legal or policy space needed for the private sector to emerge and exist, even though this process was slow, gradual, and tentative. The party opened the door slightly for the private sector in July 1981 when the State Council issued a document permitting the establishment of individually operated businesses (geti jingji) in the urban areas. The document, "Several Policy Provisions on Nonagricultural Individually Operated Economic Activities in Urban Areas," allowed private entrepreneurs to hire up to seven employees and operate mainly micro service businesses, such as retail, restaurants, handicrafts, and residential renovation.76 Shortly thereafter, with its major overhaul of the Chinese constitution in 1982, the party officially recognized the legal existence of the geti jingji. Article 11 of the amended constitution states that "economic activities of individual laborers conducted within legally permitted scopes are an auxiliary of the socialist state-owned economy. The state protects the legal rights and interests of individually operated economic activities. The state, through administrative means, guides, assists, and supervises such economic activities."77 (The constitution was amended again in 1988, 1993, 1999, and 2004 to provide greater protections for the private sector.) At the beginning of 1983, the party took another small step by allowing rural residents to engage in nonagricultural activities and, more important, to purchase tractors, motor vehicles, and boats to operate in transportation businesses.78

20世纪80年代，中共在城市地区推行经济改革的重点是国有企业。讽刺的是，尽管中共并未提供有效的经济激励措施来促进私营经济的发展，但私营经济却在这一时期蓬勃发展。中共所做的，仅仅是为私营经济的出现和存在创造了最低限度的法律和政策空间，尽管这一过程缓慢、渐进且充满不确定性。1981年7月，国务院发布文件允许在城市地区设立个体经营企业，这标志着中共为私营经济打开了一扇小门。该文件名为《关于城市非农个体经济活动的若干政策规定》，允许个体经营者雇用最多7名员工，主要从事零售、餐饮、手工艺品制作、房屋装修等微型服务业。此后不久，随着1982年对中国宪法的重大修改，中共正式承认了个体经营企业的合法地位。经修订的宪法第十一条规定：“个体劳动者在法律允许的范围内进行的经济活动是社会主义国有经济的辅助手段。国家保护个体经营经济活动的合法权益。国家通过行政手段指导、协助和监督这种经济活动。”77（宪法分别于1988年、1993年、1999年和2004年再次修订，以加强对私营部门的保护。）1983年初，党又迈出了一小步，允许农村居民从事非农业活动，更重要的是，允许他们购买拖拉机、汽车和船只从事运输业务。78

As the private sector began to grow and prosper, the conservatives pushed back. Chen Yun, Deng's ideological rival who was adamantly opposed to the rise of a private sector, launched a campaign against "economic crimes" in 1982.79 In 1985 he and his followers manufactured a national scandal, the so-called Case of Fake Medicines in Jinjiang. Private entrepreneurs producing food supplements in Jinjiang, Fujian province, were falsely accused of turning out counterfeit medicines on a massive scale. Shortly thereafter, Chen engineered the ouster of the reformist provincial party chief, Xiang Nan, blaming him for the scandal.80

随着私营经济的蓬勃发展，保守派开始反扑。邓小平的意识形态对手陈云坚决反对私营经济的崛起，于1982年发起了一场打击“经济犯罪”的运动。1985年，他及其追随者炮制了一起全国性的丑闻，即所谓的晋江假药案。福建省晋江市生产保健品的私营企业被诬告大规模生产假药。此后不久，陈云策划罢免了改革派省委书记向南，并将丑闻的责任归咎于他。

The most potent tactic deployed by the conservatives was attacking the widespread practice of private firms employing more than seven workers (the legal limit was up to and including seven workers). As they thrived, private entrepreneurs had to expand by employing more workers, thus running up against the legal limit imposed by the State Council's 1981 document on geti jingji. It was Deng's personal intervention in 1984 that apparently prevented the conservatives from cracking down on the private sector.

保守派最有力的策略是打击私营企业普遍存在的雇佣超过七名员工的做法（法定上限为七名员工）。随着私营企业的发展壮大，企业家们不得不通过雇佣更多员工来扩张规模，从而触及了国务院1981年《关于私营企业的规定》所规定的法定上限。邓小平在1984年的亲自干预，显然阻止了保守派对私营企业的打压。

At a meeting with revolutionary veterans on the Central Advisory Committee in 1984, the conservatives clamored for punishment of successful private entrepreneurs (in particular, a flamboyant private entrepreneur who had hired over a hundred workers and had made a fortune by selling snacks). But Deng pushed back hard. "Based on my view," he declared, "we should not deal with the issue of hiring labor [above the limit of seven] for two years. Can [allowing the private entrepreneur to do business] upset our overall situation? But if you touch him [the entrepreneur], the people will say that [our] policy has changed. Confidence would be shaken. Let 'Idiot Seeds' [the brand of snacks sold by the entrepreneur] do its business for a period. What is there to be afraid of?"81

1984年，在与中央顾问委员会革命老兵的一次会议上，保守派人士强烈要求惩罚成功的私营企业家（特别是那位雇佣了一百多名工人、靠卖零食发家致富的张扬企业家）。但邓小平坚决反对。他宣称：“依我之见，两年内不要处理雇佣工人（超过七人上限）的问题。（允许这位私营企业家继续经营）会扰乱我们的大局吗？但如果动他（这位企业家），人民就会说（我们的）政策变了，信心就会动摇。就让‘傻瓜种子’（这位企业家卖的零食品牌）做一段时间吧，有什么好怕的呢？”

It was not until April 1988 that the party formally endorsed private businesses (siying qiye), when the NPC amended the constitution to permit the private sector to exist and develop. Compared with the constitutional amendment passed in 1982, which allowed only individually run private businesses (geti jingji), the constitutional recognition and protection of the private sector in 1988 represented a major ideological breakthrough, even though by that time the private sector had already been thriving in a vast legal gray area for the better part of the decade.82 In June 1988 the State Council issued a landmark document granting private businesses most of the rights they needed to operate and grow. The key provisions of the document, known as "The PRC Interim Regulations on Private Businesses," include permission to hire more than eight workers, limited liability, an expanded scope of business, the right to hire and fire workers and to set their compensation, and the right to enter into joint ventures, to engage in transactions with foreign companies, to conduct foreign trade, and to have access to bank credit.83

直到1988年4月，党才正式认可私营企业，全国人大修改宪法，允许私营企业存在和发展。与1982年仅允许个体经营的私营企业相比，1988年宪法对私营企业的承认和保护是一项重大的思想突破，尽管在此之前，私营企业已经在法律灰色地带蓬勃发展了近十年。1988年6月，国务院发布了一份具有里程碑意义的文件，赋予私营企业经营和发展所需的大部分权利。这份名为《中华人民共和国民营企业暂行规定》的文件的主要条款包括：允许雇用八名以上员工、有限责任、扩大经营范围、有权雇佣和解雇员工并确定其薪酬、有权成立合资企业、与外国公司进行交易、开展对外贸易以及获得银行信贷。

Due to political support from the reformers, the private sector grew at an astonishing rate in the 1980s. At the end of 1978, the private sector, which employed only 150,000 individuals in household-run, or geti, micro businesses, was a negligible economic force. But by 1988 such micro businesses had mushroomed into 14.5 million firms, employing 23 million people.84 TVEs, most of which were private firms despite their official "collective" label, saw their employment grow from 28.3 million to 93.7 million between 1978 and 1989.85 As table 2.4 indicates, growth of the private sector in the 1980s was truly phenomenal.

由于改革者的政治支持，私营部门在20世纪80年代以惊人的速度增长。1978年底，私营部门仅雇佣了15万名家庭经营的微型企业（或称“geti”），其经济影响力微乎其微。但到1988年，这类微型企业已如雨后春笋般涌现，达到1450万家，雇佣了2300万人。尽管官方称之为“集体”企业，但大多数传统企业（TVE）的就业人数在1978年至1989年间从2830万增长到9370万。正如表2.4所示，20世纪80年代私营部门的增长堪称惊人。

Both individually owned businesses and foreign-invested businesses grew rapidly in the 1978-1989 decade (the contribution of firms in these two categories to industrial output grew from zero to more than 8 percent in just one decade). But the star performers in the private sector in the 1980s were undoubtedly the TVEs. Their output rose from 49 billion yuan to 742 billion yuan from 1978 to 1989, accounting for 21 percent of "total social output" in China in 1989.86

1978年至1989年间，个体户和外商投资企业都实现了快速增长（这两类企业对工业产出的贡献率在短短十年内从零增长到超过8%）。但20世纪80年代私营企业中的佼佼者无疑是乡镇企业。它们的产值从1978年的490亿元人民币增长到1989年的7420亿元人民币，占1989年中国“社会总产出”的21%。

Aside from the necessary political protection and regulatory framework that allowed the nascent private sector to exist and expand, several other factors also facilitated the rapid growth of the private sector. Some scholars attribute this phenomenon to the self-interests of the key actors, in particular the entrepreneurs themselves and the local officials. While the growing private businesses enabled entrepreneurs to build and accumulate wealth, the same development also helped local officials expand the sources of revenue, burnish their performance in employment and growth, and acquire private wealth from previously nonexistent opportunities for rent-seeking and self-enrichment.87

除了必要的政治保护和监管框架使得新兴的私营部门得以存在和发展之外，还有其他一些因素促进了私营部门的快速增长。一些学者将这种现象归因于关键参与者的自身利益，特别是企业家和地方官员的利益。私营企业的蓬勃发展使企业家能够积累财富，同时也帮助地方官员拓展了收入来源，提升了他们在就业和经济增长方面的业绩，并从以前不存在的寻租和中饱私囊的机会中攫取了私人财富。

However, other economic and political factors likely played a far more important and direct role in turbo-charging growth of the private sector. The most critical factor is the success of the decollectivization of agriculture. The virtuous cycle created by the rural reforms produced the essential conditions for the private sector to take root and thrive. On the supply side, higher productivity in the rural areas increased overall income, which boosted private savings for investment and in turn then allowed a small number of entrepreneurs to raise capital, either by borrowing from family, relatives, and friends or by tapping into their savings. Greater efficiency in rural production also freed up the surplus or the underutilized vast labor pool in the countryside, channeling them into the more productive manufacturing and service sectors.

然而，其他经济和政治因素可能在推动私营部门快速增长方面发挥了更为重要和直接的作用。其中最关键的因素是农业非集体化的成功。农村改革形成的良性循环为私营部门的生根发芽和蓬勃发展创造了必要条件。在供给侧，农村地区生产力的提高增加了总收入，从而促进了私人储蓄用于投资，进而使少数企业家能够筹集资金，他们可以通过向家人、亲戚和朋友借钱或动用自身储蓄来实现这一目标。农村生产效率的提高也释放了农村地区过剩或未充分利用的大量劳动力，并将他们引导至生产率更高的制造业和服务业。

On the demand side, higher rural productivity raised farmers' income and boosted their demand for consumer goods. At the same time, the economic distortions of the Maoist era had led to serious shortages of consumer goods and services, thus creating a huge backlog of demand that the private sector could meet. The demand for employment in the modern sector, which (the already bloated) SOEs could not meet, also forced the party to liberalize the economy so that the new private firms could absorb new entrants into the labor market (between 1980 and 1985 alone, more than thirty-seven million people in the urban areas needed employment).88

在需求方面，农村生产率的提高增加了农民的收入，并刺激了他们对消费品的需求。与此同时，毛泽东时代的经济扭曲导致消费品和服务严重短缺，从而造成了巨大的需求积压，而私营部门能够满足这些需求。现代部门的就业需求（国有企业已经臃肿不堪）也迫使党进行经济自由化改革，以便新的私营企业能够吸纳新进入劳动力市场的人员（仅在1980年至1985年间，城镇地区就有超过3700万人需要就业）。

Yet, despite such favorable conditions, private entrepreneurs nevertheless hedged their bets by disguising the ownership of their businesses. A popular method was to register as "collective enterprises" rather than as "private," or siying, firms (legally, the state did not formally endorse siying firms until 1988). In addition to the political protection, private businesses registered as "collective enterprises," in a practice known as "wearing red hats," so they could navigate the many regulatory obstacles to obtain business licenses and secure access to banking services and credit as well as to government contracts. To be sure, donning a "red hat" had its disadvantages as well because such private firms were effectively paying for political protection, and they had to bear extra financial burdens (such as forced contributions to local budgets and employment). Private entrepreneurs resorting to this survival strategy also exposed themselves to legal risks, such as disputes over the ownership of their assets and even criminal prosecution.89

然而，尽管条件如此有利，私营企业家仍然通过隐瞒企业所有权来规避风险。一种常见的做法是注册为“集体企业”，而不是“私人”或“公司”（在法律上，国家直到1988年才正式认可“公司”）。除了政治保护之外，私营企业注册为“集体企业”（这种做法被称为“戴红帽子”），是为了绕过获得营业执照、银行服务和信贷以及政府合同的诸多监管障碍。当然，“戴红帽子”也有其弊端，因为这些私营企业实际上是在为政治保护付费，并且不得不承担额外的经济负担（例如强制向地方预算缴纳费用和就业）。采取这种生存策略的私营企业家也面临着法律风险，例如资产所有权纠纷，甚至刑事诉讼。

Although wearing a "red hat" was widespread, the exact share of private firms among the TVEs is a matter of dispute.90 According to a 1995 survey conducted by the State Administration for Industry and Commerce (SAIC), of 178,000 "collective firms," roughly one in five of them had private majority ownership.91 This number almost certainly underestimates the share of private firms among collective firms. Yasheng Huang's research uncovers more convincing evidence that, based on data collected by the Ministry of Agriculture, nearly 90 percent of TVEs in 1985 were actually private firms.92

尽管“红帽”现象普遍存在，但中小微企业中私营企业的确切比例仍存在争议。90 根据国家工商行政管理总局1995年的一项调查，在17.8万家“集体企业”中，约有五分之一为私营控股企业。91 这个数字几乎肯定低估了私营企业在集体企业中所占的比例。黄亚生的研究揭示了更有力的证据，根据农业部收集的数据，1985年近90%的中小微企业实际上是私营企业。92

Entrepreneurs blazing the trail in the 1980s came from a wide range of social backgrounds, but a majority hailed from the countryside, again affirming the critical contribution of the rural reform to the transformation of the Chinese economy. According to a national survey of 1,187 owners of private firms in the countryside in 1991, 42 percent had served as village cadres, 19 percent had been principal officials of TVEs, 13 percent had been workers in TVEs, and 9 percent were former PLA soldiers. Another survey of 1,853 owners of private businesses (apparently based in urban areas), also conducted in 1991, shows that 30 percent had resigned from SOEs, 31 percent had been peasants, 16 percent had been self-employed, and 12 percent had been unemployed.93 In other words, most pioneers in the private sector came from outside the state sector.

20世纪80年代开创先河的企业家来自各行各业，但其中绝大多数来自农村，这再次印证了农村改革对中国经济转型的重要贡献。1991年一项针对1187名农村私营企业主的全国性调查显示，42%的人曾担任村干部，19%的人曾担任乡镇企业主要干部，13%的人曾是乡镇企业员工，9%的人曾是解放军退役军人。同年，另一项针对1853名私营企业主（显然位于城市地区）的调查显示，30%的人曾是国有企业员工，31%的人曾是农民，16%的人是个体户，12%的人处于失业状态。换句话说，私营领域的大多数开拓者都来自国有部门之外。





Reform of the SOEs





国有企业改革


On the eve of Deng's reform, SOEs dominated the modern sectors of the Chinese economy, accounting for 87 percent of the fiscal revenue of the state, 77.6 percent of industrial output, and 78 percent of urban employment.94

在邓小平改革前夕，国有企业主导着中国经济的现代部门，占国家财政收入的87%、工业产值的77.6%和城镇就业的78%。

However, like their counterparts in the former Soviet bloc, Chinese SOEs were plagued by systemic inefficiencies.95 As economic organizations, these firms were more like government bureaucracies than profit-seeking economic actors because they were administered by the government through directives governing nearly all operational matters. As part of a planned economy, they did not have the basic freedoms for business operations, such as determining what or how much to produce. Nor did the SOEs have control in matters such as the amount of labor to employ, the appointment of management, and compensation of workers and management, because it was the supervising government bureaucracies that made these decisions. Like the SOEs in the Communist regimes of the former Soviet bloc, Chinese SOEs had two critical institutional flaws: an absence of real owners and soft budget constraints. Nominally, the "state" owned these firms. In reality, there were no real owners but instead multiple bureaucracies (such as government agencies in charge of production planning, fiscal revenue, and labor-related issues) exercising control over them. This situation not only created conflicts of interest among stakeholders but also made it impossible for the SOEs to pursue economically efficient goals. The "soft budget constraints" meant that these firms were not responsible for their failure because they could always count on the state to bail them out.96

然而，与前苏联集团的国有企业一样，中国国有企业也饱受系统性效率低下的困扰。作为经济组织，这些企业更像是政府官僚机构，而非以盈利为目的的经济主体，因为它们几乎所有运营事项都受到政府指令的约束。作为计划经济的一部分，它们缺乏基本的商业运营自由，例如决定生产什么或生产多少。国有企业也无法控制诸如雇佣多少劳动力、任命管理人员以及员工和管理人员的薪酬等事项，因为这些决策都由监管的政府官僚机构做出。与前苏联集团共产主义政权的国有企业一样，中国国有企业存在两个关键的制度缺陷：缺乏真正的所有者和预算约束的松散性。名义上，“国家”拥有这些企业。但实际上，并没有真正的所有者，而是由多个官僚机构（例如负责生产计划、财政收入和劳工相关问题的政府机构）对它们行使控制权。这种情况不仅造成了利益相关者之间的利益冲突，也使得国有企业无法追求经济效益目标。“软性预算约束”意味着这些企业无需为自身的失败负责，因为它们总能指望国家出手相救。

The last systemic flaw of Chinese SOEs was their so-called policy burden. As an essential component of the party-state, SOEs had to perform many noneconomic roles that served the needs of the party, such as maintaining employment regardless of costs and providing social services, including healthcare, housing, childcare, and retirement income.97

中国国有企业的最后一个系统性缺陷是所谓的政策负担。作为党国体制的重要组成部分，国有企业必须承担许多服务于党的需要的非经济职能，例如不惜一切代价维持就业，以及提供包括医疗、住房、托幼和退休收入在内的社会服务。

Given the centrality of the SOEs in the Chinese economy and the daunting technical difficulties of restructuring these firms (practically all attempts to reform SOEs in the former Soviet bloc and Yugoslavia had ended in failure), reformers were forced to adopt a far more cautious and incremental approach.98 Their first step was to expand the autonomy of the SOEs and to grant more financial incentives to SOE management in the belief that greater operational freedoms and material rewards could improve their efficiency. After localized experiments in Sichuan and Beijing in early 1979 produced promising results, the State Council formally endorsed measures to expand the autonomy of SOEs in July 1979.99 According to "Several Provisions on Expanding Management Autonomy of State-owned Industrial Enterprises," the management of the SOEs could retain a portion of the profits, hire workers, appoint executives, and exercise a wide range of executive authority provided they fulfilled the targets set by the state.100

鉴于国有企业在中国经济中的核心地位，以及重组这些企业所面临的巨大技术难题（事实上，前苏联集团和南斯拉夫几乎所有国有企业改革尝试都以失败告终），改革者被迫采取更为谨慎和渐进的方式。他们的第一步是扩大国有企业的自主权，并向国有企业管理层提供更多财政激励，因为他们相信更大的运营自由和物质奖励可以提高其效率。 1979年初，四川和北京的试点项目取得了令人鼓舞的成果后，国务院于1979年7月正式批准了扩大国有企业自主权的措施。根据《关于扩大国有工业企业管理自主权的若干规定》，国有企业的管理层可以在完成国家设定的目标的前提下，保留一部分利润，雇用员工，任命管理人员，并行使广泛的管理权力。

However, the expanded autonomy quickly created its own problems, especially as the managers of the SOEs gamed the new policy to retain more profits, which led to less income for the state and an increase in budget deficits.101 To liberal economists, expansion of SOE management autonomy alone was unlikely to produce sustained improvements in SOE performance. Real SOE autonomy was impossible to achieve because the state kept most of the power that directly affected the performance and operations of the enterprises. Expanding SOE autonomy also worsened the "principal-agent" problem in the state-socialist system because it allowed managers to behave more opportunistically.102 Most important, because SOEs were part of the market, giving the enterprises autonomy when the market itself had systemic flaws was unlikely to work. Specifically, when prices were distorted, even enterprises with full autonomy could not respond to distorted markets or be responsible for profits and losses.103

然而，扩大的自主权很快就带来了自身的问题，尤其是国有企业管理者利用新政策谋取更多利润，导致国家收入减少，预算赤字增加。101 在自由主义经济学家看来，仅仅扩大国有企业管理自主权不太可能持续改善国有企业的绩效。真正的国有企业自主权无法实现，因为国家仍然掌握着直接影响企业绩效和运营的大部分权力。扩大国有企业自主权还会加剧国家社会主义体制中的“委托代理”问题，因为它允许管理者更加投机取巧。102 最重要的是，由于国有企业是市场的一部分，当市场本身存在系统性缺陷时，赋予企业自主权不太可能奏效。具体而言，当价格扭曲时，即使拥有完全自主权的企业也无法应对扭曲的市场，也无法对盈亏负责。103

Once it became clear that expanding the autonomy of the SOEs was an unpromising proposition, Chinese leaders began to look for alternatives. Liberal economists argued that a successful reform of SOEs would be possible only when it was part of a package of reforms of other institutions, such as prices, taxation, wages, social security, and the financial system, that directly affected the SOEs. But the party did not adopt their proposal for comprehensive reform.104

一旦扩大国有企业自主权的方案行不通，中国领导人便开始寻找替代方案。自由派经济学家认为，只有将国有企业改革与其他直接影响国有企业的制度改革（例如价格、税收、工资、社会保障和金融体系）相结合，才能成功。但党并未采纳他们的全面改革方案。

The alternative, which the party eventually settled on in 1986, was the "contract responsibility system" (chengbao zerenzhi). In essence, the contract responsibility system was an updated version of a 1981 government attempt to attach conditions to the autonomy of the SOEs.105 What made the reform proposed in 1986 different was its granting of full operational autonomy in return for commitments to fulfill fixed financial targets. A document issued by the State Council in February 1988 formalized this system (implementation had begun in 1987).106

最终，党在1986年确定了“合同责任制”。本质上，合同责任制是1981年政府试图为国有企业自主权附加条件的举措的升级版。1986年提出的改革方案的不同之处在于，它赋予国有企业完全的运营自主权，但要求其承诺完成既定的财务目标。国务院于1988年2月发布的文件正式确立了这一制度（该制度已于1987年开始实施）。

In terms of specifics, the "contract responsibility" of the SOEs consisted of meeting financial targets, such as profitability, growth, reduction of losses, capital investments, technological innovations, and tax payments. SOEs that reached these goals could retain more profits to provide higher compensation to workers.107 However, the contract responsibility system quickly proved to be a disappointment. Because of the heterogeneity of firms and their vastly different structural conditions (such as competition, supply, and demand) among industrial sectors, it was nearly impossible for the government to stipulate standard contracting terms or to set performance standards.108

具体而言，国有企业的“合同责任”包括实现盈利、增长、减少亏损、资本投资、技术创新和纳税等财务目标。达到这些目标的国有企业可以保留更多利润，从而为员工提供更高的薪酬。然而，合同责任制度很快就被证明是令人失望的。由于各行业的企业异质性以及它们之间巨大的结构性条件（例如竞争、供求关系）差异，政府几乎不可能制定标准合同条款或设定绩效标准。

Even worse, the contract responsibility system rewarded short-term SOE behavior because the length of a typical contract was three years, which encouraged SOE managers to cut spending on capital investments and technological upgrading in order to reach their profit targets. SOEs also had powerful incentives to raise prices to increase their profit margins—an easy thing to do in sectors where incumbent SOEs faced little competition. Despite the formal contracts signed between SOE management and supervising government agencies, SOEs continued to enjoy soft budget constraints and, as a result, were not responsible for failing to fulfill the terms of their contracts. As the contract responsibility system did not touch the core issue of "state ownership," it was obviously incapable of addressing all the pathologies of such ownership.109

更糟糕的是，由于合同期限通常为三年，合同责任制反而奖励了国有企业的短期行为，这促使国有企业管理者为了达到利润目标而削减资本投资和技术升级方面的支出。国有企业也有强烈的动机提高价格以提高利润率——在现有国有企业竞争较小的行业，这很容易做到。尽管国有企业管理层与监管政府机构之间签署了正式合同，但国有企业仍然享有宽松的预算约束，因此无需为未能履行合同条款承担责任。由于合同责任制没有触及“国有所有制”的核心问题，显然无法解决这种所有制下的所有弊病。

Despite the flaws in China's approaches to reforming the SOEs in the 1980s, some economists endorsed these limited measures but with qualifications, arguing that they helped improve the SOEs' financial performance, output, and innovative capacity.110 But evidence supports the consensus opinion among Chinese policymakers and economists that the SOE reforms in the 1980s essentially were failures.111 The early experiment to expand SOE autonomy was short-lived; it was replaced by the contract responsibility system, which itself was abandoned in the early 1990s when the post-Tiananmen leadership introduced a new round of reforms that sought to "establish a modern corporate system." By then, most SOEs were mired in crisis because they simply could not compete with private firms or imports. By the end of the 1990s, the government, no longer able to keep loss-making SOEs afloat without endangering the banking system, was forced to adopt a new strategy of "grasp the big and let go of the small," by which it retained only the large SOEs in critical sectors (banking, telecommunications, transportation, and energy) and allowed small and medium-sized SOEs to go bankrupt en masse.112 Zhao Ziyang, the reformist premier in charge of the economy in the 1980s, was perhaps the most authoritative person to render a verdict on this issue. Reflecting on China's reform when he was under house arrest in the 1990s, Zhao said: "Reform of the mechanisms of SOEs did not touch the fundamentals." By "fundamentals," he likely meant the most critical institutional factors affecting the performance of the SOEs, such as state ownership, the pricing system, capital markets, and the social safety net. However, Zhao believed that, ironically, the failure to reform the SOEs had a positive impact during China's transition to a market economy.113 Although he did not elaborate on this point, he was likely thinking of the potential political risks and costs of more aggressive reforms that might have made SOEs far more efficient but would have also triggered strong opposition from both the ideological conservatives and the affected interest groups.

尽管中国在20世纪80年代对国有企业进行改革的方式存在缺陷，但一些经济学家对这些有限的措施表示赞同，并附加了一些条件，认为这些措施有助于改善国有企业的财务绩效、产出和创新能力。然而，有证据支持中国政策制定者和经济学家普遍认同的观点，即20世纪80年代的国有企业改革本质上是失败的。早期扩大国有企业自主权的尝试昙花一现，很快就被承包责任制所取代。而承包责任制本身也在20世纪90年代初被废除，当时后天安门时代的领导层推出了一轮旨在“建立现代公司制度”的新改革。到那时，大多数国有企业都深陷危机，因为它们根本无法与私营企业或进口产品竞争。到了20世纪90年代末，政府已无力在不危及银行体系的情况下维持亏损国有企业的运营，被迫采取“抓大放小”的新策略，即只保留关键领域（银行、电信、交通和能源）的大型国有企业，而允许中小国有企业大规模破产。20世纪80年代负责经济的改革派总理赵紫阳或许是对此问题做出最权威评判的人。20世纪90年代，赵紫阳在被软禁期间反思中国的改革时说：“国有企业机制改革没有触及根本。”他所说的“根本”很可能是指影响国有企业绩效的最关键的制度因素，例如国有所有权、定价体系、资本市场和社会保障体系。然而，赵认为，具有讽刺意味的是，国有企业改革的失败反而对中国向市场经济转型产生了积极影响。尽管他没有详细阐述这一点，但他可能考虑到更激进的改革可能带来的潜在政治风险和成本，这些改革虽然可能使国有企业效率更高，但也会引发意识形态保守派和相关利益集团的强烈反对。





Dual-Track Price Reform





双轨制价格改革


As in Soviet-type economies, prices in China during the prereform era were set by the state, not by the market (although as a more decentralized economy, some prices in China were set by local, not central, authorities).114 Theoretically, price reform should be a top priority during a country's transition from state-socialism to a market economy. But as the experience of the former Soviet bloc in the early 1990s shows, price reform could only be completed with a "big bang" that freed all prices at once—at the cost of hyperinflation that would be economically disruptive and politically destructive for the reformers.115

与苏联式经济体类似，中国改革前的物价由国家而非市场决定（尽管中国经济较为分散，部分物价由地方而非中央政府决定）。理论上，物价改革应是国家从国家社会主义向市场经济转型过程中的首要任务。但正如前苏联集团在20世纪90年代初的经验所示，物价改革只能通过“大爆炸”式的改革才能完成，即一次性释放所有价格——但这将导致恶性通货膨胀，对经济造成破坏，对改革者而言则具有政治毁灭性。

By comparison, China adopted a far more gradual and cautious approach to price reform in the 1980s, for two reasons. Economically, unlike the Soviet bloc after the fall of communism, China did not face high inflation in the early 1980s and therefore had no need for the stabilization program that all Soviet bloc countries had to adopt. Politically, Chinese reformers in the early 1980s had to share power with conservatives, so they did not have the ability to push through radical reforms, such as the freeing up of prices. Even more important, Chinese reformers likely realized that a failed price reform could spell calamity for the entire reform program (such fears were realized when mere talk of price reform triggered panic buying and high inflation in the summer of 1988).

相比之下，中国在20世纪80年代采取了更为渐进和谨慎的价格改革方式，原因有二。首先，经济方面，与苏联解体后的苏联集团不同，中国在20世纪80年代初并未面临高通胀，因此无需像所有苏联集团国家那样实施稳定经济的方案。其次，政治方面，20世纪80年代初的中国改革者必须与保守派分享权力，因此他们无力推行激进的改革，例如价格自由化。更重要的是，中国改革者可能意识到，价格改革的失败可能会给整个改革计划带来灾难性的后果（这种担忧在1988年夏天得到了印证，当时仅仅是谈论价格改革就引发了恐慌性抢购和高通胀）。

As a result, China did not start to reform the pricing system until 1984, when the government implemented an experimental program of "dual-track pricing." Instead of ending mandatory pricing set by the state, dual-track pricing retained mandatory pricing but also introduced a second set of parallel prices determined by the market. The initial concept was proposed by a graduate student at an academic conference in 1984. Economists advocating dual-track pricing argued that since the prices of most products cannot be liberalized without eviscerating the command economy, the only way to reform a planned economy without abandoning it right away is to introduce pricing that allows both plan-mandated and liberalized prices to operate alongside each other to bring supply and demand into balance.116

因此，直到1984年，中国才开始改革价格体系，政府实施了“双轨制”试点项目。双轨制并没有废除国家强制定价，而是保留了强制定价，同时引入了由市场决定的平行价格体系。这一概念最初是由一位研究生在1984年的一次学术会议上提出的。支持双轨制的经济学家认为，由于大多数产品的价格自由化必然会瓦解计划经济体制，因此，在不立即放弃计划经济体制的前提下，改革计划经济的唯一途径是引入一种允许计划价格和自由化价格并行运作的价格体系，以平衡供求关系。

The government quickly embraced this alluring concept. In May 1984 the State Council formally permitted SOEs to adopt dual-track pricing. Specifically, SOEs could sell excess output at prices they set by themselves (but only 20 percent above or below the state-mandated prices).117

政府迅速接受了这一极具吸引力的理念。1984年5月，国务院正式允许国有企业实行双轨定价。具体而言，国有企业可以自行定价出售过剩产品（但价格不得高于或低于国家规定的价格20%）。

Leading economists have since hailed dual-track pricing reform as an innovative measure that produced winners but no losers.118

此后，多位知名经济学家称赞双轨定价改革是一项创新举措，它造就了赢家，却没有输家。

It likely also gave the SOEs a greater incentive to increase production because they could charge higher prices for products exceeding the planned target. Such marked-up products also provided a vital source of inputs for the nonstate sector, in particular the TVEs that otherwise could not purchase products made by SOEs outside the plan.119

这也可能促使国有企业更有动力提高产量，因为它们可以对超出计划目标的产品收取更高的价格。这些加价产品也为非国有部门，特别是那些原本无法购买计划外国有企业产品的乡镇企业，提供了重要的投入来源。

But the dual-track pricing system also facilitated rent-seeking behavior and corruption because the SOEs and well-connected individuals could easily make a quick profit by obtaining products at lower state-mandated prices within the plan and then selling them at higher prices. Many SOEs also gamed the new system by trying to get more "fixed-price" (below-market price) inputs from the plan and to underreport their production so they could sell more at above-plan prices.120

但双轨定价体系也助长了寻租行为和腐败，因为国有企业和关系密切的个人可以轻易地通过在计划内以较低的国家规定价格获取产品，然后再以更高的价格出售，从而快速牟利。许多国有企业还试图钻新体系的空子，从计划中获取更多“固定价格”（低于市场价格）的投入品，并少报产量，以便能够以高于计划价格出售更多产品。

For all the attention the dual-track pricing in the 1980s received, it is impossible to evaluate its contribution to China's price reform.
