Although the share of products subject to state-mandated prices continued to fall, it was most likely the result of increased production that can be credited to other factors, especially the rapid increase in industrial output by nonstate firms.121 Instructively, when nearly all prices were fully liberalized in the 1990s, this achievement was not due to any price reform. By that time, China was no longer a shortage economy. The liberalization of prices was almost certainly the result of sufficient supply made possible by the explosive growth of the private sector and foreign trade.

尽管20世纪80年代的双轨定价政策备受关注，但我们无法评估其对中国价格改革的贡献。虽然受国家强制定价的产品比例持续下降，但这很可能是产量增加的结果，而产量增加又可归功于其他因素，特别是国有企业工业产出的快速增长。值得注意的是，20世纪90年代几乎所有价格都实现了完全自由化，但这并非价格改革的结果。到那时，中国已不再是短缺型经济体。价格自由化几乎可以肯定是由于私营部门和对外贸易的爆炸式增长带来了充足的供应。





Summary





概括


Measured by key indicators of economic performance, China achieved unqualified success in the 1980s. Through domestic reform and integration with the global economy, the country scored its best growth rates since 1949. Per capita income, which was 315 yuan in 1978, rose to 1,189 yuan in 1989. Adjusted for inflation, real per capita income nearly tripled during the period. The gross social product (a proximate measure of the gross national product) rose from 677.6 billion yuan in 1978 to 3.46 trillion yuan in 1989, representing a 3,600 percent increase after adjusting for inflation. Despite high inflation in 1988-1989, China maintained overall macroeconomic stability, with inflation averaging 6.8 percent per year between 1979 and 1989. The economic structure improved as well. Household consumption averaged 65 percent of national income during the period, reflecting a relatively balanced economy. The rapid growth of the nonstate sector reduced the role of the state in the economy, as indicated by the fall of its share in industrial output from 78 percent in 1978 to 56 percent in 1989.122

从关键经济指标来看，中国在20世纪80年代取得了巨大的成功。通过国内改革和融入全球经济，中国实现了自1949年以来最高的经济增长率。人均收入从1978年的315元人民币增长到1989年的1189元人民币。经通货膨胀调整后，实际人均收入在这一时期几乎增长了两倍。社会生产总值（国民生产总值的近似指标）从1978年的6776亿元人民币增长到1989年的3.46万亿元人民币，经通货膨胀调整后增长了3600%。尽管1988-1989年通货膨胀率较高，但中国总体上保持了宏观经济稳定，1979年至1989年间的年均通货膨胀率为6.8%。经济结构也得到了改善。在此期间，家庭消费占国民收入的比例平均为65%，反映出经济相对平衡。非国有部门的快速增长削弱了国家在经济中的作用，这体现在其工业产出份额从1978年的78%下降到1989年的56%。

China's integration with the world economy proceeded at a rapid pace as well. Foreign trade rose from $20.6 billion in 1978 to $111.6 billion in 1989, averaging an annual growth rate of 49 percent. Exports increased from $9.75 billion to $52.5 billion during the same period. The inflow of FDI totaled $15.4 billion during the decade.123 Even though China would attract far more FDI in the 1990s, this amount still represents foreign investors' vote of confidence in Deng's economic revolution.

中国融入世界经济的进程也同样迅猛。对外贸易额从1978年的206亿美元增长到1989年的1116亿美元，年均增长率达49%。同期，出口额从97.5亿美元增长到525亿美元。十年间，外国直接投资流入总额达154亿美元。尽管中国在20世纪90年代吸引的外国直接投资远超这一数字，但154亿美元的流入量仍然体现了外国投资者对邓小平经济革命的信心。

Aside from these measurable achievements, reform in the 1980s also scored major political and institutional breakthroughs. Obviously, by delivering a proverbial "early harvest" of the fruits of reform, Deng and his supporters reaped immense political capital to bolster their case for more reform. Thus the most important success of the reform in the 1980s was the laying of the foundations for China's economic take-off in the subsequent two decades.

除了这些可衡量的成就之外，20世纪80年代的改革也取得了重大的政治和制度突破。显然，通过提前收获改革的成果，邓小平及其支持者积累了巨大的政治资本，从而更有力地推动了进一步的改革。因此，20世纪80年代改革最重要的成就，是为中国此后二十年的经济腾飞奠定了基础。

As this chapter shows, Deng's reform and opening in the decade substantially weakened the command economy by growing out of the plan. Rural decollectivization not only dismantled a key pillar of the Maoist economic system but also unleashed pent-up entrepreneurial energy and created a virtuous cycle that powered the emergence and growth of a new and dynamic private sector. At the same time, integrating China into the global economy through trade and investment enabled a previously self-isolated economy to capitalize on its comparative advantage of cheap labor. The combination of an efficient domestic private sector and integration with the global economy quickly became the engine of Chinese growth.

正如本章所示，邓小平在十年间推行的改革开放，通过摆脱计划经济的束缚，极大地削弱了计划经济体制。农村非集体化不仅瓦解了毛泽东时代经济体系的关键支柱，也释放了被压抑的创业能量，形成良性循环，推动了新兴且充满活力的私营部门的出现和发展。与此同时，通过贸易和投资将中国融入全球经济，使这个此前相对封闭的经济体能够充分发挥其廉价劳动力的比较优势。高效的国内私营部门与全球经济的融合，迅速成为中国经济增长的引擎。

To be sure, growing out of the plan avoided tackling the thorny issue of SOE reform. Indeed, China's attempts to reform these dinosaurs of totalitarianism in the 1980s were largely unsuccessful. It would take another decade and a pending banking crisis for the party to muster the courage to push through major SOE reforms. But this particular failure must be understood in the political context of the times. With powerful conservative forces led by Chen Yun entrenched at the top of the party's leadership, it was inconceivable that Deng and his fellow reformers would risk a confrontation in order to enact far more radical SOE reforms (such as mass bankruptcy and privatization—the approach the party eventually adopted at the end of the 1990s). Given the complete lack of knowledge in the 1980s about how to reform the SOEs and the far superior alternative of cultivating new and more efficient economic forces, such as domestic private firms and foreign-invested firms, it made perfect political and economic sense to prioritize growing out of the plan over reforming the plan itself.

诚然，从该计划中发展而来，回避了棘手的国有企业改革问题。事实上，中国在20世纪80年代对这些极权主义“恐龙”进行改革的尝试大多以失败告终。又过了十年，加上迫在眉睫的银行业危机，党才鼓起勇气推进国有企业重大改革。但必须将这一失败置于当时的政治背景下理解。在陈云领导的强大保守势力牢牢把持党内领导层的情况下，邓小平及其改革派同僚几乎不可能冒着对抗的风险去推行更为激进的国有企业改革（例如大规模破产和私有化——这是党在20世纪90年代末最终采取的措施）。鉴于 20 世纪 80 年代人们对如何改革国有企业完全缺乏了解，而且培育国内私营企业和外商投资企业等新的、更高效的经济力量是一种远优于改革国有企业的替代方案，因此，优先发展摆脱计划的经济力量而不是改革计划本身，在政治和经济上都是完全合理的。

Nevertheless, the success of growing out of the plan during the decade was achieved at the expense of not dismantling, once and for all, the economic foundations of totalitarianism—the SOEs through which the party-state controlled the "commanding heights" of the economy. Even though the output of the private sector eventually exceeded that of these firms, they continued to dominate some of the most important sectors of the economy, in particular finance, energy, telecommunications, and transportation. The party-state's control of these firms not only allowed the regime access to bountiful economic resources but also necessitated costly protection of these firms that distorted markets and undercut economic efficiency. Zhao Ziyang, the reformer in charge of economic policy in the 1980s, foresaw the long-term danger of a "dual-track" transition characterized by rapid growth of the private sector and continuing state dominance in a large segment of the economy. "The long-term coexistence of two systems and two tracks," he warned in the 1990s, "ultimately will produce enormous negative effects. It was right to resort to gradual transition initially, but this approach must not continue in the long run."124 If anything, the deposed former premier and CCP general secretary likely underestimated the economic and political costs of the dual-track transition. The dual-track transition would ultimately lose momentum, and the party-state would be forced to use its power to support a hugely inefficient state sector at the expense of the private sector.125

然而，尽管在十年间成功摆脱了该计划的束缚，但代价是未能彻底瓦解极权主义的经济基础——即党国通过控制经济“制高点”的国有企业。即使私营部门的产出最终超过了这些企业，它们仍然主导着一些最重要的经济部门，特别是金融、能源、电信和交通运输。党国对这些企业的控制不仅使政权能够获取丰富的经济资源，而且还需要对这些企业进行代价高昂的保护，从而扭曲市场并削弱经济效率。20世纪80年代负责经济政策的改革者赵紫阳预见到了“双轨”转型带来的长期危险，这种转型的特点是私营部门快速增长，而国家在经济的大部分领域仍然占据主导地位。他在上世纪90年代就警告说：“两套制度、两条轨道长期并存，最终会产生巨大的负面影响。最初采取渐进式过渡是正确的，但这种做法绝不能长期持续下去。”124 事实上，这位被罢黜的前总理兼中共中央总书记很可能低估了双轨制过渡的经济和政治代价。双轨制过渡最终会失去动力，党国将被迫动用权力扶持效率低下的国有部门，而牺牲私营部门的利益。125







3 Building Neo-Authoritarianism, 1992-2002

3 构建新威权主义，1992-2002




THE BLOODY end of the Tiananmen crisis closed off, at least for the foreseeable future, China's path to a more open and free society. But the neoauthoritarian order—capitalist economic development under one-party rule—did not emerge in the immediate aftermath of the crackdown. Indeed, the party still had two plausible pathways to choose. One was to reverse the economic reforms of the 1980s, reassert the party's control over the economy and society, and reconstitute a system embodying most of the institutional characteristics of the early 1950s. The other was to fully embrace neoauthoritarian developmentalism. Initially, between mid-1989 to the end of 1991, hard-liners who had gained power after the crackdown attempted to resuscitate the old communist system. Even though their efforts largely failed, a prolonged political stasis during which the regime would be stuck in a transitional no-man's land was a distinct possibility.

天安门事件的血腥结局至少在可预见的未来，堵死了中国通往更加开放自由社会的道路。但新威权秩序——一党专政下的资本主义经济发展——并非在镇压结束后立即出现。事实上，中共当时仍有两条可行的道路可供选择。一条是逆转20世纪80年代的经济改革，重新确立党对经济和社会的控制，并重建一个体现20世纪50年代初期大部分制度特征的体系。另一条则是全面拥抱新威权发展主义。最初，从1989年中期到1991年底，镇压后掌权的强硬派试图复兴旧的共产主义制度。尽管他们的努力大多以失败告终，但政权陷入长期的政治停滞，处于过渡时期的不上不下状态，这并非不可能。

The event galvanizing the party into unreservedly endorsing neo-authoritarian developmentalism was the fall of the Soviet Union in December 1991. Less than a month later, Deng Xiaoping started his tour of southern China that, in substance though not in name, launched the post-Tiananmen era of neo-authoritarian rule. Due to the purge of the liberal wing from the party in 1989 and the demoralization of the hard-liners by the dissolution of the Soviet Union, party leadership became ideologically more homogenous. However reluctantly, hard-liners bought into Deng's vision of capitalist economic modernization under one-party rule because this was the only feasible survival strategy despite their past resistance to this path.

促使党毫无保留地拥护新威权发展主义的事件是1991年12月苏联的解体。不到一个月后，邓小平开始了对中国南方的访问，这次访问虽然名义上并非如此，但实际上开启了后天安门时代的新威权统治。由于1989年党内自由派的清洗以及苏联解体对强硬派士气的打击，党的领导层在意识形态上变得更加同质化。尽管强硬派过去一直抵制这条道路，但最终还是接受了邓小平在一党专政下推行资本主义经济现代化的愿景，因为这是唯一可行的生存策略。

After he rallied the party to his neo-authoritarian vision and installed a new leadership team in the fall of 1992, Deng gradually faded away from the political scene. Jiang Zemin, the compromise choice for the CCP general secretary the elders picked during the Tiananmen crisis, became an effective implementer of Dengist neo-authoritarian strategy. Under Jiang's leadership, the party was laser-focused on economic development while adopting novel tactics to keep its grip on a fast-changing society. The individual components of the party's survival strategy, such as performance-based legitimacy, an implicit security pact among elites, nationalism, social co-optation, and selective repression, evolved into the key pillars of the post-1989 neo-authoritarian order.

1992年秋季，邓小平将党内团结起来，推行他的新威权主义理念，并组建了新的领导团队，之后他逐渐淡出政坛。江泽民是中共元首在天安门事件后由元老们推选的折衷人选，他成为邓小平新威权主义战略的有效执行者。在江泽民的领导下，中共将重心放在经济发展上，同时采取新策略来巩固其在快速变化的社会中的统治地位。党的生存战略的各个组成部分，例如基于绩效的合法性、精英阶层间的隐性安全契约、民族主义、社会收编和选择性镇压，逐渐演变为1989年后新威权秩序的关键支柱。

Judging by the economic boom and political tranquility at both the elite and mass levels in the post-Tiananmen era (1992-2012), Deng's neo-authoritarian vision had to be credited with bringing about the party's golden period and enabling the regime to weather the shocks of the Tiananmen debacle and the collapse of the Soviet Union. Behind the façade of stability and prosperity, however, new dangers began to emerge. The party's success in delivering rising standards of living, albeit on an investment-led growth model that would soon produce diminishing returns, reduced incentives for deeper and more difficult economic reforms. At the same time, the party's control of immense and fast-growing economic resources fueled corruption, exposing the fundamental flaws of Dengist neo-authoritarianism.

从后天安门时代（1992-2012年）精英阶层和大众层面的经济繁荣和政治稳定来看，邓小平的新威权主义理念被认为是中共黄金时期的缔造者，并使政权得以渡过天安门事件和苏联解体的冲击。然而，在稳定繁荣的表象之下，新的危险开始浮现。尽管中共成功地提高了人民的生活水平，但这种以投资为主导的增长模式很快就会出现收益递减，这削弱了进行更深入、更艰难的经济改革的动力。与此同时，中共对庞大且快速增长的经济资源的控制也助长了腐败，暴露了邓小平新威权主义的根本缺陷。





A Family "Vacation" That Changed History





一次改变历史的家庭“度假”


The brutal crushing of the Tiananmen protests on June 4, 1989, severely damaged Deng politically. The purge of Zhao Ziyang and other liberal reformers meant Deng could no longer rely on members of this group to implement his agenda of reform and opening. The octogenarian was said to be very depressed, and, after having given up smoking for several years, he began to smoke again.1 The only consolation for Deng was that he managed to install a compromise choice, Jiang Zemin, former party chief of Shanghai, as Zhao's replacement, thus preventing an ideological hard-liner from taking over the party's top leadership position. But Deng's power play failed to prevent the hard-liners from implementing policies to roll back the reforms of the 1980s as Jiang, a risk-averse opportunist with no power base of his own, lacked both the inclination and the ability to put up any resistance.

1989年6月4日，天安门事件遭到残酷镇压，邓小平的政治地位遭受重创。赵紫阳和其他自由派改革者的清洗意味着邓小平再也无法依靠这些人来推行他的改革开放政策。据说这位八旬老人情绪低落，戒烟数年后又重新开始吸烟。邓小平唯一的安慰是，他成功地安插了一位折衷人选——前上海市委书记江泽民——接替赵紫阳，从而避免了一位意识形态强硬派掌控党的最高领导权。然而，邓小平的权力博弈未能阻止强硬派推行旨在推翻20世纪80年代改革的政策，因为江泽民是一个规避风险的机会主义者，自身又没有权力基础，既没有意愿也没有能力进行任何抵抗。

Li Peng and Yao Yilin, the two arch conservatives in charge of economic policy, doubled down on an austerity program adopted in late 1988 to contain inflation. Although initially it prioritized reducing investment, in the wake of the Tiananmen crackdown they aggressively pushed for a recentralization of power and a reinvigoration of economic planning. These measures favored the SOEs at the expense of the nascent private sector.2

负责经济政策的两位保守派大佬李鹏和姚一林，为了抑制通货膨胀，加倍推行了1988年底开始实施的紧缩政策。尽管该政策最初侧重于减少投资，但在天安门事件后，他们积极推动权力集中化和经济计划的复兴。这些措施有利于国有企业，却损害了新兴的私营经济。

Consequently, the economy registered its weakest growth in a decade. GDP rose only 4.1 percent in 1989 and 3.9 percent in 1990, even though it rebounded to 9.5 percent in 1991.3

因此，经济增长创下十年来最低水平。1989年和1990年国内生产总值分别仅增长4.1%和3.9%，尽管1991年反弹至9.5%。

The TVEs, the largest component of the private sector, averaged an annual growth rate of 40 percent from 1985 to 1988, but in 1989 and 1990 they grew only 15 percent and 14 percent, respectively.4

中小型企业是私营部门的最大组成部分，1985年至1988年平均年增长率为40%，但1989年和1990年分别仅增长了15%和14%。

Hard-liners had less success in recentralizing the economy, however, as such efforts encountered strong resistance from the large and economically important provinces, such as Shanghai and Shandong.5

然而，强硬派在经济重整化方面收效甚微，因为这些努力遭到了上海、山东等经济大省的强烈抵制。

The political crackdown launched by the hard-liners targeting the participants in the prodemocracy movement produced mixed results at best. The regime successfully restored political control on university campuses.6 But its witch hunt for prodemocracy activists at the grassroots level largely failed due to resistance by sympathetic local officials.7 The hard-liners' thinly veiled ideological attacks on Deng's policy of reform and opening instantly encountered pushback from Deng himself.8 The overall political situation in the year and a half following the Tiananmen crackdown can be best described as a political stalemate.9 Although ascendant hard-liners had momentum to reverse Deng's reform and regain the party's eroded control over society, they were not fully successful. At the same time, the reformist camp led by Deng, now structurally weakened as the result of his purge of the liberals at the top, lacked strength to breathe new life into reform and opening. To outside observers, the Chinese regime in 1990 "showed many of the classic signs of a moribund system."10

强硬派针对民主运动参与者发起的政治镇压，充其量只能说是喜忧参半。政权成功恢复了对大学校园的政治控制。6 但由于同情民主运动人士的地方官员的抵制，其在基层对民主活动人士的“猎巫”行动大多以失败告终。7 强硬派对邓小平改革开放政策的隐晦意识形态攻击，立即遭到邓小平本人的反击。8 天安门事件后一年半的整体政治局势，可以用政治僵局来形容。9 尽管强硬派势力抬头，试图扭转邓小平的改革，重新夺回党对社会的掌控，但他们并未完全成功。与此同时，邓小平领导的改革派阵营，由于其对高层自由派的清洗，结构性地被削弱，无力为改革开放注入新的活力。在外部观察家看来，1990年的中国政权“呈现出许多垂死体制的典型特征”。

Deng, whose legacy was hanging in the balance, was reluctant to see his project of modernizing China wither in midcourse. In 1991 he began to take actions to revive his reform and opening.11 He first visited Shanghai in January 1991 and gave a series of speeches calling for "emancipating the mind" and taking bolder steps in reform and opening.12 Shortly after he returned from his visit, Deng elevated Zhu Rongji, the no-nonsense party chief and mayor of Shanghai, to the position of vice premier, even though Zhu was only an alternate member of the Central Committee (traditionally vice premiers were also Politburo members). The promotion of Zhu in April 1991 marked the beginning of the erosion of control of economic policy by the hard-liners in the State Council.

邓小平的政治遗产岌岌可危，他不愿看到自己为中国实现现代化所做的努力半途而废。1991年，他开始采取行动，重振改革开放。他于1991年1月首次访问上海，并发表了一系列讲话，呼吁“解放思想”，在改革开放方面采取更大胆的举措。访问上海后不久，邓小平提拔了务实的上海市委书记、市长朱镕基为国务院副总理，尽管朱镕基当时只是中央候补委员（传统上，副总理也是政治局委员）。1991年4月朱镕基的晋升，标志着国务院强硬派对经济政策的控制开始瓦解。

However useful these political maneuvers might have been for Deng, they were insufficient to change the political dynamics decisively in his favor. What really made the difference was the shock of the fall of the Soviet Union in late 1991. Judging by the rebound of the Chinese economy that year, the primary motivation behind Deng's last-ditch effort to salvage his legacy at the beginning of 1992 was not China's economic difficulties but the geopolitical and ideological environments that had been altered beyond recognition by the events in the Soviet Union.13

然而，尽管这些政治手段对邓小平或许有所帮助，但它们不足以从根本上改变政治格局，使之向有利于他的方向发展。真正起到决定性作用的是1991年底苏联解体的冲击。从当年中国经济的反弹来看，邓小平在1992年初为挽救其政治遗产而孤注一掷的主要动机并非中国的经济困境，而是苏联解体后地缘政治和意识形态环境发生的翻天覆地的变化。

On August 19, 1991, diehard conservatives in Moscow, in a desperate attempt to save the imploding Soviet Union, launched a coup. Initially, their counterparts in Beijing were thrilled. Some of them even proposed that they should publicly support the coup, but Deng quashed the idea and urged caution.14 If anything, the crisis in the Soviet Union reinforced Deng's conviction that only economic success could keep the CCP in power. The day after the coup, Deng stressed that the party's survival would largely depend on reform and opening. Instead of seeing the pending Soviet collapse as a crisis, he warned leading members of the Central Committee that "great changes are taking place in the world, and this gives us an opportunity.... If we don't seize this opportunity to raise the economy to a higher level, other countries will leap ahead of us, leaving us far behind."15

1991年8月19日，莫斯科的顽固保守派为了挽救即将崩溃的苏联，发动了政变。起初，北京的保守派对此感到欣喜若狂，甚至有人提议公开支持政变，但邓小平否决了这一想法，并敦促各方保持谨慎。苏联危机反而更加坚定了邓小平的信念：只有经济成功才能使中共继续执政。政变后的第二天，邓小平强调，党的生存很大程度上取决于改革开放。他没有将即将到来的苏联解体视为危机，而是警告中央委员会的领导成员：“世界正在发生巨大变化，这给我们带来了机遇……如果我们不抓住这个机遇，把经济提升到一个更高的水平，其他国家就会超越我们，把我们远远甩在后面。”

How Deng personally reacted to the dissolution of the USSR at the end of 1991 is unknown. However, three weeks after Gorbachev signed away the USSR, Deng embarked on his historic southern tour that would usher in the post-Tiananmen era of neo-authoritarianism. Ostensibly, the thirty-six-day trip that took Deng, then 87 years old, to several cities in the South was a family vacation. Before his train rolled out of Beijing on January 17, 1992, there was no indication that the political stalemate after the Tiananmen crackdown would end anytime soon. But by the time Deng returned to Beijing on February 21, he was on the verge of relaunching an economic revolution that would establish a new order: capitalist economic development under one-party rule and the route to modernization that Deng had consistently advocated since the late 1970s.16 Within a week of Deng's return, as a gesture of endorsing his views, the party distributed summaries of the speeches he had given during his tour. On March 9 and 10 the Politburo convened a rare two-day meeting (Politburo meetings usually last one day) and decided to implement the "spirit" of Deng's speeches.17 The political atmosphere in the country changed instantly afterward. After it became clear that Deng had regained dominance, provincial leaders vied with one another in calling for more rapid economic reform. Growth immediately exploded (GDP would rise 14 percent in 1992).18 By October 1992 Deng had installed a Politburo Standing Committee dominated by a new group of leaders who shared his neo-authoritarian vision (Li Peng, the premier, was the only surviving hard-liner in the top leadership).

邓小平本人对1991年底苏联解体的反应不得而知。然而，在戈尔巴乔夫签署苏联解体协议三周后，邓小平开始了具有历史意义的南方之行，开启了后天安门时代的新威权主义。表面上看，这趟为期36天的旅程，让当时87岁高龄的邓小平走访了南方的几个城市，是一次家庭旅行。在他于1992年1月17日乘火车离开北京之前，没有任何迹象表明天安门事件后的政治僵局会很快结束。但到2月21日邓小平返回北京时，他已接近重启一场经济革命，这场革命将建立一种新的秩序：一党专政下的资本主义经济发展，以及邓小平自20世纪70年代末以来一直倡导的现代化道路。邓小平回国一周内，为了表示支持他的观点，党内分发了他巡视期间讲话的摘要。3月9日至10日，政治局召开了一次罕见的为期两天的会议（政治局会议通常持续一天），决定贯彻落实邓小平讲话的“精神”。此后，中国的政治氛围立即发生了变化。在邓小平重新掌权之后，各省领导人竞相呼吁加快经济改革。经济增长立即爆发（1992 年 GDP 将增长 14%）。到 1992 年 10 月，邓小平已经建立了一个由一群认同他新威权主义理念的新领导人主导的政治局常委（总理李鹏是最高领导层中唯一幸存的强硬派）。

There is no single answer to the question of how a monthlong "family trip" by a retired 87-year-old leader, whose only title at that time was "honorary chairman of the China Bridge Association," could change the course of Chinese history.

对于一位退休的 87 岁领导人（当时他唯一的头衔是“中国桥牌协会名誉主席”）为期一个月的“家庭旅行”如何改变中国历史进程这个问题，并没有一个简单的答案。

At the level of elite politics, the most important impact of Deng's tour was to force Jiang Zemin, who had toed a more conservative line since his appointment as party chief in June 1989, to fully embrace Deng's policy. Based on one unofficial, but apparently authentic, version of the summaries of the talks by Deng during his tour, Deng could barely conceal his deep dissatisfaction with the post-Tiananmen leadership, and he implicitly threatened to sack Jiang.19 In addition, Deng talked at length about the fall of the Soviet Union. "What I have been thinking about the most these days," Deng allegedly told his audience in Shenzhen, "is the Soviet Union. This is a country with such bountiful natural resources, a deep cultural tradition, a powerful state, and a huge Communist Party. But it collapsed overnight." (Ironically, Xi Jinping would be reflecting on the Soviet collapse in nearly identical language two decades later after he assumed the position of party chief in November 2012.) Deng's diagnosis of the Soviet collapse was its economic failure ("it could not even fill up the bellies of its people," to use his colorful language). If China failed economically, Deng warned, "today's Soviet Union will be tomorrow's China."20

在政治精英层面，邓小平此次巡视最重要的影响是迫使自1989年6月担任中共中央总书记以来一直奉行更为保守路线的江泽民全面接受邓小平的政策。根据一份非官方但显然真实的邓小平巡视期间会谈记录，邓小平几乎无法掩饰他对天安门事件后领导层的强烈不满，并含蓄地威胁要撤换江泽民。此外，邓小平还详细谈到了苏联的解体。据称，邓小平在深圳对听众说：“这些天我一直在思考的就是苏联。这是一个拥有如此丰富的自然资源、深厚的文化传统、强大的国家和庞大的共产党的国家。但它却在一夜之间崩溃了。” （具有讽刺意味的是，二十年后，习近平在2012年11月就任中共中央总书记后，以几乎相同的措辞反思了苏联的解体。）邓小平对苏联解体的诊断是其经济失败（用他生动的话说，“连人民的肚子都养不活”）。邓小平警告说，如果中国经济失败，“今天的苏联就会成为明天的中国”。

Deng's threat to dismiss Jiang in early 1992 seems credible. A well-connected Chinese journalist, Yang Jisheng, writes that Deng was disappointed with Jiang, and he implied that Jiang should step aside if he would not support reform more aggressively. Later, Deng did not sack Jiang, but this was only because he was dissuaded by a close associate, veteran revolutionary Bo Yibo. Ezra Vogel also claims that Jiang, in February 1992, was aware that Deng was "determined" to fire him if he did not support reform.21

邓小平在1992年初威胁要解雇江泽民，这似乎并非空穴来风。一位与中国政界关系密切的记者杨继生写道，邓小平对江泽民感到失望，并暗示如果江泽民不更积极地支持改革，就应该下台。后来，邓小平最终没有解雇江泽民，但这仅仅是因为他受到了亲信、资深革命家薄一波的劝阻。埃兹拉·沃格尔也声称，江泽民在1992年2月就已经知道，如果他不支持改革，邓小平“决心”要解雇他。

With his job on the line, Jiang decided to back Deng's agenda wholeheartedly. Even though in 1992 Jiang had not yet consolidated power, the shift in his position from a fence-sitting opportunist to a supporter of Deng's renewed call for economic reform decisively tipped the balance at the top of the leadership in favor of Deng's policy. In addition, by early 1992 the major aging hard-liners were either in poor health or dying. The eighty-six-year-old Chen Yun, the leader of the conservative camp who might have been able to resist Deng's offensive, was apparently in poor health and politically inactive. (Chen died in April 1995.)22

由于工作岌岌可危，江泽民决定全力支持邓小平的政策。尽管1992年江泽民尚未完全巩固权力，但他从一个摇摆不定的机会主义者转变为邓小平重启经济改革的支持者，这一转变彻底扭转了领导层内部的局势，使邓小平的政策占据了上风。此外，到1992年初，主要的强硬派领导人要么年迈体弱，要么已去世。保守派领袖陈云，这位86岁高龄的老人，原本或许能够抵挡邓小平的攻势，但显然健康状况不佳，且已不再活跃于政坛。（陈云于1995年4月去世。）

In terms of policy, the conservative forces could not put up any resistance because by 1992 they had no credibility left. Their retrograde economic policies had produced the worst two-year growth record since 1979. The implosion of the Soviet Union, the party's model, fully revealed the ideological bankruptcy of orthodox communism. While Deng had laid out a strategy to keep the CCP in power in the changed world that was becoming implacably hostile to communism, the hard-liners simply had no alternatives to offer. Deng's call for accelerated economic development also resonated with the public. One alternative to this path—reversion to a planned economy and totalitarian social control—hardly sounded attractive to people who still remembered the dark era of Maoism. The other alternative—economic modernization concurrent with political liberalization—was impractical. The Tiananmen crackdown had dealt a fatal blow to the (already weak) prodemocracy forces at all levels. Their patron in the top leadership, Zhao Ziyang, had been purged. Leading liberal intellectuals and activists had been either exiled or imprisoned. The political control imposed after the Tiananmen crackdown eliminated any public space for advocating political change.23

在政策方面，保守势力无力抵抗，因为到1992年，他们已经丧失了所有信誉。他们倒退的经济政策导致了自1979年以来最糟糕的两年经济增长记录。苏联的解体——中共的模式——彻底暴露了正统共产主义意识形态的破产。尽管邓小平制定了在对共产主义日益敌视的世界中维持中共政权的战略，但强硬派却拿不出任何替代方案。邓小平呼吁加快经济发展也引起了民众的共鸣。另一种选择——回归计划经济和极权社会控制——对于那些仍然记得毛泽东时代黑暗历史的人来说，几乎没有任何吸引力。另一种选择——经济现代化与政治自由化同步进行——也不切实际。天安门事件对各级（本已虚弱的）民主力量造成了致命打击。他们在最高领导层的支持者赵紫阳遭到清洗。主要的自由派知识分子和活动家要么被流放，要么被监禁。天安门事件后实施的政治控制消除了任何倡导政治变革的公共空间。

Under these circumstances, a neo-authoritarian path appeared to offer something for everybody. For those determined to perpetuate one-party rule, this survival strategy was the most pragmatic and promising. For those seeking to reform the one-party regime, economic modernization could be a roundabout way to liberalize or even democratize the dictatorship. For the vast majority of Chinese people, with a per capita income of only 1,262 in purchasing power parity in 1992, a ruling regime bent on economic development appeared to be much better than one that was not.24

在这种情况下，新威权主义道路似乎能满足各方需求。对于那些决心维护一党专政的人来说，这种生存策略最为务实且前景光明。对于那些寻求改革一党专政的人来说，经济现代化或许是实现独裁政权自由化甚至民主化的迂回途径。对于绝大多数中国民众而言，1992年人均收入按购买力平价计算仅为1262元，一个致力于经济发展的政权似乎远胜于一个不致力于经济发展的政权。

Lastly, the Soviet factor likely had a major, albeit difficult to measure, impact on the attitudes of ordinary Chinese people toward their government. The chaos in the wake of the Soviet collapse, which the Chinese government portrayed in apocalyptic terms through official propaganda, probably made ordinary Chinese, for whom the turmoil of the Cultural Revolution was recent memory, prefer order and stability to change that might bring about a calamity on the order of the Soviet collapse. Indeed, opinion surveys conducted in the early 1990s show a surprisingly high level of support for the CCP. In addition to the party's satisfactory economic performance, an important source of support was fear of social instability.25

最后，苏联因素可能对普通中国民众对政府的态度产生了重大影响，尽管这种影响难以衡量。苏联解体后的混乱局面，被中国政府通过官方宣传以世界末日般的语气描绘出来，这可能导致普通中国民众——他们对文化大革命的动荡记忆犹新——更倾向于秩序和稳定，而不是可能带来类似苏联解体灾难的变革。事实上，20世纪90年代初进行的民意调查显示，民众对中国共产党的支持率出奇地高。除了党在经济方面取得的令人满意的成绩外，民众对社会不稳定的担忧也是其支持的重要来源。

After turning the tide with his southern tour, Deng immediately set about to rearrange the party's top leadership to ensure that his neo-authoritarian survival strategy would be faithfully implemented. Because Chen Yun had largely abandoned his opposition to Deng's policy, partially due to his poor health, Deng had near-complete freedom to pick the top leaders at the Fourteenth Party Congress in October 1992.26 Judging by the line-up of the top leadership chosen at the congress, Deng scored a total political triumph. The Central Committee featured a number of technocrats who could be trusted with the mission of supercharging economic development.27 Of the seven members of the PSC, Deng could count on six to carry out his policy, including Jiang Zemin (general secretary), Zhu Rongji (executive vice premier), and Hu Jintao (a rising star whom Deng anointed as Jiang's successor). The only conservative on the PSC was Premier Li Peng.

邓小平南巡扭转局势后，立即着手重组党的最高领导层，以确保其新威权主义生存战略得以忠实执行。由于陈云身体欠佳，已基本放弃反对邓小平的政策，邓小平在1992年10月召开的中共十四大上几乎可以完全自由地挑选最高领导人。从大会选出的最高领导层来看，邓小平取得了彻底的政治胜利。中央委员会由一批技术官僚组成，他们肩负着推动经济发展的重任。在七名国家政治保卫委员会委员中，有六人可以依靠邓小平执行其政策，包括江泽民（总书记）、朱镕基（常务副总理）和胡锦涛（邓小平钦定的江泽民接班人）。国家政治保卫委员会中唯一的保守派是总理李鹏。

Deng's anointment of Hu Jintao, then 50 years old, as Jiang's successor likely reflected his fear that there might be a succession struggle after Jiang completed his second full term as party chief in 2002. Such a fight not only would be destabilizing but would probably result in elevating a leader to the top who could threaten Deng's legacies. Deng's choice of Hu, a party apparatchik with a thin record of accomplishments, remains a puzzle. Since Deng hardly knew Hu personally because Hu was nearly forty years younger and had not worked under him directly, it is very likely that Deng had relied on the recommendation of close associate and Hu's lifelong patron Song Ping, a conservative and member of the PSC (1989-1992). Deng might have also been reassured by Hu's loyalty to the party because, as party chief in Tibet beginning in 1988, he had ordered martial law and had crushed the protests by Tibetans in March 1989, several months before the Tiananmen massacre. At the same time, Hu had not demonstrated any opposition to market-oriented reforms. Under these circumstances, Hu Jintao apparently was the safest choice as a future leader.28

邓小平钦点时年50岁的胡锦涛接替江泽民，很可能反映了他对江泽民2002年第二个完整任期结束后可能出现权力交接之争的担忧。这样的争斗不仅会造成政局动荡，而且很可能导致一位可能威胁邓小平政治遗产的领导人登上权力巅峰。邓小平选择政绩平平的胡锦涛，至今仍令人费解。由于胡锦涛比邓小平年轻近40岁，且从未直接在其麾下工作，邓小平与他本人几乎素不相识，因此很可能是采纳了胡锦涛的亲信、长期支持者宋平的推荐。宋平是一位保守派人士，曾于1989年至1992年担任国家政治保卫委员会委员。邓小平或许也因胡锦涛对党的忠诚而感到安心，因为胡锦涛自1988年起担任西藏地方委书记，曾下令实施戒严，并在1989年3月镇压了藏人的抗议活动，而这距离天安门事件仅几个月之遥。与此同时，胡锦涛并未表现出对市场化改革的任何反对。在这种情况下，胡锦涛显然是未来领导人最稳妥的选择。





Intellectual Foundations of the Post-Tiananmen Order





天安门事件后秩序的知识基础


Intellectually, the CCP's survival strategy in the post-Tiananmen era was derived, in most part, from the developmental successes of the East Asian countries (in particular South Korea, Taiwan, and Singapore) under authoritarian rule from the 1960s to the 1980s and, after the Soviet collapse, from their own interpretation of the causes of the failure of the Soviet regime. "Neo-authoritarian developmentalism"—a combination of pro-market reforms, integration with the West-dominated global economy, and authoritarian rule—probably best summarizes the essence of Deng's strategy of economic modernization. As indicated by his speeches emphasizing both economic development and preservation of the CCP's political monopoly (the most important of his "four cardinal principles"), from the outset neo-authoritarian developmentalism was the ideological inspiration of Deng's reform and opening, even though he never invoked the term in his public speeches. The only credible piece of evidence that Deng embraced the concept is provided by Zhao Ziyang, who said that Deng commented to him in a meeting in 1988 that "neo-authoritarianism"—economic development in a stable environment under the rule of a strongman—"is my position, but there is no need to frame it in such a way."29

从思想层面来看，中共在后天安门时代的生存战略，很大程度上源于东亚国家（特别是韩国、台湾和新加坡）在20世纪60年代至80年代威权统治下取得的发展成就，以及苏联解体后，中共自身对苏联政权失败原因的解读。“新威权发展主义”——结合了亲市场改革、融入西方主导的全球经济以及威权统治——或许最能概括邓小平经济现代化战略的本质。正如他强调经济发展和维护中共政治垄断（这是他“四大原则”中最重要的一项）的讲话所表明的那样，尽管邓小平从未在公开讲话中提及“新威权发展主义”一词，但它从一开始就是邓小平改革开放的意识形态基础。唯一可信的证据表明邓小平接受了这一理念，赵紫阳称，邓小平在1988年的一次会面中曾对他说，“新威权主义”——在强人统治下，于稳定的环境中实现经济发展——“是我的立场，但没必要这样表述。”

Indeed, the concept of “neo-authoritarianism” had become a hot topic in 1988 in China’s intellectual circles due to advocacy by a group of young and middle-aged scholars with conservative leanings participating in a larger debate on China’s optimal path forward. Although there is no evidence that hardliners were behind the proponents of neo-authoritarianism at the time, the idea of an authoritarian regime committed to economic development held tremendous appeal and was seen among its advocates as an alternative to the model of development under a liberal political regime.30 In terms of real-world examples, champions of neo-authoritarianism could find persuasive cases supporting their argument. South Korea, Taiwan, Singapore, and to a less extent Thailand, Indonesia, and Malaysia had achieved spectacular developmental successes since the 1960s under authoritarian rule. Even though no academic research explicitly argues that authoritarian rule made such economic success possible, the connection between authoritarianism and rapid economic development appears intuitively obvious.31 Although neo-authoritarianism was the guiding principle of Deng’s reform and opening prior to its ascendance in scholarly circles in 1987–1988, Deng had encountered great difficulty completely translating this vision into policy because of opposition, primarily from the hard-liners and secondarily from the liberals. The hard-liners, led by Chen Yun, steadfastly resisted Deng’s efforts to liberalize the Chinese economy, while the liberals advocated political reform even though they supported Deng on economic policy. The decimation of the liberals as a political force after the Tiananmen crackdown in 1989 eliminated one set of obstacles to Deng’s neo-authoritarian vision. After the Soviet collapse in 1991, hard-liner opposition to a survival strategy that would rely on capitalist economic development to perpetuate one-party rule also melted away.

事实上，“新威权主义”的概念在1988年成为中国知识界的热门话题，这源于一群倾向保守主义的中青年学者在一场关于中国未来发展道路的更广泛辩论中对其的倡导。尽管没有证据表明当时强硬派是新威权主义倡导者的幕后推手，但致力于经济发展的威权政体理念具有巨大的吸引力，并被其支持者视为自由政治体制下发展模式的替代方案。30 就现实世界的案例而言，新威权主义的拥护者可以找到令人信服的例子来支持他们的论点。自20世纪60年代以来，韩国、台湾、新加坡，以及在某种程度上泰国、印度尼西亚和马来西亚，都在威权统治下取得了令人瞩目的发展成就。尽管没有学术研究明确论证威权统治促成了如此巨大的经济成功，但威权主义与经济快速发展之间的联系似乎显而易见。31 尽管新威权主义在1987-1988年学术界兴起之前一直是邓小平改革开放的指导原则，但由于主要来自强硬派、其次来自自由派的反对，邓小平在将这一理念完全转化为政策方面遇到了巨大困难。以陈云为首的强硬派坚决抵制邓小平改革中国经济的努力，而自由派虽然在经济政策上支持邓小平，却主张政治改革。1989年天安门事件后，自由派政治力量的衰落消除了邓小平推行新威权主义理念的一大障碍。1991年苏联解体后，强硬派反对依靠资本主义经济发展来维持一党专政的生存策略的势力也随之瓦解。

Besides bolstering Deng's neo-authoritarian strategy, the Soviet collapse also informed the CCP's survival strategy in many important ways.32 In the 1990s the Chinese leadership tasked the country's social scientists with carrying out a number of studies probing the factors responsible for the Soviet collapse. Not surprisingly, these studies reached very different and contradictory conclusions. In general, the liberal scholars pinned the blame on the inefficient economic system, imperial overreach, corruption, and the rigidity of the Soviet regime, but the conservative academics attributed the Soviet collapse mainly to Mikhail Gorbachev's policies of glasnost and perestroika and to the "peaceful evolution" advocated by the West.33 The conservative interpretation of the Soviet collapse would become the dominant official narrative and would influence the CCP's strategy of suppressing domestic dissent and guarding against Western influence in the post-Tiananmen era. But two conclusions drawn by liberal scholars—the Soviet regime's failure to reform its economy and its imperial overreach—had a profound impact on the party's survival strategy during this period. To be sure, credit for these two observations should go first to Deng himself because he not only had pointed out that economic failure would doom the party but also had insisted that China "must never take the lead" in confronting the West.34

除了强化邓小平的新威权主义战略外，苏联解体也在许多重要方面影响了中共的生存战略。20世纪90年代，中国领导层责成国内社会科学家开展一系列研究，探究导致苏联解体的因素。不出所料，这些研究得出了截然不同甚至相互矛盾的结论。总体而言，自由派学者将苏联解体归咎于低效的经济体制、帝国主义的过度扩张、腐败以及苏联政权的僵化；而保守派学者则主要将苏联解体归因于戈尔巴乔夫的公开性和改革政策，以及西方倡导的“和平演进”。保守派对苏联解体的解读逐渐成为官方的主流叙事，并影响了中共在后天安门时代压制国内异议和防范西方影响的战略。但自由派学者得出的两个结论——苏联政权未能成功进行经济改革以及其帝国主义扩张过度——对这一时期中共的生存战略产生了深远的影响。当然，这两个观点的功劳首先应归于邓小平本人，因为他不仅指出经济失败将导致中共的覆灭，而且还坚持认为中国在对抗西方时“绝不能带头”。

The lessons the Chinese leadership derived from the Soviet collapse, albeit eclectically, complemented Deng's neo-authoritarian vision almost perfectly and guided the party's domestic and foreign policies until the rise of Xi Jinping at the end of 2012. Domestically, the Soviet collapse underscored the centrality of economic development for the party's performance-based legitimacy, thus justifying bold market-oriented reforms and integration with the global economy. In foreign relations, the post-Tiananmen leadership faithfully followed Deng's dictum of taoguan yanghui (hiding your brightness and building up strength) and took great pains to avoid conflict with the United States. At the same time, however, the party also methodically strengthened social control to guard against "peaceful evolution," systematically cultivated nationalism to augment regime legitimacy, carried out a campaign of co-opting the social elites to expand its base of support, and consistently maintained control of the key sectors of the economy to prevent the market reforms from undermining the economic foundations of one-party rule. To be sure, the party's post-Deng leadership arrived at this comprehensive survival strategy mainly through learning and adaptation.35 Yet, judging by the party's success in economic growth and regime survival in the two decades following Deng's southern tour, the core ideas of neo-authoritarianism and the lessons from the Soviet collapse can claim a great deal of credit for the golden age of one-party rule in China from 1992 to 2012.

中国领导层从苏联解体中汲取的经验教训，尽管不尽相同，却几乎完美地契合了邓小平的新威权主义理念，并指导了中共的内外政策，直至2012年底习近平上台。在国内，苏联解体凸显了经济发展对于中共基于绩效的执政合法性的核心地位，从而为大胆的市场化改革和融入全球经济提供了正当理由。在外交方面，后天安门时代的领导层忠实地遵循了邓小平“埋头积强”的原则，并竭力避免与美国发生冲突。然而，与此同时，中共也系统性地加强社会控制，以防范“和平演进”；系统性地培育民族主义，以增强政权合法性；开展拉拢社会精英的运动，以扩大其支持基础；并始终保持对经济关键部门的控制，以防止市场改革动摇一党专政的经济基础。诚然，邓小平之后的中共领导层主要通过学习和适应，才形成了这一全面的生存战略。然而，从邓小平南巡后二十年间中共在经济增长和政权存续方面取得的成功来看，新威权主义的核心思想以及从苏联解体中汲取的经验教训，对1992年至2012年中国一党专政的黄金时代起到了至关重要的作用。





Key Pillars of the Post-Tiananmen Order





天安门事件后秩序的关键支柱


The neo-authoritarian order, beginning with Deng's historic southern tour in 1992 and ending with Xi Jinping's takeover as party chief in November 2012, lasted about two decades. In addition to producing the Chinese economic "miracle" during this period, the post-Tiananmen order was characterized by ideological consensus among the elite on policy, collective leadership and power-sharing at the top, an implicit security pact among the rulers, and recruitment and promotion of elites apparently based on established rules and norms. These observed features of elite politics deviated substantially from those that had characterized all other periods in post-1949 China. During the Maoist period (1949-1976), personalist strongman rule and constant purges dominated elite politics, as has been the case in Xi's "new era" since 2013. During the 1980s, ideological differences led to bitter conflicts over policy and triggered the fall of two general secretaries. What made post-Tiananmen elite politics relatively stable has fueled a vigorous debate about the role of institutions and power in the post-Deng era.

从邓小平1992年历史性的南巡开始，到习近平2012年11月接任中共中央总书记结束，这一新威权秩序持续了约二十年。除了在此期间创造了中国经济“奇迹”之外，后天安门时代的秩序还具有以下特征：精英阶层在政策上达成意识形态共识；高层实行集体领导和权力分享；统治者之间存在着一种隐性的安全契约；精英的招募和晋升似乎都遵循着既定的规则和规范。这些精英政治的特征与1949年以后中国其他时期截然不同。在毛泽东时代（1949-1976年），个人强人统治和持续不断的清洗主导着精英政治，正如习近平2013年以来的“新时代”一样。在20世纪80年代，意识形态分歧导致了激烈的政策冲突，并引发了两位总书记的下台。天安门事件后精英政治相对稳定的原因引发了关于邓小平后时代制度和权力作用的激烈辩论。

One obvious factor behind this development was the smooth exit of the revolutionary veterans, which began in the early 1990s and ended with Deng's death in February 1997. The transition from revolutionary veterans to a new and younger generation of well-educated technocrats (Jiang Zemin was the first party chief with a college education) took place without incident, mainly due to Deng's political maneuvering in 1992. The meltdown of opposition to his neo-authoritarian vision allowed him to appoint a leadership team that could implement his agenda of keeping the party in power through supercharged economic development. By pure coincidence, but crucially, nearly all the heavyweight hard-liners died before Deng. Their departure removed a potential threat to the new leadership to which Deng had entrusted his unfinished agenda. To be sure, a small number of slightly younger hard-liners were still alive. But shorn of powerful patrons and official positions, they could do little more than occasionally rail against a "capitalist restoration."36 The marginalization of the hard-liners after 1992 and the purge of the liberals in 1989 allowed the new leadership to pursue Deng's agenda without distraction or debilitating infighting.

这一发展背后的一个显而易见的因素是革命老将们的平稳退出，这一过程始于20世纪90年代初，止于邓小平1997年2月的逝世。从革命老将到新一代受过良好教育的、更年轻的技术官僚（江泽民是第一位拥有大学学历的党的总书记）的过渡进行得十分顺利，这主要归功于邓小平在1992年的政治运作。反对他新威权主义理念的力量瓦解，使他得以任命一个能够通过大力发展经济来巩固党的执政纲领的领导团队。纯属巧合，但至关重要的是，几乎所有重量级的强硬派都在邓小平之前去世。他们的离世消除了对新领导层的潜在威胁，而邓小平将他未竟的事业托付给了这个新领导层。当然，当时仍有一些稍年轻的强硬派在世。但由于失去了强大的支持者和官方职位，他们除了偶尔抨击“资本主义复辟”之外，几乎无能为力。1992 年后强硬派的边缘化和 1989 年自由派的清洗，使得新领导层能够不受干扰或内讧影响地推行邓小平的政策。

After Deng selected the new leadership team at the Fourteenth Party Congress in October 1992, he receded from the scene. According to his official chronology, his last public appearance was in February 1994, about three years before his death on February 19, 1997. It was during this period that the foundations of the post-Tiananmen political order were laid. Despite his reputation as an opportunist, Jiang Zemin had by then become fully committed to Deng's vision and started to implement Deng's neo-authoritarian agenda with few reservations.

1992年10月，邓小平在中共十四大上选出新的领导班子后，便淡出了公众视野。据官方记载，他最后一次公开露面是在1994年2月，大约在他1997年2月19日去世前三年。正是在这一时期，后天安门时代的政治秩序奠定了基础。尽管江泽民素有投机取巧之名，但此时他已完全认同邓小平的理念，并开始几乎毫无保留地推行邓小平的新威权主义路线。

In November 1993 Jiang shepherded approval of a landmark document at the Third Plenum of the Fourteenth Central Committee. "The CCP Center's Resolution on Several Questions on Establishing Institutions of a Socialist Market Economy" legitimized, for the first time, the status of the market economy, representing the ideological breakthrough that had eluded Deng throughout the 1980s. The resolution also laid out a blueprint for the radical economic reforms that the hard-liners had bitterly opposed in the prior decade. The fifty provisions of the resolution include plans to reform the SOEs, develop the underlying institutions of a market economy, encourage the growth of the private sector, establish mechanisms of macroeconomic management, expand the opening to the world economy, and build a modern legal system.37

1993年11月，江泽民在中共十四届三中全会上主导通过了一份具有里程碑意义的文件——《关于建立社会主义市场经济制度若干问题的中央决议》。该决议首次确立了市场经济的地位，标志着邓小平在整个20世纪80年代都未能实现的意识形态突破。决议还为激进的经济改革制定了蓝图，而强硬派在过去十年中一直强烈反对这些改革。决议的五十条规定包括改革国有企业、发展市场经济的基本制度、鼓励私营部门发展、建立宏观经济管理机制、扩大对外开放以及构建现代法律体系等。





Institutionalization of the Party and the Balance of Power





党的制度化与权力平衡


Compared with the preceding Maoist and Dengist periods as well as the subsequent Xi era, the post-Tiananmen era stands out for its normality and stability. No earth-shaking political events on the order of the Cultural Revolution, the Tiananmen crackdown, or Xi's unrelenting purge took place during this period. Although Jiang Zemin and Hu Jintao each sent a rival Politburo member to prison, these incidents are notable mainly because they were so rare. Throughout this period, China's rulers conducted their business seemingly according to a set of written rules and unwritten norms, of which the most important and effective appear to have been those governing the recruitment and promotion of officials on the basis of their age, educational qualifications, and administrative record and the disciplining and punishment of party members suspected of corruption.

与之前的毛泽东时代、邓小平时代以及随后的习近平时代相比，后天安门时代以其秩序井然和稳定著称。这一时期没有发生像文化大革命、天安门事件或习近平持续不断的清洗那样惊天动地的政治事件。尽管江泽民和胡锦涛都曾将政敌送进监狱，但这些事件之所以引人注目，主要是因为它们极为罕见。在此期间，中国的统治者似乎都遵循着一套成文的规则和不成文的规范行事，其中最重要、最有效的似乎是那些根据年龄、学历和行政记录来选拔和晋升官员，以及对涉嫌腐败的党员进行惩戒和惩罚的规则。

To be sure, the idea of making elite politics more rule-based originated in the early 1980s, as exemplified by "Guidelines on Political Life in the Party" passed by the Central Committee in 1980.38 However, few specific rules on governance within the party were formulated in the 1980s. One of Jiang's top priorities in the early to mid-1990s was to promulgate specific rules and regulations governing key procedures for appointment, promotion, discipline, and administration of local party committees. Some of the party's most important regulations, such as the Trial Regulations on the Selection and Appointment of Party and Government Leading Cadres (1995) and the Regulations on Chinese Communist Party Discipline and Sanctions (1997), were promulgated under Jiang's leadership. (The project of subjecting politics within the party to more rules continued under Hu Jintao, who updated the interim rules passed by Jiang and rolled out new ones.)39

诚然，精英政治更加规则化的理念起源于20世纪80年代初，例如1980年中央通过的《党内政治生活指导原则》。然而，80年代鲜有关于党内治理的具体规则出台。20世纪90年代初中期，江泽民的首要任务之一是颁布关于地方党委任命、晋升、纪律处分和管理等关键程序的具体规章制度。一些最重要的党规，例如《党政领导干部遴选和任命试行条例》（1995年）和《中国共产党纪律和制裁条例》（1997年），都是在江泽民的领导下颁布的。 （胡锦涛继续推进党内政治规则的制定，他更新了江泽民时期通过的临时规则，并推出了新的规则。）

The stipulations in these rules and norms provided the party with significant benefits. Making certain measurable qualifications—such as age, education attainment, and record of administrative competence (mainly in terms of economic management)—some of the considerations for recruiting and promoting officials helped add youthful vigor and technocratic capabilities to the party's local apparatus. The value placed on administrative experience in different capacities and different sectors enabled the party to train and promote well-rounded officials. The concomitant de-emphasis on ideology allowed the party to confine disagreements to policy and personality, not to polarizing debate over ideological values.

这些规则和规范中的规定给党带来了显著的益处。将年龄、教育程度和行政能力（主要体现在经济管理方面）等可衡量的资格条件纳入招募和晋升官员的考量范围，有助于为党的基层机构注入青春活力和技术官僚能力。对不同岗位和不同领域行政经验的重视，使党能够培养和提拔全面发展的官员。与此同时，对意识形态的弱化使得党能够将分歧限制在政策和个人层面，而不是陷入意识形态价值观的激烈争论。

Nonetheless, rules on "meritocracy" and administrative accomplishments could be gamed by clever local officials. For instance, officials without a genuine four-year college education could burnish their credentials with degrees obtained through less rigorous college or graduate programs. Xi Jinping, for example, received a doctorate from the prestigious Tsinghua University via a correspondence program in the late 1990s while he served as the governor of Fujian province. The practice of faking economic data to embellish one's record was widespread. Cultivating ties with superiors, often through illicit means such as bribes, could advance an official's career.40 Such meritocracy appeared to apply to the promotion of local officials more strictly than to national-level officials as patronage—personal ties to senior leaders in the party—played a decisive role in the selection of members of the Central Committee who typically staff the most important political and administrative positions in the party-state.41

然而，精明的官员可能会钻“精英选拔”和行政成就的空子。例如，一些没有真正四年制大学学历的官员可以通过一些要求较低的大学或研究生项目获得的学位来粉饰自己的资历。例如，习近平在20世纪90年代末担任福建省省长期间，就通过函授项目获得了清华大学的博士学位。伪造经济数据以美化个人政绩的做法十分普遍。与上级建立关系，通常通过贿赂等非法手段，可以促进官员的晋升。这种精英选拔制度似乎对地方官员的晋升比对国家级官员的晋升更为严格，因为裙带关系——即与党内高层领导人的私人关系——在中央委员的选拔中起着决定性作用，而中央委员通常占据着党国中最重要的政治和行政职位。

Yet, despite these flaws, codified rules and implicit norms on elite politics helped the party recruit more talented individuals and keep them committed to the party out of self-interest. At a minimum, these rules and norms provided them with a career road map for upward mobility inside the party-state. Enforced limits on term (usually two terms in the same position) and age (the mandatory retirement age was 60 for officials with the rank of vice minister or deputy provincial governor, while ministers and governors were required to retire at 65) accelerated elite circulation as officials reaching these limits were forced to retire and give way to a younger cohort. This allowed the party to avoid the Maoist-era problem when the absence of age and term limits enabled the revolutionary veterans to stay in office indefinitely, blocking the careers of younger officials. These frustrated followers of the party played an outsized role in toppling the old guard at the beginning of the Cultural Revolution.42

然而，尽管存在这些缺陷，成文的规则和关于精英政治的隐性规范仍然帮助党招募了更多人才，并出于自身利益使他们忠于党。至少，这些规则和规范为他们提供了在党国内部向上流动的职业路线图。对任期（通常同一职位最多两届）和年龄（副部长或省副省长级官员的强制退休年龄为60岁，部长和省长级官员的强制退休年龄为65岁）的强制限制加速了精英的更迭，因为达到这些限制的官员被迫退休，为更年轻的一代让路。这使得党避免了毛泽东时代的问题，当时由于没有年龄和任期限制，革命老将可以无限期地留在岗位上，阻碍了年轻官员的职业发展。这些对党感到不满的追随者在文化大革命初期推翻旧势力的过程中发挥了举足轻重的作用。

To avoid alienating a large group of officials forced into mandatory retirement, the party appointed them as deputies to local people's congresses or people's political consultative conferences (an advisory body). Those officials who retired from frontline responsibilities also retained their perks, such as generous retirement benefits, government-provided housing, and access to high-quality healthcare. They could count on support and services provided by a special bureaucracy, the "Veteran Cadres Bureau," which originally had been set up in the central government in the 1980s to cater to the needs of the octogenarian revolutionaries but had been expanded to all levels of the party-state in the 1990s. Although maintaining an ever-growing number of officials in their early sixties consumed enormous resources, the party had no trouble covering the expenses because the coffers of the state were flush with tax revenues generated from the rapidly expanding economy.

为了避免疏远一大批被迫强制退休的官员，党任命他们为地方人民代表大会或人民政治协商会议（一个咨询机构）的代表。这些从一线岗位退休的官员也保留了他们的福利，例如优厚的退休金、政府提供的住房和优质的医疗保健。他们可以依靠一个专门的机构——“老干部局”——提供的支持和服务。该机构最初于20世纪80年代在中央政府设立，旨在满足八十多岁革命者的需求，但在20世纪90年代扩展到党国各级。尽管维持越来越多六十岁出头的官员需要耗费巨资，但由于经济快速增长带来的税收充裕，国家财政收入充裕，党并不愁没有这笔开支。

Unlike during the Maoist and the Dengist eras, elite politics during the period when Jiang was effectively in charge (1993-2002) was marked by a degree of stability and collective leadership that was unmatched in all other periods of PRC history, except for the Hu era (2003-2012). When Mao ruled the party, he conducted ceaseless purges to get rid of his enemies, including his two designated successors (Liu Shaoqi and Lin Biao). In the 1980s Deng's disenchantment with his own protégés, Hu Yaobang and Zhao Ziyang, ultimately led to their ouster from power.

与毛泽东时代和邓小平时代不同，江泽民实际掌权时期（1993-2002年）的精英政治展现出前所未有的稳定性和集体领导，这在中华人民共和国历史上除胡耀邦时代（2003-2012年）外，其他任何时期都无法比拟。毛泽东执政时期，他不断进行清洗以清除异己，包括他指定的两位接班人（刘少奇和林彪）。20世纪80年代，邓小平对他的两位亲信胡耀邦和赵紫阳感到失望，最终导致他们被赶下台。

By contrast, the end of bitter ideological feuding after 1992 dramatically bolstered elite unity in the post-Tiananmen era. Jiang did not carry out any mass purges during his time as general secretary, even though he occasionally did conduct half-hearted anticorruption campaigns, mainly targeting mid-level officials.43 Only a personal rival, Politburo member Chen Xitong, was imprisoned on corruption charges in 1995 (an act of poetic justice in the eyes of many because Chen had played a dark role in the Tiananmen crackdown). To be sure, in the post-Tiananmen era personal vendettas and naked power struggles likely replaced ideological conflicts as the main cause of conflict among elites. This change may not seem to be much of an improvement. However, the presence of explicit rules for approval of the penalties to officials accused of corruption most likely constrained discretion among most party officials who would have liked to see their rivals sent to prison. It is worth noting that anticorruption investigations were not weaponized on a meaningful scale until after the rise of Xi Jinping. The party established procedures for approving penalties for senior officials found guilty of corruption in 1983. Normally, expulsion from the party had to be blessed by the standing committee of a party organization. So a member of the Central Committee could not be punished without the approval of the PSC.44

相比之下，1992年后激烈的意识形态斗争的结束，极大地增强了后天安门时代的精英阶层的团结。江泽民担任总书记期间，并未进行任何大规模清洗，尽管他偶尔也会开展一些不痛不痒的反腐运动，主要针对中层官员。1995年，只有他的私人对手、政治局委员陈希同因贪污罪入狱（在许多人看来，这是一种“诗意的正义”，因为陈希同在天安门镇压事件中扮演了不光彩的角色）。诚然，在后天安门时代，个人恩怨和赤裸裸的权力斗争很可能取代了意识形态冲突，成为精英阶层内部冲突的主要原因。这种变化或许看起来并不像是进步。然而，对贪污官员的处罚制定了明确的审批规则，这很可能限制了大多数希望将对手送进监狱的党内官员的自由裁量权。值得注意的是，反腐调查直到习近平上台后才被大规模地武器化。中共于1983年制定了对贪污高级官员进行处罚的程序。通常情况下，开除党籍需要得到党组织常务委员会的批准。因此，未经党政委员会批准，中央委员不能受到处罚。

At the highest level of the party, however, what most likely helped curb the weaponization of corruption investigations against political rivals was not merely the presence of such rules but the delicate balance of power in the PSC.45 During the Jiang era, Jiang had to share power with formidable rivals. Li Peng, the hard-line premier (and later chairman of the Standing Committee of the NPC) who occupied the second most senior position in the party, had a strong base of support among conservatives. Qiao Shi, the third-ranked leader until 1997, had enjoyed a more illustrious career than Jiang, having overseen the party's Organization Department and security apparatus. Zhu Rongji, who joined the PSC in 1992 and became premier in 1998, was no pushover, either. In 1993, after poor health and high inflation forced Li Peng, then the premier, to cede much of the executive authority of the State Council to Zhu, the former hard-charging mayor of Shanghai quickly established his credentials as the country's economic czar and served as the most influential economic policymaker in the post-Tiananmen era until his retirement in 2003.

然而，在党的最高层，真正有助于遏制将反腐调查武器化以打击政治对手的，很可能并非仅仅是相关规则的存在，而是国家政协内部微妙的权力平衡。江泽民时代，他不得不与实力强大的对手分享权力。强硬派总理李鹏（后任全国人大常委会委员长）在党内位居第二，拥有强大的保守派支持基础。乔石在1997年之前一直位列第三，他的政治生涯比江泽民更为辉煌，曾掌管党的组织部和安全机构。朱镕基于1992年进入国家政协，1998年成为总理，他也绝非等闲之辈。 1993 年，由于健康状况不佳和通货膨胀严重，时任国务院总理李鹏被迫将国务院的大部分行政权力让渡给朱棣文。这位曾任上海市长、作风强硬的朱棣文迅速确立了自己作为国家经济沙皇的地位，并在后天安门时代担任最有影响力的经济政策制定者，直至 2003 年退休。

In addition to these three political heavyweights, Jiang also had to contend with Li Ruihuan, the fourth-ranked member of the PSC, whom Deng had promoted after the Tiananmen crackdown to counter the hard-liners. Even though they allegedly did not get along, Jiang could do little more than maneuver Li into retirement at the Fifteenth Party Congress in 1997.46 The presence of Hu Jintao, Jiang's successor designated by Deng in 1992, further tied Jiang's hands. The leader-in-waiting could not be counted as a Jiang ally. If anything, Hu had a stake in preserving the balance of power to prevent Jiang from becoming a strongman and threatening his ascension to the top party position after Jiang served out his full second term in 2002.

除了这三位政治重量级人物之外，江泽民还不得不应对国家常委李瑞环。李瑞环是邓小平在天安门事件后提拔的，目的是为了对抗强硬派。尽管两人据称关系不睦，但江泽民也只能在1997年的中共十五大上设法让李瑞环退休。胡锦涛的存在进一步束缚了江泽民的手脚。胡锦涛是邓小平在1992年指定的江泽民接班人。这位未来的领导人不能算是江泽民的盟友。事实上，胡锦涛更希望维持权力平衡，防止江泽民成为强人，从而避免在江泽民2002年第二个任期结束后威胁到他自己接任党的最高领导人。

This analysis suggests that, perhaps more critical than any formal rules, the finely tuned balance of power during the Jiang era (and later in the Hu era) preserved elite stability and collective leadership. Rules are effective only when they can be enforced with coercive power. In the post-Tiananmen era, the appearance of institutionalization and relative stability in elite politics led some to conclude that the party had successfully established binding rules and norms, and politics in the erstwhile Hobbesian world had become “normal.”47 But skeptics questioned whether, in the absence of a third-party enforcer, elites in an autocracy can be counted on to exercise self-restraint and abide by any rules and norms.48 What stands out in the post-Tiananmen era is the total absence of a third party—such as an empowered electorate, an independent judiciary, or a free press—that could enforce party rules and norms. The absence of third-party enforcers was by design rather than by accident. It was Deng’s firm opposition to the political liberalization and to the checks and balances proposed by Zhao in 1987 that blocked the establishment of potential third-party enforcers.

这项分析表明，或许比任何正式规则都更为关键的是，江泽民时代（以及后来的胡锦涛时代）精心调配的权力平衡维护了精英阶层的稳定和集体领导。规则只有在能够通过强制力来执行时才有效。在后天安门时代，精英政治的制度化和相对稳定使一些人得出结论：党已经成功建立了具有约束力的规则和规范，昔日霍布斯式世界的政治已经“正常化”。但怀疑论者质疑，在缺乏第三方强制执行的情况下，专制政体中的精英是否能够自律并遵守任何规则和规范。后天安门时代最显著的特点是完全缺乏能够强制执行党的规则和规范的第三方——例如拥有实权的选民、独立的司法机构或自由的媒体。第三方执法机构的缺失并非偶然，而是有意为之。正是邓小平在1987年对政治自由化和赵立坚提出的权力制衡方案的坚决反对，才阻碍了潜在第三方执法机构的建立。

The fragile balance of power in the post-Tiananmen era enabled the party to adhere to its rules of succession. But a closer look at the two successions, in 2002 and 2012, shows that these two cases were close calls, and they reveal that the institutionalization of elite politics in the post-Tiananmen era was mostly an optical illusion. In the case of Hu's succession in 2002, Jiang most likely resented Deng's appointment of Hu as his successor, but he lacked the power to remove him. Yet Jiang still tried to hang on to power by keeping his position as chairman of the party's Central Military Commission, ostensibly following the precedent set by Deng (who retained the same position after giving up his seat on the PSC in 1987). In Chinese vernacular, Jiang did not retire "naked" (luotui) by giving up all his official titles, as Hu would later do in 2012.

天安门事件后脆弱的权力平衡使得中共得以继续执行其权力交接规则。但仔细分析2002年和2012年的两次权力交接，就会发现这两起事件都险象环生，也揭示了天安门事件后精英政治制度化的表象在很大程度上只是一种假象。以2002年胡锦涛的继任为例，江泽民很可能对邓小平任命胡锦涛为接班人感到不满，但他却无力罢免胡锦涛。然而，江泽民仍然试图通过保留中共中央军事委员会主席的职位来保住权力，表面上是效仿邓小平的做法（邓小平在1987年卸任国家安全委员会委员后仍保留了这一职位）。用通俗的话来说，江泽民并没有像胡锦涛在2012年那样“赤身裸体”（放弃所有官职）地退休。

The shallowness of the party's institutionalization was again on display at its Seventeenth Party Congress in 2007, when Hu's successor was to be selected. Deng's far-sighted, if not preemptive, move to designate Jiang's successor in 1992 may have spared the party a brutal power struggle in 2002, but in 2007 the party was forced to reach agreement on who should succeed Hu. As will be discussed later in this chapter, there were no rules for the party to follow. Xi Jinping—the eventual victor emerging from a contest between Jiang and Hu—was unaffiliated with either faction. But it was this relatively unknown princeling who, after his rise to power in November 2012, wasted little time in purging his political rivals and destroying the fragile balance of power at the top. Xi's success in expanding and perpetuating his personal power reconfirmed that the many rules and norms the party had instituted in the post-Mao era were no match to the political ruthlessness and machinations of a strongman. If anything, the relative tranquility in elite politics during the post-Tiananmen era was the exception that proves the rule of the impossibility of institutionalizing politics in a dictatorship.

2007年，在选择胡锦涛接班人的十七大上，党的制度化程度再次暴露无遗。邓小平在1992年高瞻远瞩地指定江泽民的接班人，或许避免了2002年党内残酷的权力斗争，但到了2007年，党不得不就胡锦涛的接班人达成一致。正如本章稍后将要讨论的，当时党内没有任何规则可循。最终在江泽民和胡锦涛的竞争中胜出的习近平，与这两个派系都没有任何关联。然而，正是这位相对不为人知的“太子党”在2012年11月上台后，迅速清洗了政治对手，破坏了高层脆弱的权力平衡。习近平成功扩大并巩固了个人权力，这再次印证了毛泽东时代之后党内建立的诸多规则和规范，根本无法抵挡强人的政治冷酷无情和权谋手段。如果说有什么例外的话，那就是天安门事件后精英政治的相对平静，恰恰证明了在独裁政权下政治制度化是不可能的。





The Patriotic Education Campaign and the Resurgence of Nationalism





爱国主义教育运动与民族主义的复兴


On June 9, 1989, five days after the PLA crushed the Tiananmen prodemocracy movement, Deng Xiaoping met with senior military officers responsible for the crackdown. As he thanked them for their "hard work," Deng also admitted that "the biggest mistake [we] have made in the last decade was . . . [neglecting] ideological and political education."49 To remedy this mistake, his successors in the 1990s launched a comprehensive campaign to revive nationalism as a means of cultivating mass support for the party. The core component of this campaign was patriotic education—a program utilizing party control of the education system, media, and cultural facilities to instill in the Chinese public, especially the younger generations, national pride, resentment against Western imperialism, and loyalty to the party.

1989年6月9日，解放军镇压天安门民主运动五天后，邓小平会见了负责镇压的高级军官。在感谢他们“辛勤工作”的同时，邓小平也承认“过去十年我们犯的最大错误是……忽视了思想政治教育”。为了弥补这一错误，他的继任者在20世纪90年代发起了一场全面的民族主义复兴运动，以此来培养群众对党的支持。这场运动的核心是爱国主义教育——一项利用党对教育系统、媒体和文化设施的控制，向中国民众，特别是年轻一代灌输民族自豪感、反西方帝国主义情绪和对党的忠诚的计划。

The patriotic education campaign slightly predated Deng's historic southern tour. In late August 1991, prodded by newly installed party general secretary Jiang Zemin, the State Education Commission issued two important documents. One required a strengthening of the history curriculum in primary and middle schools so that pupils would learn more about China's modern and contemporary history. The document explicitly stated that this undertaking aimed to "smash the plot of 'peaceful evolution' by domestic and foreign hostile forces." To ensure that students would have an incentive to study the party's version of history, the document also mandated that starting in 1992, the college entrance examinations, or gaokao, would test knowledge of party history. The second document directed schools and universities to organize visits to museums and revolutionary monuments as part of a program to foster "patriotism and a revolutionary spirit."50

爱国主义教育运动略早于邓小平的历史性南巡。1991年8月下旬，在新任中共中央总书记江泽民的推动下，国家教育委员会发布了两份重要文件。其中一份文件要求加强中小学历史课程，使学生更多地了解中国近代史和当代史。该文件明确指出，此举旨在“粉碎国内外敌对势力‘和平演进’的阴谋”。为了确保学生有动力学习党的历史版本，该文件还规定，从1992年开始，高考将考察学生对党的历史知识。第二份文件指示各中小学和高校组织学生参观博物馆和革命纪念碑，以此作为培养“爱国主义和革命精神”的举措之一。

The most important policy document on patriotic education, "Outline on the Implementation of Patriotic Education," was issued by the CCP Central Propaganda Department in August 1994.51 It laid out the specific provisions for this campaign. Among other things, patriotic education was to focus on Chinese history, China's contributions to civilization, Chinese resistance to foreign aggression and oppression, and CCP policy and accomplishments in economic development. The younger generations were to be the target audience of the patriotic education campaign, and schools were to be the primary venue for this endeavor. Textbooks in primary and middle schools were required to include content on patriotic education. Additionally, films, television, publications, and music would be utilized to disseminate patriotic education. The government would also fund the establishment of "patriotic education bases"—museums, historical monuments, sites of major battles during the civil war, and well-known cultural heritage sites. Patriotic rituals, such as singing the national anthem and flag-raising, would be required at graduation commencement ceremonies and at large sports events. Patriotic education also included promotion of patriotic models—party leaders, artists, poets, and revolutionary martyrs—who had made outstanding contributions to China.

关于爱国主义教育最重要的政策文件是1994年8月由中共中央宣传部发布的《爱国主义教育实施纲要》。该纲要详细阐述了爱国主义教育的具体内容。爱国主义教育的重点包括中国历史、中国对文明的贡献、中国抵抗外国侵略和压迫的历史以及中共在经济发展方面的政策和成就。爱国主义教育的目标群体是青年一代，学校是开展这项活动的主要场所。中小学教科书必须包含爱国主义教育内容。此外，电影、电视、出版物和音乐等也将被用于传播爱国主义教育。政府还将资助建立“爱国主义教育基地”，包括博物馆、历史古迹、内战时期重大战役遗址和著名文化遗产地。爱国主义仪式，例如唱国歌和升国旗，将成为毕业典礼和大型体育赛事上的必要环节。爱国主义教育还包括宣传爱国主义楷模——为中国做出杰出贡献的党的领导人、艺术家、诗人以及革命烈士。

The motivation behind Jiang's push for patriotic education is easy to identify. Politically, he wanted to establish his bona fides as an ideological conservative faithfully implementing Deng's edicts. In the aftermath of the Tiananmen debacle of 1989 and the disintegration of the Soviet Union, cultivating Chinese nationalism also served party interests because it could rally the public behind the party after orthodox Communist ideology had lost its popular appeal.52

江泽民大力推行爱国主义教育的动机不难理解。从政治角度来看，他希望借此确立自己作为忠实执行邓小平思想的保守派意识形态形象。在1989年天安门事件和苏联解体之后，培养民族主义也符合党的利益，因为在正统共产主义意识形态失去民心之后，民族主义能够重新凝聚民众力量，支持党的利益。

Following promulgation of the "Outline" in 1994, the party mobilized its propaganda apparatus and the entire education system to implement patriotic education. Judging from official publications, universities and schools carried out the specific instructions laid out in the "Outline." Curricula were revised to include the required patriotic education content, such as the history of Western imperial aggression and Chinese culture, tradition, and patriotism. Schools began to hold regular flag-raising ceremonies, sing the national anthem at major events, and hang national flags in classrooms, lecture halls, and offices.53 "Patriotic education bases"—newly designated revolutionary monuments, sites of major battles during the second Sino-Japanese war (1937-1945), history museums, and birthplaces of major revolutionary and cultural figures—were established throughout the country. The narratives in the majority of these bases explicitly glorified the role of the CCP in regaining the country's sovereignty, independence, and dignity after a century of national weakness and humiliation.54

1994年《爱国主义纲要》颁布后，党动员宣传机器和整个教育系统开展爱国主义教育。从官方出版物来看，各高校和中小学都严格执行了《纲要》的具体指示。课程进行了修订，纳入了西方帝国主义侵略史、中国文化传统和爱国主义等爱国主义教育内容。学校开始定期举行升旗仪式，在重大活动中奏唱国歌，并在教室、讲堂和办公室悬挂国旗。全国各地还建立了“爱国主义教育基地”，包括新指定的革命纪念碑、抗日战争（1937-1945）重大战役遗址、历史博物馆以及重要革命和文化人物的故居。这些基地中的大多数叙事都明确地歌颂了中国共产党在经历了一个世纪的民族衰弱和屈辱之后，为恢复国家主权、独立和尊严所发挥的作用。

University students were the chief target of patriotic education because the party viewed them as more deeply corrupted by Western ideas and potentially more threatening to CCP rule than any other social groups. Students were required to take two courses: "Theories of Marxism and Leninism" and the "Current Situation and Policy" (xingshi zhengce jiaoyu). Although the campaign was labeled "patriotic education," its primary objective, according to a senior official in the State Education Commission, was to ensure loyalty to Deng's "four cardinal principles" and to the party mission of constructing "socialism with Chinese characteristics under the leadership of the Communist Party."55 Some university officials explicitly stated that the "basic component" of patriotic education was "love for the party and socialism."56

大学生是爱国主义教育的主要目标群体，因为中共认为他们比其他任何社会群体都更容易受到西方思想的腐蚀，对中共统治的潜在威胁也更大。学生必须修读两门课程：“马克思列宁主义理论”和“形势与政策”。尽管这场运动被冠以“爱国主义教育”之名，但据国家教育委员会一位高级官员称，其主要目的是确保学生忠于邓小平的“四项基本原则”以及党的“在党的领导下建设中国特色社会主义”的使命。一些大学官员明确指出，爱国主义教育的“基本组成部分”是“热爱党和社会主义”。

In a major departure from the party's triumphalist tone in promoting Chinese nationalism during the Mao era, the post-Tiananmen leadership opted for a victimhood narrative emphasizing imperial bullying of China and portraying the party as the greatest defender of China's honor.57 The party deliberately picked this theme because, after the Tiananmen crackdown and the Soviet collapse, China was isolated from the West, and it was easy to portray the West as again attempting to subjugate China.

与毛泽东时代党在宣扬中国民族主义时所持的凯旋式口吻截然不同，天安门事件后的领导层选择了一种受害者叙事，强调帝国主义对中国的欺凌，并将党描绘成中国荣誉的最伟大捍卫者。党之所以刻意选择这一主题，是因为在天安门事件和苏联解体后，中国与西方隔绝，很容易将西方描绘成再次试图征服中国。

By coincidence, a series of incidents in the 1990s helped lend credibility to the party's victimhood narrative and reinforce its message that the United States, then the world's sole superpower, was intent on containing China. In 1993 the so-called Yinhe incident enraged the Chinese public. US intelligence agencies accused the Yinhe, a Chinese container ship, of carrying materials to be used in Iran's chemical weapons, and, likely due to American diplomatic intervention, the United Arab Emirates prevented it from docking in its ports. Even after an inspection revealed that the Yinhe was not carrying any contraband, the United States refused to apologize. In 1995, under pressure from Congress, the Clinton administration was forced to grant a visa to Lee Tenghui to visit the United States. Lee was at the time the president of Taiwan, who was reviled in Beijing for his pro-independence aspirations. In response to the pro-independence remarks Lee had made in the United States, China staged a series of military exercises as a warning to Taiwan. But Washington responded in March 1996 by dispatching two carrier battle groups to the waters surrounding Taiwan as China was conducting its largest military exercises thus far, which included the firing of missiles into the waters near Taiwan. Although no military conflict broke out, America's show of support for Taiwan once again angered the Chinese public.58

巧合的是，上世纪90年代发生的一系列事件反而增强了中共的受害者叙事可信度，并强化了其关于美国——当时世界唯一的超级大国——意图遏制中国的论调。1993年，所谓的“银河号事件”激怒了中国民众。美国情报机构指控中国货轮“银河号”载有用于伊朗化学武器的材料，很可能是由于美国的干预，阿联酋阻止了该船停靠其港口。即使检查结果显示“银河号”并未载有任何违禁品，美国仍拒绝道歉。1995年，在国会的压力下，克林顿政府被迫向李登辉发放签证，允许他访问美国。李登辉当时是台湾地区领导人，因其支持台独的倾向而受到北京的强烈谴责。为了回应李登辉在美国发表的台独言论，中国举行了一系列军事演习，以警告台湾。但华盛顿在1996年3月做出回应，派遣两个航母战斗群前往台湾周边海域，当时中国正在进行迄今为止规模最大的军事演习，其中包括向台湾附近海域发射导弹。尽管没有爆发军事冲突，但美国对台湾的支持再次激怒了中国公众。

The event that perhaps did more than anything else to help reinforce the party's narrative of Chinese victimhood is the accidental bombing of the Chinese Embassy in Belgrade by an American stealth fighter during a NATO bombing campaign against Serbia in May 1999. Despite Washington's explanations and apologies, Chinese leaders insisted that this was a deliberate act, and ordinary Chinese took part in nationwide anti-American demonstrations. Angry protestors in Beijing, many of whom were university students, trashed the American Embassy with rocks and other projectiles. In Chengdu, mobs set on fire the residence of the US consul-general.59

或许最能强化中共“中国受害者”叙事的事件，莫过于1999年5月北约轰炸塞尔维亚期间，美国隐形战斗机误炸中国驻贝尔格莱德大使馆。尽管华盛顿方面做出了解释和道歉，中国领导人仍坚称这是一起蓄意行为，普通中国民众也参与了全国范围内的反美示威活动。在北京，愤怒的抗议者（其中许多是大学生）用石块和其他投掷物砸毁了美国大使馆。在成都，暴徒纵火焚烧了美国总领事官邸。

Judging by such a virulent outpouring of anti-Americanism, exactly one decade after prodemocracy students had erected a miniature Statue of Liberty in Tiananmen Square, the party's patriotic education campaign obviously succeeded beyond its own expectations. Indeed, most scholarly research on the rise of Chinese nationalism in the 1990s finds that the attitudes of the Chinese public at the time, in particular the attitudes of the younger generations, became more patriotic and more progovernment.60

从如此强烈的反美情绪来看，就在民主派学生在天安门广场竖起一座微型自由女神像整整十年后，中共的爱国主义教育运动显然取得了超出预期的成功。事实上，大多数关于20世纪90年代中国民族主义兴起的学术研究都发现，当时中国公众，特别是年轻一代的态度变得更加爱国，也更加亲政府。





Selective Repression





选择性抑制


One of the key lessons learned by the party leadership from the Tiananmen crisis was the need for a more effective coercive apparatus. As a result, the party undertook a comprehensive campaign in the 1990s to invest in the state's coercive capacity.61 In April 1990 the party issued a key policy document on strengthening domestic security. Its provisions included restoration of the Central Political and Legal Affairs Commission, a specialized party bureaucracy in charge of law enforcement that had been abolished by reformist party chief Zhao Ziyang in 1988. This resurrected commission was to supervise the strengthening of law enforcement and to coordinate implementation of the party's security agenda. The document vows to wage a merciless struggle against "hostile forces, infiltration, and subversion." It explicitly orders the establishment of urban mobile antiriot forces to quell demonstrations (China had not had specialized antiriot police to deal with the prodemocracy protesters in 1989).62

中共领导层从天安门事件中吸取的重要教训之一是，需要建立更有效的强制机制。因此，中共在20世纪90年代开展了一场全面的运动，旨在提升国家的强制能力。1990年4月，中共发布了一份关于加强国内安全的重要政策文件。该文件规定恢复中央政法委，这是一个负责执法的专门党务机构，曾于1988年被改革派领导人赵紫阳废除。恢复后的政法委负责监督加强执法工作，并协调党的各项安全议程的实施。该文件誓言要对“敌对势力、渗透和颠覆”进行无情的斗争。它明确命令建立城市机动防暴部队来镇压示威活动（1989年中国没有专门的防暴警察来应对民主抗议者）。

Ten months after the issuance of this document, the party released a second directive on domestic security, "Decision on Strengthening Comprehensive Management of Public Security." On paper, this document appears to emphasize law and order as well as social stability, but it also includes provisions for tightening social control, such as monitoring the "floating population" (people without fixed household registrations) and surveillance of dance halls, printed materials, and venues for showing videos. It calls on local governments to increase funding for law enforcement.63

在该文件发布十个月后，党发布了第二份关于国内安全的指令——《关于加强公安综合管理的决定》。这份文件表面上强调维护法律秩序和社会稳定，但同时也包含加强社会管控的条款，例如对“流动人口”（无固定户籍的人）进行监控，以及对舞厅、印刷品和视频播放场所进行监视。文件还要求地方政府增加执法经费。

Investment in China's coercive apparatus—police, courts, and procuratorates—rose dramatically in the years after these documents were issued. From 1991 to 1995 the amount spent on these three branches of the state rose threefold in absolute terms (from 10 billion yuan in 1991 to 30 billion yuan in 1995). By 2002, a decade after Deng's southern tour, spending on these three branches would rise to 110 billion yuan, ten times the amount in 1991 (unadjusted for inflation).64

这些文件颁布后的几年里，对中国强制机构——警察、法院和检察机关——的投资大幅增长。1991年至1995年，这三个国家部门的支出绝对值增长了三倍（从1991年的100亿元人民币增至1995年的300亿元人民币）。到2002年，即邓小平南巡十年后，这三个部门的支出将达到1100亿元人民币，是1991年的十倍（未经通货膨胀调整）。

The size of the police force more than doubled from 1989 to 2010 (from 769,000 to at least 2 million).65 Starting in the early 2000s, the party expanded the police units responsible for domestic surveillance and political repression ("domestic security protection"), adding probably more than ten thousand police devoted solely to dealing with political dissidents, underground religious believers, and cult members.66 In mid-1990 the People's Armed Police (PAP) began to form specialized antiriot units. By the end of the 1990s, most local police departments had established similar units.67

从1989年到2010年，警察部队规模增加了一倍多（从76.9万人增至至少200万人）。从21世纪初开始，党扩大了负责国内监视和政治镇压的警察部队（“国内安全保护”），可能增加了超过一万名专门负责处理政治异见人士、地下宗教信徒和邪教成员的警察。1990年代中期，人民武警开始组建专门的防暴部队。到1990年代末，大多数地方警察部门都建立了类似的部队。

In the 1990s the party launched a series of initiatives to upgrade the capabilities of the surveillance state. In November 1991 the powerful Ministry of Public Security (MPS) issued new rules on surveillance of "key populations" (such as dissidents, activists in underground religious groups, and ex-convicts). In December 1991 the ministry established covert operations on university campuses. In May 1992 it directed local police to increase manpower to target Western "infiltration," underground Catholic groups, and cults. At the direction of the party, police intensified internet surveillance in July 1997, and in October 1997 it tightened control over foreign funding of Chinese social science research organizations.68 The decade saw a major expansion of the network of informants recruited by the police to act as the "eyes and ears" of law enforcement. For example, the number of "special intelligence personnel" (informers) employed by police in Shaanxi province nearly doubled between 1988 and 2001.69

上世纪90年代，中共推出了一系列举措，旨在提升监控国家的能力。1991年11月，权力强大的公安部颁布了针对“重点人群”（如异见人士、地下宗教团体活动人士和刑满释放人员）的监控新规。1991年12月，公安部在大学校园内开展了秘密行动。1992年5月，公安部指示地方警察增加警力，以打击西方“渗透”、地下天主教团体和邪教组织。在中共的指示下，警方于1997年7月加强了对互联网的监控，并于1997年10月收紧了对中国社会科学研究机构接受外国资助的控制。这十年间，警方招募的线人网络大幅扩张，这些线人充当了执法部门的“耳目”。例如，1988年至2001年间，陕西省警方雇佣的“特殊情报人员”（线人）人数几乎翻了一番。

The 1990s also saw the beginning of a well-funded program to upgrade the technological capabilities of the coercive capacity of the party-state. In November 1991 the MPS convened a national conference on the modernization of law enforcement technology, marking the beginning of a drive to upgrade law enforcement with advanced surveillance technology.70 In 1998 the party formally approved the Golden Shield Project (the IT modernization program of the MPS that includes the "Great Firewall of China").71

20世纪90年代，一项旨在提升党国强制能力技术水平的专项资金计划也开始实施。1991年11月，公安部召开全国执法技术现代化会议，标志着以先进监控技术升级执法工作的开端。1998年，党正式批准了“金盾工程”（公安部信息技术现代化项目，其中包括“防火长城”）。

In addition to its sustained and massive investment in coercive capacity, during the Jiang era the party constantly refined its tactics of repression, often deploying methods used in soft-authoritarian regimes in other East Asian countries.72 Inviting known dissidents to "tea" as a subtle form of intimidation became a routine tactic, as was the use of family relatives and friends to engage in emotional blackmail against ordinary citizens who participated in peaceful petitioning. When brutal force was needed, local authorities would hire thugs to beat up the protesters. Aware that major public holidays, key anniversaries (such as the anniversary of the June 4 massacre), or visits by foreign dignitaries could become rallying points for collective protests, police would tighten security measures on those sensitive dates to prevent such disturbances from occurring.73

除了持续大规模地投入强制力之外，江泽民时代，中共不断完善其镇压策略，经常借鉴其他东亚国家温和威权政权的手段。邀请已知的异见人士“喝茶”作为一种隐晦的恐吓手段成为常规做法，利用亲友对参与和平请愿的普通民众进行情感勒索也成为惯例。必要时，地方当局会雇佣暴徒殴打示威者。警方意识到重大公共假日、重要纪念日（例如六四事件周年纪念日）或外国政要访问都可能成为集体抗议的集结点，因此会在这些敏感日期加强安保措施，以防止此类骚乱发生。

The regime became more selective in picking its targets. It prosecuted and jailed fewer dissidents, often preferring to charge dissidents with nonpolitical crimes (such as disturbing public order) instead of "subverting state power." To decapitate political opposition at home and to placate Western governments, which the post-1989 regime sought to woo in order to maintain access to capital, technology, and markets, the party forced into exile nearly all the best-known dissidents, such as Wei Jingsheng (the symbol of the Democracy Wall Movement in 1978–1979) and Wang Dan and Wang Juntao (leaders of the Tiananmen protests in 1989).74

该政权在选择打击目标时变得更加有选择性。它减少了对异议人士的起诉和监禁，往往更倾向于以非政治罪名（例如扰乱公共秩序）而非“颠覆国家政权”来指控异议人士。为了在国内铲除政治反对派，并安抚西方政府（1989年后的政权试图拉拢西方国家以维持其获取资本、技术和市场的渠道），该党迫使几乎所有最知名的异议人士流亡海外，例如魏京生（1978-1979年民主墙运动的象征人物）以及王丹和王军涛（1989年天安门抗议活动的领导人）。

Several key factors motivated the post-Tiananmen regime to massively increase investment in its coercive capacity but at the same time also to adopt more refined tactics of repression. Due to the party's near-death experience during the Tiananmen crisis, it came to appreciate that its coercive capacity was the ultimate guarantor of regime survival and that prevention of a similar crisis was far preferable to a brutal crackdown. The rapid growth of fiscal revenue during the booming 1990s also enabled the state to channel more resources into law enforcement and surveillance. The switch to soft-authoritarian tactics of repression allowed the party to target fewer political threats more effectively and to leave most of the population unaffected. Politically, selective repression served the party well. Most ordinary people enjoyed continual expansion of their personal freedoms as the economy thrived. This was translated into mass support for the regime. Geopolitically, soft-authoritarian repression helped reduce tensions between China and its key trading partners in the West, justifying that engagement with China offered tangible evidence that economic liberalization might lead to a political opening in the future.

天安门事件后，促使中共政权大幅提升其强制力，同时采取更为精细的镇压策略，是多种关键因素共同作用的结果。由于天安门事件中中共的生死存亡，它认识到强制力是政权生存的最终保障，预防类似危机远比残酷镇压更为可取。20世纪90年代经济繁荣时期财政收入的快速增长，也使得国家能够将更多资源投入执法和监控。转向温和的威权镇压策略，使得中共能够更有效地打击少数政治威胁，同时又不至于影响到大多数民众。在政治上，选择性镇压对中共十分有利。随着经济的繁荣发展，大多数普通民众的个人自由不断扩大，这转化为对政权的广泛支持。从地缘政治角度来看，温和的威权镇压有助于缓解中国与其西方主要贸易伙伴之间的紧张关系，证明与中国的接触提供了切实的证据，表明经济自由化可能会在未来带来政治开放。

Despite adoption of more refined tactics of repression, the essential bureaucratic organizations of totalitarianism and the mechanisms of deploying them for mass terror remained intact.
