The party could quickly mobilize these organizations when confronted with a direct and forceful challenge to its authority, as in the case of the protests staged by the Falungong spiritual group in 1999. After the party leadership issued an order banning this group, which allegedly had tens of millions nationwide followers, Chinese police resorted to extremely brutal methods to arrest, imprison, and torture its leaders and followers, effectively destroying the group as an organized force within only a few years.75

尽管采取了更为精细的镇压策略，但极权主义的基本官僚机构及其用于大规模恐怖活动的机制依然完好无损。当面临对其权威的直接而强烈的挑战时，例如1999年法轮功精神团体发起的抗议活动，党可以迅速动员这些机构。据称，法轮功在全国拥有数千万信徒，在党的领导层下令取缔该团体后，中国警方采取了极其残酷的手段逮捕、监禁和酷刑折磨其领导人和追随者，在短短几年内有效地摧毁了该团体的组织力量。

The near-total destruction of Falungong foreshadowed the return of totalitarian rule under Xi Jinping more than a decade later.

法轮宫的近乎彻底的毁灭预示着十多年后习近平领导下的极权统治的回归。





Co-optation of Social Elites





对社会精英的收买


A distinct feature of the post-1989 neo-authoritarian order is the successful effort by the party to expand its social base beyond workers and peasants, the two groups that made up the majority of party members but that had lost huge economic ground and political influence during the post-Mao era. In 1978, on the eve of Deng's reform, peasants constituted 47 percent of party members, while workers accounted for nearly 19 percent. Only 1.6 percent of the 37 million party members were classified as "professionals, cadres, and students."76 The majority of party members were poorly educated. In 1980, 11 percent of party members were illiterate, 45 percent had only a primary-school education, and a mere 3 percent had received a college-level education.77 As the party pivoted to a survival strategy centered on economic development, it needed to recruit individuals with better educational and professional qualifications. Beyond the requirement for expertise that would be useful in managing a complex economy, the party's strategy was to co-opt the very social elites whom it had viewed as enemies or threats during the Maoist era. This tactic also contained a Machiavellian element: preempting elite-based opposition in Chinese society. Exclusion of elites with a higher social status and more economic resources could antagonize and even turn such social elites into opponents of the regime. Because repression of the intelligentsia and private entrepreneurs could endanger the party's economic agenda, it therefore was no longer attractive, and co-optation became a preferred option.

1989年后新威权秩序的一个显著特征是，党成功地将其社会基础扩展到工人和农民之外。工人和农民这两个群体虽然构成了党员的大多数，但在后毛泽东时代失去了巨大的经济地位和政治影响力。1978年，在邓小平改革前夕，农民占党员总数的47%，工人占近19%。在3700万党员中，只有1.6%被归类为“专业人才、干部和学生”。大多数党员的教育水平较低。1980年，11%的党员是文盲，45%的党员只有小学学历，仅有3%的党员接受过大学教育。随着党转向以经济发展为中心的生存战略，它需要招募具有更高教育和专业素质的人才。除了需要具备管理复杂经济所需的专业知识外，党的策略还在于拉拢那些在毛泽东时代被视为敌人或威胁的社会精英。这一策略也包含着马基雅维利式的成分：先发制人，扼杀中国社会中精英阶层的反对。排斥那些拥有较高社会地位和较多经济资源的精英，可能会激怒他们，甚至使他们成为政权的反对者。由于镇压知识分子和私营企业家可能会危及党的经济议程，因此这种做法不再具有吸引力，拉拢精英便成为更优的选择。

The broad outline of the party's strategy of co-opting social elites was laid out in a September 1994 Central Committee decision on party building. Among the top priorities identified by the party were the appointment and promotion of a large number of loyal and talented young officials and recruitment of "outstanding elements" among young people and women.78 Initially, the focus of the co-optation strategy was the recruitment and promotion of well-educated individuals, in particular university students, a group the party had a strong incentive to win over given its role in leading the prodemocracy movements in the 1980s.79 (The party issued a specific directive in 2005 on strengthening recruitment of university students.)80 For example, the share of party members among undergraduates at prestigious Tsinghua University doubled from 8.3 percent to 16.5 percent between 1995 and 2005 (the share would rise to 29 percent in 2011).81 As the party controlled access to career opportunities, it had no difficulty luring talented and ambitious university students to join its ranks.82

1994 年 9 月，中央委员会就党的建设问题作出了决定，概述了党拉拢社会精英的战略纲要。该党确定的首要任务之一是任命和提拔大量忠诚且有才华的青年官员，以及招募青年和妇女中的“优秀人才”。78 最初，拉拢策略的重点是招募和提拔受过良好教育的人员，特别是大学生。鉴于该党在20世纪80年代领导民主运动的作用，它有强烈的动机争取大学生的支持。79 （该党在2005年发布了一项关于加强招募大学生的专项指示。）80 例如，在著名的清华大学，本科生中党员的比例从1995年的8.3%翻了一番，达到2005年的16.5%（到2011年，这一比例将上升到29%）。81 由于该党控制着职业机会，因此它很容易吸引有才华且有抱负的大学生加入其政党。排名.82

The drive to recruit well-educated individuals made rapid progress in the 1990s, and toward the end of the post-Tiananmen era it had dramatically transformed the composition of the party. In 1990 only 10.3 percent of party members had received a college-level education or higher. A decade later, 21 percent of party members had a college-level education or higher.83 By 2000 the party would be unrecognizable to its founders. Of the 64.5 million members, workers and peasants accounted for about 44 percent (compared with 66 percent in 1979). The share of professionals had risen to 19 percent (from 1.6 percent in 1978).84 The share of workers and peasants in the party would continue to fall as the party recruited more college graduates and professionals. In 2011 workers and peasants made up 39 percent of party members, while managers (excluding full-time party and government officials), professionals, and college students accounted for 27 percent. Close to 40 percent of party members had a college-level education or higher.85

20世纪90年代，招募高学历人才的行动取得了快速进展，到后天安门时代末期，这一行动已彻底改变了党的构成。1990年，仅有10.3%的党员拥有大学或以上学历。十年后，这一比例上升至21%。到2000年，党的面貌已与创始人所设想的截然不同。在6450万党员中，工人和农民约占44%（1979年为66%）。专业人士的比例上升至19%（1978年为1.6%）。随着党招募更多大学毕业生和专业人士，工人和农民在党内的比例将继续下降。 2011年，工人和农民占党员总数的39%，管理人员（不包括专职党政干部）、专业人士和大学生占27%。近40%的党员拥有大专及以上学历。

After the party's efforts to co-opt the well-educated yielded impressive results, it shifted its attention to private entrepreneurs who had gained social status and enormous resources during the booming 1990s. The milestone was Jiang Zemin's theory of the "Three Represents," unveiled with great fanfare on July 1, 2001, the eightieth anniversary of the founding of the party.86 Ostensibly, Jiang was trying to advance a new ideological theory spelling out what the party stood for (or represented) to replace the party's orthodox ideological doctrine that had emphasized revolution and struggle against capitalism. Ideologically, the "Three Represents" implicitly endorsed capitalism, which Jiang euphemistically but awkwardly termed "advanced social productive forces." In practice, this framing opened the door for the party to admit as members private entrepreneurs—the very exploiting class whose destruction theoretically is the goal of orthodox communism.

在党拉拢受过良好教育的人群取得显著成效后，它将注意力转向了在20世纪90年代经济繁荣时期获得社会地位和巨额资源的私营企业家。一个里程碑式的事件是江泽民提出的“三个代表”理论，该理论于2001年7月1日，即党建党八十周年之际，高调发布。表面上看，江泽民试图推进一种新的意识形态理论，阐明党的立场（或代表），以取代党以往强调革命和反资本主义斗争的正统意识形态。从意识形态上看，“三个代表”实际上认可了资本主义，江泽民委婉但笨拙地将其称为“先进的社会生产力”。实际上，这种框架为党接纳私营企业家——这个剥削阶级，而理论上，消灭他们是正统共产主义的目标——打开了大门。

Even though Jiang's "Three Represents," which the party enshrined in its charter in November 2002 as "important thought," do not appear to have done much to rejuvenate the party ideologically, the green light to recruit capitalists quickly had a notable impact on co-opting a new social group that was in control of a growing portion of the national economy. By 2000, private firms (excluding micro household businesses) employed over 24 million workers.87 Obviously, the party was eager to gain the support of this group of social elites.

尽管江泽民的“三个代表”（该思想于2002年11月被写入党章，并被奉为“重要思想”）似乎并未在意识形态上对党产生多大影响，但迅速允许招募资本家却对拉拢一个掌控着国民经济日益增长份额的新兴社会群体产生了显著影响。到2000年，私营企业（不包括微型家庭企业）雇佣了超过2400万名员工。显然，党渴望获得这群社会精英的支持。

Based on surveys conducted in the early 2000s of owners of private firms, in 1999 only 18 percent of them were party members.88

根据2000年代初对私营企业所有者进行的调查，1999年只有18%的私营企业所有者是党员。

Following Jiang's call to admit capitalists into the party, the share of private entrepreneurs who were party members rose rapidly. Survey results show that in 2002 that share had risen to 30 percent, compared with only 20 percent in 2000.89 Toward the end of the 2000s, the party was recruiting about 80,000 "managers and technical personnel" of private firms each year.90 To be sure, private entrepreneurs had mixed motives for joining the party. Many, if not most, sought the political status that came with party membership as a layer of protection of their wealth, or they believed that they could have more access to opportunities via membership. Additionally, having this new social group inside the party was, on the whole, a successful move to shore up support for the party in the rapidly changing society.91

在江泽民号召接纳资本家入党后，私营企业家的党员比例迅速上升。调查结果显示，2002年这一比例上升至30%，而2000年仅为20%。到2000年代末，党每年从私营企业招募约8万名“管理人员和技术人员”。当然，私营企业家入党的动机不一。许多人，甚至大多数人，寻求党员身份带来的政治地位，以此作为对其财富的保护，或者他们认为通过党员身份可以获得更多机会。此外，将这一新的社会群体纳入党内，总体而言，是巩固党在快速变化的社会中支持率的成功举措。

Party membership was not the only enticement used to co-opt social elites. In the post-Tiananmen era, a select group of eminent intellectuals, professionals, and private entrepreneurs were picked to be delegates to the local people's congresses and the people's political consultative conferences. The inclusion of these successful and well-known individuals conveyed the impression to the public that the party enjoyed their support.92

党员身份并非拉拢社会精英的唯一手段。在后天安门时代，一批杰出的知识分子、专业人士和私营企业家被选为地方人民代表大会和人民政治协商会议的代表。这些成功人士和知名人士的加入，向公众传递了党得到他们支持的印象。





False Dawn: The Limits of Neo-Authoritarianism





虚假的黎明：新威权主义的局限性


As illustrated, within a decade of Deng's southern tour in 1992, the collective leadership under Jiang Zemin had successfully transformed Deng's neo-authoritarian vision into a comprehensive strategy of regime survival. Its key pillars consisted of performance legitimacy, collective leadership underpinned by a fragile balance of power, expansion of popular support through the cultivation of Chinese nationalism, selective repression, and co-optation of social elites. By and large, the party showed a remarkable degree of adaptation in the 1990s, and its new strategy served it well.

如图所示，在邓小平1992年南巡后的十年内，江泽民领导下的集体领导成功地将邓小平的新威权主义构想转化为一套全面的政权生存战略。其关键支柱包括：政绩合法性、以脆弱的权力平衡为基础的集体领导、通过培育中国民族主义扩大民众支持、选择性镇压以及拉拢社会精英。总的来说，中共在20世纪90年代展现出了惊人的适应能力，其新战略也取得了成功。

Ideologically, the party was far more homogenous than perhaps at any time in its history. The purge after the Tiananmen crackdown eliminated the liberals at the top of the leadership. Ever fearful of elevating China's equivalent of a Gorbachev to the top, the party, dominated by conservative technocrats, denied power to those with liberal leanings. At the same time, ultra-conservatives who resisted the market reforms were sidelined as well because their ideological orthodoxy was incompatible with the party's conviction that its survival depended on performance legitimacy, which could be delivered by business-friendly policies. In terms of elite politics, ideological homogeneity was translated into relative elite stability. In contrast to the 1980s, the Jiang era—as well as the Hu Jintao era—stands out mainly because of the absence of bitter ideological clashes such as those that ended with the purge of Hu Yaobang, Zhao Ziyang, and their close associates. To be sure, conflicts among senior leaders existed, but they were over personality and power, not ideology. More important, such conflicts were contained, as evidenced by the fact that during the Jiang era, only one Politburo member was jailed on charges of corruption.

从意识形态上看，中共的同质性或许比其历史上任何时期都要高。天安门事件后的清洗清除了领导层中的自由派人士。由于始终担心会出现类似戈尔巴乔夫的人物，由保守派技术官僚主导的中共，因此拒绝给予倾向自由主义的人士权力。与此同时，那些抵制市场改革的极端保守派也被边缘化，因为他们的意识形态正统性与中共的信念相悖，即中共的生存取决于政绩合法性，而这种合法性可以通过亲商政策来实现。在精英政治层面，意识形态的同质性转化为相对的精英稳定。与20世纪80年代相比，江泽民时代——以及胡锦涛时代——之所以引人注目，主要是因为没有发生像胡耀邦、赵紫阳及其亲信被清洗那样激烈的意识形态冲突。诚然，高层领导人之间确实存在冲突，但这些冲突是围绕个人恩怨和权力展开的，而非意识形态之争。更重要的是，这些冲突得到了有效控制，江泽民时期仅有一名政治局委员因贪污罪入狱便证明了这一点。

The timing of the party's pivot to neo-authoritarian rule in the 1990s could not have been more fortuitous. Economically, the reforms in the 1980s had built the foundations of a market economy—privatization of agriculture, a fast-growing private sector, and linkages with the global economy. The massive rural-urban migration coupled with the young population (nearly 90 percent of the population was under the age of 59 in 1990) became a sustained and powerful driver of growth during the subsequent two decades.93 Despite a few episodes of tensions between the United States and China, the external environment was relatively benign. Instead of efforts by Washington to contain China after the end of the Cold War, as Beijing feared, the United States promoted globalization as an instrument to integrate China into the global economy, thus giving China unprecedented access to Western markets, capital, and technology.

上世纪90年代，中共转向新威权统治的时机可谓恰到好处。经济方面，80年代的改革奠定了市场经济的基础——农业私有化、快速发展的私营部门以及与全球经济的联系。大规模的农村人口向城市迁移，加上年轻人口众多（1990年近90%的人口年龄在59岁以下），成为随后二十年经济增长的持续强劲动力。尽管中美之间偶尔出现紧张关系，但外部环境相对友好。冷战结束后，华盛顿并没有像北京所担心的那样试图遏制中国，而是将全球化作为将中国融入全球经济的工具，从而使中国以前所未有的方式进入西方市场，获得西方资本和技术。

The tools deployed by the party to guard against domestic threats to its power proved surprisingly effective. The nationalism cultivated by the party generated a new source of mass support. Co-optation of social elites broadened the party's base and improved the educational and professional qualifications of party officials. More sophisticated tactics of political repression enabled the party to contain emerging threats to its power. In the 1990s surveillance, intimidation, imprisonment, and exile neutralized the prodemocracy movement as a serious danger, and the party's investment in a coercive apparatus paid off handsomely, as shown by the suppression of ethnic minority unrest in Tibet and Xinjiang, the banning of Falungong, and the suppression of worker unrest in the aftermath of the mass layoffs by bankrupt SOEs at the end of the decade.94

党为防范国内对其政权的威胁而采取的手段出人意料地有效。党所培育的民族主义催生了新的群众支持来源。对社会精英的拉拢扩大了党的群众基础，并提高了党内官员的教育和专业素质。更为老练的政治镇压策略使党能够遏制对其政权的新兴威胁。在20世纪90年代，监视、恐吓、监禁和流放有效地消除了民主运动的严重威胁，党对强制机器的投入获得了丰厚的回报，例如镇压西藏和新疆的少数民族动乱、取缔法轮功以及在90年代末国有企业破产大规模裁员后镇压工人的抗议活动。

However, the neo-authoritarian order constructed in the 1990s under Jiang Zemin's leadership had inherent flaws, which would become both more visible and more serious during the Hu era. Elite security was ensured not by rules and norms enforceable by a third party but by a fragile balance of power among rivals. Senior leaders with their respective extensive power bases in the party-state prevented the two party chiefs, Jiang and Hu, from turning collective leadership into strongman rule, as Xi Jinping was able to do shortly after his rise in late 2012. Without durable institutional constraints, which are difficult to establish and preserve even in democracies, elite security was certain to vanish once the underlying balance of power ceased to exist.

然而，江泽民领导下于上世纪90年代构建的新威权秩序存在固有缺陷，这些缺陷在胡锦涛时代变得更加明显和严重。精英阶层的安全并非依靠第三方强制执行的规则和规范来保障，而是依靠竞争对手之间脆弱的权力平衡。党国内部拥有广泛权力基础的高级领导人阻止了江泽民和胡锦涛两位领导人将集体领导转变为强人统治，而习近平在2012年底上台后不久便做到了这一点。缺乏持久的制度约束（即使在民主国家，建立和维护持久的制度约束也并非易事），一旦潜在的权力平衡不复存在，精英阶层的安全必然会消失。

In addition, the post-Tiananmen neo-authoritarian order was fundamentally incompatible with genuine political liberalization, democratization, and rule of law, thus diminishing the possibility that economic development under one-party rule could result in a transition to democracy. The reforms championed by liberals and moderates in the party laid the foundation for a modern legal system. Landmark legislation such as the Criminal Procedure Law (1980), Economic Contract Law (1981), Foreign Company Law (1986), and Administrative Litigation Law (1989) were all passed in the 1980s. Despite their flaws, they marked a promising first step toward rule of law. Even with the booming economy, however, the progress in legal reform in the 1990s was mixed at best. The NPC enacted many more laws than it did in the 1980s, and judges and lawyers were also better educated and trained. But the party steadfastly resisted any reforms that would make the judiciary more independent, and it frequently ignored or even violated the laws passed by the NPC. Consequently, by the end of the Jiang era, China's legal system remained firmly under the control of the party despite its ostensible modern appearance of robed judges presiding over proceedings in newly built courtrooms.95

此外，天安门事件后的新威权秩序与真正的政治自由化、民主化和法治从根本上来说是不相容的，从而降低了一党专政下的经济发展最终实现民主转型的可能性。党内自由派和温和派倡导的改革为现代法律体系奠定了基础。20世纪80年代通过了一系列具有里程碑意义的立法，例如《刑事诉讼法》（1980年）、《经济合同法》（1981年）、《外国公司法》（1986年）和《行政诉讼法》（1989年）。尽管这些法律存在缺陷，但它们标志着迈向法治的良好开端。然而，即便在经济蓬勃发展的时期，20世纪90年代的法律改革进展也只能说是喜忧参半。全国人大颁布的法律数量远超20世纪80年代，法官和律师的教育和培训水平也得到了提高。但中共坚决抵制任何旨在增强司法独立的改革，并经常无视甚至违反全国人大通过的法律。因此，到江泽民时代末期，尽管表面上出现了身着法袍的法官在新建成的法庭里主持审理案件的现代化景象，但中国的司法体系仍然牢牢掌握在中共手中。

Substantive progress in developing a basic system of accountability was also minimal. With the support of the party, the NPC enacted an interim law permitting rural residents to elect "village committees" and their directors in 1987. Even though the "village committees" were civic organizations and thus lacked formal political authority or power, this move was initially hailed as another tentative step in the direction of grassroots democracy. By the 1990s, however, this route had turned out to be a dead end. The party allowed such elections throughout rural China, but it refused to take the next step of permitting competitive elections for township governments. (Townships constitute the lowest administrative units in the Chinese state.) Eventually, this experimental effort to build grassroots democracy in rural China fizzled out.96

在建立基本问责制度方面，实质性进展也微乎其微。在党的支持下，全国人大于1987年颁布了一项临时法律，允许农村居民选举“村委会”及其主任。尽管“村委会”是公民组织，缺乏正式的政治权威或权力，但此举最初被誉为朝着基层民主迈出的又一步。然而，到了20世纪90年代，这条路却走到了尽头。党允许在中国农村地区进行此类选举，但却拒绝采取下一步行动，允许乡镇政府进行竞争性选举。（乡镇是中国国家最低的行政单位。）最终，这项在中国农村建立基层民主的实验性尝试以失败告终。

Without rule of law and accountability enforced by a civil society or a free press, economic development under autocratic rule inevitably breeds systemic corruption. Although corruption in the 1990s appeared to be less rampant than it would be in the 2000s, the decade saw several major cases of corruption that were unprecedented in terms of the number of people and the amount of bribes involved.97 In the infamous Xiamen smuggling scandal, anticorruption investigators found that a criminal group had managed to smuggle into China more than 53 billion yuan worth of goods between 1996 and 1999 with the help of dozens of government officials, including a vice minister of public security and other senior officials in Fujian's police and customs systems.98

在缺乏公民社会或新闻自由保障的法治和问责制的情况下，专制统治下的经济发展必然滋生系统性腐败。尽管20世纪90年代的腐败现象似乎不如21世纪初那样猖獗，但那十年间也出现了几起前所未有的重大腐败案件，涉及人数之多、贿赂金额之巨，都堪称史无前例。在臭名昭著的厦门走私案中，反腐调查人员发现，一个犯罪团伙在数十名政府官员的协助下，包括一名公安部副部长以及福建省公安和海关系统的其他高级官员，于1996年至1999年间走私了价值超过530亿元人民币的货物进入中国。

Toward the end of the 1990s, cracks began to appear in the party's survival strategy that had centered on economic performance, as evidenced by the rising social unrest.99 Among the drivers linked to the social unrest were the brutal enforcement of the party's "one-child policy," regressive tax-collection policies, illegal evictions in urban areas, seizure of the farmers' land by local officials, factory closures, and unpaid wages.100 Even though most social protests were small, isolated, and short-lived, this growing trend not only dented the party's image of competence but also indicated that the pro-growth policies pursued by the post-Tiananmen regime were harming a significant portion of the Chinese population, and the regime would likely lose support if inequality, corruption, and abuses of the rights of ordinary people continued to fuel popular resentment.

20世纪90年代末，随着社会动荡的加剧，党的生存战略开始出现裂痕，而该战略的核心在于经济发展。99 导致社会动荡的原因包括：党的“独生子女政策”的残酷执行、倒退的税收政策、城市地区的非法拆迁、地方官员没收农民土地、工厂倒闭以及拖欠工资。100 尽管大多数社会抗议规模较小、零星分散且持续时间短暂，但这种日益增长的趋势不仅损害了党的执政形象，也表明后天安门时代政权推行的促增长政策正在损害相当一部分中国民众的利益。如果不平等、腐败和侵犯普通民众权利等问题继续加剧民众的不满，政权很可能会失去支持。

Ultimately, economic reform pursued by a neo-authoritarian regime is likely to fall into the trap of a "partial reform equilibrium." In a transition from a planned economy to a market economy, reform tends to stall after some initial efforts have been completed but more critical measures have yet to be undertaken.101 At the midpoint in the transition process, regimes initiating a transition will lose incentives to go all the way because, although partial reforms improve economic efficiency and bolster party legitimacy, any further reforms are certain to weaken the regime's control over the economy and undermine its power.102 To be sure, the full symptoms of this "trapped transition" were not yet plainly visible, at least in the economic realm, until Hu Jintao came to power in 2002, but the political logic behind a "trapped transition" was firmly embedded in the very neo-authoritarian vision that Deng bequeathed to Jiang in 1992.

最终，新威权政权推行的经济改革很可能陷入“部分改革均衡”的陷阱。在从计划经济向市场经济转型的过程中，改革往往会在一些初步努力完成后停滞不前，因为更关键的措施尚未实施。在转型过程的中期，发起转型的政权会失去彻底改革的动力，因为尽管部分改革可以提高经济效率并增强党的合法性，但任何进一步的改革都必然会削弱政权对经济的控制，并损害其权力。诚然，这种“转型困境”的全部症状，至少在经济领域，直到胡锦涛2002年上台后才逐渐显现，但其背后的政治逻辑却牢牢地根植于邓小平1992年留给江泽民的新威权主义理念之中。





4 Stagnation in the Hu Jintao Era





4 胡锦涛时代的停滞


DENG XIAOPING, who had doggedly pursued his neo-authoritarian vision in the 1980s, almost certainly believed that this political order would have more staying power than orthodox communism. His immediate successor, Jiang Zemin, who had translated Deng's rather abstract vision into actual party policies in the 1990s with great success, also likely thought the post-Tiananmen order could endure. It is true that, in the wake of the Tiananmen crisis and the collapse of the Soviet Union, the party's decision to embrace capitalism with no ideological reservations in order to save its rule was wiser than the only other alternative of returning to the orthodox communist system of the early 1950s. But Deng, Jiang, and other post-Tiananmen party leaders overlooked the most serious flaws of neo-authoritarian developmentalism: the gradual but inevitable loss of momentum of economic reform and corruption-induced regime decay. If anything, the post-Tiananmen neo-authoritarian order turned out to be more fragile and less durable than its architects had thought. When Hu Jintao succeeded Jiang in late 2002, signs of pathologies of neo-authoritarian developmentalism such as rampant official corruption, rising socioeconomic inequality, deteriorating governance, and growing social unrest had become inescapable. By the time Hu left office in November 2012, the rot inside the regime was so advanced that Xi Jinping, who succeeded Hu, was able to dismantle it with relative ease.

邓小平在20世纪80年代执着地推行其新威权主义理念，他几乎肯定认为这种政治秩序比正统共产主义更具持久性。他的直接继任者江泽民在20世纪90年代成功地将邓小平较为抽象的理念转化为实际的党内政策，他很可能也认为后天安门时代的秩序能够长久维持。诚然，在天安门事件和苏联解体之后，为了保住政权，党决定毫无意识形态保留地拥抱资本主义，这比回归20世纪50年代初的正统共产主义体制这一唯一选择更为明智。但是，邓小平、江泽民和其他后天安门时代的党内领导人忽视了新威权发展主义最严重的缺陷：经济改革势头逐渐但不可避免的减弱以及腐败导致的政权衰败。如果说有什么不同的话，那就是后天安门时代的威权新秩序比其缔造者预想的更加脆弱、更加不持久。2002年底胡锦涛接替江泽民时，新威权发展主义的弊病，例如官僚腐败猖獗、社会经济不平等加剧、治理能力下降以及社会动荡日益加剧，已经显而易见。到2012年11月胡锦涛卸任时，政权内部的腐败已经根深蒂固，以至于接替他的习近平能够相对轻松地将其瓦解。

On the surface, however, the post-Tiananmen order persisted without much change during the decade when Hu Jintao served as the party chief, 2002-2012. The Chinese economy sustained its rapid ascent mainly because China's entry into the World Trade Organization (WTO) at the end of 2001 generated a boom in foreign direct investment and trade, while urbanization continued to funnel tens of millions of rural migrants into the manufacturing and service sectors. Despite rising incidents of social unrest, the party managed to use a mixture of carrots and sticks to maintain stability. Collective leadership was preserved, ensuring a high degree of security for the ruling elites at the top (with the exception of a politically motivated corruption investigation of a Politburo member). By and large, the party stuck with the same domestic policies that had delivered unprecedented economic prosperity and political stability in the 1990s. If anything, it was during Hu's decade that China marked its spectacular rise as a global power with the hosting of the Olympics in Beijing in August 2008.

然而，表面上看，在胡锦涛担任中共中央总书记的十年间（2002-2012年），天安门事件后的秩序并未发生太大变化。中国经济持续快速增长，主要得益于2001年底中国加入世界贸易组织（WTO）后，外国直接投资和贸易蓬勃发展，同时城镇化进程持续将数千万农村人口输送到制造业和服务业。尽管社会动荡事件不断发生，但中共仍设法软硬兼施，维持了社会稳定。集体领导制度得以保留，确保了高层统治精英的高度安全（除了政治局委员因政治动机而接受的腐败调查）。总体而言，中共沿用了上世纪90年代带来前所未有的经济繁荣和政治稳定的国内政策。如果说有什么标志性事件，那就是在胡锦涛执政的十年间，中国凭借2008年8月在北京成功举办奥运会，标志着其作为全球强国的崛起。

But a closer look at the Hu era reveals the growing cracks in the post-Tiananmen order. Economic reform lost its momentum because the party under Hu introduced no new measures to accelerate the building of a market economy. Instead, it doubled down on a flawed growth model that relied excessively on investment at the expense of consumption. Inefficient state-owned enterprises retained their privileged positions in the economy. Growth was maintained largely thanks to the massive increase in foreign trade following the WTO entry and the rise of the real estate sector as a major domestic driver. In the meantime, the combination of repression of the freedom of the press, the lack of rule of law, and the party's control of immense economic resources fueled corruption and made Dengist neo-authoritarian developmentism increasingly look like crony capitalism. Practices symptomatic of regime decay, such as collusive corruption and bribing superiors for government office, became endemic.

但仔细审视胡锦涛时代，便会发现后天安门时代秩序的裂痕日益加深。经济改革失去了动力，因为胡锦涛领导下的共产党没有出台任何新措施来加速市场经济建设。相反，它加倍推行一种存在缺陷的增长模式，过度依赖投资而忽视消费。效率低下的国有企业继续保持着其在经济中的特权地位。经济增长主要得益于加入世贸组织后对外贸易的大幅增长以及房地产行业作为国内经济增长主要驱动力的崛起。与此同时，对新闻自由的压制、法治的缺失以及党对庞大经济资源的控制，助长了腐败，使得邓小平的新威权发展主义越来越像裙带资本主义。勾结腐败、贿赂上级等政权衰败的典型特征变得司空见惯。

To be sure, the party under Hu's leadership did try to address some of the social problems created by its single-minded focus on economic development during the Jiang era. The issues included rising inequality, inadequate social protection, and environmental degradation. Hu Jintao and Wen Jiabao, the premier, also attempted to make the economy less reliant on investment for growth. But their efforts were too little and too late. To make matters worse, the party responded to the global financial crisis in 2008 with a massive injection of credit. Although the stimulus sustained growth temporarily, it blew a colossal debt bubble that would create huge financial risks and constrain growth in the future.

诚然，胡锦涛领导下的中共确实试图解决江泽民时代一味追求经济发展所造成的一些社会问题，例如日益加剧的不平等、社会保障不足以及环境恶化。胡锦涛和总理温家宝也曾努力降低经济增长对投资的依赖，但他们的努力力度不够，也为时已晚。更糟糕的是，中共在2008年全球金融危机爆发后，采取了大规模信贷刺激措施。尽管这种刺激措施暂时维持了经济增长，但却催生了巨大的债务泡沫，这将造成巨大的金融风险，并在未来制约经济增长。

It is tempting to blame Jiang Zemin for the stagnation of reform under Hu. Although he nominally retired in November 2002, Jiang retained his post as chairman (commander-in-chief) of the Central Military Commission. In addition, he elevated at least four supporters to the PSC, which was expanded from seven persons to nine to accommodate Jiang's scheme.1 Jiang continued to wield enormous influence even after giving up the position of chairman of the CMC in 2004. Tellingly, judging by the fact that Hu did not succeed in obtaining the moniker "core leader," which Deng had conferred on Jiang and Xi bestowed on himself, he failed to establish uncontested authority as party chief during his tenure in office. But Jiang's political maneuvering was not the sole, or even the most important, cause of the effective demise of post-Mao reform in the Hu era. By all accounts, the neo-authoritarian model, which the party adopted fully in the wake of the crises of the Tiananmen crackdown in 1989 and the fall of the USSR in 1991, could no longer provide the intellectual guidance needed to perpetuate regime survival. With the selection of Xi Jinping as Hu's successor in November 2007, the writing was already on the wall for the post-Tiananmen order.

人们很容易将胡锦涛时期改革停滞不前归咎于江泽民。尽管江泽民名义上于2002年11月退休，但他仍然保留了中央军委主席（总司令）的职位。此外，他还提拔了至少四名支持者进入国家政治保卫委员会，该委员会的人数也从七人扩充到九人，以配合江泽民的计划。即使在2004年卸任中央军委主席之后，江泽民仍然拥有巨大的影响力。值得注意的是，胡锦涛未能获得“核心领导人”的称号——邓小平曾授予江泽民，习近平也曾授予自己这一称号——这表明他在任期间未能确立其作为党总书记的绝对权威。但是，江泽民的政治运作并非导致胡锦涛时代后毛泽东时代改革有效失败的唯一原因，甚至并非最重要的原因。种种迹象表明，中共在1989年天安门事件和1991年苏联解体危机后全面采纳的新威权模式，已无法为政权的延续提供必要的理论指导。随着2007年11月习近平被选为胡锦涛的继任者，后天安门时代的政治格局已然走向终结。





Building a Harmonious Society





建设和谐社会


By the time Hu succeeded Jiang as general secretary of the CCP, the project of building the foundations of Deng's neo-authoritarian order had largely been completed. On the economic front, Hu took over at a propitious time. After China's formal accession to the WTO in 2001, FDI began to pour into China, and exports grew explosively. The powerful economic momentum meant that, unlike Jiang in the early 1990s, Hu faced little pressure to launch new reform initiatives.

当胡锦涛接替江泽民担任中共中央总书记时，邓小平新威权秩序的基础建设已基本完成。在经济方面，胡锦涛接任的时机恰到好处。2001年中国正式加入世贸组织后，外商直接投资开始涌入中国，出口也实现了爆炸式增长。强劲的经济增长势头意味着，与上世纪90年代初的江泽民不同，胡锦涛几乎没有面临推出新改革举措的压力。

As a new leader, however, Hu needed to advance a political agenda that would bolster his authority and differentiate his performance from that of his predecessor. His challenge was to formulate and implement such an agenda without reversing Jiang's policies or clashing with Jiang directly. Practically, the consensus-based decision-making process gave a veto to Jiang's proxies on the PSC, making it difficult for Hu to effect a radical shift. These factors meant that policy change would occur only on the margins, with modest outcomes.

然而，作为新任领导人，胡锦涛需要推进一项能够巩固自身权威并与前任江泽民划清界限的政治议程。他面临的挑战是如何在不推翻江泽民政策或与其直接冲突的情况下，制定并实施这样一项议程。实际上，基于共识的决策机制赋予了江泽民在政协中的代理人否决权，使得胡锦涛难以进行根本性的政策调整。这些因素意味着政策变革只能在边缘层面发生，且收效甚微。

At first glance, Hu seemed to have inherited a booming economy. But daunting socioeconomic challenges lurked underneath. Economically, growth had become more dependent on investment. In 1992 consumption and investment accounted for 61.6 and 37.2 percent of GDP, respectively. By 2002, investment accounted for 39.4 percent of GDP, while the share of consumption fell to 58 percent.2 This unbalanced growth model threatened future sustainability because ever-increasing investment would lead to excess capacity and diminishing returns, whereas surging exports generated large trade surpluses but also tensions with China's trading partners. Socially, the party's obsessive focus on growth during the post-Tiananmen era had neglected environmental protection, income equality, and social services. Income inequality, perhaps the single most important indicator of the health of a society, worsened dramatically from 1990 to 2002, with the Gini index rising from 0.322 to 0.42.3

乍看之下，胡锦涛似乎继承了一个蓬勃发展的经济。然而，严峻的社会经济挑战却潜藏其下。经济方面，经济增长对投资的依赖程度日益加深。1992年，消费和投资分别占GDP的61.6%和37.2%。到2002年，投资占GDP的比重降至39.4%，而消费占比则下降至58%。这种不平衡的增长模式威胁着未来的可持续发展，因为不断增长的投资会导致产能过剩和收益递减，而出口激增虽然带来了巨额贸易顺差，但也加剧了与贸易伙伴之间的紧张关系。社会方面，中共在后天安门时代对经济增长的过度关注忽视了环境保护、收入平等和社会服务。收入不平等或许是衡量一个社会健康状况最重要的单一指标，在1990年至2002年间急剧恶化，基尼系数从0.322上升至0.42。

The government also underinvested in healthcare during the Jiang era. The data in table 4.1 show that the share of health spending funded by the state fell from 20.8 percent to 15.7 percent between 1992 and 2002. During the same period, employers were also paying less for workers' healthcare. This resulted in a significant increase in personal out-of-pocket spending on healthcare. In 1992 such spending accounted for about 40 percent of total healthcare spending. A decade later, this ratio had risen to 57.7 percent, representing an increase of nearly 45 percent. As this ratio is used to measure access to healthcare, people have less access to healthcare in countries where personal out-of-pocket spending on healthcare is high. In comparative terms, personal out-of-pocket spending on healthcare in China in 2002 was about three times the global average (19.3 percent).4

江泽民时期，政府对医疗保健的投入也不足。表4.1的数据显示，1992年至2002年间，国家承担的医疗卫生支出比例从20.8%下降到15.7%。同期，雇主为员工支付的医疗保健费用也减少。这导致个人自付医疗费用显著增加。1992年，个人自付医疗费用约占医疗卫生总支出的40%。十年后，这一比例上升至57.7%，增幅近45%。由于该比例用于衡量医疗服务的可及性，因此，在个人自付医疗费用较高的国家，人们获得医疗服务的机会较少。相比之下，2002年中国的个人自付医疗费用约为全球平均水平（19.3%）的三倍。

Education is another area that fell victim to government neglect under Jiang Zemin. Public spending on education from 1992 to 2002 dropped during most of the decade, and by 2002 it had barely recovered to the level it had reached a decade earlier as a share of GDP. Measured as a share of total government spending, education outlays stagnated throughout this decade (table 4.2).

教育是江泽民执政时期政府忽视的另一个领域。1992年至2002年间，公共教育支出在大部分时间里都在下降，到2002年，其占GDP的比重也仅勉强恢复到十年前的水平。若以占政府总支出的比例来衡量，教育支出在这十年间则一直停滞不前（表4.2）。

During the Jiang era, environmental protection was not a priority, either. Spending on environmental projects was woefully low throughout the 1990s—consistently less than 0.24 percent of GDP. Only in the 2000s did spending on the environment exceed 1 percent of GDP (1.13 percent in 2000 and 1.30 percent in 2002).5

江泽民时代，环境保护也并非优先事项。整个20世纪90年代，环保项目支出都极低，始终低于GDP的0.24%。直到21世纪初，环保支出才超过GDP的1%（2000年为1.13%，2002年为1.30%）。

To Hu and Wen Jiabao, the new premier who succeeded Zhu Rongji in 2003, these socioeconomic challenges presented an opportunity to offer a different agenda that would ameliorate these imbalances. Although Hu and Wen did not have close ties to each other before their rise to the top, they became temporary political allies because they shared an interest in countering the influence of Jiang's faction.

对胡锦涛和2003年接替朱镕基的新任总理温家宝而言，这些社会经济挑战为他们提供了一个契机，可以提出一套不同的方案来缓解这些不平衡现象。尽管胡锦涛和温家宝在掌权之前关系并不密切，但由于他们都希望遏制江泽民派的影响，因此成为了暂时的政治盟友。

The outbreak of SARS in early 2003, which occurred just months after Hu became CCP chief, provided both Hu and Wen with an opportunity to show that their agenda would be an improvement. Their pitch for a kinder and gentler China apparently was well received because the SARS crisis had exposed the dark side of the party's policy of growth at any cost. When the epidemic broke out, China lacked a basic public health infrastructure to provide an adequate response, such as early detection and warning, data analysis, and treatment facilities.6 Although the party relied on draconian measures to suppress a rapid spread of the virus, Hu and Wen followed up with a more comprehensive plan to address the country's mounting social deficit.

2003年初，胡锦涛就任中共总书记仅数月后，非典疫情爆发。这场疫情为胡锦涛和温家宝提供了一个契机，让他们得以展现其施政纲领的改进之处。他们提出的建设一个更加仁慈温和的中国的主张显然受到了广泛欢迎，因为非典危机暴露了中共不惜一切代价追求经济增长政策的阴暗面。疫情爆发之初，中国缺乏基本的公共卫生基础设施来提供充分的应对措施，例如早期检测和预警、数据分析以及治疗设施。尽管中共采取了严厉的措施来遏制病毒的迅速传播，但胡锦涛和温家宝随后提出了一项更为全面的计划，以解决国家日益严重的社会问题。

Hu spelled out its substance comprehensively at a July 2003 national conference reviewing party performance during the SARS crisis. Calling for "coordinated development of the economy and society," Hu maintained that even though economic development remained the party's central task, it had to be sustainable and measured not only in terms of growth but also in terms of indices such as environmental health and human development. He singled out the development of rural areas, ground zero of government neglect. Hu also pledged to invest more in public health, reform the poorly resourced healthcare system, and strengthen state capacity for order, stability, and crisis management.7

胡锦涛在2003年7月召开的全国代表大会上全面阐述了这一方针，该大会回顾了党在非典危机期间的工作。胡锦涛呼吁“经济与社会协调发展”，强调经济发展固然是党的首要任务，但必须具有可持续性，衡量经济发展的标准不仅在于增长，还在于环境卫生、人类发展等指标。他特别指出农村地区的发展，因为农村地区长期以来被政府忽视。胡锦涛还承诺加大对公共卫生的投入，改革资源匮乏的医疗卫生体系，并加强国家维护秩序、稳定和危机管理的能力。

In October 2003, Hu's agenda was given the fancy title, "Scientific Outlook of Development," which, in 2007, the party enshrined into its charter as one of its ideological tenets. Its essence was sustainable or, in Hu's signature phrase, "harmonious" development that maintains the right balance between speed and quality of economic development. In an important speech to high-ranking officials in February 2005, Hu further defined the party's goal of building a "socialist harmonious society."8

2003年10月，胡锦涛的纲领被赋予了“科学发展观”这一高大上的标题，并在2007年被党写入党章，成为其思想纲领之一。其核心是可持续发展，或者用胡锦涛的标志性说法，是“和谐发展”，即在经济发展的速度和质量之间保持适当的平衡。在2005年2月对高级官员的一次重要讲话中，胡锦涛进一步阐明了党建设“社会主义和谐社会”的目标。

The highest-profile—and much applauded—step Hu took to achieve a "socialist harmonious society" was abolition of the agricultural tax in December 2005. The amount of revenue generated by this tax—a levy on agricultural produce calculated on the basis of the land leased to farmers—was small, so the government could easily absorb the fiscal costs. Total revenue from various rural taxes (such as levies on tobacco leaves or on the nonagricultural use of arable land) was 93.6 billion yuan in 2005, the year before abolition of the agricultural tax. In 2006 tax revenue from rural sources amounted to 108.4 billion yuan. This suggests that the unpopular agricultural tax generated a relatively small amount of revenue (tax revenues from all rural sources accounted for only 3.2 percent of total tax receipts in 2005).9 Hu's reform also ended other regressive nontax levies that funded public services (such as education, public health, and law enforcement). Lost revenue was made up for with subsidies from the central government.10 Even though these measures did not significantly increase farmers' net income, they were welcomed by Chinese farmers who had long resented paying the agricultural tax and other assorted administrative fees that were collected by rural officials using brutal methods.11

胡锦涛为实现“社会主义和谐社会”所采取的最引人注目、也最受赞誉的举措，是于2005年12月废除农业税。这项税收——根据农民租赁土地面积计算的农产品税——所产生的收入数额很小，因此政府完全可以承担其财政支出。在废除农业税的前一年，即2005年，各项农村税收（例如烟叶税或耕地非农用途税）的总收入为936亿元人民币。2006年，农村税收收入达到1084亿元人民币。这表明，这项不受欢迎的农业税产生的收入相对较少（2005年农村税收总收入仅占税收总额的3.2%）。胡锦涛的改革还取消了其他一些用于资助公共服务（例如教育、公共卫生和执法）的非税收累退税项。中央政府通过补贴弥补了税收损失。尽管这些措施并未显著提高农民的净收入，但却受到了长期以来对缴纳农业税和其他各种行政费用感到不满的中国农民的欢迎，这些费用通常由农村官员以粗暴手段征收。

Another high-profile reform enacted in the early phase of Hu's tenure was abolition of a draconian regulation allowing local authorities to detain undocumented vagrats found in cities, based on the "Procedures for Detaining and the Repatriation of Vagrants and Beggars in Cities," issued by the State Council in 1982. Local authorities routinely abused this administrative rule to extort money from migrants, who were frequently maltreated and beaten in detention centers run by local governments. In March 2003, at the height of the SARS crisis, a college graduate, Sun Zhigang, was detained by police as a vagrant in Guangzhou because he was not carrying the proper identification papers. Sun was beaten to death a few days after he had been transferred to a detention center for vagrats.

胡锦涛执政初期推行的另一项引人注目的改革是废除了一项严苛的规定。该规定允许地方政府依据1982年国务院颁布的《城市流浪乞丐拘留和遣返程序》拘留在城市中发现的无证流浪人员。地方政府经常滥用这项行政规定敲诈勒索流动人口，这些流动人口在地方政府运营的拘留中心经常遭受虐待和殴打。2003年3月，正值非典疫情高峰期，大学毕业生孙志刚因未携带有效身份证件在广州被警方以流浪人员身份拘留。孙志刚被送往流浪人员拘留中心几天后，遭到殴打致死。

This scandal shocked the country because college graduates were considered elite members of society, and Sun's horrific death was a devastating illustration of the cruelty of the regulation and the lawlessness of local law enforcement officials. Seizing the opportunity, in May 2003 three liberal legal scholars petitioned the Standing Committee of the NPC to review the constitutionality of the regulation. The combined political pressure from public

这起丑闻震惊全国，因为大学毕业生被视为社会精英，而孙某的惨死则残酷地揭示了该法规的残酷性和地方执法人员的违法行为。抓住这一契机，三位自由派法学学者于2003年5月向全国人大常委会请愿，要求审查该法规的合宪性。公众舆论的共同压力促使该请愿最终得以通过。

opinion and the legal challenge probably would not have been enough to force the new leadership to embrace a radical solution, such as abolishing the regulation. After all, the party could resort to strict censorship, and the NPC Standing Committee controlled by the party could reject the petition summarily. However, the Hu-Wen administration surprisingly announced abolition of the regulation five weeks after the legal challenge. The most likely explanation is that the new leaders were looking to burnish their public image.12

舆论和法律挑战或许不足以迫使新领导层采取激进的解决方案，例如废除该规定。毕竟，党可以诉诸严格的审查制度，而由党控制的全国人大常委会也可以断然驳回请愿。然而，在法律挑战五周后，胡文政府却出人意料地宣布废除该规定。最可能的解释是，新领导层希望借此改善其公众形象。

Judging by available data, Hu's project of building a "socialist harmonious society" achieved mixed results. His administration scored greater success in some areas than in others. The level of income inequality did not fall during his tenure, mainly because he failed to take any substantive measures, such as tax reforms or meaningful income support for the poor. Data collected by the National Bureau of Statistics show that income inequality rose slightly during Hu's decade in power. When Hu left office in 2012, income inequality had already returned to the 2002 level (table 4.3).

从现有数据来看，胡锦涛构建“社会主义和谐社会”的工程成效参差不齐。他的执政在某些领域取得了显著成就，而在其他领域则不然。在他执政期间，收入不平等程度并未下降，这主要是因为他未能采取任何实质性措施，例如税制改革或对贫困人口提供有效的收入保障。国家统计局的数据显示，胡锦涛执政的十年间，收入不平等程度略有上升。到2012年胡锦涛卸任时，收入不平等程度已回落至2002年的水平（表4.3）。

Hu scored moderately better results in the area of environmental protection, at least measured in terms of investment. Government spending on the environment steadily increased during his decade in office. Although spending stagnated during his first term, it rose meaningfully during his second term (table 4.4).

胡锦涛在环境保护领域取得了较为显著的成绩，至少从投资角度来看是如此。在他执政的十年间，政府在环境保护方面的支出稳步增长。尽管在他第一个任期内支出停滞不前，但在第二任期内却出现了显著增长（表4.4）。

Like spending on the environment, public expenditures on education stagnated during Hu's first term, but they rose measurably as a share of GDP during his second term. In 2003 education spending was 2.84 percent of GDP. In 2006 it was still only 2.93 percent. But it rose steadily from 2009 to 2012, and by the time Hu left office in 2012, government spending on education had reached 4.28 percent of GDP.13

与环境支出类似，胡锦涛第一任期内公共教育支出停滞不前，但在第二任期内，教育支出占GDP的比重显著上升。2003年，教育支出占GDP的2.84%。2006年，这一比例仅为2.93%。但从2009年到2012年，教育支出稳步增长，到胡锦涛2012年卸任时，政府教育支出已达到GDP的4.28%。

Hu made the greatest mark in terms of improving access to healthcare during his second term in power. He implemented a package of reforms in 2009 that significantly expanded access. In 2002, 45 percent of urban residents and 79 percent of rural residents had no health insurance. In 2010, a year after Hu's healthcare reform, 95 percent of the population was covered by various health insurance schemes. This was achieved mainly through large government subsidies to cover premiums and to reimburse hospitalization costs.14 As a result, access to healthcare increased significantly, as measured by the dramatic decline in personal out-of-pocket spending on health. Hu's reforms increased the share of spending covered by the government from 17 to 30 percent of total spending. The share of personal out-of-pocket spending on health fell from 56 percent in 2003 to 34 percent in 2012 (table 4.5).

胡锦涛在其第二个任期内，在改善医疗服务可及性方面取得了最显著的成就。他于2009年实施了一揽子改革，大幅扩大了医疗服务的覆盖范围。2002年，45%的城镇居民和79%的农村居民没有医疗保险。2010年，即胡锦涛医改一年后，95%的人口都享有各种医疗保险。这主要得益于政府的大量补贴，用于支付保费和报销住院费用。因此，医疗服务的可及性显著提高，个人自付医疗费用大幅下降便是明证。胡锦涛的改革使政府承担的医疗支出比例从17%提高到30%。个人自付医疗费用比例从2003年的56%下降到2012年的34%（表4.5）。

However, by the more commonly used measure of human welfare—the Human Development Index (HDI) developed by the United Nations Development Program (UNDP)—the progress made by Hu's project to build a "socialist harmonious society" achieved a magnitude of improvement in China's HDI from 2003 to 2012 that was similar to that gained during the Jiang period. The HDI rose 8 basis points, or an improvement of 15.7 percent under Jiang. During the 2003-2012 period, China's HDI rose 9 basis points, representing an improvement of 14.8 percent (table 4.6).

然而，按照更常用的衡量人类福祉的指标——联合国开发计划署（UNDP）制定的人类发展指数（HDI）——胡锦涛领导的“社会主义和谐社会”建设工程所取得的进展，使得中国2003年至2012年间的HDI提升幅度与江泽民时期相近。江泽民时期，HDI上升了8个基点，增幅为15.7%。而在2003年至2012年期间，中国的HDI上升了9个基点，增幅为14.8%（见表4.6）。

Based on his record in addressing China's social deficit, Hu's decade in power may be divided into two phases. He scored marginal progress during his first term, most likely due to his lack of authority and the residual influence of Jiang Zemin. Since any substantial modification of Jiang's policies that

根据胡锦涛在解决中国社会赤字问题上的政绩，他十年的执政生涯可以分为两个阶段。第一阶段他取得的进展甚微，这很可能是由于他缺乏权威以及江泽民的残余影响。由于江泽民的政策几乎没有进行任何实质性的改变，
