In retrospect, the intensification of corruption during the Hu era was the result of a convergence of several factors, most of which were embedded in the nature of the post-Tiananmen political economy. The ruling elites had abundant opportunities to abuse their political power to engage in rent-seeking or self-enriching activities.59 Despite the regime's unabashed endorsement of the pro-market reforms in the 1990s, the state continued to retain enormous influence over the economy. It owned large commercial entities with trillions of yuan in assets. In 2002 state-owned and state majority-controlled industrial firms held 8.9 trillion yuan in assets (nearly two-thirds of total industrial assets). By 2012, the end of the Hu era, the state-owned or state-controlled industrial assets in these firms reached 31.2 trillion yuan (about 41 percent of total industrial assets).60 Despite the relative decline in their share, SOEs still directly controlled enormous assets, creating plentiful opportunities for officials to convert their political power into illicit income. Aside from industrial assets, the state also monopolized land rights, which it could lease to private entrepreneurs for commercial development. Unsurprisingly, sweetheart deals between private developers and local officials turned real estate into one of the most corrupt sectors in China during the Hu era.61 China's government-funded infrastructure boom that began in the 1990s also spawned sector-wide corruption because local officials in charge of building highways could dole out contracts to construction companies in return for bribes. Between 1995 and 2014, seventeen directors of provincial transportation departments were arrested on charges of corruption. The vast amounts of bribes that they received necessitated severe punishment: One was executed, another received a suspended death sentence, and five were imprisoned for life.62

回顾历史，胡锦涛时代腐败的加剧是多种因素共同作用的结果，其中大部分因素都根植于天安门事件后的政治经济体制之中。统治精英拥有大量滥用政治权力的机会，从事寻租或中饱私囊的活动。尽管政权在20世纪90年代毫不掩饰地支持市场改革，但国家仍然对经济保持着巨大的影响力。国家拥有资产规模达数万亿元人民币的大型商业实体。2002年，国有及国有控股的工业企业资产总额达8.9万亿元人民币（几乎占工业总资产的三分之二）。到2012年胡锦涛时代末期，这些企业中国有或国有控股的工业资产达到31.2万亿元人民币（约占工业总资产的41%）。尽管其份额相对下降，但国有企业仍然直接控制着巨额资产，为官员将政治权力转化为非法收入提供了大量机会。除了工业资产，国家还垄断了土地使用权，并将其租赁给私人企业进行商业开发。不出所料，私人开发商与地方官员之间的利益输送使房地产在胡锦涛时代成为中国最腐败的行业之一。始于20世纪90年代的中国政府主导的基础设施建设热潮也滋生了行业腐败，因为负责修建高速公路的地方官员可以通过向建筑公司行贿来获得合同。1995年至2014年间，共有17名省级交通运输部门负责人因涉嫌腐败被捕。他们收受的贿赂数额巨大，因此必须受到严厉惩罚：一人被处决，一人被判处缓刑，五人被判处终身监禁。

The sectors singled out by China's top prosecutor for bribery investigations in 2008—infrastructure projects, sale of land rights, transfer of property rights (of SOEs), purchase and sale of medicine, government procurement, and development of natural resources—illustrate that state control of assets, regulatory approvals, and project financing are some of the root causes of corruption.63 Politically, two factors likely fueled official corruption in the post-Tiananmen era. First, the neo-authoritarian model of development that combines political repression with capitalism can make corruption more difficult to control because of the suppression of a civil society and the lack of press freedom. One of the most effective approaches to combatting official corruption is to rely on civil society and a free press to act as public watchdogs.64 However, the space for civil society in the post-Tiananmen era was extremely compressed due to the party's paranoia about the emergence of an organized opposition. The regime also maintained tight press censorship (although it would become even worse during the Xi era).

2008年，中国最高检察长重点调查的贿赂领域包括基础设施项目、土地权买卖、国有企业产权转移、药品买卖、政府采购和自然资源开发。这些领域表明，国家对资产的控制、监管审批和项目融资是腐败的根源之一。63 从政治角度来看，后天安门时代官员腐败的滋生可能有两个因素。首先，将政治压制与资本主义相结合的新威权发展模式，由于压制公民社会和缺乏新闻自由，使得腐败更难控制。打击官员腐败最有效的方法之一是依靠公民社会和自由媒体发挥公众监督作用。64 然而，由于党对有组织的反对派的出现感到恐惧，后天安门时代公民社会的空间受到了极大的压缩。该政权还维持着严格的新闻审查制度（尽管在习近平时代情况会变得更糟）。

Second, the party's primary approach to fighting corruption—waging periodic political campaigns—was largely ineffective. The sole bureaucratic organizations charged with the task, the party's own discipline inspection committees, lacked independence and were easily politicized.65 The effects of the anticorruption campaigns were short-lived also because the officials on the take would simply lie low during the campaigns and then resume stealing once the political heat had subsided.66 The fragile balance of factional power at the top levels of the leadership similarly constrained the party's ability to combat corruption because of the implicit mutual security pact among top leaders. No single leader was powerful enough to launch a sustained anticorruption drive that could potentially send his rivals and their followers to jail (as Xi did immediately after gaining power). Because the collective leadership in the post-Tiananmen era made decisions through consensus, prosecuting senior officials (those at or above the ministerial or provincial level) likely required unanimous agreement among the members of the Politburo or the PSC. This arrangement may explain why relatively few ministerial-level and provincial-level officials were prosecuted in the post-Tiananmen era and why the number jumped in the Xi era. Although the unspoken mutual security pact at the top of the regime probably helped maintain leadership cohesion and limited the weaponization of anticorruption investigations, it also made it more difficult to contain corruption.

其次，党的主要反腐手段——定期开展政治运动——在很大程度上收效甚微。唯一负责反腐的官僚机构，即党的纪律检查委员会，缺乏独立性，且极易被政治化。反腐运动的效果也往往昙花一现，因为贪污官员会在运动期间销声匿迹，待政治热度消退后便重操旧业。此外，高层领导之间派系权力的脆弱平衡也限制了党的反腐能力，因为高层领导人之间存在着隐性的相互安全协议。没有哪位领导人拥有足够的权力发起一场持续的反腐运动，从而有可能将自己的对手及其追随者送进监狱（就像习近平上台后立即采取的行动那样）。由于天安门事件后集体领导层通过协商一致的方式做出决策，因此对高级官员（部级或省级及以上官员）的起诉很可能需要政治局或国家政协成员的一致同意。这种安排或许可以解释为何天安门事件后被起诉的部级和省级官员相对较少，而习近平时代这一数字却大幅上升。尽管政权高层之间不成文的相互安全默契可能有助于维护领导层的凝聚力，并限制反腐调查被武器化，但也使得遏制腐败变得更加困难。

Even though corruption in the Hu era was widespread, it is difficult to calculate its economic costs. On the surface, the pervasive corruption did not lead to a slowdown of growth.67 But the economic costs of corruption were likely reflected in performance data that are not captured by growth. For instance, the costs of "white elephant" infrastructure projects and inflated prices of goods procured by the government actually boosted GDP growth because of the use of expenditures in growth accounting. Since goods and services tainted by corruption are typically of inferior quality, measuring the economic costs is methodologically difficult. Research on corruption nevertheless shows that most of its costs tend to be indirect and manifested in high income inequality, inadequate social services, poor food safety, environmental degradation, and social unrest—exactly the socioeconomic pathologies widely observed during the Hu era.68

尽管胡时代腐败盛行，但其经济成本难以估量。表面上看，普遍存在的腐败并未导致经济增长放缓。但腐败的经济成本很可能反映在经济增长无法捕捉到的绩效数据中。例如，政府采购的“面子工程”和价格虚高的商品，由于增长核算中采用了支出项，实际上推高了GDP增长。由于受腐败污染的商品和服务通常质量低劣，因此在方法论上难以衡量其经济成本。然而，对腐败的研究表明，其大部分成本往往是间接的，体现在收入不平等加剧、社会服务不足、食品安全问题严重、环境恶化和社会动荡等诸多方面——而这些恰恰是胡时代普遍存在的社会经济弊病。

Politically, endemic official corruption during the Hu era created favorable conditions for the return of a ruthless strongman such as Xi Jinping. As corruption permeated the regime and a large number of officials were tainted, they became easy targets for a potential strongman who could purge rivals and amass huge power under the guise of cleansing the party. This is precisely what occurred during Xi's first term.

胡锦涛时代根深蒂固的官僚腐败，为习近平这样一位冷酷无情的强人重返政坛创造了有利条件。随着腐败渗透到政权各个角落，大量官员身陷囹圄，他们很容易成为潜在强人的目标。这位强人可以借着“洗白党内”的幌子，清除异己，攫取巨大权力。这正是习近平第一任期内发生的情况。





The Beginning of the End of the Post-Tiananmen Order





天安门事件后秩序终结的开端


On the surface, the Hu era seems to be almost a seamless continuation of the Jiang period. With the exception of the purge of one Politburo member, Shanghai's party boss Chen Liangyu, elite politics was relatively stable. But trouble was brewing beneath the façade of elite unity. The two major factions—the "Shanghai Gang," led by the retired Jiang Zemin, and the "Youth League faction" (tuanpai), under the aegis of Hu Jintao—had no real ideological differences over policy as they both were committed adherents to Deng's neo-authoritarian vision. But at the same time they were fierce rivals for power over personnel appointments. This rivalry would peak in 2007 with the party selection of Hu's successor. The impasse between the two factions ended with the anointment of a dark horse, Xi Jinping—who was unaffiliated with either faction—as future party chief. This fateful decision would later change the course of history. The designation of Xi, however, did not completely settle the issue of succession. As Xi was seen as a potentially weak leader because he lacked his own power base, ambitious party apparatchiks, in particular Bo Xilai, who was promoted to the Politburo in 2007, began to maneuver for more power in the run-up to the leadership transition scheduled for late 2012. The ultimate outcome of Bo's power grab was a spectacular and sordid scandal that not only ended his political career but also put a fitting end to the two-decade-long post-Tiananmen era, fully exposing the rot and decay that had been accumulating beneath the ever-prospering economy.

表面上看，胡锦涛时代似乎是江泽民时代的无缝延续。除了上海市委书记陈良宇被清洗之外，精英政治相对稳定。然而，在精英团结的表象之下，暗流涌动。两大派系——以退休的江泽民为首的“上海帮”和以胡锦涛为首的“共青团派”——在政策上并无真正的意识形态分歧，因为他们都坚定地拥护邓小平的新威权主义理念。但与此同时，他们在人事任命上却展开了激烈的权力斗争。这种斗争在2007年党内选举胡锦涛的接班人时达到了顶峰。两大派系之间的僵局最终以一位黑马——习近平——被推举为未来的党总书记而告终。习近平当时既不属于任何派系，也不属于任何派系。这一具有决定性意义的决定，日后将改变历史的进程。然而，习近平的任命并未彻底解决权力交接问题。由于习近平缺乏自身权力基础，被视为潜在的软弱领导人，因此，野心勃勃的党内干部，尤其是2007年晋升为政治局委员的薄熙来，开始在2012年底的领导层换届前夕攫取更多权力。薄熙来最终的夺权行动以一场轰动一时、丑闻缠身的丑闻告终，这场丑闻不仅终结了他的政治生涯，也为长达二十年的后天安门时代画上了句号，彻底暴露了繁荣经济下暗流涌动的腐败和衰败。

The rivalry between the Shanghai Gang and the Youth League faction reached its peak ahead of the Seventeenth Party Congress in 2007, which was scheduled to select Hu's successor. The most widely circulated rumor is that in that year the deadlocked party leadership conducted an informal poll of more than four hundred top officials, and Xi came up on top of his rival, Li Keqiang, a former CYL leader and Hu's protégé.69 Xi was subsequently promoted to the Politburo Standing Committee in 2007 and was slated to succeed Hu in 2012. Li Keqiang, also elevated to the PSC, was ranked below Xi and would be the future premier.

上海帮和同盟党派之间的竞争在2007年召开的中共十七大前达到顶峰，当时正值选举胡锦涛接班人之际。流传最广的传言是，在当年陷入僵局的党领导层进行了一次针对四百多名高级官员的非正式民意调查，习近平胜过了他的竞争对手李克强——李克强曾是同盟党领导人，也是胡锦涛的门生。随后，习近平于2007年晋升为政治局常委，并被安排在2012年接替胡锦涛。同样晋升为政治局常委的李克强排名在习近平之后，并将成为未来的总理。

Although this version of the events of 2007 lacks documented evidence, several factors apparently converged to produce this surprise outcome. The most important factor in Xi's favor was that the Shanghai Gang could not put forward a competitive candidate. Chen Liangyu, a protégé of Jiang and former Shanghai party chief, might have been a plausible candidate even though he would be 61 in 2007, six years older than Xi, and he would be 66 if he were to succeed Hu in 2012. But he was purged by Hu on corruption charges in 2006, most likely as a preemptive move to clear the path to the top for Li Keqiang.70 With no candidate of its own, the strategic goal of the Shanghai Gang was to deny the Youth League faction the top prize, even if it had to consent to picking someone who was not part of its network.

尽管这种对2007年事件的描述缺乏确凿的证据，但显然有几个因素共同促成了这一出人意料的结果。对习近平有利的最重要因素是上海帮无法推出一位有竞争力的候选人。陈良宇是江泽民的门生，曾任上海市委书记，他原本可能是一位合适的候选人，尽管他在2007年时已61岁，比习近平年长6岁，如果他在2012年接替胡锦涛，则将年满66岁。但他在2006年被胡锦涛以腐败指控清洗，这很可能是为了先发制人，为李克强铺平通往权力顶峰的道路。由于自身没有候选人，上海帮的战略目标是阻止共青团派系赢得最高职位，即使这意味着他们必须同意选择一位不属于自己阵营的人。

In terms of his "princeling" family background and political career, Xi had no prior contact with the Shanghai Gang. But his political prospects brightened significantly on the eve of Jiang's retirement as party chief in 2002. Although Xi had spent seventeen years in Fujian province, climbing from the position of deputy mayor of Xiamen (in 1985) to Fujian's governor (in 2000), he had a lackluster record as an administrator.71 Nevertheless, Jiang gave Xi a critical career boost by making him party chief of Zhejiang in late 2002 and placing him in a favored position for promotion to the Politburo in 2007. Jiang's role in Xi's rise in 2002 indicates that he probably saw Xi as a potential ally despite his lack of ties with Jiang's Shanghai Gang.

就其“太子党”出身和政治生涯而言，习近平此前与上海帮并无任何联系。但2002年江泽民卸任中共中央总书记前夕，习近平的政治前景显著好转。尽管习近平曾在福建省工作十七年，从厦门市副市长（1985年）一路晋升至福建省省长（2000年），但他的行政政绩却乏善可陈。然而，江泽民在2002年底任命习近平为浙江省委书记，并为其在2007年晋升政治局委员铺平道路，这无疑为习近平的政治生涯注入了一剂强心针。江泽民在2002年习近平崛起过程中扮演的角色表明，尽管习近平与江泽民的上海帮并无关联，但江泽民可能仍将习近平视为潜在的盟友。

The inherent weakness of the Youth League faction in general, and the weak leadership of Hu Jintao in particular, further contributed to the faction's 2007 defeat in the succession struggle, to Xi's benefit. On paper, the Communist Youth League seems to be an impressive political organization. With more than 73 million members (in 2023) and branch organizations spanning the entire country, CYL officials are on a fast track to promotions in the party's organizational hierarchy.72 In the post-Mao era, two national leaders of the league, Hu Yaobang and Hu Jintao, became the party's general secretary. The third, Hu Qili, was made a PSC member and a future successor before he was dismissed after the Tiananmen crackdown.

共青团派系本身固有的弱点，尤其是胡锦涛领导能力的不足，进一步导致了该派系在2007年权力交接斗争中的失败，这对习近平有利。从表面上看，共青团似乎是一个令人印象深刻的政治组织。它拥有超过7300万名党员（2023年数据），分支机构遍布全国，共青团官员在党的组织架构中晋升迅速。在后毛泽东时代，共青团的两名全国性领导人胡耀邦和胡锦涛成为了中共中央总书记。第三位领导人胡其礼在天安门事件后被解职之前，曾被任命为国家政治保卫委员会委员，并被视为未来的接班人。

However, senior leaders promoted from the CYL have one glaring weakness. With the exception of Hu Yaobang, who climbed to the top of the CYL by starting as a local official in Sichuan, most league members who ascended to the top lacked local administrative experience as party chiefs. Typically, they began their political careers inside the CYL and then helicoptered to provincial governments to gain the requisite experience before they could be promoted to national-level leadership. This path to the top may have put some CYL officials on a faster track to the top than most CCP officials, but it also tended to produce weaker leaders.73 First, the CYL as an ancillary organization of the party does not have real administrative authority, so its leaders have few opportunities to gain executive experience at the local levels. When the lucky few are promoted to the top, they are untested and unproven leaders. Second, due to the status of the CYL as an ancillary organization of the party, the league has no say in the distribution of government resources, making it impossible for its officials to trade favors with local party officials or other elites or to build up their own networks. As a consequence, CYL stars such as Hu Qili, Hu Jintao, and Li Keqiang rose to the top mainly due to the support of powerful patrons. Hu Jintao, the only former head of the CYL to become CCP chief after the fall of Hu Yaobang, owed his good fortune to Deng Xiaoping, who designated him as Jiang's successor—an arrangement Jiang could not undo.

然而，从青年团晋升的高级领导人存在一个明显的弱点。除了胡耀邦——他从四川地方官员做起，最终登上青年团高层——之外，大多数从青年团晋升到高层的党政干部都缺乏地方行政经验。通常情况下，他们的政治生涯始于青年团内部，然后被“空投”到省级政府，积累必要的经验，才能晋升到国家级领导岗位。这种晋升路径或许使一些青年团官员比大多数中共官员更快地登上权力顶峰，但也往往造就了能力较弱的领导人。首先，青年团作为党的附属组织，没有真正的行政权力，因此其领导人很少有机会在地方层面积累行政经验。当少数幸运儿晋升到高层时，他们都是未经考验、能力未得到证明的领导人。其次，由于青年联盟是中共的附属组织，它在政府资源分配上没有发言权，其成员无法与地方党政官员或其他精英进行利益交换，也无法建立自己的关系网。因此，像胡其力、胡锦涛和李克强这样的青年联盟明星人物之所以能够晋升到高层，主要依靠的是权势人物的支持。胡锦涛是胡耀邦下台后唯一一位从青年联盟出身并最终成为中共中央总书记的人，他的成功要归功于邓小平，邓小平指定他为江泽民的接班人——江泽民无法推翻这一安排。

But when the party had to pick Hu's successor, the weakness of the CYL became evident. Its power could not match that of the Shanghai Gang, which was determined to prevent another former CYL leader from taking over the party's top post. Li Keqiang, the CYL candidate, appeared to be a clone of Hu. Like Hu, he had risen to the top of the CYL, and later he had helicoptered to Henan and Liaoning to burnish his credibility and experience. Also like Hu, Li was colorless and had no track record as a dynamic and capable leader. Furthermore, Li's patron was Hu Jintao, not Deng Xiaoping. Deng's support and authority ensured Hu's appointment as Jiang's successor, but in 2007 Hu had nowhere near the same amount of prestige and power as Deng had in 1992 to pick a successor.

但当党必须选出胡锦涛的接班人时，青年联盟的弱点就暴露无遗。它的实力无法与上海帮相提并论，后者决心阻止另一位青年联盟前领导人接任党的最高职位。青年联盟的候选人李克强，看起来就像是胡锦涛的翻版。和胡锦涛一样，他也曾是青年联盟的领导人，后来又乘直升机前往河南和辽宁，以提升自己的威望和经验。同样，李克强也缺乏个性，没有展现出领导才能和魄力的记录。此外，李克强的幕后支持者是胡锦涛，而不是邓小平。邓小平的支持和权威确保了胡锦涛被任命为江泽民的接班人，但在2007年，胡锦涛的威望和权力远不及邓小平在1992年时那样强大，难以挑选接班人。

Hu Jintao is commonly believed to be the weakest of all Chinese leaders in the post-Mao era.74 He had no close allies on the powerful PSC during his first term, and he could count on only one member (Li Keqiang) during his second term. By contrast, his predecessor Jiang, with at least four supporters on the PSC during Hu's decade in power, could constrain Hu's exercise of power.75 In retrospect, however much Hu might have wanted Li to be his heir, he lacked the clout to make it happen.

人们普遍认为，胡锦涛是后毛泽东时代中国领导人中最弱势的一位。在他第一个任期内，他在权力强大的国家安全委员会中没有亲密的盟友；第二个任期内，他也只能依靠一位委员（李克强）。相比之下，他的前任江泽民在胡锦涛执政的十年间，至少有四位委员支持他，足以制约胡锦涛的权力。事后看来，尽管胡锦涛可能非常希望李克强成为他的接班人，但他缺乏足够的权力来实现这一目标。

Even though the details of the succession struggle in 2007 may never be fully known, its outcome—the selection of Xi Jinping—would change China's trajectory decisively, and dramatically, after 2012. To be sure, before Xi was made Shanghai party chief in 2007 after the fall of Chen Liangyu, he was a plausible successor but not in the top tier. If it is indeed true that Hu Jintao's purge of Chen was intended to remove a potential obstacle to Li Keqiang, he achieved just the opposite: He actually paved the way for Xi to move to the front row. When the party was forced to pick a successor, the impasse between the Shanghai Gang and the Youth League faction resulted in an apparent compromise—a successor seen as unaffiliated with either group.

尽管2007年权力交接之争的细节或许永远无法完全揭晓，但其结果——习近平的当选——在2012年后彻底改变了中国的发展轨迹。诚然，在陈良宇下台后，习近平于2007年被任命为上海市委书记之前，他虽然是一位可能的接班人，但并非核心人物。如果胡锦涛清洗陈良宇的目的是为了清除李克强的潜在障碍，那么他实际上却适得其反：他为习近平跻身权力核心铺平了道路。当党被迫选择接班人时，上海帮和同盟派之间的僵局最终导致了一个表面上的妥协——一位被认为不属于任何一方的接班人。

After the Sixteenth Party Congress ended in November 2007, the struggle for power at the top only intensified. By that time, the influence of the Shanghai Gang was beginning to wane because its chief patron, Jiang Zemin, was 81 and had been in retirement for five years. His associates on the PSC were all expected to step down in 2012. In the meantime, Xi, the designated successor, was perceived to be a weak leader because he had no faction of his own. The political landscape at the top of the regime appeared to open up opportunities for ambitious apparatchiks to jockey for power in the post-Hu era.

2007年11月中共十六大闭幕后，高层权力斗争愈演愈烈。当时，“上海帮”的影响力开始减弱，因为其主要支持者江泽民已81岁高龄，退休五年。他在国家政治保卫委员会的同僚预计都将在2012年卸任。与此同时，作为指定接班人的习近平被认为软弱无能，因为他没有自己的派系。后胡锦涛时代，政权高层的政治格局似乎为野心勃勃的官僚们提供了争夺权力的机会。

As with other power struggles in dictatorships, the political maneuvering during Hu's second term is shrouded in secrecy and spiced up with unsubstantiated rumors. But two characters feature prominently during this period. The first and most well-known is Bo Xilai, another princeling and newly promoted member of the Politburo and party chief of Chongqing. The second and more obscure figure is Ling Jihua, the director of the powerful General Office of the Central Committee and Hu's long-serving chief of staff. The salacious allegations about Ling's machinations are impossible to verify,76 but because he is one of the four "biggest tigers" (senior officials) whom Xi arrested at the height of his anticorruption campaign, it is reasonable to believe that Xi saw Ling as a lethal threat.

如同其他独裁政权的权力斗争一样，胡锦涛第二任期内的政治角力也笼罩在神秘的面纱之下，充斥着未经证实的谣言。但有两个人物在这一时期尤为突出。第一个也是最广为人知的是薄熙来，他也是一位“太子党”，刚刚晋升为政治局委员，并担任重庆市委书记。第二个人物则较为隐晦，他是中央办公厅主任，也是胡锦涛的长期幕僚长。关于凌继华幕后操纵的种种传闻无从考证，但由于他是习近平反腐运动高峰期逮捕的四大“老虎”（高级官员）之一，因此有理由相信，习近平将凌继华视为致命威胁。

By comparison, the scandal involving Bo Xilai and his family is well-known. The most revealing part of Bo's saga, for the purpose of understanding elite politics during the second half of Hu's rule, is not Bo's spectacular fall in early 2012 or the sleazy details of the corruption in his family, but his attention-grabbing antics to brand himself as a new type of leader during his tenure as Chongqing's party chief.

相比之下，薄熙来及其家族的丑闻早已广为人知。就理解胡锦涛执政后半期精英政治而言，薄熙来事件中最具启发性的部分并非他2012年初的轰然倒台，也并非他家族腐败的种种丑闻细节，而是他在担任重庆市委书记期间，为了将自己塑造成新型领导人而采取的种种引人注目的举动。

Almost as soon as Bo Xilai became Chongqing's party chief in late 2002, he embarked on a risky strategy of promoting himself as a future member of the PSC (mainly because the top two slots—the party chief and the premier—had already been assigned to Xi and Li Keqiang). Unlike Xi, who had shunned the limelight so he would not be seen as an ambitious and potentially dangerous leader, Bo gambled that his only path to the party's most powerful body was to market himself as a more dynamic and creative leader, far different from the risk-averse and colorless apparatchiks who had made up the overwhelming majority of the party's senior echelons in the post-Tiananmen era.

薄熙来在2002年底就任重庆市委书记后不久，便开始实施一项冒险策略，力图将自己塑造成未来国家常委委员（主要是因为中共中央总书记和国务院总理这两个最高职位当时已分别由习近平和李克强占据）。与习近平不同，习近平为了避免被视为野心勃勃且可能构成威胁的领导人而刻意保持低调，而薄熙来则赌上了自己的地位，认为通往党内最高权力机构的唯一途径就是把自己包装成一个更具活力和创造力的领导人，与后天安门时代占据中共高层绝大多数的那些保守乏味、缺乏个性的官僚截然不同。

Bo's campaign consisted of two tracks, both with a populist touch. Ideologically, he revived Maoist symbols with a campaign of "singing red" by organizing mass performances of revolutionary songs popular during the Maoist era. Given his family's suffering under Mao, Bo might not have been a real Maoist. But he apparently calculated that invoking Maoist symbols would resonate with a population concerned about high socioeconomic inequalities and rampant materialism. As no other senior apparatchiks dared to flaunt Maoist symbols, Bo's strategy succeeded in attracting enormous publicity and made him into an instant political star. Simultaneously, Bo launched a ferocious crackdown on alleged "organized crime" (dahei, literally smashing black). This drive led to the arrest and execution of local officials and private businesspeople accused of "organized crime." He dramatically expanded the police force as part of his "Safe Chongqing" campaign. This combination of Maoist ideological revival and cultivation of a public image as a strongman made Bo a popular figure among the local population.77 But Bo's unabashed campaign of self-promotion also earned him many enemies. Liberal scholars and private entrepreneurs saw him as a dangerous ultra-leftist. His rivals in the party were alarmed by the prospect of having this ambitious and ruthless man as one of the top leaders in the post-Hu era.

薄熙来的竞选活动包含两条路线，都带有明显的民粹主义色彩。在意识形态上，他通过组织群众演唱毛泽东时代流行的革命歌曲，发起了一场“唱红歌”运动，复兴了毛泽东时代的象征符号。考虑到他的家庭在毛泽东统治时期遭受的苦难，薄熙来或许并非真正的毛派。但他显然认为，援引毛泽东的象征符号能够引起民众的共鸣，因为民众普遍关注着严重的社会经济不平等和泛滥的物质主义。由于其他高级官员不敢公开使用毛泽东的象征符号，薄熙来的策略成功地吸引了大量公众的关注，使他迅速成为政治明星。与此同时，薄熙来对所谓的“大黑”进行了猛烈的打击。这场运动导致许多被指控“大黑”的地方官员和私营企业主遭到逮捕和处决。作为“安全重庆”运动的一部分，他还大幅扩充了警力。这种毛泽东思想复兴与强人形象塑造相结合的策略，使薄熙来在当地民众中颇受欢迎。但薄熙来毫不掩饰的自我宣传也为他树敌众多。自由派学者和私营企业家视他为危险的极左分子。党内对手则对后胡锦涛时代可能出现这样一位野心勃勃、冷酷无情的领导人感到担忧。

The most remarkable—and revealing—aspect of Bo's attempted power grab before his fall in March 2012 is that he almost succeeded. During his campaign of "singing red and smashing black," not a single senior leader dared to criticize him. Nearly all members of the PSC, including Xi, visited Chongqing as an endorsement of Bo's "Chongqing model." Only Hu and Wen did not go to Chongqing. Bo might have secured one of the seats on the PSC at the Eighteenth Party Congress in November 2012 if his police chief, Wang Lijun, had not exposed the murder of a British businessman by Bo's wife in November 2011.78

薄熙来在2012年3月倒台前试图夺权，其最引人注目——也最具启发性——之处在于他几乎成功了。在他“唱红打黑”的竞选活动中，没有一位高级领导人敢于批评他。几乎所有国家安全委员会成员，包括习近平，都访问了重庆，以示对薄熙来“重庆模式”的支持。只有胡锦涛和温家宝没有去重庆。如果不是他的公安总长王力军在2011年11月揭露了薄熙来的妻子谋杀一名英国商人的罪行，薄熙来或许能在2012年11月的中共十八大上获得一个国家安全委员会的席位。

In retrospect, the greatest beneficiary of Bo's political demise was Xi (who allegedly played a crucial role in urging the PSC to pursue a thorough investigation of Wang Lijun in hopes of implicating Bo).79 Had Bo been promoted to the PSC in fall 2012, he would have made a formidable rival to Xi, likely complicating the latter's efforts to consolidate power. Ironically, although Xi sent Bo to prison for life in August 2013, he has copied the tactics Bo had used in building up his authority and image in Chongqing. Instead of an anticrime drive, Xi launched a wide-ranging crackdown on corruption to destroy political rivals and amass power. Ideologically, Xi went even further than "singing red"—he launched a comprehensive movement of orthodox ideological indoctrination to return the party, which he believed had become too corrupted by materialism, to its revolutionary roots.

回顾历史，薄熙来政治生涯的终结，最大的受益者无疑是习近平（据称，习近平在敦促国家常委对王立军进行彻底调查，以期牵连薄熙来方面发挥了关键作用）。如果薄熙来在2012年秋季晋升为国家常委，他将成为习近平的强劲对手，很可能阻碍习近平巩固权力的努力。具有讽刺意味的是，尽管习近平在2013年8月将薄熙来判处无期徒刑，但他却效仿了薄熙来在重庆建立权威和形象的策略。习近平没有开展反犯罪运动，而是发起了一场范围广泛的反腐运动，旨在铲除政治对手，巩固自身权力。在意识形态方面，习近平的行动甚至超越了“唱红”——他发起了一场全面的正统意识形态灌输运动，试图让党——他认为该党已经过度腐败于物质主义——回归革命根基。





Fatal Flaws of Dengism





邓小平主义的致命缺陷


The fall of Bo Xilai is a fitting coda of the post-Tiananmen political order. By the time the once-swaggering princeling was brought down by his own hubris and political enemies, the foundations of the neo-authoritarian order, envisioned by Deng and constructed during the Jiang era, had begun to crack. Elite unity was fraying as power struggles assumed an increasingly vicious nature. The fragile balance of power was on the verge of collapse as the Shanghai Gang was losing influence due to the advanced age of its principal patron, Jiang Zemin, while the Youth League faction lacked the strength to become an effective countervailing force. A new generation of politicians unaffiliated with either faction, such as Xi and many others, was poised to rise to the top and to fundamentally reshape the elite landscape. Because of the unsustainable investment-driven growth model and the lack of economic reforms during the Hu era, the economy was beginning to lose steam, threatening to undercut the party's claim to performance legitimacy. If the incidence of mass protests is a measurement, tensions between the state and society were greater than at any time since the Tiananmen crackdown. Co-optation of elites might have secured some support from wealthy private businesspeople, but at the price of rampant corruption as ruling elites and well-connected entrepreneurs forged a self-serving alliance. Chinese leaders also appeared to have abandoned Deng's dictum of "keeping a low profile" on foreign policy as they began to flex their muscles abroad in the belief that their moment in the sun had arrived. The only pillars of the post-Tiananmen order that remained intact were the party's security apparatus, now equipped with the most advanced surveillance technologies, and Chinese nationalism.

薄熙来的倒台恰好为后天安门时代的政治秩序画上了一个句号。这位曾经趾高气扬的“太子党”最终因自身的傲慢和政敌的攻击而下台，此时，邓小平构想、江泽民时代构建的新威权秩序的根基已开始动摇。随着权力斗争愈演愈烈，精英阶层的团结日渐瓦解。由于其主要支持者江泽民年事已高，上海帮的影响力日渐式微；而同盟派又缺乏有效制衡的力量，脆弱的权力平衡岌岌可危。以习近平等为代表的新一代政治人物，不隶属于任何派系，正蓄势待发，准备从根本上重塑精英格局。由于胡锦涛时代不可持续的投资驱动型增长模式和经济改革的缺失，经济增长开始放缓，这威胁到党的政绩合法性。如果以大规模抗议活动的发生频率作为衡量标准，那么国家与社会之间的紧张关系达到了自天安门事件以来的最高点。对精英阶层的收买或许能获得一些富裕私营企业主的支持，但代价却是腐败横行，因为统治精英和关系密切的企业家们结成了一个自私自利的联盟。中国领导人似乎也放弃了邓小平关于外交政策“保持低调”的原则，开始在海外炫耀武力，认为他们的时代已经来临。后天安门时代秩序中唯一保持完好的支柱只有党的安保机构（如今配备了最先进的监控技术）和中国民族主义。

To be sure, the post-Tiananmen order could conceivably have lasted longer if Li Keqiang, instead of Xi Jinping, had become party chief in November 2012. It was Xi who demolished the post-Tiananmen order. Before the rise of a neostalinist figure like Xi, few would have imagined that Hu's successor could reverse Deng's policy of reform and opening and reimpose totalitarian control on the party and on a Chinese society that had been so thoroughly transformed by two decades of economic modernization.

诚然，如果2012年11月接任中共中央总书记的是李克强而非习近平，那么天安门事件后的秩序或许能够维持更久。正是习近平摧毁了天安门事件后的秩序。在习近平这样一位新斯大林主义人物崛起之前，几乎没有人会想到胡锦涛的继任者会推翻邓小平的改革开放政策，重新对党和中国社会实施极权统治——而中国社会此前已经历了二十年的经济现代化进程，发生了翻天覆地的变化。

In retrospect, Xi's speedy dismantling of the post-Tiananmen order—without much resistance in the party to boot—suggests that forces larger than the ambitions and ideological visions of a princeling were at work. In other words, the post-Tiananmen order contained the seeds of its own destruction. Under Xi, it came to a quick and abrupt end. Had a different leader succeeded Hu, the decaying order might have experienced a slower death, but it would nevertheless have met its end.

回望过去，习近平迅速瓦解天安门事件后的秩序——而且党内几乎没有遇到任何阻力——表明，其背后存在着比一位太子党的野心和意识形态愿景更为强大的力量。换言之，天安门事件后的秩序本身就蕴含着自我毁灭的种子。在习近平的领导下，它迅速而突然地走向终结。如果胡锦涛之后是另一位领导人，这个摇摇欲坠的秩序或许会经历一个更为缓慢的消亡过程，但最终也难逃覆灭的命运。

Like other dictatorships, the party in the post-Tiananmen era could not evade the law of negative selection: Its power and privileges mainly attracted opportunists who embraced the regime for personal gain, not out of genuine ideological commitment. As patronage and corruption became the principal means to get ahead in the regime, only apparatchiks with fewer scruples had a better chance to gain power, thus creating a dynamic of bad money driving out good money. Over time, less capable but more venal and sycphantic apparatchiks came to dominate the ranks of the regime. Institutionally, the degeneration of elites created favorable conditions for the rise of a ruthless personalistic ruler because they were too compromised by their record of corruption or too cowardly to put up a fight.80

与其他独裁政权一样，后天安门时代的党也无法逃脱负面选择规律：其权力和特权主要吸引的是那些为谋取私利而拥护政权的投机分子，而非出于真正的意识形态认同。随着裙带关系和腐败成为在政权中晋升的主要手段，只有那些道德底线更低的官僚才更有可能获得权力，从而造成了“坏钱赶好钱”的局面。随着时间的推移，能力较弱但更加贪婪谄媚的官僚逐渐主导了政权。从制度层面来看，精英阶层的堕落为冷酷无情的个人统治者的崛起创造了有利条件，因为他们要么因自身的腐败记录而声名狼藉，要么因为懦弱而不敢反抗。

The post-Tiananmen order unraveled also because of the inherent limitations of Deng's neo-authoritarian model. Transition from a centrally planned economy to a market economy under a Leninist regime faces impossible odds because such a transition will necessitate a near-total withdrawal of the state from the economy, fatally weakening a Leninist party-state's control of the economy. It is worth recalling that market reform was Deng's tactic to save the party, not his ultimate goal. As a pragmatic Leninist, he embraced capitalism out of necessity, not out of ideological conviction.

天安门事件后的社会秩序瓦解，也源于邓小平新威权主义模式的固有局限性。在列宁主义政权下，从计划经济向市场经济转型几乎不可能成功，因为这种转型需要国家几乎完全退出经济领域，从而从根本上削弱列宁主义党国对经济的控制。值得注意的是，市场改革是邓小平挽救党的策略，而非其最终目标。作为一个务实的列宁主义者，他拥抱资本主义是出于无奈，而非出于意识形态的信念。

Toward the end of the Hu era, however, the logic of a "partial reform equilibrium" set in. The remarkable economic achievements after the Tiananmen debacle, likely unanticipated by the regime (or anyone else, for that matter), boosted the party's legitimacy and confidence but also perversely diminished incentives to carry out further reforms.81 The most insidious aspect of a "partial reform equilibrium" is that this status quo offered maximum benefits to the party if it could be preserved. As a partially reformed economy was far more efficient than a centrally planned economy, the party could claim a higher degree of performance legitimacy. At the same time, this equilibrium also allowed the party to maintain a substantial degree of control over the economy and enabled the ruling elites to wield their political influence to extract personal benefits. Consequently, the regime had no desire either to return to a Maoist system or to advance to a full market system. But a "partial reform equilibrium" cannot be sustained forever. The combination of corruption and systemic inefficiency in the partial reform economy began to sap China's economic dynamism on the eve of Xi's takeover.

然而，在胡锦涛时代末期，“部分改革均衡”的逻辑开始形成。天安门事件后取得的显著经济成就，很可能是政权（或者任何人）始料未及的，这提升了党的合法性和自信心，但也适得其反地削弱了进一步改革的动力。“部分改革均衡”最阴险之处在于，如果能够维持现状，就能为党带来最大利益。由于部分改革后的经济效率远高于中央计划经济，党可以宣称其政绩具有更高的合法性。与此同时，这种均衡也使党能够对经济保持相当程度的控制，并使统治精英能够利用其政治影响力谋取私利。因此，政权既不愿回到毛泽东时代的体制，也不愿过渡到完全的市场经济体制。但是，“部分改革均衡”不可能永远维持下去。在习近平接任国家主席前夕，腐败和部分改革经济体制效率低下的问题开始削弱中国的经济活力。

The growth of private wealth, expansion of a middle class, and emergence of a nascent civil society constituted yet another existential threat to the post-Tiananmen order. Although the party had invested massive resources in surveillance and had acquired an unprecedented coercive capacity toward the end of the Hu era, it also began to encounter more direct and well-organized challenges to its authority from many directions—ethnic minorities in Tibet (which in 2008 experienced the region's most violent uprising in two decades) and Xinjiang (which saw China's most deadly ethnic riot in July 2009), underground religious and cult groups, human rights activists, environmental movements, and ordinary people victimized by government policies and abusive officials. Despite the regime's formidable capacity to quell these challenges, it would have to resort to more brutal tactics to deter and suppress societal opposition forces.

私人财富的增长、中产阶级的壮大以及新兴公民社会的出现，对后天安门时代的秩序构成了又一生存威胁。尽管中共在胡锦涛时代末期投入巨资加强监控，并获得了前所未有的强制力，但它也开始面临来自多方面的、更加直接且组织严密的挑战——西藏（2008年爆发了该地区二十年来最激烈的起义）和新疆（2009年7月爆发了中国历史上最致命的民族骚乱）的少数民族、地下宗教和邪教组织、人权活动人士、环保运动以及受政府政策和官员滥用职权迫害的普通民众。尽管中共政权拥有强大的镇压能力，但它不得不诉诸更加残酷的手段来威慑和镇压社会反对力量。

On the external front, the durability of the post-Tiananmen order critically depended on stable and largely cooperative relations with the West, its primary source of technology, market access, and capital. The strategic restraint urged by Deng served China well. However, there were two fundamental flaws in Deng's "hide and bide" strategy. First, ideological hostility toward the West's capitalist democracy was deeply embedded in the party, which saw the US-led West as an existential political threat and its economic engagement with China simply as an instrument of "peaceful evolution" or regime change. Such insecurity, if not paranoia, limited the extent of the West's economic engagement with China because China would prioritize regime security over economic benefits, and the West would understandably erect safeguards against a potential geopolitical adversary that was rapidly gaining strength through globalization. Second, China's rapid growth in the post-Tiananmen era radically transformed the global balance of power and changed its leaders' strategic calculus. When Deng prescribed strategic restraint in the wake of the Soviet collapse, it was not so much a stroke of geopolitical genius as a concession to reality: China was simply too weak to be assertive. All this would change toward the end of the Hu era. Finally, due to its growing power, China felt confident enough to take steps to extend its global influence, even at the risk of antagonizing the West, particularly the United States. Xi Jinping would later adopt a far more systematic and aggressive foreign policy, but China's strategic overreach actually began under the leadership of Hu Jintao.82

在对外层面，后天安门时代秩序的持久性关键在于与西方保持稳定且基本合作的关系，因为西方是中国技术、市场准入和资本的主要来源。邓小平倡导的战略克制对中国大有裨益。然而，邓小平的“观望”战略存在两个根本缺陷。首先，对西方资本主义民主的意识形态敌意根深蒂固于党内，党将以美国为首的西方视为生存的政治威胁，并将西方与中国的经济往来仅仅视为“和平演进”或政权更迭的工具。这种不安全感，甚至可以说是偏执，限制了西方与中国的经济往来程度，因为中国会优先考虑政权安全而非经济利益，而西方自然会建立起防范机制，以应对一个通过全球化迅速崛起的潜在地缘政治对手。其次，后天安门时代中国的快速发展从根本上改变了全球力量平衡，也改变了中国领导人的战略考量。邓小平在苏联解体后提出的战略克制，与其说是地缘政治上的天才之举，不如说是对现实的妥协：当时的中国实力太弱，无力采取强硬姿态。这一切在胡锦涛时代末期发生了改变。最终，由于国力日益增强，中国自信地采取措施扩大其全球影响力，即便冒着激怒西方，特别是美国的风险。习近平后来采取了更为系统和激进的外交政策，但中国的战略扩张实际上始于胡锦涛的领导时期。





5 China's Economic Miracle





5中国的经济奇迹


BASED ON CHINA's rapid growth in the post-Tiananmen era, it is tempting to think that this was primarily due to the party's neo-authoritarian development model. But such a conclusion is at most just partly correct because many other factors likely played a greater role in supercharging economic growth in the two decades following Deng Xiaoping's southern tour in early 1992.1 Certainly, the party's single-minded focus on economic development gave rise to an incentive structure that motivated local officials to prioritize growth. Reforms carried out in the 1990s helped lay some of the critical institutional foundations of a market economy. Additionally, the Chinese state's unrivaled capacity for mobilizing resources enabled the country to invest in physical capital, such as factories and infrastructure, on an unprecedented scale. However, a closer look at the underlying drivers of sustained economic growth in the post-Tiananmen era makes it clear that the most important foundations had actually been laid in the 1980s. A dynamic private sector that would evolve into the most powerful and efficient productive force in the post-Tiananmen era was created in the 1980s. The opening to the outside world, another critical step taken in the 1980s, allowed China to capitalize on the globalization boom in the post-Cold War era. The highly favorable demographic structure enabled China to benefit from an abundant supply of young workers and a low old-age dependency ratio. Cooperative relations with the West helped China gain support for accession to the World Trade Organization and become a trading superpower.

基于中国在天安门事件后的快速增长，人们很容易认为这主要归功于中共的新威权主义发展模式。但这种结论至多只能说是部分正确，因为在邓小平1992年初南巡后的二十年里，许多其他因素可能在推动经济增长方面发挥了更大的作用。诚然，中共对经济发展的专注催生了一种激励机制，促使地方官员优先考虑经济增长。20世纪90年代的改革也为市场经济奠定了一些关键的制度基础。此外，中国政府无与伦比的资源调动能力使其能够以前所未有的规模投资于工厂和基础设施等物质资本。然而，仔细审视天安门事件后持续经济增长的根本驱动因素，就会发现最重要的基础实际上早在20世纪80年代就已经奠定。上世纪80年代，中国创建了一个充满活力的私营部门，并在后天安门时代发展成为最强大、最高效的生产力。80年代的另一项关键举措是对外开放，这使中国得以充分利用后冷战时代的全球化浪潮。优越的人口结构使中国拥有充足的年轻劳动力和较低的老年抚养比。与西方国家的合作关系帮助中国获得了加入世界贸易组织的支持，并最终成为贸易超级大国。

Unfortunately, favorable economic and geopolitical factors seldom last forever. China's post-Tiananmen economic miracle conceivably could have become even more spectacular and endure longer had its leaders undertake more radical reforms to complete the country's march to a full market economy. Yet, the logic of path dependence again precluded this possibility. Instead of taking advantage of favorable structural factors to implement the difficult reforms, the party in the Hu Jintao era was trapped in a "partial reform equilibrium." The hybrid economy that emerged in the 1980s turned out to be far more difficult to reform. Strong economic performance reduced the party's incentive to risk tougher reforms. Its choice of an investment-driven development model became an addiction despite evidence of its diminishing returns in the Hu era. Further reduction of the state's influence over the market, especially through the privatization of state-owned enterprises, was politically unthinkable because the party saw them as the economic foundations of its monopoly of power. When China's economic momentum began to decelerate in the second half of Hu's decade in power, the party took the easy way out. Instead of painful structural reforms, it turned to credit-funded stimulus and blew an epic investment bubble that would burst and mire the economy in stagnation a dozen years later. In retrospect, party supremacy over market—the sine qua non of Dengism and the ultimate destiny of neo-authoritarian developmentalism—meant that the party would not permit considerations of economic efficiency to subvert its goal of regime survival. In this light, China's economic miracle in the post-Tiananmen era could not last.

不幸的是，有利的经济和地缘政治因素很少能永远持续下去。如果中国领导人能够进行更彻底的改革，完成向全面市场经济的转型，那么天安门事件后中国的经济奇迹或许会更加辉煌，持续时间也会更长。然而，路径依赖的逻辑再次排除了这种可能性。胡锦涛时代的党没有利用有利的结构性因素来推行艰难的改革，而是陷入了“局部改革均衡”的困境。20世纪80年代出现的混合经济模式被证明更难改革。强劲的经济表现降低了党进行更深入改革的动力。尽管胡锦涛时代已经出现了收益递减的迹象，但党仍然选择投资驱动型发展模式，并对此深恶痛绝。进一步削弱国家对市场的影响，特别是通过国有企业私有化，在政治上是不可想象的，因为党认为这些企业是其垄断权力的经济基础。在胡锦涛执政的后半段，中国经济增速开始放缓，中共选择了最简单的应对方式。它没有进行痛苦的结构性改革，而是转向信贷刺激，吹起了巨大的投资泡沫，最终泡沫破裂，导致经济在十几年后陷入停滞。事后看来，党凌驾于市场之上——这是邓小平主义的必要条件，也是新威权发展主义的最终归宿——意味着中共不会允许经济效率的考量影响其政权生存的目标。由此看来，后天安门时代中国的经济奇迹注定无法持久。





Economic Achievements





经济成就


Judging by measurable data, China's economic performance from the time between Deng's historic southern tour in 1992 and the end of Hu Jintao's rule in 2012 was among the most impressive in the annals of development. Although the quality of Chinese growth is marred by extensive environmental degradation, high income inequality, and rampant corruption, its quantitative achievements are undeniable. Factoring in the economic accomplishments of the 1980s, China transformed itself from an impoverished agrarian society to a moderately prosperous one within one generation. The main driver of this economic revolution was sustained growth in the post-Tiananmen period (table 5.1). During the two "miracle decades" (1993-2012), the Chinese economy grew at an annualized rate of 10.2 percent. The size of the Chinese economy in 2012 was nearly twenty times larger than that in 1992 in dollar terms (from $0.427 trillion to $8.53 trillion) and ten times larger in purchasing power parity (PPP) (from 1.47 trillion to 15.12 trillion).2

从可量化的数据来看，从邓小平1992年历史性的南巡到胡锦涛2012年卸任，中国的经济表现堪称发展史上最令人瞩目的成就之一。尽管中国经济增长的质量受到严重的环境恶化、收入不平等和腐败猖獗等问题的制约，但其量化成就毋庸置疑。考虑到20世纪80年代的经济成就，中国在一代人的时间内就从一个贫困的农业社会转型为小康社会。这一经济革命的主要驱动力是天安门事件后持续增长的时期（表5.1）。在两个“奇迹十年”（1993-2012年）期间，中国经济年均增长率达到10.2%。 2012年中国经济规模按美元计算几乎是1992年的20倍（从0.427万亿美元增至8.53万亿美元），按购买力平价（PPP）计算则是1992年的10倍（从1.47万亿美元增至15.12万亿美元）。

During this period, China also became a foreign trade powerhouse. The volume of exports rose more than elevenfold, and imports increased by the same order of magnitude (table 5.2). The explosive growth of Chinese foreign trade turned the country into the world's largest exporting economy within the two decades after the end of the Cold War. In 1992 China's share of global exports of goods (including Hong Kong) was 5.2 percent, placing it behind the United States, Germany, Japan, and France as the world's fifth-largest exporter. By 2012, China's share of global exports of goods (including Hong Kong) reached 13.9 percent, making it the world's largest exporter (a position it continued to hold in the mid-2020s).3 As a result of government support, Chinese exports included a large share of electronics and manufactured goods that were technologically more sophisticated than those of other economies at a comparable income level.4 Burgeoning exports filled China's foreign exchange coffers to the brim. In 1992 the country had only $19 billion in hard currency reserves. Two decades later, it boasted the world's largest foreign exchange reserves ($3.3 trillion).5

在此期间，中国也成为外贸强国。出口额增长超过11倍，进口额也增长了10倍（表5.2）。冷战结束后的二十年内，中国外贸的爆炸式增长使其成为世界最大的出口经济体。1992年，中国（包括香港）在全球商品出口中所占份额为5.2%，位列美国、德国、日本和法国之后，成为世界第五大出口国。到2012年，中国（包括香港）在全球商品出口中所占份额达到13.9%，成为世界最大的商品出口国（这一地位在2020年代中期仍然保持）。由于政府的支持，中国出口产品中电子产品和制成品的占比很高，这些产品的技术水平高于其他收入水平相当的经济体。蓬勃发展的出口使中国的外汇储备迅速增长。1992年，中国的外汇储备仅为190亿美元。二十年后，中国拥有了世界最大的外汇储备（3.3万亿美元）。

Economic growth in the post-Tiananmen period also urbanized a predominantly rural society. In 1992 only 27.5 percent (or 322 million) of the population lived in urban areas. By 2012, 52.6 percent (or 712 million) of the population were urban residents.6 The structure of the economy was transformed beyond recognition as the modern sectors (industry and services) dominated economic activities by 2012. In 1992 agriculture, industry, and services accounted for 21.8, 43.5, and 34.8 percent of GDP, respectively. By 2012, the share of agriculture had declined to 10.1 percent, while the shares of industry and services were 45.3 and 44.5 percent, respectively.7

天安门事件后的经济增长也推动了以农村为主的社会城市化进程。1992年，仅有27.5%（即3.22亿）的人口居住在城镇地区。到2012年，城镇人口比例上升至52.6%（即7.12亿）。经济结构也发生了翻天覆地的变化，现代产业（工业和服务业）在2012年主导了经济活动。1992年，农业、工业和服务业分别占GDP的21.8%、43.5%和34.8%。到2012年，农业占GDP的比重下降至10.1%，而工业和服务业的比重分别达到45.3%和44.5%。

The standard of living for the average Chinese rose from 1,262 in PPP in 1992 to 11,169 in PPP in 2012, a nearly tenfold improvement.8 Due to sustained high growth, the scale of the reduction in poverty during this period was unprecedented. On the eve of Deng's reform and opening, China had 770 million people living in poverty, of whom 658 million were living in rural areas. By 2013, the number of rural poor had fallen to 82 million (8.5 percent of the rural population). In other words, economic growth reduced the number of rural poor by 576 million between 1990 and 2013.9

1992年至2012年间，中国人均生活水平（按购买力平价计算）从1262提高到11169，增长了近十倍。由于经济持续高速增长，这一时期减贫规模空前。邓小平改革开放前夕，中国有7.7亿贫困人口，其中6.58亿生活在农村地区。到2013年，农村贫困人口减少到8200万（占农村人口的8.5%）。换言之，1990年至2013年间，经济增长使农村贫困人口减少了5.76亿。





Economic Reform and the Chinese Miracle





经济改革与中国奇迹


The post-Tiananmen leadership benefited enormously from the legacy of reform implemented by Zhao Ziyang and the other liberal reformers in the 1980s. When Deng reigned reform in 1992, most of the basic institutional framework for a market-oriented economy had already been laid. Agriculture, for example, had been privatized, freeing up an immense pool of surplus labor to engage in more productive activities in manufacturing and services. A dynamic private sector had firmly established itself as a new engine of growth. (In 1991 nonstate firms were generating 47 percent of industrial output.)10 China's linkages to the world economy through trade and investment were fully restored by the beginning of the 1990s. Geopolitically, China's ties with the West survived the shock of the Tiananmen crackdown despite the (mostly symbolic) sanctions imposed by its main trading partners in protest. With the end of the Cold War in 1991, China managed to preserve its commercial ties with the West. Instead of being cast aside or isolated, China joined the high tide of globalization championed by the United States, then the world's sole superpower.

天安门事件后的领导层从赵紫阳和其他自由派改革者在20世纪80年代推行的改革遗产中获益匪浅。1992年邓小平执政改革时，市场经济的大部分基本制度框架已经搭建完成。例如，农业私有化释放了大量剩余劳动力，使其能够从事生产性更高的制造业和服务业活动。充满活力的私营部门已稳固确立自身作为新的增长引擎的地位。（1991年，非国有企业创造了47%的工业产值。）到20世纪90年代初，中国通过贸易和投资与世界经济的联系已全面恢复。在地缘政治方面，尽管主要贸易伙伴为抗议天安门事件而实施了（大多是象征性的）制裁，但中国与西方的关系经受住了天安门镇压的冲击。随着1991年冷战的结束，中国成功地维持了与西方的商业联系。中国没有被抛弃或孤立，而是加入了由当时世界唯一的超级大国美国所倡导的全球化浪潮。

Conservative resistance to more radical economic reforms collapsed after Deng's southern tour in early 1992. In November 1993 the party issued a comprehensive package of reform, "Resolution on Several Questions on the Construction of a Socialist Market Economic System."11 With Jiang Zemin's support, Executive Vice Premier Zhu Rongji sidelined the conservative premier Li Peng and supervised the major institutional reforms laid out in the resolution.

邓小平1992年初南巡之后，保守派对更激进的经济改革的抵制瓦解。1993年11月，党发布了一揽子改革方案——《关于建设社会主义市场经济体制若干问题的决议》。在江泽民的支持下，常务副总理朱镕基架空了保守派总理李鹏，并主导了决议中提出的重大体制改革。

The first measure—unification of exchange rates and a major devaluation—went into effect on January 1, 1994. Prior to this reform, China had two exchange rates, with a highly overvalued official exchange rate. Yi Gang, who later became China's central bank governor, has recalled that the average official rate in 1993 was 5.6 yuan to the dollar, while the average market rate was 9.04 yuan to the dollar, implying an overvaluation of roughly 60 percent.12 The dual exchange rates encouraged Chinese firms to withhold their foreign exchange earnings from the central government, fueling black market transactions and disincentivizing exports. The positive impact of the exchange rate reform was felt instantly. The Chinese yuan was effectively devalued by 60 percent, thus making exports highly competitive. The unification of the exchange rates also simplified the administration of foreign exchange and encouraged firms to export.13 Chinese exports in 1994 rose 32 percent vis-à-vis 1993 (in 1993, exports had grown only 8 percent over 1992). China's foreign exchange reserves more than doubled in 1994 (from $21.1 billion in 1993 to $51.6 billion in 1994).14

第一项措施——统一汇率和大幅贬值——于1994年1月1日生效。在此改革之前，中国实行双轨制汇率，官方汇率被严重高估。后来成为中国央行行长的易纲回忆说，1993年官方平均汇率为1美元兑5.6元人民币，而市场平均汇率为1美元兑9.04元人民币，这意味着官方汇率被高估了约60%。这种双重汇率制度促使中国企业将外汇收入隐瞒起来，不上缴中央政府，助长了黑市交易，并抑制了出口。汇率改革的积极影响立竿见影。人民币实际贬值了60%，从而使出口竞争力大幅提升。汇率统一简化了外汇管理，鼓励企业出口。1994年中国出口额较1993年增长32%（1993年出口额较1992年仅增长8%）。1994年中国外汇储备翻了一番多（从1993年的211亿美元增至1994年的516亿美元）。

A revamped fiscal system that recentralized government revenues was also put in place on January 1, 1994. In the 1980s Beijing had resorted to a form of "fiscal contracting"—or tax-farming—to incentivize local governments to increase economic output. Under fiscal contracting, local governments could keep surplus revenues after meeting their previously negotiated quota with Beijing. Although fiscal contracting contributed to local economic dynamism, it also had several major shortcomings. The most serious was a decline in the share of revenue collected by the central government because this arrangement ensured that local governments reaped more benefits of the growth than did Beijing. As a result, the share of the central government was only 22 percent of total government revenue in 1993.15 Lack of fiscal resources limited Beijing's ability to fund infrastructure and other expensive capital projects. Fiscal contracting also encouraged "local protectionism" as provincial governments erected trade barriers to products from other regions so as to protect their local industries.16

1994年1月1日，一项重新集中政府财政收入的改革财政体系正式实施。上世纪80年代，北京曾采取一种“财政契约”（或称包税制）来激励地方政府提高经济产出。根据财政契约，地方政府在完成与北京事先约定的配额后，可以保留剩余收入。尽管财政契约促进了地方经济的活力，但也存在几个重大缺陷。最严重的是中央政府财政收入份额的下降，因为这种安排确保了地方政府比北京获得更多经济增长的收益。结果，1993年中央政府的财政收入仅占政府总收入的22%。财政资源的匮乏限制了北京为基础设施和其他昂贵的资本项目提供资金的能力。财政紧缩也助长了“地方保护主义”，因为省级政府为了保护本地区产业，对来自其他地区的商品设置了贸易壁垒。

In 1993 Zhu Rongji personally negotiated with provincial leaders an agreement on a new fiscal system that would recentralize revenue. At the heart of the reform was the introduction of a national value-added tax, which dramatically broadened the tax base. The central government would receive 75 percent of the value-added tax, with the remainder going to local governments. Local governments could also collect other taxes, but they contributed a much smaller share of taxes. In 1995, one year after the new system went into effect, the value-added tax accounted for 43 percent of total tax revenue.17 To sweeten the deal, the central government allowed local authorities to keep income from the leasing of land, thus giving birth to the so-called land-based fiscal system (tudi caizheng).

1993年，朱镕基亲自与各省领导人协商，达成一项关于重新集中财政收入的新财政体制协议。改革的核心是引入全国增值税，这极大地拓宽了税基。中央政府将获得增值税的75%，其余部分归地方政府所有。地方政府也可以征收其他税种，但其税收份额要小得多。1995年，新体制实施一年后，增值税占税收总额的43%。为了进一步促进改革，中央政府允许地方政府保留土地租赁收入，由此诞生了所谓的土地财政体制。

In subsequent years, the central government's share of fiscal revenue rose dramatically. (During 1996-2000, it shot up to 50 percent.)18 Like all reforms, the fiscal recentralization in 1994 produced winners and losers. In this case, the winner was clearly the central government, which was able to capture the lion's share of the tax revenue generated by China's fast-growing economy in the post-Tiananmen era. Its abundant revenue allowed Beijing to invest in infrastructure, military modernization, and domestic security. The losers were the local governments that subsequently experienced chronic budgetary shortfalls and had to rely increasingly on income from the sale of land-user rights and bank loans to fund their investments and operations. A lack of fiscal resources also limited the local governments' ability to pay for social services.19 On balance, however, the fiscal reform of 1994 largely accomplished Beijing's objectives, despite the mixed outcomes. The fiscal system became more stable, and the lower budget deficits helped contain inflation (from 1980 to 1990 the consumer price index rose 11.6 percent on average annually, but in the decade following implementation of the new fiscal regime the increase averaged only 6.8 percent per annum).20 The central government acquired ever-increasing resources to invest in high-priority projects. The negative effects of the new fiscal system did not become clear until roughly two decades later, when local governments began to borrow heavily from banks to finance their capital projects, thus accumulating a huge amount of debt that they could not repay.21

在随后的几年里，中央政府的财政收入份额大幅上升。（1996年至2000年间，这一比例飙升至50%。）18 与所有改革一样，1994年的财政权力下放改革也产生了赢家和输家。在这种情况下，赢家显然是中央政府，它能够攫取后天安门时代中国快速增长的经济所产生的大部分税收收入。充裕的财政收入使北京得以投资基础设施、军事现代化和国内安全。输家则是地方政府，它们随后经历了长期的财政赤字，不得不越来越依赖土地使用权出售收入和银行贷款来为其投资和运营提供资金。财政资源的匮乏也限制了地方政府支付社会服务的能力。19 然而，总的来说，尽管结果喜忧参半，1994年的财政改革在很大程度上实现了北京的目标。财政体系变得更加稳定，预算赤字的降低有助于抑制通货膨胀（1980年至1990年，消费者价格指数平均每年上涨11.6%，但在新财政制度实施后的十年里，平均年涨幅仅为6.8%）。中央政府获得了越来越多的资源，用于投资高优先级项目。新财政制度的负面影响直到大约二十年后才显现出来，当时地方政府开始大量向银行借款以资助其资本项目，从而积累了巨额债务，最终无力偿还。

A third major reform in the 1990s was the establishment of a modern financial system and increased independence of the central bank, the People's Bank of China (PBOC). At the end of 1993, the State Council announced a comprehensive overhaul of the financial system.22 During the Maoist period, China had no commercial banks. Few financial reforms were carried out in the 1980s as such reforms were technically too complicated and too risky to undertake in a transition economy. But because a modern financial sector is critical to mobilizing savings and allocating capital, the party identified reform of the financial sector, in particular the establishment of a modern banking sector, as a priority in its resolution on pro-market reform issued at the November 1993 Central Committee plenum.

20世纪90年代的第三项重大改革是建立现代金融体系并增强中央银行——中国人民银行（央行）的独立性。1993年底，国务院宣布对金融体系进行全面改革。毛泽东时代，中国没有商业银行。20世纪80年代，由于转型经济体在技术上过于复杂且风险过高，金融改革鲜有开展。但由于现代金融部门对于动员储蓄和配置资本至关重要，党在1993年11月中央全会通过的关于市场化改革的决议中，将金融部门改革，特别是建立现代银行业，列为优先事项。

Financial sector reform encompassed three subsectors: banking, insurance, and capital markets (equity and bonds). Because the insurance industry was relatively small and the tightly regulated capital markets played only a minor role in channeling savings into investments, the most critical sector was banking, the largest component of China's financial system.

金融业改革涵盖三个子行业：银行业、保险业和资本市场（股票和债券）。由于保险业规模相对较小，且监管严格的资本市场在引导储蓄投资方面作用有限，因此，银行业——中国金融体系中规模最大的组成部分——成为最为关键的行业。

The most successful part of the financial reform carried out in the 1990s, also led by Zhu Rongji, was the reform of the PBOC. Local governments had wielded substantial influence over the central bank, whose local branches were set up according to the administrative hierarchy of the state (for example, the PBOC had a branch office in each province and city). Since local governments appointed the leadership and staff of these offices, they could influence the PBOC. Zhu's reform established larger regional PBOC offices responsible for multiple provinces and filled them with officials appointed by the PBOC, making the central bank less dependent on local governments and increasing the technocratic capabilities of its local staff.23 (Xi Jinping would reverse this reform in 2023 and increase party control of monetary policy.)

上世纪90年代朱镕基领导的金融改革中最成功的部分是对中国人民银行的改革。地方政府对央行拥有相当大的影响力，央行的地方分支机构是根据国家行政层级设立的（例如，央行在每个省市都设有分支机构）。由于地方政府任命这些机构的领导和工作人员，因此它们可以影响央行。朱镕基的改革设立了规模更大的区域性央行办事处，负责多个省份，并由央行任命官员，从而降低了央行对地方政府的依赖，并提高了其地方工作人员的技术能力。（习近平在2023年推翻了这项改革，加强了党对货币政策的控制。）

However, the other components of the banking-sector reform achieved mixed results. On the positive side, the reform increased competition in the banking sector and improved supervision, albeit from a very low level. Although the five largest state-owned banks (the Industrial and Commercial Bank of China, Construction Bank of China, Bank of China, Agricultural Bank of China, and Communications Bank) continued to dominate, reform in the 1990s brought in a large number of smaller banks with a diverse set of owners (mostly local governments, state-owned companies, and private and foreign investors), thus moderately increasing competition.24 Separating policy lending from commercial lending, at least technically, the reform created a better division of labor in the financial sector. The policy to allow major Western banks, such as Bank of America, HSBC, and Singapore Development Bank, to purchase up to 20 percent of equity ownership in Chinese banks in the early 2000s was another positive step toward strengthening the financial health of the banking sector and introducing more sophisticated banking practices.

然而，银行业改革的其他组成部分成效不一。积极的一面是，改革增强了银行业的竞争，并改善了监管，尽管监管力度仍然很低。虽然五大国有银行（中国工商银行、中国建设银行、中国银行、中国农业银行和交通银行）仍然占据主导地位，但20世纪90年代的改革引入了大量规模较小的银行，这些银行的所有者构成也更加多元化（主要是地方政府、国有企业以及私人和外国投资者），从而在一定程度上增强了竞争。改革将政策性贷款与商业贷款分开，至少在技术层面上，这在金融领域实现了更合理的分工。21世纪初，允许美国银行、汇丰银行和新加坡发展银行等西方大型银行收购中国银行至多20%的股权的政策，是加强银行业的财务健康和引入更成熟的银行业务实践的又一积极举措。

At the same time, the banking reform in the post-Tiananmen era did not create a truly market-based system. The state-controlled banks continued to channel a disproportionate amount of credit to the SOEs and to discriminate against the more efficient private firms. One survey of private firms at the end of the 1990s found that bank loans provided only 4 percent of the start-up capital and about 9 percent of the operating funds of private firms.25 Consequently, private firms often had to resort to bribery to gain bank credit or had to tap into the more costly and less stable shadow banking system for credit.26

与此同时，天安门事件后的银行业改革并未建立起真正以市场为导向的体系。国有银行继续将不成比例的信贷输送给国有企业，并歧视效率更高的私营企业。20世纪90年代末的一项针对私营企业的调查发现，银行贷款仅占私营企业启动资金的4%和运营资金的9%左右。因此，私营企业往往不得不通过行贿来获得银行贷款，或者不得不依赖成本更高、稳定性更差的影子银行体系来获取信贷。

Progress in developing other parts of the financial system, such as equity and debt markets, was similarly uneven. China established these markets in the early 1990s, but initially it limited access only to state-owned enterprises and other state entities. Even after private firms were allowed access, an effective quota system led to a complex and time-consuming process to obtain approvals to raise capital. Foreign investors could only invest in B-class shares, which had far less liquidity than the A-class shares that were available to domestic investors. Although China's equity markets grew significantly in the post-Tiananmen era and would boast about 2,500 listed companies, with a total market value of 23 trillion yuan (over $3 trillion) in 2012, they remained a secondary channel through which firms could raise capital. By comparison, the outstanding credit of the banking system in the same year was 63 trillion yuan, nearly three times larger than the total market value of Chinese stocks.27

金融体系其他部分的发展，例如股票和债券市场，同样不均衡。中国在20世纪90年代初建立了这些市场，但最初仅限于国有企业和其他国有实体参与。即使在允许私营企业进入之后，有效的配额制度也导致融资审批流程复杂且耗时。外国投资者只能投资B类股，其流动性远低于国内投资者可投资的A类股。尽管中国股票市场在天安门事件后发展迅速，2012年拥有约2500家上市公司，总市值达23万亿元人民币（超过3万亿美元），但它们仍然是企业融资的次要渠道。相比之下，同年银行体系的未偿信贷额为63万亿元人民币，几乎是中国股票总市值的三倍。

Reform of the SOEs, which made little progress in the 1980s, was another priority of the government in the 1990s. However, because the party initially resisted large-scale privatization and mass bankruptcy of unprofitable SOEs due to ideological concerns and worries about social unrest, it preferred mostly half-measures, such as leasing, mergers, and a comprehensive program of "establishing a modern enterprise system based primarily on state ownership.28 The party's conception of a "modern enterprise system" appeared to be inspired by the corporate governance system prevalent in the West. Chinese reformers hoped that by adopting a Western-style corporate governance system they could make SOEs more efficient without changing their ownership.

20世纪80年代进展甚微的国有企业改革，在90年代成为政府的另一项优先事项。然而，由于意识形态上的顾虑以及对社会动荡的担忧，中共最初抵制大规模私有化和亏损国有企业的集体破产，因此更倾向于采取折衷方案，例如租赁、合并以及“建立以国有制为主的现代企业制度”的综合方案。中共对“现代企业制度”的构想似乎受到了西方盛行的公司治理体系的启发。中国改革者希望通过借鉴西方式的公司治理体系，在不改变国有企业所有权的情况下提高其效率。

As a consequence, many large SOEs went through mostly cosmetic changes, such as establishment of a board of directors, regular financial disclosures, and audits conducted by professional firms. Some were listed on domestic and international stock exchanges to attract nonstate minority investments and to create external pressures and oversight as tools to increase SOE efficiency. Yet, these reforms did not divest the state of complete or partial ownership. Most crucially but logically, the SOEs continued to serve the interests of the party, which retained effective control over these firms through management appointments. In theory, the party's "modern enterprise system" was supposed to maximize efficiency and improve the financial performance of the SOEs. In reality, the party's most important objective in retaining control over the SOEs was not to increase their economic value but to use them as tools to maintain a patronage system to reward loyalists, to implement industrial policy for regime and national security purposes, and to allocate SOE investments to balance factional and regional competition for resources. The subordination of economic efficiency to the party's self-interests inevitably meant that efforts to build a "modern enterprise system" would unlikely succeed in turning the SOEs into truly efficient and competitive firms. Indeed, the cosmetic reforms implemented in the 1990s failed to address most of the long-standing SOE problems, such as soft-budget constraints, low profitability, bloated employment, and excess wages and benefits.29

因此，许多大型国有企业经历了表面上的改革，例如设立董事会、定期披露财务信息以及接受专业公司的审计。一些国有企业在国内和国际证券交易所上市，以吸引非国有少数股权投资，并利用外部压力和监督来提高国有企业的效率。然而，这些改革并未剥夺国家全部或部分所有权。最关键也最合乎逻辑的是，国有企业继续服务于党的利益，党通过管理层任命对这些企业保持着有效的控制。理论上，党的“现代企业制度”旨在最大限度地提高效率并改善国有企业的财务业绩。但实际上，党维持对国有企业控制的最重要目标并非提升其经济价值，而是将其作为工具，以维持裙带关系体系，奖励忠诚者，实施符合政权和国家安全的产业政策，并分配国有企业投资以平衡各派系和地区对资源的竞争。经济效率屈从于党的自身利益，这必然意味着，构建“现代企业制度”的努力不太可能成功地将国有企业转变为真正高效且具有竞争力的企业。事实上，20世纪90年代实施的表面改革未能解决国有企业长期存在的诸多问题，例如预算约束不明确、盈利能力低下、人员臃肿以及工资福利过高等。

In 2003 the party tried a different approach—it decided to imitate Singapore's model of managing state-owned assets. As in China, Singapore's largest firms are state-owned or state-controlled. But the city-state established an agency—Temasek—to which the state transferred its shares so it could function as a more independent and effective supervisor. China thus set up its own version of Temasek—the State Asset Supervision and Administration Commission (SASAC)—in 2003. Its mandate was to exercise the power of the owner of the asset and monitor SOE operations and financial performance. Initially it was responsible for overseeing about two hundred large "centrally owned SOEs," whose state-owned shares were transferred to SASAC. Provinces also formed their SASAC equivalents to oversee provincially owned enterprises. Theoretically, this new bureaucracy would assume sole responsibility for management and prevent other state bureaucracies from interfering. Unlike Temasek, however, SASAC had one fatal design flaw. In Singapore, the ruling People's Action Party does not appoint management of the country's SOEs, leaving the responsibility to Temasek. But in China, the CCP's Organization Department, not SASAC, is empowered to appoint or remove SOE management, thus significantly weakening the supervisory role of SASAC.30 Consequently, the setting up of SASAC produced no meaningful improvement in efficiency, as demonstrated by the persistent underperformance of SOEs relative to private firms in terms of profitability, generation of employment, and debt levels.31

2003年，中共尝试了一种不同的方法——效仿新加坡管理国有资产的模式。与中国一样，新加坡最大的企业也是国有或国有控股企业。但新加坡设立了淡马锡控股（Temasek），政府将其股份转让给该机构，使其能够发挥更独立、更有效的监管作用。因此，中国在2003年也成立了类似淡马锡的机构——国资委（SASAC）。国资委的职责是行使资产所有者的权力，监督国有企业的运营和财务绩效。最初，国资委负责监管约200家大型“中央所有制企业”，这些企业的国有股份已转让给国资委。各省也成立了与国资委类似的机构，负责监管省属企业。理论上，这个新的官僚机构将承担全部管理责任，防止其他国家官僚机构干预。然而，与淡马锡不同的是，国资委存在一个致命的设计缺陷。在新加坡，执政的人民行动党并不任命国有企业的管理层，而是将这项责任交给了淡马锡控股。但在中国，任命或罢免国有企业管理层的权力属于中共的组织部，而非国资委，这大大削弱了国资委的监管作用。因此，国资委的设立并未带来效率上的实质性提升，国有企业在盈利能力、创造就业和债务水平等方面持续落后于私营企业，便证明了这一点。

Ironically, the most successful measure implemented by the party to reform the SOEs was the one it wanted to talk about the least: privatization and mass bankruptcy of loss-making small and medium-sized enterprises. In the mid-1990s the overall strategy of reforming SOEs was to "grasp the large and release the small"—focusing on improving the large SOEs but letting the smaller SOEs sink or swim. "Grasping the large" achieved at best modest results, as illustrated by the outcomes of corporatization and the experience of SASAC. "Releasing the small" meant, literally, allowing small and medium-sized SOEs to be restructured or liquidated through whatever means that could take these zombie firms off the hands of the government. Initially, releasing the small proceeded slowly and cautiously, and it appeared to take the form of management buyouts (insider privatization), mergers, and leasing. This process created opportunities for SOE management and well-connected private entrepreneurs to obtain state assets at steep discounts.32

具有讽刺意味的是，党推行的国有企业改革中最成功的措施，恰恰是它最不愿提及的：对亏损的中小型企业进行私有化和大规模破产清算。上世纪90年代中期，国有企业改革的总体战略是“抓大放小”——重点改善大型国有企业，而对小型国有企业则任其自生自灭。“抓大放小”充其量只能取得有限的成效，公司化改革的后果以及国资委的经验便是最好的证明。“放小放小”的字面意思，就是允许通过任何能够将这些“僵尸企业”从政府手中剥离的手段，对中小国有企业进行重组或清算。最初，“放小放小”的进程缓慢而谨慎，其形式似乎主要是管理层收购（内部私有化）、合并和租赁。这一过程为国有企业管理层和人脉广泛的私营企业家提供了以极低价格获得国有资产的机会。

After the East Asian financial crisis of 1997, Chinese leaders endorsed a drastic solution: the mass bankruptcy of small and medium-sized SOEs that could no longer be sustained without endangering the undercapitalized banking system. Judging by official data, this was carried out in 1998 quickly and most probably with no prior planning. The number of industrial SOEs in 1997 was 110,000, representing a moderate decline of about 17,000 over 1996, and with the overall number of SOEs peaking at 127,600. This indicates that releasing the small began in 1997 but proceeded slowly. However, the shock of the East Asian financial crisis, which led to the collapse of currencies in Thailand, South Korea, and Indonesia and the fall of the long-ruling Suharto regime in Indonesia, forced Chinese leaders to take the unprecedented step of closing, in the industrial sector alone, nearly 55,000 SOEs and laying off 13 million workers in 1998. In 1999 they shuttered an additional 3,400 firms and laid off roughly 12 million workers.33

1997年东亚金融危机后，中国领导人批准了一项激进的解决方案：大规模破产清算那些无法在不危及资本不足的银行体系的情况下继续维持运营的中小国有企业。根据官方数据，这项举措于1998年迅速实施，很可能事先没有任何规划。1997年，工业国有企业数量为11万家，较1996年略微减少了约1.7万家，而国有企业总数峰值为12.76万家。这表明，释放中小企业的进程始于1997年，但进展缓慢。然而，东亚金融危机的冲击导致泰国、韩国和印尼货币崩溃，以及印尼长期执政的苏哈托政权垮台，迫使中国领导人采取了前所未有的举措：仅在工业领域，1998年就关闭了近5.5万家国有企业，裁员1300万人。1999年，他们又关闭了3400家企业，裁员约1200万人。

Economically, releasing the small definitely achieved its desired objective of ridding the state of massive liabilities. But this achievement came with enormous social costs, as tens of millions of workers in the bankrupt SOEs were cast out on their own, most with no social safety net. Many fell into poverty.34 Even though the government faced waves of demonstrations by the large number of laid-off workers, it managed to contain and ultimately suppress them through coercive means.35

从经济角度来看，释放小企业无疑实现了其预期目标，即摆脱国家巨额债务。但这一成就也带来了巨大的社会代价，数千万破产国有企业的员工被迫失业，其中大多数人没有任何社会保障。许多人陷入了贫困。尽管政府面临着大量下岗工人的多次示威游行，但它最终还是通过强制手段控制并镇压了这些示威活动。

The housing reform launched in the mid-1990s created a powerful new engine of growth. In July 1994 the State Council released a package of policies to privatize state-owned housing. Subsequently, state-owned housing units rented to employees in government-affiliated entities were privatized at heavily subsidized prices. Four years later the State Council issued a document promoting development of a private real estate market to address the housing shortages. In retrospect, the real estate boom during the subsequent two decades constituted a powerful engine of growth before it began to lose steam in the mid-2010s.36

20世纪90年代中期启动的住房改革催生了强劲的新增长引擎。1994年7月，国务院出台了一系列国有住房私有化政策。随后，政府机构员工租住的国有住房以高额补贴价格私有化。四年后，国务院发布文件，推动发展私人房地产市场以解决住房短缺问题。回顾过去，随后二十年的房地产繁荣成为强劲的增长引擎，直到2010年代中期才开始放缓。

On balance, the reforms of the 1990s achieved mixed results. On the positive side, they strengthened the fiscal system significantly and made the financial system moderately more market-oriented. Policies to privatize housing and promote the real estate market unleashed a powerful source of growth. But the efforts to reform the SOEs were largely unsuccessful. The strategy of "grasping the large and releasing the small" preserved state control over big firms in strategic sectors, such as telecommunications, energy, transportation, and finance, but did not improve their efficiency. The mass bankruptcy of small and medium-sized SOEs did succeed in shutting down the loss-making firms that the state could no longer support, thus producing an improvement in efficiency, but this was carried out in a hasty and chaotic manner that impoverished tens of millions of workers.

总体而言，20世纪90年代的改革成效不一。积极的一面是，这些改革显著加强了财政体系，并使金融体系在一定程度上更加市场化。住房私有化和房地产市场促进政策释放了强劲的增长动力。但国有企业改革的努力大多以失败告终。“抓大放小”的战略虽然维持了国家对电信、能源、交通和金融等战略性行业大型企业的控制，但并未提高它们的效率。大规模中小国有企业破产确实关闭了国家无力继续扶持的亏损企业，从而提高了效率，但这一过程仓促混乱，导致数千万工人陷入贫困。





Ascendance of the Private Sector





私营部门的崛起


If the party's efforts to reform the SOEs in the post-Tiananmen era ended mostly in failure, an unintended consequence of this setback was the rapid rise of the private sector, which consisted of private domestic and foreign-invested firms. As described earlier, the government's inability to turn around the inefficient SOEs with half measures finally forced it to embrace mass bankruptcy of the small and medium SOEs in 1998-1999. This solution, adopted out of desperation to avoid wrecking China's banking system, caused massive losses of jobs and income for those workers employed in these firms. However, the exit of tens of thousands of SOEs also created opportunities for the private sector. The fire sale of the assets of the bankrupt SOEs allowed their managers to obtain them cheaply and to set up their own businesses, often in controversial if not illicit collaboration with private entrepreneurs.

如果说中共在后天安门时代对国有企业的改革努力大多以失败告终，那么这一挫折带来的一个意想不到的后果便是私营经济的迅速崛起，其中包括国内私营企业和外商投资企业。正如前文所述，政府无法通过半吊子的措施扭转低效国有企业的颓势，最终迫使其在1998-1999年间对中小国有企业实施大规模破产。这一出于避免摧毁中国银行体系的无奈之举，导致这些企业员工大量失业，收入锐减。然而，数万家国有企业的退出也为私营经济创造了机遇。破产国有企业的资产被贱卖，使得其管理者得以低价购得这些资产，并创办自己的企业，而这种创办往往伴随着争议，甚至可能涉及非法行为，例如与私营企业家进行合作。

Ironically, the lack of a comprehensive program of privatization conceived and approved by the central government enabled local authorities and SOE management to adopt flexible, innovative, and often questionable methods of transferring the assets of the struggling or bankrupt SOEs to private entities.37 Because most of these transactions were conducted opaquely and the purchasers of the SOE assets were managers and well-connected private entrepreneurs, conservatives and the so-called new left—scholars opposing neoliberal reforms because they were exploitative—vociferously denounced the deals as an "erosion and loss of state assets," insisting that assets sold to management and private entrepreneurs were deliberately and significantly underpriced at the expense of the Chinese people, who nominally owned these assets.38 Academic research, indeed, provides evidence that these assets were sold cheaply during privatization. Large-scale, officially sanctioned national surveys of private firms conducted in the early 2000s reveal that, on average, the assets of the SOEs were underpriced by about 20 percent. Managers who bought these assets enjoyed a discount of 30 percent.39

具有讽刺意味的是，由于缺乏中央政府构思和批准的全面私有化方案，地方政府和国有企业管理层得以采取灵活、创新且往往颇具争议的方式，将陷入困境或破产的国有企业的资产转移给私人实体。由于这些交易大多不透明，且国有企业资产的购买者是管理层和人脉广泛的私营企业家，保守派和所谓的“新左派”（反对新自由主义改革，认为其具有剥削性的学者）强烈谴责这些交易是“国有资产的侵蚀和损失”，坚称出售给管理层和私营企业家的资产被故意大幅压低价格，损害了名义上拥有这些资产的中国人民的利益。学术研究确实提供了证据，证明这些资产在私有化过程中被低价出售。 2000年代初期，官方授权开展的大规模全国性私营企业调查显示，国有企业的资产平均被低估了约20%。收购这些资产的管理者则享受了30%的折扣。

However, critics decrying privatization as a process in which state-owned assets were sold too cheaply apparently ignored two crucial factors. First, those willing to buy the assets of the underperforming or nearly bankrupt SOEs took enormous risks and understandably demanded deep discounts. Second, China had no functioning institutions that could price such assets correctly. It was impossible to determine the appropriate price at which such assets should be sold.

然而，批评者们指责私有化过程中国有资产被低价出售，显然忽略了两个关键因素。首先，那些愿意收购业绩不佳或濒临破产的国有企业资产的人承担了巨大的风险，因此他们要求大幅折扣也是情理之中的。其次，中国当时没有有效的机构能够对这些资产进行合理定价。因此，根本无法确定这些资产的合理售价。

In any case, the mass bankruptcy of tens of thousands of SOEs and the quick disposal of their discounted assets most likely boosted economic performance during the Hu era. With one stroke, privatization achieved three objectives: ending the waste of precious resources on zombie firms, saving the banking system, and transferring underperforming assets to private firms that could deploy them more productively. One study shows that, after privatization, private firms utilizing the same assets that were previously owned by collective firms could increase their output on average by 5-7 percent. Since private firms were more efficient than collective firms, it is reasonable to assume that the assets of SOEs in the hands of private firms would be utilized even more productively.40

无论如何，胡锦涛时代数万家国有企业的大规模破产以及其折价资产的快速处置很可能促进了经济发展。私有化一举实现了三个目标：停止将宝贵资源浪费在僵尸企业上，拯救银行体系，并将低效资产转移给能够更高效利用这些资产的私营企业。一项研究表明，私有化后，私营企业利用原国有企业拥有的相同资产，平均产出可提高5%至7%。由于私营企业的效率高于国有企业，因此可以合理推断，国有企业的资产在私营企业手中将得到更高效的利用。

Parallel to the privatization of small and medium SOEs was the conversion of TVEs into private firms. Since a large number of these were private firms that had disguised themselves as TVEs when they were first established in the 1980s, part of this process was not privatization but normalization. The real owners—rural entrepreneurs who had established them—simply gained formal legal title to their property. Another part of the process involved the privatization of collectively owned assets. The transformation of TVEs into private firms began in southern Jiangsu in 1994 and quickly spread to other parts of the country. Nearly all TVEs had been converted to private firms by the end of the Jiang era.41 This is evidenced by the rapid decline of employment in "collectively owned" firms (in all sectors) and the corresponding rise of employment in private firms from the mid-1990s to 2002 (table 5.3).

与中小国有企业私有化并行的是乡镇企业向私营企业的转型。由于其中许多私营企业在20世纪80年代初创时就伪装成乡镇企业，因此这一过程的一部分并非私有化，而是规范化。真正的所有者——创办这些企业的农村企业家——只是获得了对其财产的正式法律所有权。该过程的另一部分涉及集体所有制资产的私有化。乡镇企业向私营企业的转型始于1994年江苏南部，并迅速蔓延至全国其他地区。到江泽民时代末期，几乎所有乡镇企业都已转型为私营企业。41 这可以从20世纪90年代中期至2002年期间“集体所有制”企业（所有行业）就业人数的迅速下降以及私营企业就业人数的相应增长得到证实（表5.3）。

The positive impact of the privatization of TVEs was the emergence of some of China's largest and most successful private corporations, such as Fuyao Glass (which later became one of the world's leading makers of automobile glass, as featured in the Oscar-winning documentary, American Factory), Wanxiang Group (maker of auto parts), and Hope Group (agrobusiness).

乡镇企业私有化的积极影响是催生了一些中国规模最大、最成功的私营企业，例如福耀玻璃（后来成为世界领先的汽车玻璃制造商之一，并在奥斯卡获奖纪录片《美国工厂》中有所介绍）、万向集团（汽车零部件制造商）和希望集团（农业综合企业）。
