Privatization in the 1990s enabled the private sector to eclipse the state sector as the most important engine of economic growth and job creation during the post-Tiananmen period. In terms of employment, the state sector employed 103.5 million people in 1990, compared to only 1.7 million in private firms. By 2012, employment in the state sector had declined to 68.4 million, while that in private firms had increased to 113 million (table 5.4). The decline in the number of SOEs in industrial sectors was most pronounced. For example, SOEs in the manufacturing sector employed 34.4 million people in 1993. By 2002, their employment had fallen to 9.8 million, a decrease of more than two-thirds. SOEs in mining and construction saw their employment fall by more than half during the same period.42 The output of SOEs plummeted correspondingly. In 1993 SOEs accounted for 43 percent of China's total industrial output. By 2011, their share had fallen to 26 percent.43

20世纪90年代的私有化使私营部门在后天安门时代超越国有部门，成为经济增长和创造就业的最重要引擎。就就业而言，1990年国有部门的就业人数为1.035亿，而私营企业仅为170万人。到2012年，国有部门的就业人数下降至6840万人，而私营企业的就业人数则增至1.13亿人（表5.4）。工业部门国有企业数量的下降最为显著。例如，1993年制造业国有企业的就业人数为3440万人。到2002年，其就业人数下降至980万人，减少了三分之二以上。同期，采矿和建筑业国有企业的就业人数也减少了一半以上。国有企业的产出也相应大幅下降。 1993年，国有企业占中国工业总产值的43%。到2011年，这一比例下降到26%。

Fast-growing domestic private firms became a powerful force in China's industrial sector. In 1993 the share of industrial output by domestic nonstate firms reached 47 percent. By 2011, private firms contributed 46.6 percent of industrial output, and foreign-invested firms accounted for 25.8 percent (about the same as the SOEs), while the share of collectively owned firms fell to 1.3 percent.44 Even though the party did not actively promote the private sector, it deserves credit for taking the crucial political steps to give it legitimacy and protection. In March 1999 the party-controlled National People's Congress passed a constitutional amendment that formally recognized the legal status of nonstate economic entities. Jiang's theory of the "Three Represents," first unveiled in early 2000 and written into the party's charter in 2002, elevated the political status of private entrepreneurs by identifying them as a group the party should represent and recruit.

快速发展的国内民营企业成为中国工业领域的一股强大力量。1993年，国内非国有企业占工业总产值的47%。到2011年，民营企业占工业总产值的46.6%，外商投资企业占25.8%（与国有企业大致持平），而集体所有制企业的份额下降到1.3%。尽管党并未积极推动民营经济的发展，但它采取了关键的政治措施，赋予民营经济合法性和保护作用，这一点值得肯定。1999年3月，党控制的全国人民代表大会通过了宪法修正案，正式承认非国有经济实体的法律地位。江泽民提出的“三个代表”理论于2000年初首次提出，并于2002年写入党章，该理论将民营企业家明确为党应该代表和招募的群体，从而提升了民营企业家的政治地位。





Globalization





全球化


China's opening in the post-Tiananmen era was more aggressive and far-reaching than its domestic reforms. Policies to attract FDI and increase exports in the post-Cold War era were necessary for China to build commercial ties with the triumphant West and to avoid geopolitical isolation. At the same time, the globalization championed by the United States and its allies after the end of the Cold War provided China with an unprecedented opportunity to utilize its comparative advantage of cheap labor to compete for a larger share in the global marketplace. Zhao Ziyang should receive credit for the strategy of closely integrating China into the world economy in the late 1980s when he proposed prioritizing development of the coastal areas as platforms to connect with the global economy. Although Zhao was purged during the Tiananmen crisis, his economic strategy not only survived him but also yielded spectacular outcomes few Chinese leaders could have imagined in the 1980s.

后天安门时代，中国的对外开放比其国内改革更为积极和深远。冷战后，吸引外商直接投资、增加出口的政策对于中国与西方建立经贸联系、避免地缘政治孤立至关重要。与此同时，冷战结束后，美国及其盟友倡导的全球化为中国提供了一个前所未有的机遇，使其能够利用自身廉价劳动力的比较优势，在全球市场中争取更大的份额。赵紫阳在20世纪80年代末提出的将中国紧密融入世界经济的战略功不可没，他主张优先发展沿海地区，将其作为连接全球经济的平台。尽管赵紫阳在天安门事件中遭到清洗，但他的经济战略不仅在他去世后得以延续，而且取得了在20世纪80年代鲜有中国领导人能够想象的辉煌成就。

One measurement of China's embrace of globalization in the post-Tiananmen era is its success in attracting FDI. Between 1979 and 1989, foreign firms invested about $16 billion in China. But starting in 1992, foreign investors dramatically increased their bets on China. In 1992 alone, they invested $11 billion in China.45 In the subsequent two decades, the amount of FDI would reach a staggering $1.24 trillion (table 5.4).

衡量中国在后天安门时代融入全球化程度的一个指标是其吸引外商直接投资的成功程度。1979年至1989年间，外国企业在中国的投资额约为160亿美元。但自1992年起，外国投资者对华投资大幅增加。仅1992年一年，他们在华投资额就达到了110亿美元。在随后的二十年里，外商直接投资额更是达到了惊人的1.24万亿美元（见表5.4）。

Several factors turned China into a favored destination for direct investments by foreign companies. In the early 1990s the government opened up more cities, including the major cities along the Yangtze River (such as Chongqing and Wuhan) and all inland provincial capitals, to foreign investors and allowed them to offer the same preferential terms as were initially made available only to foreign investors in the SEZs. To compete for foreign capital, local governments built large industrial parks and provided subsidies, such as cheap land and tax holidays. The most important city to become a giant SEZ in the early 1990s was Shanghai's Pudong area. With Deng's constant prodding, the government approved the city's proposal to open up Pudong to foreign investors in the 1990s. Within a few years, the area was transformed into a high-tech manufacturing hub built mainly with foreign direct investment.46 Furthermore, the process to approve FDI projects was simplified and decentralized. In Guangdong, for example, the government allowed cities to approve projects under $30 million and counties to approve projects under $15 million.47 Liberalized rules were adopted so that FDI projects not on the "restricted" or "prohibited" lists were all allowed.48 Further liberalization measures implemented in the early 1990s included amendments to the laws on joint ventures and wholly foreign-owned enterprises and passage of new laws and regulations on income tax, intellectual property, and foreign exchange that made it easier for foreign investors to conduct business.49 As a result, foreign firms were permitted to form retail joint ventures in several major cities and to become involved in natural resource exploration. They could also invest in power generation and infrastructure using the build-operate-transfer model. American International Group (AIG) was given a coveted license to sell some insurance products in Shanghai, and foreign banks could conduct local currency transactions.50

多种因素促使中国成为外国企业直接投资的热门目的地。20世纪90年代初，政府向外国投资者开放了更多城市，包括长江沿岸主要城市（如重庆和武汉）以及所有内陆省会城市，并允许他们提供与最初仅对经济特区外国投资者相同的优惠条件。为了吸引外资，地方政府建设了大型工业园区，并提供诸如廉价土地和税收优惠等补贴。20世纪90年代初，上海浦东新区成为最重要的经济特区。在邓小平的不断推动下，政府在20世纪90年代批准了上海提出的浦东对外开放的提案。短短几年内，浦东就转型成为一个主要依靠外商直接投资建设的高科技制造业中心。此外，外商直接投资项目的审批流程也得到了简化和分散。例如，在广东省，政府允许市级政府批准3000万美元以下的项目，县级政府批准1500万美元以下的项目。47 放宽了相关规定，使得不在“限制”或“禁止”名单上的外商直接投资项目全部获准进行。48 20世纪90年代初，进一步的自由化措施包括修订合资企业和外商独资企业相关法律，以及颁布新的所得税、知识产权和外汇相关法律法规，这些措施使外国投资者更容易开展业务。49 因此，外国公司获准在几个主要城市成立零售合资企业，并参与自然资源勘探。他们还可以采用建设-运营-移交模式投资发电和基础设施建设。美国国际集团（AIG）获得了在上海销售部分保险产品的宝贵许可证，外国银行也可以进行本币交易。50

Although the government's policies definitely helped make China an attractive destination for FDI, other factors were in its favor as well. Perhaps the most important was timing. The revival of the country's reform and opening after the Tiananmen crackdown occurred just after the end of the Cold War and the beginning of the high tide of globalization. In East Asia, Japan and the four little dragons—Hong Kong, Taiwan, Korea, and Singapore—began to lose their competitiveness in labor-intensive manufacturing, forcing their companies to relocate elsewhere. Because of its vast pool of cheap labor and its geographical proximity, China was an ideal destination. In 1992 the average hourly wage of a Chinese manufacturing worker was a mere 1.27 yuan, or $0.16 at the unofficial exchange rate of 8 yuan to one dollar.51 By one estimate, the wage of Chinese manufacturing workers in the early 1990s was the lowest in Asia.52

尽管政府的政策无疑有助于中国成为外商直接投资的理想目的地，但其他因素也对其有利。其中最重要的或许是时机。天安门事件后，中国重启改革开放，恰逢冷战结束和全球化浪潮兴起之际。在东亚，日本和“四小龙”（香港、台湾、韩国和新加坡）在劳动密集型制造业的竞争力开始下降，迫使其企业迁往他处。由于拥有庞大的廉价劳动力和地理位置优势，中国成为理想的投资目的地。1992年，中国制造业工人的平均时薪仅为1.27元人民币，按当时8元兑1美元的非官方汇率计算，约合0.16美元。据估计，20世纪90年代初中国制造业工人的工资是亚洲最低的。

China enjoyed an additional unique advantage: its huge diaspora in the region. Successful ethnic Chinese entrepreneurs in Hong Kong and Taiwan, in particular, were eager to utilize their cultural and social connections to the mainland as a competitive edge in identifying investment opportunities.53 Official data for 1997-2006, for example, show that investors from Hong Kong alone accounted for about 35 percent of total FDI utilized during this period, with Taiwan contributing about 6 percent.54 The amount of FDI flowing from Hong Kong was likely inflated due to the practice of “round-tripping”—mainland Chinese firms would first transfer their capital to the former British colony and then use the same capital to invest in the mainland as FDI so they could enjoy greater legal protections and take advantage of the preferential treatment Beijing had granted to foreign investors.55

中国还拥有一项独特的优势：其在该地区拥有庞大的华人社群。尤其是在香港和台湾，成功的华裔企业家们渴望利用他们与大陆的文化和社会联系，在寻找投资机会时获得竞争优势。例如，1997年至2006年的官方数据显示，仅香港投资者就占同期外商直接投资总额的约35%，台湾投资者则占约6%。由于“循环投资”的做法，香港的外商直接投资额可能被夸大了——中国大陆企业会先将资金转移到这个前英国殖民地，然后用同样的资金以外商直接投资的形式投资大陆，从而享受更完善的法律保护，并利用北京给予外国投资者的优惠待遇。

China also had a geopolitical turn of good fortune in the early 1990s. The United States and its allies decided to continue their policy of engagement and integration with China despite the Tiananmen crackdown and the end of the Cold War, which overnight had reduced China's strategic value to the West. President Bill Clinton's 1994 decision to stop linking China's most-favored nation (MFN) trading status to its human rights record lifted a dark shadow over Sino-American commercial ties.

20世纪90年代初，中国也迎来了地缘政治上的转机。尽管天安门事件和冷战的结束一夜之间削弱了中国对西方的战略价值，美国及其盟友仍决定继续推行与中国的接触和一体化政策。1994年，比尔·克林顿总统决定停止将中国的最惠国待遇与人权记录挂钩，这为中美商业关系扫清了一道阴霾。

Additionally, the party's renewed commitment to reform and opening after Deng's southern tour in 1992 and the explosive growth momentum unleashed thereafter significantly brightened China's economic future, making the country not only a cost-competitive and business-friendly export platform but also a fast-growing market for Western goods and services. The fierce competitive dynamics that pitted Western firms against one another in outsourcing their production to low-cost manufacturers benefited China immensely, since companies reluctant to invest in China would likely be outcompeted by their rivals that could take advantage of China's lower labor costs and large market. In the 1990s domestic Chinese firms were not strong enough to compete against foreign firms. With government policies giving foreign firms many advantages denied to domestic firms, foreign investors could count on capturing a significant share of the Chinese market.56

此外，1992年邓小平南巡后，党重申改革开放的决心，此后经济爆发式增长，极大地提振了中国的经济前景，使中国不仅成为具有成本竞争力和营商环境友好的出口平台，也成为西方商品和服务快速增长的市场。西方企业竞相将生产外包给低成本制造商，由此产生的激烈竞争使中国受益匪浅，因为不愿投资中国的企业很可能被那些能够利用中国较低劳动力成本和庞大市场的竞争对手挤出局。20世纪90年代，中国本土企业实力不足以与外国企业竞争。由于政府政策给予外国企业诸多国内企业无法享有的优势，外国投资者得以占据中国市场相当大的份额。

Massive inflows of FDI brought China bountiful benefits. In 1993 foreign-invested firms employed 2.87 million people. By 2012, more than 22 million Chinese were working in these companies.57 In addition to the employment, capital, and technology that came with FDI, such investments generated significant spillover effects and improved the efficiency of Chinese firms. Foreign-invested firms allowed to sell goods inside of China increased competition in the marketplace, forcing domestic firms to improve their productivity and services. FDI firms also added to China's human capital by training a large pool of skilled labor and management. Once they reached a critical mass, such firms helped create local supply chains and form clusters of specialized industrial ecosystems, such as electronics in Shenzhen and Kunshan (near Shanghai).

大量外商直接投资（FDI）为中国带来了丰厚的收益。1993年，外商投资企业雇佣了287万人。到2012年，超过2200万中国人受雇于这些企业。除了外商直接投资带来的就业、资本和技术之外，此类投资还产生了显著的溢出效应，并提高了中国企业的效率。获准在中国境内销售商品的外商投资企业加剧了市场竞争，迫使国内企业提高生产力和服务水平。外商直接投资企业还通过培养大量技术工人和管理人员，丰富了中国的人力资本。一旦达到一定规模，这些企业便有助于建立本地供应链，并形成专业化的产业生态系统集群，例如深圳和昆山（上海附近）的电子产业集群。

The transfer of tangible and intangible know-how to domestic Chinese firms via the FDI process was invaluable, albeit difficult to calculate.58

通过外商直接投资向中国国内企业转移有形和无形技术诀窍的价值是无法估量的。

The most significant impact of FDI in the post-Tiananmen era was on China's foreign trade. As part of the global trend of outsourcing manufacturing to countries with low labor costs, the majority of foreign firms used China as a processing center that assembled imported components to make products for export. Called "processing trade," this model served the interests of foreign investors well because they could utilize China's ultra-cheap labor and thus reduce costs. For China, FDI made the country a global foreign trade juggernaut. In 1992 foreign-invested firms accounted for 26 percent of China's total foreign trade in goods and 20 percent of its exports. By 2012, the share of foreign-invested firms in China's total foreign merchandise trade rose to 50 percent.59 The rapid increase of foreign-invested firms in imports and exports reflects the role of "processing trade." Indeed, the share of processing trade rose steadily during the post-Tiananmen era, hovering between 50 and 57 percent of total exports from 1996 to 2006. FDI-funded firms accounted for 75–85 percent of China's processing trade between 2002 and 2008. Processing trade began to decline slightly toward the end of the Hu era. In 2012, 47 percent of China's merchandise trade was processing trade.60

天安门事件后，外商直接投资对中国对外贸易的影响最为显著。随着全球制造业外包至劳动力成本低廉国家的趋势，大多数外资企业将中国作为加工中心，组装进口零部件，生产出口产品。这种被称为“加工贸易”的模式，由于外资可以利用中国超低廉的劳动力成本，从而降低成本，因此非常有利于外资的利益。对中国而言，外商直接投资使其成为全球对外贸易巨头。1992年，外商投资企业占中国货物贸易总额的26%，占出口总额的20%。到2012年，外商投资企业在中国货物贸易总额中的占比上升至50%。外商投资企业在进出口领域的快速增长，体现了“加工贸易”的作用。事实上，在后天安门时代，加工贸易的份额稳步上升，1996年至2006年间，加工贸易占出口总额的比例徘徊在50%至57%之间。2002年至2008年间，外商直接投资企业占中国加工贸易的75%至85%。胡锦涛时代末期，加工贸易开始略有下降。2012年，加工贸易占中国商品贸易总额的47%。





Foreign Trade and the WTO





对外贸易与世贸组织


The explosive growth of foreign trade in the post-Tiananmen era was one of the most important factors behind the Chinese economic miracle. Although China began to liberalize its foreign trade in the 1980s, the pace was greatly accelerated in the 1990s, resulting in sustained growth in that trade. The volume of merchandise trade grew more than tenfold from 1993 to 2012 due to a combination of government-initiated reforms, luck, and specific policies (table 5.5). The State Council radically liberalized foreign trade with a set of new policies in 1994, including a series of tariff reductions that brought down the average import tariffs from well over 50 percent in the early 1980s to 17 percent in 1998.61 The tariffs would be cut even further after China's entry into the WTO in 2001.62 The government also ended subsidies to exporters to create a more level playing field, lowered entry barriers to foreign trade, and made the renminbi freely convertible for the purpose of foreign trade. The government passed a new Foreign Trade Law in 1994, authorizing any company to engage in such trade if it registered with the government and could find an agent to serve as intermediary. This measure significantly increased competition in foreign trade because previously only firms approved by the government could engage in that trade. As a result of this reform, nonstate (mainly private) domestic firms gained a growing share of foreign trade. In 1992 they accounted for only 1 percent of total foreign trade (SOEs accounted for 72.5 percent). By 2000, their share had risen to 4.7 percent (compared with a SOE share of 45 percent).63 At the end of the Hu era, domestic private firms accounted for 31.6 percent of China's foreign trade, second only to the share of foreign-invested firms at 49 percent (the share of SOEs had fallen to 19.4 percent).64 In 2019 domestic private firms overtook foreign-invested firms as the largest contributor to foreign trade.65

天安门事件后对外贸易的爆炸式增长是中国经济奇迹背后最重要的因素之一。尽管中国早在20世纪80年代就开始推行对外贸易自由化，但90年代步伐显著加快，从而实现了贸易的持续增长。1993年至2012年间，商品贸易额增长超过十倍，这得益于政府主导的改革、机遇和特定政策的共同作用（表5.5）。 1994年，国务院出台一系列新政策，大幅推进对外贸易自由化，其中包括一系列关税减让措施，将平均进口关税从20世纪80年代初的50%以上降至1998年的17%。2001年中国加入世贸组织后，关税进一步下调。政府还取消了对出口商的补贴，以创造更加公平的竞争环境，降低了对外贸易的准入门槛，并允许人民币自由兑换用于对外贸易。1994年，政府颁布了新的《对外贸易法》，授权任何公司只要在政府注册并找到代理人作为中间人，即可从事对外贸易。这项措施显著加剧了对外贸易的竞争，因为此前只有获得政府批准的企业才能从事此类贸易。改革后，非国有（主要是私营）国内企业在对外贸易中占据了越来越大的份额。 1992年，民营企业仅占对外贸易总额的1%（国有企业占72.5%）。到2000年，民营企业的份额上升至4.7%（相比之下，国有企业的份额为45%）。胡锦涛时代末期，民营企业占中国对外贸易总额的31.6%，仅次于外商投资企业（49%）（国有企业的份额下降至19.4%）。2019年，民营企业超过外商投资企业，成为对外贸易的最大贡献者。

To promote exports, China sweetened the incentives for exporters. The new foreign exchange policy that became effective in January 1994 allowed exporters to buy and sell foreign currency freely through the banking system. Exporters could also get a rebate from the VAT on their goods, a common international practice, to be more competitive. The Export-Import Bank of China was established in 1994 to finance foreign trade. Although both increasing competition and making exports more attractive were useful, the single most effective export-promotion policy was undoubtedly the one-time major devaluation of Chinese currency in January 1994 that not only unified exchange rates but also made Chinese exports much less expensive. In 1993 the official exchange rate of the renminbi was 5.77 yuan to the dollar. In 1994, the rate was 8.7 yuan to the dollar, representing a devaluation of over 50 percent.66

为了促进出口，中国加大了对出口商的激励力度。1994年1月生效的新外汇政策允许出口商通过银行系统自由买卖外汇。此外，出口商还可以获得商品增值税退税，这是国际惯例，旨在提高竞争力。中国进出口银行于1994年成立，负责为对外贸易提供融资。尽管增强竞争和提高出口吸引力都发挥了作用，但最有效的出口促进政策无疑是1994年1月人民币的一次性大幅贬值。此次贬值不仅统一了汇率，还大幅降低了中国出口商品的价格。1993年人民币官方汇率为5.77元兑1美元。1994年，人民币兑1美元汇率为8.7元兑1美元，贬值幅度超过50%。

Taken together, these factors vaulted China to the front row of global trading nations. In 1993 China (including Hong Kong) was the world's fourth largest trading nation, with 6.1 percent of world trade. By 2012, China and Hong Kong accounted for 14 percent of global trade and claimed the number one spot.67

综合这些因素，中国一跃成为全球贸易强国。1993年，中国（包括香港）是世界第四大贸易国，占世界贸易总额的6.1%。到2012年，中国和香港的贸易额占全球贸易总额的14%，跃居榜首。

China's formal entry into the WTO in December 2001 was the most important event after Deng's southern tour in 1992 that altered the country's economic trajectory. China applied to join the General Agreement on Tariffs and Trade (GATT), the predecessor of the WTO, in 1987. But the country's non-market economy, protectionist trading practices, and enormous potential to disrupt global trade due to its size made it difficult for the United States and Europe to support the application. China's bid languished until the late 1990s, when Jiang Zemin and Zhu Rongji put their support behind a renewed drive to gain accession, most likely to use WTO entry to spur a new round of economic reform at home and to seek further integration with the global economy. Although Zhu personally led the critical negotiations toward the end of the process in 2000, Jiang's political support was crucial because China's trade partners were demanding many concessions as conditions for Chinese entry. The most important concession was that China had to forgo the preferential terms accorded to developing country members of the WTO. To assuage fears of a flood of Chinese exports, China also accepted the "safeguards" demanded by its key partners, such as the United States and the European Union, allowing them to take unilateral measures against Chinese exports to protect their industries.

2001年12月中国正式加入世贸组织，是继1992年邓小平南巡之后，改变中国经济发展轨迹的最重要事件。早在1987年，中国就申请加入世贸组织的前身——关税及贸易总协定（GATT）。但由于中国经济体制并非市场经济，贸易保护主义倾向严重，且其庞大的体量可能对全球贸易造成巨大冲击，因此美国和欧洲难以支持中国的申请。中国的入世进程一度停滞不前，直到20世纪90年代末，江泽民和朱镕基才重新推动入世进程。他们很可能希望借助加入世贸组织，在国内推动新一轮经济改革，并进一步融入全球经济。尽管朱镕基亲自领导了2000年入世进程最后阶段的关键谈判，但江泽民的政治支持至关重要，因为中国的贸易伙伴要求中国做出诸多让步才能加入世贸组织。最重要的让步是，中国必须放弃世贸组织给予发展中国家成员的优惠待遇。为了消除人们对中国出口产品泛滥的担忧，中国还接受了其主要伙伴（如美国和欧盟）提出的“保障措施”要求，允许它们采取单边措施限制中国出口，以保护本国产业。

The timing of China's renewed bid was propitious because President Clinton, a strong US proponent of engagement with China, saw China's accession to the WTO as a strategic opportunity to bind China closer to the West-led economic order and to advance America's own economic interests. Sensing the enormous potential of a more liberalized China market after WTO entry, corporate America furiously lobbied a skeptical Congress, which reluctantly passed a bill in late 2000 granting China permanent normal trading status to pave the way for its WTO accession.68

中国重新申请加入世贸组织的时机恰到好处，因为克林顿总统作为美国对华接触的坚定支持者，将中国加入世贸组织视为一个战略机遇，既能使中国更紧密地融入西方主导的经济秩序，又能推进美国自身的经济利益。美国企业界意识到中国加入世贸组织后市场更加自由化的巨大潜力，于是积极游说持怀疑态度的国会。最终，国会在2000年底勉强通过了一项法案，赋予中国永久正常贸易地位，为中国加入世贸组织铺平了道路。

China's entry into the WTO has remained a hotly debated issue. Geopolitically, after US-China relations turned completely adversarial toward the end of the first administration of Donald Trump, some argued that US economic engagement with China in the post-Cold War era, including support for its entry into the WTO, had been an epic strategic blunder.69 In 2023 several hard-line senators introduced legislation to strip China of its permanent normal trading status. Whether China has lived up to its commitments remains similarly controversial.70 What is not controversial is that China's WTO entry radically reshaped the landscape of global trade and supercharged its domestic economic development until the momentum dissipated toward the end of the post-Tiananmen era.

中国加入世贸组织一直是一个备受争议的话题。从地缘政治角度来看，在唐纳德·特朗普第一任期末期美中关系彻底恶化之后，一些人认为，美国在后冷战时代与中国的经济接触，包括支持中国加入世贸组织，是一个极其严重的战略失误。2023年，几位强硬派参议员提出立法，试图取消中国的永久正常贸易地位。中国是否履行了其承诺也同样存在争议。但毋庸置疑的是，中国加入世贸组织极大地重塑了全球贸易格局，并极大地促进了其国内经济发展，直到天安门事件后这种发展势头逐渐消退。

The impact of WTO accession on FDI and foreign trade was instant and dramatic as foreign investors rushed to China to take advantage of its commitments to open its domestic market for services and to build manufacturing facilities for exports. In the five years (2002-2006) immediately following WTO entry, inbound FDI grew at an annualized rate of 36 percent, averaging $59 billion a year. Even more FDI flowed into China thereafter. During 2007-2011, foreign investors poured $478 billion into China. Altogether, FDI totaled $775 billion in the first decade following China's WTO accession.71

加入世贸组织对外国直接投资和对外贸易的影响立竿见影且十分显著，外国投资者蜂拥而至，希望利用中国开放国内服务市场和建设出口制造设施的承诺。在加入世贸组织后的五年（2002-2006年）内，流入中国的外国直接投资年均增长率高达36%，平均每年达到590亿美元。此后，流入中国的外国直接投资更是大幅增长。2007年至2011年间，外国投资者向中国投入了4780亿美元。加入世贸组织后的第一个十年，外国直接投资总额达到7750亿美元。

The inflow of FDI and China's greater access to global markets granted under WTO rules precipitated explosive growth in foreign trade and, within a decade, made China (excluding Hong Kong) the world's second largest trading nation after the United States. In 2001, on the eve of China's WTO entry, its total foreign merchandise trade was $509.6 billion (exporting $266 billion in goods). A decade later, China's total merchandise trade had skyrocketed to $3.64 trillion. Its exports reached $1.9 trillion, surpassing Germany as the world's largest exporter by volume (but not by value-added).72

外国直接投资的流入以及中国根据世贸组织规则获得更广泛的全球市场准入，促使对外贸易呈爆炸式增长，并在短短十年内，使中国（不包括香港）成为仅次于美国的世界第二大贸易国。2001年，在中国加入世贸组织前夕，其商品贸易总额为5096亿美元（其中商品出口额为2660亿美元）。十年后，中国的商品贸易总额飙升至3.64万亿美元。其出口额达到1.9万亿美元，按出口量计算超过德国，成为世界最大的出口国（但按增加值计算并非如此）。

The most beneficial impact of China's WTO entry has been to make its economy more efficient and able to grow faster through three channels: an increase in foreign trade due to liberalization, a dramatic rise in FDI, and efficiency gains produced by implementation of the reforms China pledged to undertake and by the rising competition from greater access to the Chinese market by foreign manufacturers and service companies (such as retail).73 Areas more exposed to WTO entry experienced greater productivity growth due to accelerated development of the modern sector (manufacturing and services) and a more rapid shrinking of the agricultural sector.74 The magnitude of the boost in growth delivered by WTO accession is substantial but difficult to measure precisely. One study comparing China's growth performance from 2002 to 2007 with that of a group of developed and developing countries finds that accession increased China's real growth rate by 2.5 percentage points each year, implying that without WTO accession, China's average growth rate during this period would have been 8 percent, instead of 10.5 percent.75

中国加入世贸组织最积极的影响体现在三个方面：一是自由化带来的对外贸易增长；二是外国直接投资的显著增加；三是落实中国承诺的改革措施所带来的效率提升，以及外国制造商和服务企业（如零售业）更容易进入中国市场所带来的日益激烈的竞争。73 受世贸组织影响较大的地区，由于现代产业（制造业和服务业）的加速发展和农业部门的快速萎缩，生产率增长更为显著。74 加入世贸组织带来的经济增长提升幅度巨大，但难以精确衡量。一项研究对比了2002年至2007年中国与一组发达国家和发展中国家的经济增长情况，发现加入世贸组织使中国的实际增长率每年提高了2.5个百分点，这意味着如果没有加入世贸组织，中国在此期间的平均增长率将为8%，而不是10.5%。

However beneficial, WTO accession was a one-off event, and the momentum it generated gradually petered out. Instead of taking advantage of the favorable economic environment after WTO accession to implement more market-oriented reforms, the government continued to protect SOEs, maintain hidden barriers to critical sectors (such as financial services and energy), and pursue industrial policies prioritizing technological self-sufficiency.76 Debate over whether China fulfilled its accession commitments also began to surface almost immediately after it became a WTO member. Trade tensions with its key trading partners, in particular the United States, rose as Chinese exports surged and the promised economic bounties to Western firms in terms of market access failed to fully materialize. The most contentious issues were China's poor protection of Western intellectual property rights, industrial policy, and regulatory restrictions on services and agricultural imports.77

然而，加入世贸组织虽然益处良多，但毕竟只是一次性事件，其带来的发展势头逐渐消退。中国政府并未利用加入世贸组织后有利的经济环境推行更多市场导向型改革，而是继续保护国有企业，维持对关键行业（如金融服务和能源）的隐性壁垒，并奉行优先发展技术自主的产业政策。76 关于中国是否履行了其加入世贸组织承诺的争论几乎在其成为世贸组织成员后立即出现。随着中国出口激增，而承诺给予西方企业市场准入的经济优惠未能完全兑现，与主要贸易伙伴（尤其是美国）的贸易紧张局势加剧。最具争议的问题包括中国对西方知识产权保护不力、产业政策以及对服务和农产品进口的监管限制。77

Globalization might have been more beneficial for China than it was for any other developing country. But it was not all good news for the developed economies. The combination of technological progress and globalization was responsible for a significant reduction of manufacturing employment in high-income countries. Because after its WTO accession China had become the world's largest exporter of manufactured goods, and because it maintained huge trade surpluses with the advanced economies, in particular the United States, China was blamed for the loss of millions of blue-collar jobs. President Barack Obama managed to contain trade tensions with China, but China's rise as a global manufacturing superpower has had a lasting impact on America's political landscape. Research by labor economists shows that trade exposure drove American working-class voters, who had turned against globalization, to the Republican Party and put Donald Trump in the White House in 2016 (and brought him back to power in 2024).78

全球化对中国或许比对其他任何发展中国家都更有利。但对发达经济体而言，这并非全是好消息。技术进步与全球化的结合导致高收入国家的制造业就业人数大幅下降。由于中国加入世贸组织后成为全球最大的制成品出口国，并且与发达经济体（尤其是美国）保持着巨额贸易顺差，因此中国被指责为造成数百万蓝领工作岗位流失的罪魁祸首。巴拉克·奥巴马总统成功控制了与中国的贸易紧张局势，但中国崛起为全球制造业超级大国对美国的政治格局产生了深远的影响。劳动经济学家的研究表明，贸易影响促使那些原本反对全球化的美国工人阶级选民转向共和党，并在2016年将唐纳德·特朗普送入白宫（并在2024年再次助其连任）。





Strong Economic Fundamentals





强劲的经济基本面





The Demographic Dividend





人口红利


Among the strong economic fundamentals that contributed to the Chinese "economic miracle" in the post-Mao era, the so-called demographic dividend is likely the most important. "Demographic dividend" refers to the gains from a decades-long period during which a country's labor force grows more rapidly than its population, resulting in more producers than consumers. However, not all countries with a favorable population structure (a large working-age population and a relatively small population of retirees) can reap this dividend because the productive utilization of a large labor force depends crucially on appropriate government policies affecting human capital accumulation through education and healthcare, savings, investments, and trade. Countries with the right policies during this window of demographic opportunity, as the countries in East Asia had, achieve higher rates of growth than those who do not have such policies. During the 1960-2000 period, the demographic dividend in Korea, Singapore, and Thailand contributed roughly one-third of the rise of per capita income, compared with only 16 percent of the rise of per capita income in the Latin American region.79 China's population transition to an era of low birth and death rates actually began in the late 1960s. But during the Maoist era, the demographic dividend was wasted due to the radical economic policies and political turmoil. The favorable structural factors did not begin to drive economic development until the reform era.80

在后毛泽东时代中国“经济奇迹”的诸多强劲经济基本面中，所谓的“人口红利”或许是最重要的因素。“人口红利”指的是一个国家在长达数十年的时间里，劳动力增长速度超过人口增长速度，从而导致生产者多于消费者所带来的收益。然而，并非所有拥有有利人口结构（劳动年龄人口众多，退休人口相对较少）的国家都能获得这一红利，因为庞大劳动力的生产性利用在很大程度上取决于政府制定的、能够通过教育和医疗保健、储蓄、投资和贸易等途径促进人力资本积累的政策。那些在人口红利时期采取了正确政策的国家，例如东亚国家，其经济增长速度往往高于那些没有采取此类政策的国家。 1960年至2000年间，韩国、新加坡和泰国的人口红利贡献了人均收入增长的约三分之一，而拉丁美洲地区仅贡献了人均收入增长的16%。中国向低出生率和低死亡率时代的转型实际上始于20世纪60年代末。但在毛泽东时代，由于激进的经济政策和政治动荡，人口红利被浪费了。直到改革开放时期，有利的结构性因素才开始推动经济发展。

A population with low dependency ratios (more workers than both the old-age and young populations) contributes to economic development through two mechanisms. The first is the accumulation of savings due to the low dependency ratio and the extra savings that can fund investments in physical and human capital. The second mechanism is the development of capital markets because workers need to save for their retirement and thus require a more sophisticated financial system.81

人口抚养比低（劳动人口多于老年人口和青年人口）通过两种机制促进经济发展。第一种机制是低抚养比带来的储蓄积累，以及可用于投资物质资本和人力资本的额外储蓄。第二种机制是资本市场的发展，因为劳动者需要为退休储蓄，因此需要更完善的金融体系。

Evidence of China's population transition can be seen in the dramatic fall in its birth rate starting in the mid-1960s. The country's birth rate peaked at 4.3 percent in 1963. By 1969, the birth rate had fallen to 3.4 percent, and in the 1970s the birth rate averaged 2.4 percent per year.82 The sustained lower birth rate coupled with the low mortality, following a period of high birth and low mortality rates (the 1950s and early 1960s), resulted in a population structure with a low dependency ratio. According to the 1990 census, China's working-age population was 60 percent of its 1.13 billion people, while its old-age population (age 60 for men and 55 for women) was only 10 percent of the population, making the old-age dependency ratio 6 to 1 (six workers supporting one retiree). Those under 14 years of age accounted for 28 percent of the total population. So the total dependency ratio was slightly less than 3 to 1.83 Studies of the magnitude of the effect of China's demographic dividend on economic growth show a substantial positive impact. One frequently cited article estimates that between 1982 and 2000, the demographic dividend contributed about 27 percent of China's per capita GDP growth. Another study finds that changes in the age structure of the Chinese population added about 20 percent to its per capita GDP growth between 1990 and 2005.84

中国人口转型的一个显著特征是其出生率自20世纪60年代中期开始急剧下降。1963年，中国的出生率达到峰值4.3%。到1969年，出生率已降至3.4%，70年代的平均出生率为每年2.4%。在经历了高出生率和低死亡率时期（20世纪50年代和60年代初）之后，持续的低出生率和低死亡率共同造就了中国低抚养比的人口结构。根据1990年的人口普查，中国11.3亿人口中，劳动年龄人口占60%，而老年人口（男性60岁，女性55岁）仅占10%，老年抚养比为6:1（六名劳动人口赡养一名退休人员）。 14岁以下人口占总人口的28%。因此，总抚养比略低于3:1。83 对中国人口红利对经济增长影响程度的研究表明，其具有显著的积极影响。一篇被广泛引用的文章估计，1982年至2000年间，人口红利对中国人均GDP增长的贡献约为27%。另一项研究发现，1990年至2005年间，中国人口年龄结构的变化使其人均GDP增长增加了约20%。84

One unique characteristic of China's demographic dividend is the massive transfer of surplus labor from rural areas to the cities. This process was set in motion in the 1980s by the decollectivization of agriculture, which raised productivity in the agricultural sector significantly and freed up a huge pool of surplus labor. In the 1980s the rural surplus labor was transferred mainly to the TVEs. Starting in the 1990s the boom in coastal areas and large cities attracted even more rural laborers who were migrating from villages to urban areas where they could earn higher wages in manufacturing, construction, and services. Estimates vary about the exact number of rural laborers transferred from the agricultural sector to manufacturing and services. The National Bureau of Statistics reports that 268.9 million rural laborers had transferred to the modern sector by the end of 2013.85

中国人口红利的一个独特特征是大量剩余劳动力从农村向城市转移。这一过程始于20世纪80年代的农业非集体化，农业生产率显著提高，释放出大量剩余劳动力。20世纪80年代，农村剩余劳动力主要转移到了乡镇企业。从20世纪90年代开始，沿海地区和大城市的繁荣吸引了更多农村劳动力从农村涌入城市，在制造业、建筑业和服务业中获得更高的工资。关于从农业部门转移到制造业和服务业的农村劳动力的具体人数，各方估计不一。国家统计局报告称，截至2013年底，已有2.689亿农村劳动力转移到现代部门。

The infusion of a labor force that was larger than the population of most countries into manufacturing and services enabled China to keep wages low and maintain its competitiveness. More important, because the transfer of labor from a sector in which labor productivity is low to one in which one unit of labor can produce more value delivers a one-time improvement in labor productivity. The epic transfer of hundreds of millions of rural laborers to the modern sector in the post-Mao era (with most of this transfer taking place in the post-Tiananmen era due to the relaxation of restrictions on internal migration) accounted for a significant rise in productivity.86 Estimates of the one-off boost in productivity due to the transfer of labor from less productive sectors (agriculture and SOEs) vary. According to one study, labor transfers from agriculture to nonagricultural sectors during 1978-1998 contributed about one-fifth of per capita GDP growth in China. Another study shows that relocating labor from agriculture to the nonagricultural sectors during 1991-2003 accounted for roughly 26 percent of Chinese growth in labor productivity. For the 1978-2015 period, the transfer of labor from less productive sectors to more productive sectors was responsible for 45 percent of the increase in labor productivity.87

中国向制造业和服务业注入了比大多数国家人口规模还要庞大的劳动力，这使得中国能够保持低工资水平并维持其竞争力。更重要的是，劳动力从劳动生产率低的部门转移到劳动生产率高的部门，能够一次性提高劳动生产率。后毛泽东时代数亿农村劳动力向现代部门的大规模转移（其中大部分发生在天安门事件后，因为当时放宽了对国内人口流动的限制）显著提高了生产率。86 关于劳动力从生产率较低的部门（农业和国有企业）转移所带来的生产率一次性提升的估计值各不相同。一项研究表明，1978年至1998年间，劳动力从农业向非农业部门的转移约占中国人均GDP增长的五分之一。另一项研究表明，1991年至2003年间，劳动力从农业向非农业部门的转移约占中国劳动生产率增长的26%。而在1978年至2015年期间，劳动力从生产率较低的部门向生产率较高的部门的转移则贡献了劳动生产率增长的45%。

However, China's demographic window of opportunity began to close toward the end of the post-Tiananmen era. By 2012, the country had reached the "Lewis Turning Point," whereby rural surplus labor was exhausted and wages were beginning to rise rapidly.88 Due to the party's draconian one-child policy, which restricted urban families to one child and rural families to two, China quickly confronted a far more adverse demographic landscape—low birth rates and a rapid rise in aging—in the 2010s. In 1990 the total dependency ratio was 3 to 1. But the population structure indicates a continuation of the demographic dividend because roughly two-thirds of dependents were under age 15 and the elderly population constituted only 9 percent of the working population. By 2012, the share of the population under age 14 had fallen to 223 million (compared with 323 million in 1992), while the number of those aged 65 and above had risen to 127 million (in 1992 there were 72 million people in this age-group), raising the old-age population dependency ratio to nearly 13 percent.89 Therefore, demographic aging began to act as a drag on future economic growth.

然而，中国的“人口红利窗口”在后天安门时代末期开始关闭。到2012年，中国达到了“路易斯转折点”，农村剩余劳动力消耗殆尽，工资开始快速上涨。由于中共严苛的独生子女政策（限制城镇家庭只能生育一个孩子，农村家庭只能生育两个孩子），中国在2010年代迅速面临着更为严峻的人口形势——低出生率和人口老龄化加剧。1990年，总抚养比为3:1。但人口结构表明人口红利仍在延续，因为大约三分之二的受抚养人口年龄在15岁以下，老年人口仅占劳动人口的9%。到2012年，14岁以下人口的比例下降到2.23亿（1992年为3.23亿），而65岁及以上人口的数量上升到1.27亿（1992年该年龄段人口为7200万），使老年人口抚养比上升到近13%。因此，人口老龄化开始对未来的经济增长构成阻碍。





High Savings and Investments





高储蓄和投资


The positive impact of the demographic dividend on China's growth in the post-Mao period is a much less disputed factor than the role of savings and investment. Like other fast-growing economies in East Asia, the story of the Chinese "economic miracle" also features high savings and investment rates. As an influential World Bank study of the East Asian development experience argues, high savings and high investment rates were the most important factors behind the region's post-World War II developmental success.90 Even those economists who maintain that there was no such thing as an economic miracle in East Asia acknowledge that high investment rates made the region an economic development star after World War II.91

人口红利对后毛泽东时代中国经济增长的积极影响远比储蓄和投资的作用更具争议性。与其他东亚快速增长的经济体一样，中国“经济奇迹”的故事也离不开高储蓄率和高投资率。正如世界银行一份关于东亚发展经验的重要研究报告所指出的，高储蓄率和高投资率是该地区二战后发展成功的最重要因素。即使是那些认为东亚不存在所谓“经济奇迹”的经济学家也承认，高投资率使该地区在二战后成为经济发展的明星。

Not surprisingly, economists examining the sources of growth in post-Mao China also disagree on whether an increase in total factor productivity (TFP) or an increase in investment played a more important role in the Chinese economic miracle. Some insist that TFP growth in the private sector and agriculture after reform began accounted for most of the increase in per capita GDP growth because the state sector, which had invested more than half of the capital during the period covered by the study (1978-2007), wasted a significant amount of its investment.92 Other economists, however, give more credit to investment. One study covering the 1978-2004 period finds that investment contributed 44 percent of the output of each worker, and TFP accounted for 49 percent. Another study examining the sources of growth during the 1978-2005 period produces similar results.93

不出所料，研究后毛泽东时代中国经济增长来源的经济学家们对于全要素生产率（TFP）的提高还是投资的增加在中国经济奇迹中发挥了更重要的作用存在分歧。一些经济学家坚持认为，改革开放后私营部门和农业的全要素生产率增长是人均GDP增长的主要贡献者，因为在研究涵盖的时期（1978-2007年）内投资超过一半资本的国有部门浪费了大量投资。然而，另一些经济学家则更看重投资。一项涵盖1978-2004年的研究发现，投资贡献了每位劳动者产出的44%，而全要素生产率贡献了49%。另一项研究1978-2005年期间经济增长来源的研究也得出了类似的结果。

At the heart of this esoteric debate is the sustainability of China's growth. If China's growth is driven primarily by investment and not by growth in productivity, it will eventually grind to a halt because of the law of diminishing returns (each additional unit of investment will produce less of an increase in output). But if China's growth is due more to rising productivity than it is to investment, its growth will be more sustainable.

这场深奥辩论的核心在于中国经济增长的可持续性。如果中国经济增长主要由投资而非生产率增长驱动，那么最终会因边际效益递减规律（每增加一个单位的投资，产出增长幅度都会递减）而停滞不前。但如果中国经济增长更多地源于生产率的提高而非投资，那么其增长将更具可持续性。

What is not disputed, however, are the sustained high levels of savings and investment in the post-Tiananmen era. Even though the sources of growth—whether productivity growth or high investments—will remain a subject of academic debate, the undeniable fact is that China could not have achieved its sustained high growth without an abundant source of capital. As table 5.6 shows, its savings and investment rates were extremely high throughout the post-Tiananmen period, reaching a peak toward the end of the Hu era.

然而，无可争议的是，后天安门时代中国持续保持着高水平的储蓄和投资。尽管增长的来源——无论是生产率增长还是高投资——仍将是学术界争论的话题，但不可否认的事实是，如果没有充裕的资本来源，中国不可能实现持续的高速增长。如表5.6所示，后天安门时代中国的储蓄和投资率一直居高不下，并在胡锦涛时代末期达到顶峰。

Even compared with its neighbors in East Asia that are known for high savings and investment rates, China stands out during this period. In the Jiang era, its savings rate was 25 percent more than the regional average, and its investment rate was 12 percent higher. This gap would grow even further in the Hu era. On average, China saved a whopping 43 percent more than its neighbors and invested 35 percent more.94 China was able to maintain high rates of investment mainly because of its abundant domestic savings, not because of FDI. Although utilized FDI totaled $1.24 trillion during 1993-2012, it was only a fraction of China's total investment. In 2012 alone, China invested $5.3 trillion in fixed assets. In the same year, inbound FDI was $111 billion, roughly 2 percent of total fixed asset investments.95

即使与以高储蓄率和高投资率著称的东亚邻国相比，中国在这一时期也表现突出。江泽民时期，中国的储蓄率比区域平均水平高出25%，投资率高出12%。到了胡锦涛时期，这一差距进一步扩大。平均而言，中国的储蓄率比邻国高出惊人的43%，投资率高出35%。中国之所以能够保持高投资率，主要得益于其充裕的国内储蓄，而非外商直接投资。尽管1993年至2012年间，中国利用的外商直接投资总额达1.24万亿美元，但这仅占中国总投资的一小部分。仅2012年一年，中国在固定资产上的投资就高达5.3万亿美元。同年，流入的外商直接投资为1110亿美元，约占固定资产投资总额的2%。

The reasons for China's high savings rate are not only hotly debated but also reflective of some of the flaws in the Chinese political and economic systems. In terms of the positive factors contributing to high savings, the most obvious is the combination of high growth and the demographic dividend. China experienced a virtuous cycle during most of the reform era—the reforms increased productivity and growth, resulting in higher income. Reinforced by the demographic dividend, more income was saved.96 Another factor is simply rational human behavior. According to the life-cycle hypothesis, people save when their income is high so they will have money to spend when they have no income. Indeed, China's reform and opening produced higher growth and hence higher income, and as a result individuals rationally saved more.97 This explanation is intuitively persuasive, but it does not address the unique and largely adverse circumstances in China's transitional economy during the post-Mao era. One casualty of the reforms is the (limited) socialist welfare state and the employment security of workers in urban areas. Uncertainty about future income in a transition economy motivated Chinese households to save more.98 The theory of "precautionary savings" appears to make more sense in the Chinese context because, during much of the reform era, China did not provide sufficient social services (such as publicly funded healthcare or education) or a social safety net (pensions or unemployment insurance), forcing individuals to set aside a portion of their income for such future expenditures. Another factor unique to China that also forced people to save more was the high housing prices that motivated potential home purchasers to save for down payments.99

中国高储蓄率的原因不仅引发了激烈的争论，也反映了中国政治经济体制的一些缺陷。就促成高储蓄率的积极因素而言，最显而易见的是高增长和人口红利的结合。在改革开放的大部分时期，中国经历了良性循环——改革提高了生产力和经济增长，从而带来了更高的收入。人口红利的推动下，更多的收入被储蓄起来。另一个因素则简单来说就是理性的人类行为。根据生命周期假说，人们会在收入高的时候储蓄，以便在没有收入时有钱消费。事实上，中国的改革开放带来了更高的经济增长，从而带来了更高的收入，因此人们理性地增加了储蓄。这种解释在直觉上很有说服力，但它并没有考虑到后毛泽东时代中国转型经济所面临的独特且大多不利的境况。改革的牺牲品之一是（有限的）社会主义福利国家和城镇工人的就业保障。转型经济体中未来收入的不确定性促使中国家庭增加储蓄。98 “预防性储蓄”理论在中国似乎更具意义，因为在改革开放的大部分时期，中国缺乏充足的社会服务（例如公共医疗或教育）和社会保障体系（例如养老金或失业保险），迫使个人将部分收入用于应对未来的支出。另一个促使人们增加储蓄的中国特有因素是高房价，这促使潜在购房者为首付储蓄。99

Although high domestic savings are critical to funding China's massive investment in infrastructure, alone they cannot sustain its economic development. Savings are expected to fall as China exhausts its demographic dividend and must provide for its rapidly aging society. If savings are not productively invested, they will not generate sufficient returns to cover pensions. The latter probably is far more challenging because China's state-dominated financial system and capital controls (which prevent Chinese households from investing abroad) limit investment options and potential returns. Instructively, the only class of assets that appears to have generated high returns is housing, in contrast to the equity market that has not delivered any returns despite its high volatility between 2008 and 2016.100

尽管高额的国内储蓄对于中国大规模的基础设施投资至关重要，但仅靠储蓄本身无法支撑其经济发展。随着中国人口红利的耗尽以及必须应对快速老龄化的社会，储蓄预计将会下降。如果储蓄没有得到有效投资，其收益将不足以支付养老金。后者可能更具挑战性，因为中国以国家为主导的金融体系和资本管制（限制了中国家庭在海外的投资）限制了投资选择和潜在收益。值得注意的是，唯一似乎产生高回报的资产类别是房地产，而股票市场尽管在2008年至2016年期间波动剧烈，却没有带来任何回报。





Losing Momentum





失去势头


No one was in a better position to sound the alarm about the Chinese economy than China's premier, the country's chief economic manager. While the rest of the world was admiring China's economic miracle, Premier Wen Jiabao, uncharacteristically frank for a senior party official, told journalists at a press conference after the conclusion of the annual session of the NPC in March 2007 that the Chinese economy had "huge" (juda) problems—"the same persistent problems of instability, imbalances, lack of coordination, and unsustainability." In particular, Wen singled out the excessive investment growth rate, amount of credit, and liquidity; the large imbalances in foreign trade and the current account and between investment and consumption; excessive dependence on investment and exports to generate growth; and unsustainable environmental degradation.101 When he delivered his work report to the NPC in March 2013 before retiring as premier, he reiterated his warning that economic imbalances, lack of coordination, and unsustainability continued to be prominent problems.102

没有人比中国总理、国家首席经济管理者更有资格对中国经济发出警告。当世界其他国家都在赞叹中国的经济奇迹时，温家宝总理——一位罕见的、不拘泥于传统高官作风的总理——在2007年3月全国人大年度会议闭幕后的记者会上告诉记者，中国经济存在“巨大”问题——“同样是长期存在的不稳定、失衡、缺乏协调、不可持续的问题”。温家宝特别指出，中国经济存在投资增速过快、信贷规模过大、流动性过强等问题；外贸和经常账户以及投资与消费之间存在巨大失衡；过度依赖投资和出口来推动经济增长；以及不可持续的环境恶化。101 2013年3月，他在卸任国务院总理前向全国人大作工作报告时，重申了经济失衡、缺乏协调和不可持续性仍然是突出的问题。102

The premier's warning reveals the weaknesses of China's economic development model in the post-Tiananmen era. Even though the party delivered two decades of spectacular growth, exceeding its own expectations, many of the factors that contributed to this economic miracle either were one-off or began to yield diminishing returns toward the end of the Hu era. If the party had adopted substantive reforms to correct these imbalances when Wen first sounded the alarm in 2007, the Chinese economy would likely have been in better shape than it was when Hu and Wen left office in 2012/2013.

总理的警告揭示了后天安门时代中国经济发展模式的缺陷。尽管中共实现了长达二十年的辉煌增长，远超预期，但促成这一经济奇迹的诸多因素要么是一次性的，要么在胡锦涛时代末期开始逐渐失效。如果中共在温家宝2007年首次发出警告时就采取实质性改革措施纠正这些失衡，那么中国经济在胡锦涛和温家宝2012/2013年卸任时，状况很可能会更好。

But that did not happen. Instead of addressing the worsening macro-economic imbalances through reform, the party under Hu merely rode the momentum generated by China's WTO entry, the housing boom, and the demographic dividend. When the global financial crisis (GFC) of 2008 hit, the leadership reacted with a massive credit-fueled stimulus package that avoided a recession over the short term. But the price was high. The party's panicked response to the GFC drastically increased the overall level of debt in the economy and led to a gigantic housing bubble. This credit-fueled investment cycle began to unwind around 2021 when the housing bubble popped and local government debt threatened to unleash a financial crisis. In retrospect, the party's stimulus package at the end of the Hu era merely delayed China's economic reckoning.

但这种情况并未发生。胡锦涛领导下的中共并未通过改革解决日益恶化的宏观经济失衡问题，而是仅仅依靠中国加入世贸组织、房地产繁荣和人口红利带来的发展势头。2008年全球金融危机爆发时，领导层采取了大规模信贷驱动的刺激计划，短期内避免了经济衰退。但代价高昂。中共对金融危机的恐慌性反应导致经济整体债务水平急剧上升，并催生了巨大的房地产泡沫。大约在2021年，随着房地产泡沫破裂和地方政府债务可能引发金融危机，这种信贷驱动的投资周期开始瓦解。回首来看，胡锦涛时代末期的刺激计划只不过是推迟了中国经济的清算。





Macroeconomic Imbalances and Falling Productivity





宏观经济失衡与生产率下降


By the end of the Hu era, most economic indicators were flashing yellow, or even red, signaling the end of the Chinese economic miracle. GDP recorded its last double-digit growth rate (10.3 percent) in 2010. Growth would fall to 6.4 percent in 2019, the year before the Covid-19 pandemic.103 Judging by the structure of the Chinese economy, growth had become excessively dependent on investment (table 5.7). An economy that relies too much on one of the three drivers of growth—consumption, investment, and trade—can become vulnerable if this main driver loses momentum. In the Chinese case, the economy was most balanced in the 1980s, when Zhao Ziyang was the premier in charge of it. Consumption contributed, on average, 64 percent of the growth, and investment accounted for 31 percent. The ratio began to shift toward investment in the Jiang era, during which time foreign trade also claimed a much higher share of the source of growth. Nicholas Lardy, a leading authority on the Chinese economy, argues that macroeconomic data show that the Chinese economy became "highly imbalanced" in about 2003, the year Hu began his decade in power.104

胡锦涛时代末期，大多数经济指标都亮起了黄灯，甚至红灯，预示着中国经济奇迹的终结。2010年，国内生产总值（GDP）录得其最后一次两位数增长（10.3%）。到2019年，也就是新冠疫情爆发前一年，增速将降至6.4%。从中国经济结构来看，经济增长过度依赖投资（表5.7）。如果一个经济体过度依赖消费、投资和贸易这三大增长动力中的任何一个，一旦该主要动力失去动力，经济体就会变得脆弱。就中国而言，经济在20世纪80年代最为平衡，当时赵紫阳担任总理。消费平均贡献了64%的增长，投资占31%。江泽民时代，这一比例开始向投资倾斜，与此同时，对外贸易在经济增长中所占的份额也大幅增加。中国经济权威专家尼古拉斯·拉迪认为，宏观经济数据显示，中国经济在2003年左右开始出现“高度失衡”，而那一年正是胡锦涛开始执政的十年时期。

At the end of the Hu era, the economy was less dependent on trade, as the contribution of trade to growth had fallen to 3.4 percent, most probably due to the decline in external demand following the GFC. But the domestic imbalances in the economy deteriorated, with investment contributing on average 52.4 percent of the growth during Hu's decade in power and consumption falling to 44.2 percent. Data from Hu's second term reveal even worse imbalances. During 2008-2012 investment accounted for an average of 56.5 percent of GDP growth, while trade brought down 6.2 percent of the growth because of the slump in world trade after the 2008 GFC.105

胡锦涛执政末期，中国经济对贸易的依赖程度有所降低，贸易对经济增长的贡献率降至3.4%，这很可能是由于全球金融危机后外部需求下降所致。但国内经济失衡状况恶化，胡锦涛执政十年间，投资对经济增长的贡献率平均为52.4%，而消费支出则降至44.2%。胡锦涛第二任期的数据显示，经济失衡状况更为严重。2008年至2012年间，投资对GDP增长的贡献率平均为56.5%，而贸易增长的贡献率仅为6.2%，这主要是由于2008年全球金融危机后世界贸易低迷所致。

An economy overly reliant on investment as a source of growth faces two problems. First, investment typically yields diminishing returns: More capital is needed to generate an additional unit of output. This phenomenon is usually captured by the term "incremental capital output ratio" (ICOR). This ratio measures the unit of capital needed to generate an additional unit of output. Higher ICOR numbers indicate a greater need for capital investment to sustain growth. One estimate shows that China's average ICOR was 3.6 during 1983-1992, 4.0 during 1993-2002, and 4.3 during 2003-2012. Although it is debatable whether China's ICOR is too high, the upward trend is self-evident. In the Xi period, China's ICOR would rise even more rapidly (averaging 5.8 in 2010-2019).106 A more nuanced analysis of China's rising ICOR finds that capital-intensive housing and infrastructure investment accounted for the bulk of this increase.107 This explanation contains both good news and bad news. The positive interpretation is that China may have room to invest in the more productive sectors of the economy, such as manufacturing and services. The bad news is that the two engines behind the country's economic miracle—infrastructure and housing—cannot be sustained due to their high capital intensity coupled with their lower returns.

过度依赖投资作为增长动力的经济体面临两个问题。首先，投资通常会产生边际效益递减：需要更多的资本才能创造额外的一单位产出。这种现象通常用“增量资本产出比”（ICOR）来描述。该比率衡量的是创造额外一单位产出所需的资本量。ICOR 值越高，表明维持增长所需的资本投资就越多。据估计，中国 1983-1992 年的平均 ICOR 为 3.6，1993-2002 年为 4.0，2003-2012 年为 4.3。尽管中国的 ICOR 是否过高尚存争议，但其上升趋势显而易见。在习近平时期，中国的资本密集型资本回报率（ICOR）增长速度更快（2010-2019年平均为5.8）。对中国ICOR增长的更细致分析发现，资本密集型的住房和基础设施投资是这一增长的主要来源。这种解释既有好消息也有坏消息。好消息是，中国或许有空间投资于生产率更高的经济部门，例如制造业和服务业。坏消息是，支撑中国经济奇迹的两大引擎——基础设施和住房——由于其高资本密集度和低回报率，难以持续。

Second, excessive investment raises the risk of waste. High investment can lead to excess capacity, a chronic problem plaguing industries such as coal, steel, automobile, construction, and solar panels in China.108 If SOEs undertake investment, the return on capital is much lower than it is in the private sector (private firms produced returns on capital that were roughly 50 percent higher than returns on capital in SOEs during the 2000s). Indeed, Chinese SOEs consistently have higher debt and report far lower returns on invested capital than do private and foreign firms. In the second half of the Hu period, the performance of SOEs relative to private and foreign firms became even worse. During the entire Hu period, SOEs recorded losses averaging 0.5 percent of GDP each year, indicating an inefficient use of capital.109

其次，过度投资会增加浪费的风险。高投资会导致产能过剩，这是困扰中国煤炭、钢铁、汽车、建筑和太阳能电池板等行业的长期问题。如果国有企业进行投资，其资本回报率远低于私营部门（2000年代，私营企业的资本回报率比国有企业高出约50%）。事实上，中国国有企业的负债水平一直高于私营企业和外资企业，且投资回报率远低于后者。在胡锦涛执政时期后半段，国有企业相对于私营企业和外资企业的业绩进一步恶化。在整个胡锦涛执政时期，国有企业平均每年亏损0.5%的GDP，表明资本利用效率低下。

In addition to dramatic structural imbalances and a rising capital intensity, a third indicator of the flagging economic momentum that appeared at the end of the Hu era is the slowing of productivity. One study of the sources of growth during the post-Mao period indicates that the increase in TFP accounted for 20 percent or more of the growth of output before 2008. However, the contribution of TFP to GDP growth became negative after 2009.110 Another study shows that the contribution to GDP growth from the rise in TFP averaged 15 percent from 1980 to 2007, but TFP did not contribute to GDP growth from 2007 to 2012; in fact, TFP growth itself was negative in this period, implying declining economic efficiency.111 Several factors likely led to the fall in productivity during the second half of the Hu era. The principal culprits were the party's failure to adopt more reforms to improve economic efficiency and its massive stimulus package in response to the GFC that channeled investments into the inefficient state sector and the unproductive infrastructure.112

除了严重的结构性失衡和资本密集度上升之外，胡时代末期经济增长势头减弱的第三个指标是生产率增速放缓。一项对后毛泽东时代经济增长来源的研究表明，2008年以前，全要素生产率（TFP）的增长占产出增长的20%以上。然而，2009年以后，TFP对GDP增长的贡献转为负值。另一项研究表明，1980年至2007年，TFP增长对GDP增长的平均贡献率为15%，但2007年至2012年，TFP对GDP增长没有贡献；事实上，在此期间TFP本身的增长为负值，这意味着经济效率下降。胡时代后半期生产率下降可能由多种因素造成。主要原因在于该党未能采取更多改革措施来提高经济效率，以及其为应对全球金融危机而推出的大规模刺激计划，该计划将投资导向了效率低下的国有部门和生产力低下的基础设施。





Party Response to Global Financial Crisis in 2008





2008年全球金融危机期间，该党的应对措施


The GFC occurred at a time when the Chinese economy was at a crossroads. Its economic structure had become even more unbalanced than when Hu began as premier six years earlier. In 2007 consumption and investment contributed 40 percent to GDP growth, respectively, while foreign trade, due to China's whopping trade surplus of $261.8 billion, accounted for 20 percent. The boom in foreign trade following China's WTO entry made the Chinese economy heavily dependent on exports prior to the GFC. The positive effects of China's WTO entry took about three years to show up in China's trade data, most likely because of the time lag between the relocation of manufacturing facilities to China and their exports. During 2002-2004 foreign trade contributed an average of only 5 percent of GDP growth. But between 2005 and 2007 it accounted for an average of 21 percent of growth.113

全球金融危机爆发时，中国经济正处于十字路口。其经济结构比胡锦涛六年前就任总理时更加失衡。2007年，消费和投资分别对GDP增长贡献了40%，而由于中国高达2618亿美元的贸易顺差，外贸仅占20%。中国加入世贸组织后外贸的蓬勃发展，使得中国经济在金融危机爆发前严重依赖出口。中国加入世贸组织的积极影响大约三年后才体现在中国的贸易数据中，这很可能是因为制造业设施迁至中国与其出口之间存在时间滞后。2002年至2004年，外贸对GDP增长的贡献平均仅为5%。但2005年至2007年，外贸对GDP增长的贡献平均达到21%。

Due to tight regulations and capital controls, the Chinese financial system was insulated from the turmoil in global financial markets. However, China's foreign trade immediately felt the impact of the GFC as demand for Chinese exports in the crisis-ridden Western economies declined dramatically. In response, the party rolled out a massive stimulus package to avoid a recession. This package consisted of two sources of funding. The fiscal spending that was announced in November 2008 amounted to 4 trillion yuan (about $486 billion, or 14 percent of GDP). Most of the stimulus targeted infrastructure projects. Despite its nominally large size, it is difficult to determine the actual amount of the fiscal stimulus because cash-strapped local governments were supposed to cover the bulk of the spending.114 The other source of funding was bank loans, which provided most of the stimulus. Between December 2008 and December 2009 alone, Chinese banks lent out 11 trillion yuan in new loans, almost triple the amount of the announced fiscal stimulus.115

由于严格的监管和资本管制，中国金融体系免受全球金融市场动荡的影响。然而，随着危机重重的西方经济体对中国出口产品的需求急剧下降，中国的对外贸易立即感受到了全球金融危机的冲击。为了应对危机，中共推出了一项大规模的经济刺激计划，以避免经济衰退。该计划包含两个资金来源。2008年11月宣布的财政支出总额达4万亿元人民币（约合4860亿美元，占GDP的14%）。大部分刺激资金用于基础设施建设项目。尽管名义规模庞大，但由于资金紧张的地方政府需要承担大部分支出，因此很难确定财政刺激的实际金额。另一个资金来源是银行贷款，这提供了大部分刺激资金。仅在2008年12月至2009年12月期间，中国银行业就发放了11万亿元人民币的新贷款，几乎是宣布的财政刺激金额的三倍。

Judging by China's macroeconomic performance in the immediate aftermath of the GFC, the party appears to have made the right call. Exports in 2009 fell 16 percent from 2008, but they recovered strongly in 2010. Nevertheless, the GFC marked the end of China's export-driven growth. Foreign trade was a negative contributor to growth between 2008 and 2011, and it would not resume its role as an engine of growth until 2019.116 The injection of massive credit into the economy did succeed in achieving the party's goal of maintaining growth. In 2008 the country reported growth of 9.6 percent (a significant fall from the 14.2 percent growth in 2007). Growth in 2009 and 2010 was 9.2 and 10.4 percent, respectively.117

从中国在全球金融危机后的宏观经济表现来看，党的决策似乎是正确的。2009年出口较2008年下降了16%，但2010年强劲反弹。然而，全球金融危机标志着中国出口导向型增长时代的终结。2008年至2011年间，外贸对经济增长产生了负面影响，直到2019年才重新成为经济增长的引擎。向经济注入大量信贷确实成功实现了党维持增长的目标。2008年，中国经济增长率为9.6%（较2007年的14.2%大幅下降）。2009年和2010年的经济增长率分别为9.2%和10.4%。

Even though some economists hailed the party's response, in retrospect it was a costly mistake that led to a rapid buildup of debt in the economy, a worsening misallocation of resources, and the subsequent decline in productivity.118 Arguably the greatest—and most negative—legacy of China's response to the GFC is the rapid increase in debt. According to the Bank of International Settlements, the debt of China's nonfinancial sector averaged 140 percent of GDP from 2000 to 2008 (it was 139 percent of GDP at the end of 2008). But the debt of the nonfinancial sector reached 175 percent of GDP at the end of 2009, a net increase of 36 percentage points. This implies that China's credit-fueled stimulus package was more than one-third of its GDP—probably the largest in peacetime history. Although the pace of credit slowed in 2010 and 2011, by the time Hu left his position as CCP general secretary at the end of 2012, total outstanding debt had risen to 192 percent of GDP, a historic record. Judging by the sustained buildup of debt in the Xi era, as will be discussed later, the party's debt-driven stimulus seems to have opened the door for Xi, during his first term, to rely on credit expansion to keep growth from falling from a cliff as a substitute for reform. (Debt to GDP would reach 297 percent by the end of Xi's second term in December 2022.)119

尽管一些经济学家称赞了中共的应对措施，但事后看来，这是一个代价惨重的错误，导致经济债务迅速累积、资源错配加剧，并最终导致生产率下降。可以说，中国应对全球金融危机的最大——也是最负面的——遗产就是债务的迅速增长。根据国际清算银行的数据，2000年至2008年，中国非金融部门的债务平均占GDP的140%（2008年底为139%）。但到2009年底，非金融部门的债务占GDP的比例达到了175%，净增36个百分点。这意味着，中国以信贷驱动的刺激计划规模超过了其GDP的三分之一——这可能是和平时期历史上规模最大的刺激计划。尽管2010年和2011年信贷增速放缓，但到胡锦涛2012年底卸任中共中央总书记时，未偿债务总额已升至GDP的192%，创历史新高。正如后文将要讨论的，从习近平时代债务的持续增长来看，中共以债务驱动的刺激政策似乎为习近平在其第一任期内提供了便利，使其能够依靠信贷扩张来避免经济增长断崖式下滑，以此替代改革。（到习近平第二任期结束时，即2022年12月，债务占GDP的比重将达到297%。）

The rapid buildup of debt most likely created a large amount of nonperforming loans because SOEs and local governments had borrowed the bulk of the new credit created in 2009.120 Researchers at the International Monetary Fund estimate that half of the new credit made available after 2008 went to SOEs.121 Of all the outstanding debt to the nonfinancial sectors at the end of 2012, SOEs and local government financing vehicles (LGFVs) accounted for 37 percent.122 Because inefficient SOEs do not generate enough profits to repay their loans and local governments frequently invest in wasteful projects, relying on revenue from the leasing of land to cover their financial liabilities, it is reasonable to assume that a significant portion of the borrowing after the GFC ended up as nonperforming loans in the financial system. In addition to misallocating massive amounts of resources to inefficient producers and dragging down productivity, the party's response to the GFC limited the space for future monetary policy and made the financial sector more vulnerable to a debt crisis.

债务的迅速累积很可能造成了大量不良贷款，因为国有企业和地方政府借入了2009年新增信贷的大部分。国际货币基金组织的研究人员估计，2008年后新增信贷的一半流向了国有企业。截至2012年底，非金融部门所有未偿债务中，国有企业和地方政府融资机构（LGFV）占37%。由于效率低下的国有企业无法产生足够的利润来偿还贷款，而地方政府经常投资于浪费性项目，依靠土地租赁收入来偿还债务，因此可以合理地假设，全球金融危机后相当一部分借款最终变成了金融体系中的不良贷款。除了将大量资源错误地分配给效率低下的生产商并拉低生产力之外，该党对全球金融危机的应对措施限制了未来货币政策的空间，并使金融部门更容易受到债务危机的影响。

One lasting legacy of the stimulus package is the housing bubble that it created. Data on floor space under construction reveal a massive increase of construction in both commercial and residential real estate. In the four years before implementation of the stimulus package (2005-2008), the total amount of space under construction was 177 million square meters. In the four years following the stimulus package, floor space under construction ballooned to 313 million square meters. Floor space under construction between 2009 and 2012 exceeded the combined total in the prior eight years.123 Although the bubble would grow even bigger during the Xi era, it was a dark cloud hanging over the Chinese economy. When the real estate sector crashed during the Covid-19 pandemic in 2021-2022, a powerful engine of growth became the heaviest drag on the Chinese economy.

刺激计划留下的一个持久遗产是它所制造的房地产泡沫。在建建筑面积数据显示，商业和住宅房地产的建设量都出现了大幅增长。在刺激计划实施前的四年（2005-2008年），在建建筑总面积为1.77亿平方米。而在刺激计划实施后的四年里，在建建筑面积飙升至3.13亿平方米。2009年至2012年间的在建建筑面积甚至超过了此前八年的总和。尽管泡沫在习近平时代进一步扩大，但它始终是笼罩在中国经济上的一片阴云。2021-2022年新冠疫情期间，房地产行业崩盘，曾经强劲的增长引擎反而成了拖累中国经济的最大绊脚石。





Summary





概括


This account of the unprecedented economic growth that China achieved in the two decades following Deng Xiaoping's tour of southern China in 1992 illustrates the diverse factors that made this "miracle" possible and the obstacles to its sustainability. The reforms implemented by the party played a positive role. Even though these measures, rolled out mostly in the 1990s, were partial and oriented toward strengthening state control over the financial sector and the fiscal system, they helped make the economy more open, market-oriented, and productive.124

本文描述了邓小平1992年访问中国南方后，中国在二十年间取得的空前经济增长，并阐述了促成这一“奇迹”的诸多因素以及其可持续性面临的挑战。党推行的改革发挥了积极作用。尽管这些措施主要在20世纪90年代推出，且具有局限性，侧重于加强国家对金融部门和财政体系的控制，但它们确实有助于使经济更加开放、市场化和高效。

At the same time, however, these partial reforms did not fundamentally change China's economic system. The state—in reality, the party—retained control over the most vital economic sectors. The share of SOEs in the economy remained too large to make China qualify as a market economy. Most of the growth during this period should be credited to the private sector, globalization, and favorable structural factors.

然而，与此同时，这些局部改革并未从根本上改变中国的经济体制。国家——实际上是党——仍然控制着最重要的经济部门。国有企业在经济中的份额仍然过大，使中国无法被认定为市场经济体。这一时期的大部分增长应归功于私营部门、全球化和有利的结构性因素。

The post-Tiananmen economic model began to unravel during Hu Jintao's second term, as indicated by falling productivity growth and worsening economic imbalances. This process coincided with the emergence of cracks in the post-Tiananmen political model. In retrospect, the end of the Chinese miracle was almost inevitable. The beneficial effects of the demographic dividend and globalization had either dissipated or disappeared toward the end of the Hu era. In the meantime, the lack of reforms to address high income inequality, inefficient SOEs, macroeconomic imbalances, and the insufficient provision of social services made the economy less dynamic.125

后天安门时代经济模式在胡锦涛第二任期内开始瓦解，表现为生产率增长放缓和经济失衡加剧。这一过程与后天安门时代政治模式出现裂痕不谋而合。回望过去，中国经济奇迹的终结几乎不可避免。人口红利和全球化的积极影响在胡锦涛时代末期要么消散，要么消失殆尽。与此同时，缺乏改革措施来解决收入不平等加剧、国有企业效率低下、宏观经济失衡以及社会服务供给不足等问题，导致经济活力下降。

In the aftermath of the GFC, the party took the path of least resistance: It opened the spigot of credit to fund infrastructure and to inflate a gigantic housing bubble. Even though the party managed to sustain high growth for the short term, its stimulus package worsened the economic imbalances, channeled resources to the least productive sectors, and saddled the economy with a heavy debt burden that would eviscerate its vitality during the subsequent decade. Fittingly, the end of the Chinese miracle also marked the end of the post-Tiananmen neo-authoritarian order and the beginning of a new, and darker, era of neo-Stalinist rule.

全球金融危机之后，中共选择了阻力最小的道路：它打开信贷闸门，为基础设施建设提供资金，并催生了巨大的房地产泡沫。尽管中共在短期内维持了经济的高速增长，但其刺激计划加剧了经济失衡，将资源导向生产力最低的行业，并使经济背负了沉重的债务负担，这将在接下来的十年中严重削弱经济活力。恰如其分的是，中国经济奇迹的终结也标志着后天安门时代新威权秩序的终结，以及一个更加黑暗的新斯大林主义统治时代的开始。





6 Revival of Totalitarianism Under Xi Jinping





6 习近平领导下的极权主义复兴


BEFORE XI Jinping officially became the general secretary of the CCP in November 2012, few would have thought that he could reverse most of Deng's reforms and bring back a form of totalitarian rule within only a few years after his rise. Given the transformative socioeconomic changes China had experienced in the post-Mao era, such a scenario was simply unthinkable. Yet, like most inconceivable events in history, the revival of totalitarianism under Xi becomes almost self-evident only in hindsight. By the time he assumed power, as discussed at the end of chapter 4, the post-Tiananmen order was beginning to unravel. But the political reality of the early 2010s precluded a potential path to democracy through elite-initiated reform. Although fraying elite unity, pervasive corruption, and dissipation of economic dynamism indicated that the party was in trouble, the regime was not in a serious enough legitimacy crisis to precipitate a split between soft-liners and hard-liners, a prerequisite for an elite-led transition.1 Even more important, the absence of liberal reformers in senior leadership positions made this prospect unrealistic.

在习近平于2012年11月正式就任中共中央总书记之前，几乎没有人会想到，他会在上台短短几年内就推翻邓小平的大部分改革，并恢复某种形式的极权统治。考虑到毛泽东时代之后中国经历的翻天覆地的社会经济变革，这种情况简直是不可想象的。然而，如同历史上大多数不可思议的事件一样，习近平领导下的极权主义复兴，只有在事后看来才显得几乎是理所当然的。正如第四章末尾所述，在他掌权之时，天安门事件后的秩序已经开始瓦解。但2010年代初期的政治现实，使得通过精英主导的改革走向民主的道路变得不可能。尽管精英阶层的团结日渐瓦解、腐败盛行以及经济活力的消退表明该党陷入困境，但该政权的合法性危机尚未严重到足以引发温和派和强硬派之间的分裂，而这正是精英主导的转型所必需的。更重要的是，高层领导职位上缺乏自由派改革者，使得这种前景不切实际。

Politically, the path of least resistance for Xi would have been muddling through, as Hu had done throughout his decade in power. This would have required the party to continue its post-Tiananmen survival strategy, but with greater tactical dexterity. The party was not facing an imminent existential threat, so it did not need to adopt dramatic reforms. It seemed to make sense to keep a strategy that had enabled it to enjoy two decades of unprecedented peace, prosperity, and stability. Hu articulated the rationale of playing it safe more succinctly than anyone else. In his last political report to the party on the opening day of the Eighteenth Party Congress in November 2012, he bluntly stated that as long as the party does not zheteng (a colloquial expression best translated as "engage in useless and self-destructive actions"), it would reach its goal of making China a "prosperous, strong, democratic, civilized, and harmonious modern socialist nation."2 At the time, Hu's use of zheteng on such a formal party occasion raised eyebrows. Although Hu's invocation of this phrase was treated as a lame excuse for doing little during his tenure, his political wisdom became clear soon after Xi began to do precisely the opposite, plunging the party into its most turbulent era since the end of the Maoist period.

从政治角度来看，对习近平而言阻力最小的路径或许是像胡锦涛执政十年那样，采取得过且过的方式。这意味着中共需要延续天安门事件后的生存策略，但要更加灵活多变。由于中共并未面临迫在眉睫的生存威胁，因此无需进行剧烈的改革。继续沿用过去二十年来使其享有前所未有的和平、繁荣与稳定的策略，似乎合情合理。胡锦涛对这种稳妥策略的阐述比任何人都更加精辟。在2012年11月中共十八大开幕当天，胡锦涛向全党作最后一次政治报告时，直言不讳地指出，只要党不“作死”（“作死”一词可译为“无用且自毁的行为”），就能实现建设“富强民主文明和谐的社会主义现代化国家”的目标。当时，胡锦涛在如此正式的党内场合使用“作死”一词引起了人们的质疑。尽管胡锦涛援引这个词被认为是其任期内政绩平庸的借口，但随着习近平开始采取截然相反的做法，将党推入毛泽东时代结束以来最动荡的时期，胡锦涛的政治智慧很快就显露出来。

If insecurity motivated risk-averse leaders like Hu to prefer muddling through, the same sense of insecurity could also drive someone like Xi to opt for a radically different course—confronting perceived threats by reviving totalitarianism and reasserting party control over Chinese society. Even though few had thought Xi would embark on such a path, it was this new survival strategy that he started to implement immediately after taking office. The only part of his strategy incongruent with the regime's sense of insecurity was an expansionist foreign policy. Although one might expect an insecure regime to avoid provoking powerful external foes, Xi did the opposite. Most likely he sensed strategic opportunities created by the global financial crisis and America's relative decline in the 2000s. The rapid rise in Chinese power likely made Xi confident that the West would not push back, even if China jettisoned Deng's dictum to "keep a low profile."

如果说不安全感促使像胡锦涛这样规避风险的领导人选择得过且过，那么同样的不安全感也可能驱使像习近平这样的人选择截然不同的道路——通过复兴极权主义、重新确立党对中国社会的控制来应对其所感知到的威胁。尽管很少有人预料到习近平会走上这条道路，但他上任后立即开始实施的正是这一新的生存策略。他的策略中唯一与政权的不安全感相悖的部分是其扩张性的外交政策。人们或许会认为，一个缺乏安全感的政权会避免激怒强大的外部敌人，但习近平的做法恰恰相反。他很可能看到了全球金融危机和美国在2000年代相对衰落所带来的战略机遇。中国实力的迅速崛起可能让习近平相信，即使中国抛弃了邓小平“保持低调”的教诲，西方也不会予以反击。

Xi's personal ambitions and commitment to the preservation of CCP rule most likely had motivated him. Motives alone, however, could not explain the ease with which he dismantled the post-Tiananmen order and reestablished a form of neo-Stalinist rule. He needed enablers—not just shrewd and ruthless henchmen, but also institutional tools—to bring back totalitarian rule. It turned out that such tools were readily available, as more than three decades of economic reform had left the fundamental institutions of totalitarianism largely untouched. To reimpose strict control on Chinese society, Xi could mobilize the regime's potent repressive apparatus, modernized and strengthened by huge investments and advanced technology in the post-Tiananmen era. To reestablish strongman rule, he could weaponize anticorruption investigations to purge political rivals, most of them made vulnerable by their involvement in shady deals. With no civil society, rule of law, or genuine "inner-party" democracy, Xi faced no institutional constraints in exercising his newly acquired power. Only with the revival of totalitarian rule under Xi can we appreciate the tragic consequences of Deng Xiaoping's steadfast resistance to political reform in the 1980s when a narrow path toward a more open and free China existed.

习近平的个人野心和维护中共统治的决心很可能是他采取行动的动机。然而，仅凭动机无法解释他为何如此轻易地瓦解了天安门事件后的秩序，并重建了一种新斯大林主义式的统治。他需要的是帮手——不仅是精明强干、冷酷无情的爪牙，还有制度工具——来恢复极权统治。事实证明，这些工具唾手可得，因为三十多年的经济改革几乎没有触及极权主义的基本制度。为了重新对中国社会实施严格控制，习近平可以调动政权强大的镇压机器，这台机器在天安门事件后的巨额投资和先进技术的帮助下得到了现代化和加强。为了重建强人统治，他可以利用反腐调查来清除政治对手，而这些对手大多因为卷入不法交易而变得脆弱。由于没有公民社会、法治或真正的“党内”民主，习近平在行使他新获得的权力时没有任何制度上的约束。只有随着习近平领导下的极权统治复辟，我们才能体会到邓小平在上世纪80年代坚决抵制政治改革的悲剧后果，当时通往更加开放自由的中国的道路还很狭窄。





The Xi Jinping Manifesto





习近平宣言


Before he rose to the pinnacle of power in November 2012, Xi was a consummate practitioner of "hiding your strength and biding your time," except that he applied this Dengist foreign policy strategy to politics within the CCP. Xi had carefully maintained a low profile and kept his ideas to himself. But once he attained supreme power, he wasted no time in articulating his vision. On a tour of Guangdong in December 2012, about one month after his appointment as party general secretary, he gave a speech to local officials on the greatest threats facing the party. Although the speech was never made public, its leaked content reveals a man whose political agenda had been decidedly shaped by the lessons he had drawn from the fall of the Soviet Union.

在2012年11月登上权力巅峰之前，习近平是一位“藏实力、伺机而动”的典范，只不过他将邓小平的这一外交策略运用到了中共内部政治。习近平一直小心翼翼地保持低调，很少公开表达自己的想法。但一旦掌握了最高权力，他便立即着手阐述自己的愿景。2012年12月，在他被任命为中共中央总书记约一个月后，习近平在广东视察期间，向地方官员发表了关于党面临的最大威胁的讲话。尽管这次讲话从未公开，但泄露的内容显示，习近平的政治纲领显然受到了苏联解体经验的影响。

Notably, Xi made no reference to the abysmal economic performance of the Soviet regime, its imperial overreach, or the Cold War with the United States. Instead, he attributed the collapse of the Soviet Union to the loss of "ideals and convictions" among its elites. He lamented that, when the Soviet Union was dissolved, "in the end nobody was a real man, nobody came out to resist," apparently forgetting about the failed coup staged by the hard-liners in August 1991. His choice of words—"real man"—was especially significant because it appeared to imply that Xi thought the Soviet regime was too soft and cowardly. Unlike Deng, who sent in the military to crush the prodemocracy movement in 1989, Soviet leaders were too squeamish to use mass violence against their own people.3

值得注意的是，习近平只字未提苏联政权糟糕的经济表现、其帝国扩张以及与美国的冷战。相反，他将苏联解体归咎于其精英阶层“理想和信念”的丧失。他感叹，苏联解体后，“最终没有真正的男子汉，没有人站出来反抗”，显然忘记了1991年8月强硬派发动的失败政变。他选择的“真正的男子汉”一词尤其耐人寻味，因为它似乎暗示习近平认为苏联政权过于软弱懦弱。与邓小平在1989年动用军队镇压民主运动不同，苏联领导人过于胆怯，不敢对本国人民使用大规模暴力。

These fragments of Xi's informal conversation with local officials in 2012 give us a glimpse of the two main components of his strategy to prevent the party from following the Soviet path: reviving ideological indoctrination within the regime and escalating repression against its opponents. On January 5, 2013, shortly after his trip to Guangdong, Xi delivered what appeared to be a political manifesto to new members of the CCP Central Committee at a special training class at the Central Party School in Beijing. Significantly, the party released only a brief summary of this speech in January 2013.4 It did not publish its full content until April 2019, most probably because the fuller version of Xi's speech not only signaled a fundamental deviation from Dengism but also because it unabashedly advocated views closely associated with ideological "ultra-leftism."5

这些习近平2012年与地方官员非正式谈话的片段，让我们得以窥见他防止党走苏联道路的两大战略组成部分：在政权内部恢复意识形态灌输，以及加大对反对派的镇压力度。2013年1月5日，在访问广东后不久，习近平在北京中央党校的一个特别培训班上，向新当选的中共中央委员发表了一份看似政治宣言的讲话。值得注意的是，中共在2013年1月仅发布了此次讲话的简短摘要。直到2019年4月，中共才公布了讲话全文，这很可能是因为习近平讲话的完整版本不仅标志着与邓小平思想的根本性背离，而且还毫不掩饰地宣扬了与意识形态上的“极左”密切相关的观点。

Xi's political manifesto, like the leaked content of his talk in Guangdong in December 2012, contained few references to the importance of economic development as the party's fundamental guiding principle. Instead, Xi reminded his audience that "socialism with Chinese characteristics" was socialism and not "other isms." This system, according to Xi, would demonstrate its superiority as it became more mature and allowed China to prosper and exercise more influence in the world. Xi also mentioned the Soviet collapse, albeit without impugning the "manhood" of the Soviet regime. Xi castigated "historical nihilism," which later became Xi's favorite phrase whenever he referred to any efforts to establish the historical truth. In his judgment, the Soviet regime had been negligent in controlling the ideological domain and allowing hostile forces to comprehensively "negate" Soviet history and the Soviet leaders, such as Lenin and Stalin, thus "causing confused thinking." He used the Soviet example to warn against "negating" the Maoist period. This section of his speech represented the strongest endorsement of Mao by a top Chinese leader in the post-Tiananmen era. It also signaled Xi's intention to tighten party control over the ideological sphere.

习近平的政治宣言，如同他2012年12月在广东的讲话泄露内容一样，很少提及经济发展作为党的根本指导原则的重要性。相反，习近平提醒听众，“中国特色社会主义”就是社会主义，而不是“其他主义”。习近平认为，随着这一制度的日趋成熟，它将展现其优越性，使中国繁荣昌盛，并在世界上发挥更大的影响力。习近平还提到了苏联解体，但并未质疑苏联政权的“男子气概”。习近平谴责了“历史虚无主义”，这后来成为他每次提及任何试图确立历史真相的努力时最常用的词汇。在他看来，苏联政权疏于控制意识形态领域，任由敌对势力全面“否定”苏联历史和列宁、斯大林等苏联领导人，从而“造成思想混乱”。他以苏联为例，警告人们不要“否定”毛泽东时代。他讲话的这一部分代表了后天安门时代中国最高领导人对毛泽东最强烈的支持。这也表明了习近平意图加强党对意识形态领域的控制。

Xi concluded his speech by underscoring the imperative to reinvigorate the regime's ideological commitment to communism as its ultimate goal. The loss of this goal, Xi warned, would lead the party astray ideologically, causing it to degenerate into "utilitarianism and pragmatism." He singled out the new ideological doubts, materialism, self-centeredness, passivity, and loss of faith in communism among party members as completely incompatible with the ideological values and historical mission of communism.

习近平在讲话结尾强调，必须重振政权对共产主义的意识形态承诺，将其作为最终目标。他警告说，失去这一目标将使党在意识形态上误入歧途，最终蜕变为“功利主义和实用主义”。他特别指出，党员中出现的新的意识形态怀疑、物质主义、自我中心主义、消极被动以及对共产主义失去信心等现象，与共产主义的意识形态价值观和历史使命完全背道而驰。

Unlike his predecessors, such as Jiang Zemin and Hu Jintao, who routinely recited Communist ideological clichés but seldom allowed them to dictate policy, Xi turned out to be a true believer who meant what he said. When the full text of this political manifesto was released in the party's flagship ideological publication, Qiushi, in April 2019, Xi had been in power for six and half years and had already succeeded in turning the abstract ideas expressed in the manifesto into actual policy. In retrospect, Xi's speech in January 2013 marked the return of orthodox ideology as the party's guiding principle and the end of an era during which the party's top leadership treated economic performance as vital to regime survival.6

与江泽民和胡锦涛等前任领导人不同，他们虽然经常背诵共产主义意识形态的陈词滥调，却很少让这些陈词滥调指导政策，而习近平则是一位言行一致的真正信徒。2019年4月，当这份政治宣言全文在党的旗舰意识形态刊物《求是》上发表时，习近平已经执政六年半，并成功地将宣言中表达的抽象理念转化为实际政策。回顾来看，习近平2013年1月的讲话标志着正统意识形态回归党的指导原则，也标志着党的最高领导层将经济表现视为政权存亡关键的时代的终结。

The specific components of the political order Xi envisioned in early 2013 and later constructed differed qualitatively from the post-Tiananmen neo-authoritarian order. Under Jiang and Hu, the party relied on a diverse set of tools to maintain elite unity and popular support at home and stable ties with the West abroad. In contrast, the new political order under Xi's rule rests on different pillars: centralized one-man rule built on personality cult, rule of fear through constant purges and repression, prioritization of regime security over economic performance, revival of orthodox ideology and political rituals, and an expansionist foreign policy reinforced by a triumphant nationalist narrative—"the China dream."7 As this new order relies on the regime's coercive apparatus more than mass movements, it resembles classic Stalinist bureaucratic totalitarian rule, not Maoist antibureaucratic totalitarian rule.8

习近平在2013年初构想并随后构建的政治秩序的具体组成部分，与天安门事件后的新威权秩序有着本质区别。在江泽民和胡锦涛的领导下，中共依靠多种手段来维护国内精英的团结和民众的支持，以及与西方国家保持稳定的外交关系。相比之下，习近平统治下的新政治秩序建立在不同的支柱之上：以个人崇拜为基础的中央集权式一人统治；通过持续不断的清洗和镇压来制造恐惧；将政权安全置于经济发展之上；复兴正统意识形态和政治仪式；以及以“中国梦”这一胜利的民族主义叙事为支撑的扩张主义外交政策。由于这一新秩序更多地依赖于政权的强制机器而非群众运动，因此它更类似于经典的斯大林式官僚极权统治，而非毛泽东式的反官僚极权统治。

Xi's neo-Stalinist agenda was ambitious, risky, and, around the time of his ascent to the top, apparently unpromising. As a compromise choice to succeed Hu, Xi was selected most likely because he was seen as a weak leader without an extensive network of powerful allies. Taking on the entrenched factions headed by Jiang and Hu could be dangerous because they had planted their supporters in key party positions during their two decades in power. Adopting more repressive tactics and reverting to statist economic policies would likely encounter resistance from below. Indeed, before Xi's formal appointment as party chief in late 2012, there was debate whether Xi was a closet reformer with a more liberal agenda than his predecessors.9 Only after his (manhood) talk about the fall of the Soviet Union was leaked in February 2013 did some begin to develop a sense of foreboding. Fears that Xi was taking the party in a more hard-line and anti-Western direction were reinforced when the leaked content of a key document issued by the General Office of the Central Committee in April—known as Document No. 9—received widespread attention (more on this later).10 By the summer of 2013, when Xi launched a massive crackdown on social media, it was clear that his neo-Stalinist project was well under way.11
