By comparison, investment by SOEs rose 18.7 and 10.1 percent, respectively, providing evidence that the deleveraging campaign was not having a negative impact on SOEs.86 Overall, the private sector's investment did not recover in the wake of the campaign. Official data show that private investment in fixed assets peaked at 58.9 percent of the total in 2014. In 2016, the first year of the deleveraging campaign, it fell to 56.3 percent. By 2019, the year before the pandemic, it accounted for 56.8 percent of total fixed asset investment.87

这一时期的投资数据更清晰地展现了习近平领导下私营部门的退缩趋势。在去杠杆化运动的高峰期——2016年和2017年，私营部门对固定资产的投资分别仅增长了2.8%和5.2%。相比之下，国有企业的投资分别增长了18.7%和10.1%，这表明去杠杆化运动并未对国有企业产生负面影响。总体而言，去杠杆化运动结束后，私营部门的投资并未恢复。官方数据显示，私营部门对固定资产的投资占比在2014年达到峰值，占总投资的58.9%。在去杠杆化运动的第一年——2016年，这一比例下降至56.3%。到疫情爆发前一年——2019年，这一比例为56.8%。

If major economic policies, such as "Made in China 2025" and the deleveraging campaign, hurt the private sector indirectly, the crackdown on the private sector that occurred in 2021 was fully motivated by political concerns. Prior to the Xi era, the party did not implement policies that would be seen as blatantly hostile to the private sector, even though the government consistently favored the SOEs. All this would change during Xi's second term.

如果说“中国制造2025”和去杠杆化运动等重大经济政策间接损害了私营部门，那么2021年对私营部门的打压则完全是出于政治考量。在习近平时代之前，尽管政府一贯偏袒国有企业，但中共并未推行任何被视为公然敌视私营部门的政策。这一切在习近平的第二个任期内发生了改变。

Xi's first shot signaling a major shift in the party's policy was the abrupt suspension of the Initial Public Offering (IPO) of a private firm, the Ant Group, on November 3, 2020 (the IPO was later cancelled). The Ant Group, a fintech company affiliated with the e-commerce giant Alibaba, was on course to raise a record $37 billion by listing its shares in Hong Kong and Shanghai. But on the eve of the IPO, Xi reportedly ordered that Chinese regulators scuttle the Ant Group's listing.88 One factor that allegedly drove Xi to intervene personally was the discovery that families of several senior retired officials were early investors in the group and would have reaped small fortunes if the IPO had gone ahead.89

习近平发出党的政策重大转变信号的第一击，是于2020年11月3日突然叫停了蚂蚁集团的首次公开募股（IPO）（该IPO后来被取消）。蚂蚁集团是一家与电商巨头阿里巴巴有关联的金融科技公司，原计划通过在香港和上海上市筹集创纪录的370亿美元资金。但在IPO前夕，据报道，习近平下令中国监管机构叫停蚂蚁集团的上市。据称，促使习近平亲自干预的一个因素是，他发现几位退休高级官员的家属是该集团的早期投资者，如果IPO成功，他们将获得巨额财富。

The real reason appears to be Xi's fears that the private sector could erode the party's control of a vital economic sector—the financial system. At a Politburo seminar on the digital economy on October 18, 2020, shortly before his intervention, Xi gave a speech emphasizing the need to "prevent the expansion of platform monopolies (such as Alibaba) and the disorderly expansion of capital."90 In retrospect, cancellation of the Ant Group IPO is not an isolated incident but rather the beginning of a concerted crackdown directed by Xi to rein in "the disorderly expansion of capital."

真正的原因似乎是习近平担心私营部门会削弱党对一个至关重要的经济部门——金融体系——的控制。在2020年10月18日举行的政治局数字经济研讨会上，就在他介入此事前不久，习近平发表讲话，强调要“防止平台垄断（如阿里巴巴）扩张和资本无序扩张”。事后看来，蚂蚁集团IPO的取消并非孤立事件，而是习近平指示开展的遏制“资本无序扩张”的全面打击的开端。

The campaign quickly claimed most of China's high-tech firms, in particular its e-commerce platform companies. After abandoning the IPO of the Ant Group, Alibaba was fined a record eighteen billion yuan in April 2021 for breaking antitrust regulations. Well-known tech giants, such as Tencent, Meituan, Baidu, Didi, JD.com, and others, were later ordered to pay huge fines for alleged violations of the antimonopoly law and data security regulations.91 But compared with those private firms providing after-school coaching services, these tech firms were far luckier. Xi's crackdown on the platform economy diminished their status and precipitated a plunge in their stock prices that destroyed $1.1 trillion in market value within two years.92 But they remained in business.

这场运动迅速席卷了中国大部分高科技企业，尤其是电商平台公司。在放弃蚂蚁集团IPO后，阿里巴巴于2021年4月因违反反垄断法规被处以创纪录的180亿元人民币罚款。腾讯、美团、百度、滴滴、京东等知名科技巨头随后也因涉嫌违反反垄断法和数据安全法规而被勒令支付巨额罚款。但与那些提供课后辅导服务的私营企业相比，这些科技公司要幸运得多。习近平对平台经济的打压削弱了它们的地位，并导致其股价暴跌，两年内市值蒸发了1.1万亿美元。但它们仍然得以继续运营。

By comparison, the after-school coaching industry, which had generated $100 billion in revenue annually, was completely wiped out after the government announced a nationwide ban on July 21, 2023. This crackdown, again allegedly carried out at the direction of Xi, was supposedly motivated by the government's desire to make the education playing field more equal. Because of fierce competition for slots in high-quality middle schools and prestigious universities, Chinese parents sent their children to after-school tutoring programs in hopes that they would then perform better on exams. Xi likely saw this industry as perpetuating inequality since only the well-off could afford the extra costs. However, his drastic solution—banning the entire industry as part of a program to reduce the students' academic burdens and their families' expenses for after-school tutoring—merely addressed the symptom of the problem but failed to deal with its root causes, that is, the inadequate supply of high-quality education and a culture obsessed with exams.93

相比之下，年收入高达1000亿美元的课外辅导行业在政府于2023年7月21日宣布全国取缔后彻底消失。据称，此次打击行动同样是在习近平的指示下进行的，其动机是政府希望创造一个更加公平的教育环境。由于优质中学和名牌大学的入学名额竞争激烈，中国家长纷纷将孩子送去课外辅导班，希望他们能在考试中取得更好的成绩。习近平可能认为这个行业加剧了不平等，因为只有富裕家庭才能负担得起额外的费用。然而，他采取的极端措施——取缔整个行业，以此减轻学生的学业负担和家庭的课外辅导支出——仅仅治标不治本，未能解决问题的根源，即优质教育供给不足和应试文化盛行。

This crackdown backfired disasterously. The draconian ban on an entire privately run industry was unprecedented in the post-Mao era. Overnight it destroyed a large number of private businesses and made hundreds of thousands of people working in the industry jobless. Most important, the crackdown was a wake-up call to private entrepreneurs that their property rights were totally insecure under CCP rule. The crackdown failed to achieve its objective as it merely drove the industry underground, raising the costs for parents and making access to after-school coaching even more unequal than before the crackdown.94

这次镇压行动适得其反，造成了灾难性的后果。对整个私营行业实施如此严厉的禁令，在后毛泽东时代是前所未有的。一夜之间，大量私营企业倒闭，数十万从业人员失业。更重要的是，这次镇压行动给私营企业家敲响了警钟，让他们意识到在中共统治下，他们的财产权完全得不到保障。镇压行动未能达到预期目的，反而迫使该行业转入地下，增加了家长的负担，使得课后辅导机会的分配比镇压前更加不均等。





The Covid Pandemic





新冠疫情


When the Covid-19 pandemic first surfaced in Wuhan in December 2019, the Chinese economy was already in a precarious state. The housing bubble was on the verge of its inevitable burst. Overall levels of debt were at record highs, limiting the government's ability to use credit-fueled investment to prop up growth. Although the economy managed to expand by 6.4 percent in 2019, this was 25 percent less than growth in 2012, the year Xi ascended to the top.95 But even this moderate rate of growth would be beyond reach in the wake of the pandemic. A combination of adverse factors after the spread of the Covid-19 pandemic was responsible for the economy's lackluster performance. The most obvious reason was the direct economic cost of the pandemic as lockdowns inflicted lasting economic damage. Ill-advised government policies—an inflexible zero-Covid policy and refusal to stimulate the economy with fiscal spending—caused needless pain throughout the period of the pandemic.

2019年12月新冠疫情在武汉爆发时，中国经济已岌岌可危。房地产泡沫濒临破裂，整体债务水平处于历史高位，限制了政府利用信贷驱动投资来提振经济增长的能力。尽管2019年中国经济实现了6.4%的增长，但仍比习近平上台执政的2012年低了25%。然而，疫情爆发后，即使是这样的温和增长速度也难以企及。新冠疫情蔓延后，一系列不利因素共同导致了经济表现低迷。最显而易见的原因是疫情带来的直接经济损失，封锁措施造成了持久的经济损害。政府不明智的政策——僵化的“零感染”政策以及拒绝通过财政支出刺激经济——在疫情期间造成了不必要的痛苦。

Unlike Western countries that provided substantial Covid relief to businesses and ordinary people immediately after the pandemic struck, Beijing offered no material relief either to businesses or to individuals. At least seven million small private businesses went bust in 2020 and 2021.96 To be fair, zero-Covid—the party's immediate response to the pandemic—was probably the correct policy in the early days of the pandemic, and it did succeed in containing the virus quickly and restoring most economic activities by the middle of 2020. However, when a more contagious variant—omicron—emerged at the end of 2021, zero-Covid proved to be both ineffective and prohibitively costly. Although nearly all countries gave up zero-Covid when omicron morphed into the dominant strain, China doubled down in 2022. It enforced population-wide tests and imposed lengthy lockdowns on entire cities. In September 2022, for example, more than 300 million people in over seventy cities were under full or partial lockdown.97

与疫情爆发后立即向企业和民众提供大量新冠救助的西方国家不同，北京并未向企业或个人提供任何实质性援助。2020年和2021年，至少有700万家小型私营企业倒闭。平心而论，中共最初应对疫情的“零新冠”政策在疫情初期或许是正确的，它确实成功地迅速控制了病毒传播，并在2020年中期恢复了大部分经济活动。然而，当一种传染性更强的变种——奥密克戎毒株——在2021年底出现时，“零新冠”政策被证明既无效又代价高昂。尽管几乎所有国家在奥密克戎毒株演变为主要毒株后都放弃了“零新冠”政策，但中国在2022年却加倍投入。它实施了全民检测，并对整个城市实施了长时间的封锁。例如，2022年9月，超过70个城市的3亿多人处于全部或部分封锁状态。

Shanghai, the country's largest city with a population of over twenty-two million under lockdown from March to May in 2022, became China's most prominent victim of the zero-Covid policy. The primary reason for the party's continuation of this policy even after its ineffectiveness became abundantly clear is almost certainly Xi's own personal political interest. The strongman was seeking a norm-busting third term as CCP chief at the Twentieth Party Congress scheduled for the fall of 2022. Worried that an uncontrollable outbreak of infections ahead of the congress would dent his image and mar an important political event designed to establish his open-ended rule, Xi had compelling incentives to demand that local party officials continue to enforce zero-Covid regardless of the costs. This argument is supported by the fact that Xi decided to abandon the policy suddenly at the end of November—one month after the conclusion of the Twentieth Party Congress. Although the spread of antilockdown protests likely made Xi act sooner than he had originally planned, zero-Covid was no longer critical to him after the congress duly handed him a third term and allowed him to pack the Politburo with loyalists.98

上海是中国最大的城市，拥有超过2200万人口，在2022年3月至5月期间实施了封城，成为中国“清零”政策最显著的受害者。即便该政策的无效性已昭然若揭，中共仍然继续推行，其主要原因几乎可以肯定是习近平的个人政治利益。这位强人正寻求在2022年秋季召开的中共二十大上打破常规，连任中共总书记第三个任期。习近平担心，在党代会召开前夕，疫情一旦失控，将损害他的形象，并破坏这场旨在确立其无限期统治的重要政治盛会。因此，他有强烈的动机要求地方党政官员不惜一切代价继续执行“清零”政策。习近平在11月底——也就是中共二十大闭幕一个月后——突然决定放弃该政策，也印证了这一论点。尽管反封锁抗议活动的蔓延可能迫使习近平比原计划更早采取行动，但在党代会顺利赋予他第三个任期并允许他将亲信安插到政治局之后，清零疫情对他来说已不再至关重要。

The damage caused by Xi's zero-Covid policy is both measurable and incalculable at the same time. Despite the party's claim that this strategy kept China's Covid-related fatalities among the lowest in the world, researchers estimate that as many as 1.87 million excess deaths in China occurred among individuals thirty years and older during the first two months after the end of its zero-Covid policy.99 This is more than the total number of deaths (1.158 million) attributed to Covid-19 in the United States as of December 2023 (China has a population more than four times that of the United States).100 Due to disruptions caused by the zero-Covid lockdowns, the Chinese economy grew only 2.9 percent in 2022, marking the slowest growth in the post-Mao era and well below the official target of 5.5 percent. The invisible damage to the policy includes the loss of confidence among private entrepreneurs and foreign investors in CCP competence. The party's headstrong insistence on zero-Covid despite its ineffectiveness and mounting economic toll is a painful reminder that the narrow political interests of the Chinese regime and its personalistic ruler will always outweigh economic considerations. The one-two punch of Russia's invasion of Ukraine and the nationwide economic disruptions attributed to Xi's zero-Covid policy likely accelerated foreign investors' plans to diversify their supply chains away from China so as to reduce exposure to potential geopolitical black swan events. For domestic private entrepreneurs, the party's behavior during the pandemic reinforced a desire to seek safe havens outside of China for their assets and themselves. About twenty-five thousand "high-net-worth" Chinese reportedly emigrated in 2022 and 2023.101

习近平的“清零”政策造成的损害既可衡量又不可估量。尽管中共声称该策略使中国新冠肺炎死亡率保持在世界最低水平之列，但研究人员估计，在“清零”政策结束后的头两个月，中国30岁及以上人群的超额死亡人数高达187万。这一数字超过了截至2023年12月美国新冠肺炎死亡总人数（115.8万）（中国人口是美国的四倍多）。由于“清零”封锁措施造成的经济中断，中国经济在2022年仅增长2.9%，创下后毛泽东时代最低增速，远低于5.5%的官方目标。该政策造成的隐性损害还包括私营企业家和外国投资者对中共执政能力的信心下降。尽管疫情防控措施收效甚微且造成日益严重的经济损失，但中共仍一意孤行地坚持“清零”政策，这令人痛心地提醒我们，中国政权及其个人主义领导人的狭隘政治利益永远凌驾于经济考量之上。俄罗斯入侵乌克兰以及习近平“清零”政策导致的全国性经济混乱，很可能加速了外国投资者将供应链从中国转移出去的计划，以降低潜在地缘政治“黑天鹅”事件的风险。对于国内私营企业家而言，中共在疫情期间的行为更加强化了他们寻求海外避险的愿望，以保障自身和资产的安全。据报道，2022年和2023年约有2.5万名“高净值”中国人移居海外。

After it abandoned the zero-Covid policy in December 2022, the party hoped that the economy would bounce back. But despite an initial robust recovery in early 2023, growth stalled as the real estate crisis deepened. Given its size, the burst of the real estate bubble was obviously the most important factor leading to China's economic underperformance in 2023. In addition to registering lower than expected growth in 2023, the Chinese economy continued to struggle in 2024, weighed down by deflation, exodus of foreign firms, escalating trade tensions, and further deterioration in the collapsing real estate sector.

2022年12月放弃“零新增”政策后，中共曾寄希望于经济能够反弹。然而，尽管2023年初经济出现强劲复苏，但随着房地产危机的加剧，增长势头随即停滞。鉴于其规模之大，房地产泡沫破裂显然是导致中国2023年经济表现不佳的最重要因素。除了2023年增速低于预期外，中国经济在2024年继续举步维艰，受到通缩、外资撤离、贸易紧张局势升级以及房地产行业进一步崩盘等诸多因素的拖累。





Summary





概括


In retrospect, the end of the Chinese "economic miracle," which coincided with the Covid pandemic, is largely due to the many policy failures that preceded Xi's rise. Topping the list is the failure to undertake genuine reforms to correct macroeconomic imbalances. Such reforms would have entailed increasing real household income by providing more social services and protection. But because the party during the Hu era made at most modest progress in increasing social spending, the macroeconomic imbalances remained uncorrected, and thus they continued unabated into the Xi era.

回望过去，中国“经济奇迹”的终结（恰逢新冠疫情爆发）很大程度上归咎于习近平上台前诸多政策的失误。其中最主要的问题是未能进行真正意义上的改革来纠正宏观经济失衡。此类改革本应通过提供更多社会服务和保障来提高居民实际收入。但由于胡锦涛执政时期党在增加社会支出方面进展甚微，宏观经济失衡问题始终未能得到纠正，并延续到了习近平时代。

The party created an unprecedented credit bubble that began in 2009 and reached a dangerous magnitude by 2023, as described earlier in this chapter. Even though Xi implemented a deleveraging campaign in 2016, it achieved only modest results and had to be abandoned in mid-2018 in response to the US-China trade war. Consequently, the bubble grew so big that, when zero-Covid ended in December 2022, another major infusion of credit was not feasible as it would have raised the level of debt even higher and elevated the risks of a financial crisis.

如本章前文所述，中共制造了一个前所未有的信贷泡沫，该泡沫始于2009年，并在2023年达到了危险的规模。尽管习近平在2016年推行了去杠杆化运动，但收效甚微，并于2018年中期因中美贸易战而被迫中止。因此，泡沫膨胀至如此之大，以至于在2022年12月新冠疫情结束后，再次大规模注入信贷已不可行，因为这将进一步推高债务水平，并加剧金融危机的风险。

Similarly, the party relied too heavily on the real estate sector to drive growth during the early part of Xi's first term, as shown by the double-digit increase of investment in real estate from 2013 to 2015.102 Even after Xi grew concerned about the excessively high housing prices and ordered measures to cool down the sector in 2016, the party was unable to prevent a further expansion of the housing bubble. When the government finally ordered a crackdown in the summer of 2020, not only was the timing inauspicious (in the middle of the pandemic), but the cure also turned out to be too harsh. Instead of a soft landing, the crackdown precipitated a crash.

同样，在习近平第一任期初期，中共过度依赖房地产行业来推动经济增长，2013年至2015年房地产投资两位数的增长就证明了这一点。即使在习近平对过高的房价感到担忧，并在2016年下令采取措施给房地产行业降温之后，中共也未能阻止房地产泡沫的进一步膨胀。当政府最终在2020年夏季下令整顿房地产市场时，不仅时机不当（正值疫情期间），而且整顿措施也过于严厉。整顿非但没有带来软着陆，反而加速了经济的崩溃。

In addition to these policy mistakes, the Xi regime was less fortunate than its predecessors because most of the favorable structural factors that had earlier produced the Chinese economic miracle had either disappeared or become less favorable. The year that Xi ascended to the top, 2012, is likely to be remembered as China's "Lewis Turning Point"—an exhaustion in the supply of rural surplus labor.103 Rising labor costs made China less competitive in low-end manufacturing, and Chinese society was beginning to age rapidly, increasing healthcare and pension expenditures. Because the Hu regime did not privatize the inefficient SOEs or push through meaningful reforms to improve the overall efficiency of the economy, productivity growth was stalling, and it would completely collapse under Xi.

除了这些政策失误之外，习近平政权比其前任政权更加不幸，因为此前推动中国经济奇迹的大多数有利结构性因素要么已经消失，要么变得不再有利。习近平上台的2012年很可能被视为中国的“路易斯转折点”——农村剩余劳动力供给枯竭。劳动力成本上升导致中国在低端制造业的竞争力下降，同时中国社会开始快速老龄化，医疗和养老支出不断增加。由于胡锦涛政权没有对效率低下的国有企业进行私有化改革，也没有推进任何实质性的改革来提高经济的整体效率，生产率增长停滞不前，并在习近平执政期间彻底崩溃。

China's external environment became less favorable at the end of the Hu era mostly because of the country's increasing assertiveness in international affairs and Beijing's resistance to addressing the concerns of its Western trading partners about unfair trading practices. After Xi implemented an even more aggressive foreign policy during his first term, it became increasingly difficult for the West to sustain its decades-long policy of engagement. But it was Donald Trump's trade war in 2018 that marked the beginning of the end of China's economic integration with the West. As the Sino-American relationship turned progressively adversarial, the commercial relationship unraveled quickly. The trade war would escalate and morph into an economic cold war covering technology transfers and investments. However reluctant they were initially, after the Russian invasion of Ukraine in early 2022 America's allies in Europe and Japan fell in line and implemented measures to restrict the flow of technology to China and to actively pursue "derisking," or to reduce substantially their economic linkages with China. If globalization helped create the Chinese economic miracle, the reversal of globalization, which is certain to accelerate during the second Trump administration, will unavoidably weaken the Chinese economy and darken its prospects.

胡锦涛时代末期，中国的外部环境变得不利，这主要是因为中国在国际事务中日益强硬，以及北京拒绝解决西方贸易伙伴对不公平贸易行为的担忧。习近平在其第一个任期内实施了更为强硬的外交政策后，西方维持其数十年的接触政策变得越来越困难。但真正标志着中国与西方经济一体化走向终结的是2018年唐纳德·特朗普发起的贸易战。随着中美关系日益敌对，经贸关系迅速瓦解。贸易战不断升级，最终演变为一场涵盖技术转让和投资的经济冷战。尽管最初并不情愿，但在2022年初俄罗斯入侵乌克兰后，美国的欧洲和日本盟友最终还是屈服了，采取措施限制技术流向中国，并积极推行“去风险化”，即大幅削减与中国的经济联系。如果说全球化帮助创造了中国的经济奇迹，那么全球化的逆转（在特朗普第二任期内肯定会加速）将不可避免地削弱中国经济，并使其前景黯淡。





8 From Engagement to a New Cold War





8 从接触到新冷战


AS IS THE case with its domestic political developments, China's relations with the outside world, in particular the West, went through three distinct phases in the post-Mao period. Chinese power, the overall geopolitical environment, and the ideological values and leadership skills of the top leadership shaped Beijing's foreign policy and its ties with the West during each phase. Despite the substantive differences in Chinese foreign policy and its relations with the West in these three phases, the underlying logic of path dependence connects all of them. The prospects of engagement and even full integration with the West were the brightest in the 1980s when the possibility of a more open and free China was the greatest. Such prospects dimmed but did not disappear completely in the post-Tiananmen era, because of both the effectiveness of China's strategic restraint and the West's optimistic bet on globalization. But engagement became untenable once totalitarian rule was revived under Xi Jinping, as China started asserting its power and directly challenging the US-led order.

与国内政治发展一样，中国与外部世界，特别是与西方的关系，在后毛泽东时代经历了三个截然不同的阶段。在每个阶段，中国的实力、整体地缘政治环境以及最高领导层的意识形态价值观和领导能力都塑造了北京的外交政策及其与西方的关系。尽管中国外交政策及其与西方的关系在这三个阶段存在实质性差异，但路径依赖的内在逻辑将它们联系在一起。20世纪80年代，中国开放自由的可能性最大，与西方接触乃至全面融合的前景最为光明。天安门事件后，由于中国战略克制的有效性以及西方对全球化的乐观预期，这种前景有所减弱但并未完全消失。然而，随着习近平领导下极权统治的复兴，中国开始展现自身实力并直接挑战美国主导的国际秩序，这种接触变得难以维系。

The first phase, from 1979 to June 1989, was the "golden age" of relations between China and the West. Devastated by three decades of economic mismanagement and political chaos under Maoist rule, in 1979 China was an impoverished nation that posed no real military threat to the West. Geopolitically, both China and the West saw the Soviet Union as the primary security threat. Ideologically, Deng Xiaoping's pro-market reforms gained enthusiastic support in the West because his efforts represented a decisive break with communism. Despite Deng's avowed adherence to one-party rule, his regime presented an enticing opportunity to change China for the better and thus was worth a strategic bet.

第一阶段，即1979年至1989年6月，是中西方关系的“黄金时代”。1979年，中国经历了毛泽东统治下长达三十年的经济管理不善和政治混乱，经济衰退，对西方构不成真正的军事威胁。在地缘政治上，中西方都将苏联视为主要安全威胁。在意识形态上，邓小平的市场改革在西方获得了热烈支持，因为他的努力标志着与共产主义的决裂。尽管邓小平公开坚持一党专政，但他的政权为中国带来了改变的契机，因此值得西方进行战略押注。

A consummate pragmatist, Deng radically reoriented Chinese foreign policy to place it in the service of domestic economic development. By skillfully leveraging China's favorable geopolitical position, he cultivated friendly and economically beneficial ties with the United States and Japan, the two countries whose support would be indispensable to his "reform and opening." Although Deng's foreign policy would tie China's economic destiny to the West, he had no intention of becoming part of the West-led system. He viewed integration as the sole viable tactic for ensuring the party's survival and for restoring China to its place in the world. Steeped in geopolitical realism, Deng was convinced that only national strength could guarantee Chinese security and CCP rule. However, he believed that at the end of the Maoist era, China was not strong enough to safeguard either objective. If China succeeded in modernizing with the help of the West, in his view, the growth of Chinese power over time would improve the country's geopolitical position. Even though he was not explicitly thinking of confronting the West, Deng's grand strategy of building up strength with Western support and not being part of the West would sow seeds of conflict decades later, after his grand strategy had actually achieved its objective.

邓小平是一位务实的实干家，他彻底调整了中国的外交政策，使其服务于国内经济发展。他巧妙地利用中国有利的地缘政治位置，与美国和日本——这两个对他的“改革开放”至关重要的国家——建立了友好且互惠互利的经济关系。尽管邓小平的外交政策将中国的经济命运与西方紧密相连，但他无意成为西方主导体系的一部分。他认为融入西方是确保党的生存和恢复中国世界地位的唯一可行策略。深受地缘政治现实主义影响的邓小平坚信，只有国家实力才能保障中国的安全和中共的统治。然而，他认为在毛泽东时代末期，中国的实力不足以维护这两个目标。在他看来，如果中国在西方的帮助下成功实现现代化，随着时间的推移，中国国力的增长将提升中国的地缘政治地位。尽管邓小平并没有明确地考虑与西方对抗，但他依靠西方支持增强实力而不加入西方的宏伟战略，在几十年后，也就是他的宏伟战略实际上实现其目标之后，埋下了冲突的种子。

The crushing of the prodemocracy movement in June 1989 and the collapse of the Soviet Union in December 1991 fundamentally redefined Beijing's relations with the West and necessitated substantial adjustments to Chinese foreign policy. During the post-Tiananmen era, the two critical factors—China's status as a strategic partner of the West in an anti-Soviet common cause and muted ideological distaste for CCP autocratic rule—disappeared. The Tiananmen crackdown revealed the ideological chasm between China and the West, and it would make Chinese human rights a key issue for the West. Practically overnight, the end of the Cold War in 1991 downgraded China's geopolitical importance to the West.

1989年6月民主运动的镇压和1991年12月苏联的解体从根本上重塑了北京与西方的关系，并迫使中国外交政策做出重大调整。在后天安门时代，两个关键因素——中国作为西方在反苏共同事业中的战略伙伴的地位，以及西方对中共专制统治的意识形态上的淡漠——不复存在。天安门事件暴露了中西方之间的意识形态鸿沟，并使中国的人权问题成为西方关注的焦点。几乎在一夜之间，1991年冷战的结束降低了中国对西方的地缘政治重要性。

The West's sanctions against China following the Tiananmen crackdown and its triumph over the Soviet Union directly gave rise to a grim view of the emerging West-led world order in Beijing. If a bipolar world order in the 1980s served Chinese interests by allowing China ample space to maneuver between two opposing camps, a unipolar world order under American dominance was decidedly not in Chinese interests. It was in the early 1990s that Deng began to explicitly and consistently express opposition to the West-led order and to voice China's desire to change it. However, as China was too weak to challenge the post-Cold War order for most of the post-1989 era, its grand strategy was to avoid a self-defeating clash with the West, buy time, and build up strength to better protect its national interests.

天安门事件后西方对中国的制裁以及中国战胜苏联，直接导致北京对新兴的西方主导的世界秩序感到悲观。如果说20世纪80年代的两极世界秩序为中国提供了在两个对立阵营之间周旋的充足空间，符合中国的利益，那么美国主导的单极世界秩序则显然不符合中国的利益。20世纪90年代初，邓小平开始明确且持续地表达对西方主导秩序的反对，并表达了中国改变这一秩序的愿望。然而，由于在1989年后的绝大部分时间里，中国实力不足以挑战后冷战时代的秩序，其总体战略是避免与西方发生自取灭亡的冲突，争取时间，积蓄力量，以便更好地维护自身国家利益。

Despite incipient worries about growing Chinese power and constant tensions over its human rights record, the West adopted a policy of engagement with strategic hedging. Under this policy, economic and diplomatic engagement with China continued, with the implicit goal of integrating China into the post-Cold War order and becoming a stakeholder that would share the benefits of an inclusive order. At the same time, the United States would maintain a robust military presence and security alliances along China's periphery as insurance policies.

尽管西方对中国日益增长的实力以及其人权记录引发的持续紧张局势有所担忧，但西方仍采取了接触与战略对冲相结合的政策。在该政策下，西方继续与中国开展经济和外交接触，其隐含目标是将中国纳入后冷战时代的国际秩序，使其成为能够分享包容性秩序利益的利益攸关方。与此同时，美国则在中国周边地区维持强大的军事存在和安全联盟，作为一项保障措施。

Jiang Zemin implemented Deng's strategy effectively. Ironically, however, the very success of the policy, especially in gaining the time and space necessary to amass national power, also made conflict more likely. As China's growing clout boosted its leaders' confidence and ambitions, Deng's dictum on strategic caution gradually lost its power of restraint. The initial, albeit subtle, break with the post-Tiananmen foreign policy of strategic caution occurred under the leadership of Hu Jintao in the wake of the 2008 global financial crisis. Convinced that China could find the right balance between strategic caution and strategic activism, Hu and his colleagues embarked on a new course to probe the soft spots in the West-led order and test its response to Chinese actions.

江泽民有效地贯彻了邓小平的战略。然而，具有讽刺意味的是，这项政策的成功，尤其是在为积累国家实力争取时间和空间方面，也增加了冲突发生的可能性。随着中国日益增长的影响力增强了其领导人的信心和野心，邓小平关于战略谨慎的原则逐渐失去了约束力。在2008年全球金融危机之后，胡锦涛领导下的中国外交政策与天安门事件后奉行的战略谨慎政策出现了最初但较为微妙的决裂。胡锦涛及其同僚坚信中国能够在战略谨慎和战略积极之间找到合适的平衡点，于是他们开始探索西方主导的国际秩序中的薄弱环节，并试探其对中国行动的反应。

Although the initial abandonment of strategic caution occurred in the waning years of the Hu era, the rise of Xi Jinping at the end of 2012 marked a decisive break with China's post-Tiananmen grand strategy. To be sure, Deng's ultimate objectives of strategic caution—safeguarding one-party rule and restoring China's status as a great power—did not differ from those of Xi. But Xi misjudged Chinese strength, set overly ambitious objectives, embraced excessively risky and confrontational tactics, and underestimated the US resolve and response.

尽管战略谨慎原则的放弃最初发生在胡锦涛时代的末期，但习近平在2012年底的崛起标志着中国与后天安门时代大战略的决裂。诚然，邓小平战略谨慎原则的最终目标——维护一党专政、恢复中国大国地位——与习近平的目标并无二致。但习近平误判了中国的实力，设定了过于雄心勃勃的目标，采取了过于冒险和对抗性的策略，并且低估了美国的决心和反应。

Inspired mostly by domestic political considerations, the trade war Donald Trump launched in early 2018 quickly triggered a cascade of actions and reactions that in short order led to a complete rupture of Sino-American relations. As the confrontation between the two countries escalated, Xi made the fateful strategic decision to align with Russia to counter American power. But Russia's invasion of Ukraine in February 2022 drove the European nations, most of which probably would have preferred neutrality in the Sino-US conflict, into the arms of the United States.

2018年初，唐纳德·特朗普发起的贸易战主要出于国内政治考量，迅速引发了一系列连锁反应，并在短时间内导致中美关系彻底破裂。随着两国对抗升级，习近平做出了与俄罗斯结盟以对抗美国实力的重大战略决策。然而，2022年2月俄罗斯入侵乌克兰，迫使原本可能倾向于在中美冲突中保持中立的欧洲国家倒向了美国。

The outcome has been a full-fledged new cold war (NCW). Ideologically, China is aligned with the major autocratic regimes, such as Russia and Iran, which share its opposition to the US-led order that threatens Chinese regime security and its vital security interests. Economically, China and the West have begun a costly and complex process of severing the trade, technological, and financial ties that had been forged during the prior four decades of engagement. Militarily, the United States and China have accelerated preparations for a direct conflict in the Taiwan Strait and the South China Sea.

其结果是新冷战全面爆发。在意识形态上，中国与俄罗斯和伊朗等主要专制政权结盟，这些政权同样反对以美国为主导的、威胁中国政权安全及其重大安全利益的国际秩序。在经济上，中国和西方已经开始着手切断过去四十年间建立的贸易、技术和金融联系，而这一过程代价高昂且错综复杂。在军事上，中美两国加快了在台湾海峡和南海发生直接冲突的准备。





Birth of Engagement





订婚的诞生


When Mao died in September 1976, the dictator bequeathed to China a relatively favorable external environment following the Sino-American rapprochement that he and Richard Nixon had engineered in 1971-1972.1 By the time of his death, China and the United States were quasi-allies in their common cause against the Soviet Union. Beijing had reclaimed Chinese membership in the United Nations and held a veto-wielding permanent seat on its Security Council. China had also restored diplomatic relations with most Western countries. Although the Cold War would not end for another decade and a half, by the mid-1970s the cold war between China and the West was effectively over. For a country isolated from the capitalist world for nearly three decades, friendly relations with the economically dominant West was a precondition for its reintegration into the global economy and economic modernization.

1976年9月毛泽东逝世时，这位独裁者为中国留下了一个相对有利的外部环境。这得益于他与尼克松在1971-1972年间促成的中美关系缓和。在他逝世之时，中美两国在对抗苏联的共同事业中已成为准盟友。北京重新获得了联合国成员国资格，并在安理会拥有一个拥有否决权的常任理事国席位。中国也与大多数西方国家恢复了外交关系。尽管冷战还要持续十五年才会结束，但到20世纪70年代中期，中美之间的冷战实际上已经结束。对于一个与资本主义世界隔绝了近三十年的国家而言，与经济上占主导地位的西方建立友好关系是其重新融入全球经济和实现经济现代化的先决条件。

After Deng became de facto paramount leader in December 1978 and launched his "reform and opening," China's external environment would improve even more dramatically. The tensions between the Soviet Union and the West escalated after the former invaded Afghanistan at the end of 1979. Because Deng embarked on a path toward capitalism, the West had additional incentives to cultivate ties with China. The economic potential of a market of nearly one billion people was too enticing to ignore, despite China's low level of development. Ideologically, Deng's "reform and opening" was worth supporting because it represented a great leap forward from Mao's totalitarianism and could lead to more personal freedoms and even political openness.

1978年12月邓小平成为事实上的最高领导人并启动“改革开放”后，中国的外部环境将得到更加显著的改善。1979年底苏联入侵阿富汗后，苏联与西方之间的紧张关系加剧。由于邓小平走上了资本主义道路，西方更有动力与中国发展关系。尽管中国当时的发展水平较低，但拥有近十亿人口的市场所带来的经济潜力实在难以忽视。从意识形态上看，邓小平的“改革开放”值得支持，因为它标志着中国从毛泽东时代的极权主义向前迈出了一大步，并有可能带来更多的个人自由乃至政治开放。

Besides these favorable factors, Deng's positive assessment of China's external environment and near-total influence over foreign policy reinforced his determination to seize this historic opportunity to advance his agenda of "opening." In January 1980 he articulated the essence of his strategy of "biding your time and building your strength," even though he did not use these exact words in a talk to senior leaders. "Of all our tasks," Deng said, "modernization is . . . the essential condition for solving both our domestic and our external problems. . . . The role we play in international affairs is determined by the extent of our economic growth. If our country becomes more developed and prosperous, we will be in a position to play a greater role in international affairs. . . . In the final analysis, the return of Taiwan . . . depends on our running our affairs at home well."2

除了这些有利因素外，邓小平对中国外部环境的积极评估以及他对外交政策近乎完全的掌控，更加坚定了他抓住这一历史机遇、推进“对外开放”议程的决心。1980年1月，他阐述了“静待时机，积蓄力量”战略的精髓，尽管他在与高层领导人的谈话中并未直接使用这些措辞。邓小平说：“在我们所有的任务中，现代化……是解决我们国内外问题的根本条件……我们在国际事务中扮演的角色取决于我们经济增长的程度。如果我们的国家更加发达繁荣，我们就能够在国际事务中发挥更大的作用……归根结底，台湾的回归……取决于我们能否把国内事务处理好。”

However effusive he might have sounded about the importance of opening, Deng did not envision China becoming part of the West-led international order. He saw this order as something China could exploit profitably, but he said nothing about accepting the values and rules embodied in it. Indeed, Deng's opening was transactional and restricted primarily to economic relations. From his perspective, China would take advantage of the economic benefits of the West-led order but would remain independent of it in all other aspects.

尽管邓小平对开放的重要性表达了极大的热情，但他并未设想中国会融入西方主导的国际秩序。他认为中国可以从这一秩序中获利，但他从未表示会接受其中蕴含的价值观和规则。事实上，邓小平的开放是交易性的，主要局限于经济关系。在他看来，中国将利用西方主导的秩序带来的经济利益，但在其他所有方面都将保持独立。

For Deng's "developmental diplomacy" to succeed, he needed first to dramatically improve ties with the United States and Japan, the world's two largest economies, which could provide China with more access to capital, technology, and markets than any other country.3 Gaining the support of the United States as part of Deng's "reform and opening" was critical because the US stance on China could also influence the position of its allies. In the case of Japan, its geographic proximity to China made it an even more promising trading partner and investor than the United States. Therefore, Deng took personal charge of these two vital diplomatic tasks in 1978, even before he effectively became paramount leader in December of that year.

邓小平的“发展外交”要想取得成功，首先需要大幅改善与美国和日本这两个世界最大经济体的关系，因为这两个国家能够为中国提供比其他任何国家都多的资金、技术和市场。争取美国的支持是邓小平“改革开放”战略的关键组成部分，因为美国对华立场也会影响其盟友的立场。就日本而言，由于其地理位置靠近中国，因此比美国更有潜力成为中国的贸易伙伴和投资来源。因此，早在1978年12月正式成为最高领导人之前，邓小平就亲自负责这两项至关重要的外交任务。

Although the visit by Richard Nixon in February 1972 initiated the US-China strategic rapprochement, disagreement over the Taiwan issue prevented the two countries from normalizing diplomatic relations. The United States was seeking a form of normalization with the People's Republic of China without derecognizing the Republic of China (ROC), a position Beijing emphatically rejected. Washington and Beijing were essentially deadlocked over the Taiwan issue until late 1978, when President Jimmy Carter signaled that the United States could meet China's three conditions: severing official ties with the ROC, withdrawing US troops from Taiwan, and abrogating the US-ROC mutual defense treaty. At the most critical stage in the Sino-American normalization talks in mid-December 1978, Deng personally participated in the negotiations and made a key concession by tacitly agreeing to continued US arms sales to Taiwan despite his vocal opposition.4 On December 16 the United States and China released a joint communiqué announcing the normalization of diplomatic relations.5

尽管1972年2月尼克松访华开启了美中战略关系缓和的进程，但两国在台湾问题上的分歧阻碍了外交关系正常化。美国寻求在不否认中华民国（中华民国）的前提下，与中华民国实现关系正常化，而北京对此断然拒绝。华盛顿和北京在台湾问题上基本上陷入僵局，直到1978年底，美国总统吉米·卡特表示，美国可以满足中国提出的三个条件：断绝与中华民国的官方关系、从台湾撤军以及废除美中华民国共同防御条约。 1978年12月中旬，中美关系正常化谈判进入最关键阶段，邓小平亲自参与谈判，并做出了一项关键让步，尽管他曾公开反对，但最终还是默许了美国继续向台湾出售武器。12月16日，中美发表联合公报，宣布两国关系正常化。

To be sure, the United States and China did not resolve their fundamental differences over the status of Taiwan, but the "one China policy" that the United States formulated and later modified largely struck the right balance between reassuring Beijing and deterring reunification through military means. The Taiwan issue would become more complicated and more volatile in the 1990s after pro-independence political forces gained greater influence on the island, but in the 1980s China and the United States managed their differences over Taiwan skillfully and cooperatively.

诚然，中美两国并未就台湾地位问题达成根本共识，但美国制定并后经修改的“一个中国政策”在很大程度上平衡了安抚北京与以武力阻止统一之间的关系。20世纪90年代，随着台独势力在台湾岛内影响力的增强，台湾问题变得更加复杂和动荡，但在20世纪80年代，中美两国巧妙而合作地管控了在台湾问题上的分歧。

When the ink on the Sino-American communiqué normalizing relations was barely dry, Deng embarked on a weeklong historic visit to the United States at the end of January 1979 to cement the Sino-American partnership. In addition to specific agreements signed during his trip, Deng succeeded in winning over both the American political establishment and the American public with his style of straight talk and friendly gestures (including donning a cowboy hat during a rodeo in Houston).6

中美关系正常化联合公报墨迹未干，邓小平便于1979年1月底对美国展开为期一周的历史性访问，以巩固中美伙伴关系。除了访问期间签署的具体协议外，邓小平还以其直言不讳的风格和友好的姿态（包括在休斯顿观看牛仔竞技表演时戴上牛仔帽）成功赢得了美国政界和公众的认可。

Normalization of Sino-American relations in general, and Deng's successful visit to the United States in 1979 in particular, ushered in a golden era of relations between the two countries. Prior to normalization, their commercial relations were negligible, with two-way trade in 1978 totaling $1.1 billion.7 But by 1989 bilateral trade had risen to nearly $17 billion.8 The rapid expansion of trade was made possible because the United States granted China "most-favored-nation" (MFN) trade status following the "Agreement on Trade Relations between the United States of America and the People's Republic of China," which was signed in July 1979 and became effective on February 1, 1980. (China's MFN status was subject to annual renewal by the US president.)9

中美关系的正常化，尤其是邓小平1979年对美国的成功访问，开启了两国关系的黄金时代。在关系正常化之前，两国经贸关系微乎其微，1978年双边贸易额仅为11亿美元。但到1989年，双边贸易额已增长至近170亿美元。贸易的快速增长得益于美国根据1979年7月签署、1980年2月1日生效的《美利坚合众国与中华人民共和国贸易关系协定》给予中国“最惠国待遇”（MFN）。（中国的最惠国待遇需由美国总统每年续签。）

Cooperation in science and technology also blossomed after the January 31, 1979, signing of the US-China Agreement on Scientific and Technological Cooperation. Based on the agreement's framework, the two countries reached a series of separate deals covering specific areas, such as agriculture, civilian nuclear energy, and aerospace. The United States also significantly relaxed export controls and even allowed the export of defensive military technologies to China.10 Regular high-level exchanges further solidified the Sino-American partnership in the 1980s. Top American leaders paid frequent visits to China. In April 1984 President Ronald Reagan visited China after hosting Premier Zhao Ziyang three months earlier. George H. W. Bush made China a stop on his trip to East Asia in February 1989, shortly after becoming president. Frequent cabinet-level exchanges also took place between the two countries.11

1979年1月31日，中美签署了《中美科技合作协定》，此后，两国在科技领域的合作蓬勃发展。根据该协定的框架，两国在农业、民用核能和航空航天等领域达成了一系列具体协议。美国还大幅放宽了出口管制，甚至允许向中国出口国防军事技术。20世纪80年代，两国高层频繁互访进一步巩固了中美伙伴关系。美国高级领导人频繁访问中国。1984年4月，美国总统罗纳德·里根访问中国，此前三个月，他曾接待过赵紫阳总理。1989年2月，老布什总统就任后不久，访问东亚期间也访问了中国。两国还进行了频繁的内阁级互访。

China's relationship with Japan experienced rapid improvement during the same period. On October 22, 1978, Deng began a weeklong visit to Japan—the first visit by a top Chinese leader since 1949.12 Just as he would do a few months later in the United States, Deng won over Japanese political elites, business leaders, and the public alike with his straight talk, friendly demeanor, and diplomatic skills. He studiously avoided or downplayed the territorial dispute over the Senkaku/Diaoyu Islands, which both Japan and China claim.13 In December 1979 Prime Minister Masayoshi Ohira of Japan visited Beijing and announced a five-year loan program, totaling 370 billion yen ( $1.5 billion), to help fund the building of several major projects in China. In addition, Ohira offered preferential tariff treatment on Chinese goods, a grant to build a hospital in Beijing, and other technical assistance.14 In subsequent years, Japan's Official Development Assistance (ODA) program would channel valuable resources into China's economic development at a time when the country was desperately in need of foreign capital. Between 1979 and 2005, the amount of development assistance provided by Japan in concessional loans, grant aid, and technical assistance totaled 3.4 trillion yen (over $10 billion), more than that of any other country in the world.15 Japanese FDI in China in the 1980s reached $3.2 billion, accounting for about 15 percent of total FDI received by China, and second only to the amount of FDI from Hong Kong.16

同期，中日关系迅速改善。1978年10月22日，邓小平开始对日本进行为期一周的访问——这是自1949年以来中国最高领导人首次访问日本。正如几个月后他在美国所做的那样，邓小平凭借其直言不讳、友善的举止和外交手腕赢得了日本政界精英、商界领袖和民众的一致好评。他刻意回避或淡化了中日两国都声称拥有主权的尖阁诸岛/钓鱼岛领土争端。1979年12月，日本首相大平正义访问北京，宣布了一项为期五年、总额达3700亿日元（约合15亿美元）的贷款计划，用于资助中国多个重大项目的建设。此外，大平还提供了对中国商品的优惠关税待遇、在北京兴建医院的赠款以及其他技术援助。14 在随后的几年里，日本的官方发展援助（ODA）计划将宝贵的资源投入到中国经济发展中，当时中国急需外资。1979年至2005年间，日本提供的优惠贷款、赠款和技术援助总额达3.4万亿日元（超过100亿美元），超过世界上任何其他国家。15 20世纪80年代，日本对华直接投资达到32亿美元，约占中国吸引的外国直接投资总额的15%，仅次于香港对华直接投资。16

Diplomatic ties blossomed even more than Sino-Japanese commercial relations in the wake of Deng's visit. During his December 1979 trip to Beijing, Prime Minister Ohira signed a Sino-Japanese cultural exchange agreement. In March 1980 the first meeting of a regular Sino-Japanese diplomatic dialogue was held in Tokyo. Two months later, Chinese Premier Hua Guofeng visited Japan and signed a Sino-Japanese agreement on cooperation in science and technology. Sino-Japanese relations reached a new high following the visit by Hu Yaobang, then CCP general secretary, to Japan in November 1983. One of the highlights of Hu's visit was an agreement with Prime Minister Yasuhiro Nakasone to form the Sino-Japanese Friendship Committee for the 21st Century, an organization whose sole mission was to improve bilateral relations.17 The warming of Sino-Japanese relations also led to an increase in people-to-people exchanges. During his visit to Japan in late 1983, Hu invited three thousand Japanese youths to spend a week in China the following year (the visit took place in September 1984). In March 1985 a delegation of two hundred Chinese young people, headed by future Chinese leader Hu Jintao, visited Japan at the invitation of the Japanese government.18

邓小平访日后，中日外交关系的发展甚至超过了经贸关系。1979年12月，大平首相访问北京期间，签署了中日文化交流协议。1980年3月，中日首次定期外交对话在东京举行。两个月后，中国总理华国锋访问日本，并签署了中日科技合作协议。1983年11月，时任中共中央总书记胡耀邦访日，中日关系达到新的高度。胡耀邦访日的一大亮点是与日本首相中曾根康弘达成协议，成立“21世纪中日友好委员会”，该委员会的唯一宗旨是促进双边关系。中日关系的升温也带动了两国人民交流的增加。 1983年底胡锦涛访问日本期间，邀请三千名日本青年于次年（1984年9月）赴华访问一周。1985年3月，应日本政府邀请，由未来的中国领导人胡锦涛率领的两百名中国青年代表团访问日本。

Reintegration into the international community was another foreign policy goal in the 1980s. During the Maoist era, self-isolation had led to the exclusion of China from nearly all key international organizations. In 1977 China was a member of only twenty-one international organizations.19 This would change immediately after Deng became paramount leader. In 1979 China would join most of the UN-affiliated international organizations, such as UNDP, UNICEF, UNHCR, and WEP, and in the 1980s it would become a member of the rest, such as FO and ILO.20 China also joined a large number of international nongovernmental organizations.21

20世纪80年代，重新融入国际社会是中国外交政策的另一项目标。毛泽东时代，中国实行孤立主义，几乎被排除在所有重要的国际组织之外。1977年，中国仅是21个国际组织的成员。邓小平成为最高领导人后，这种情况立即发生了改变。1979年，中国加入了大多数联合国附属国际组织，例如联合国开发计划署（UNDP）、联合国儿童基金会（UNICEF）、联合国难民署（UNHCR）和世界经济伙伴关系组织（WEP）；20世纪80年代，中国又加入了其他一些组织，例如联合国外交关系委员会（FO）和国际劳工组织（ILO）。此外，中国还加入了大量国际非政府组织。

For a leadership laser-focused on economic development, membership in international economic institutions promised to deliver immense benefits. In April 1980 China became a member of the International Monetary Fund (IMF) and the World Bank. Six years later, it joined the Asian Development Bank and also applied to join the General Agreement on Tariffs and Trade (GATT), the predecessor of the World Trade Organization. Of these international financial institutions, the World Bank was the source of the most valuable assistance to China in the 1980s. Besides lending close to $7 billion to China during the entire decade, the World Bank's technical expertise in economic development and reform helped Chinese technocrats craft more effective policies.22

对于一个将经济发展作为核心的领导层而言，加入国际经济机构无疑会带来巨大的益处。1980年4月，中国成为国际货币基金组织（IMF）和世界银行的成员国。六年之后，中国又加入了亚洲开发银行，并申请加入关税及贸易总协定（GATT），即世界贸易组织的前身。在这些国际金融机构中，世界银行在20世纪80年代为中国提供了最宝贵的援助。除了在整个80年代向中国提供近70亿美元的贷款外，世界银行在经济发展和改革方面的技术专长也帮助中国技术官僚制定了更有效的政策。

Another of Deng's priorities was to send a large number of Chinese students abroad for higher education and advanced training. The country's higher education system, devastated during the Cultural Revolution, was unable to produce the scientists and engineers China urgently needed for economic development. Among top Chinese leaders, Deng was the most enthusiastic advocate for broadening educational exchanges with the West.23 Western educational institutions and foundations, in particular those in the United States, offered generous funding to Chinese students as most Chinese students could not afford the tuition and living expenses in the West. The number of Chinese students grew rapidly. At the end of the Maoist era, few Chinese students were studying abroad. But by 1988, the United States alone was hosting more than twenty-eight thousand Chinese students and scholars.24 This trickle would grow into a flood in later years as China opened its doors wider and well-to-do Chinese could afford to send their children abroad to study at their own expense. Official Chinese data show that about eight million Chinese students and researchers studied in more than 160 countries between 1979 and 2021.25 The benefits to China's economic modernization generated by this infusion of human capital are incalculable.

邓小平的另一项优先事项是派遣大量中国学生出国深造和接受高级培训。中国高等教育体系在文化大革命期间遭到严重破坏，无法培养中国经济发展急需的科学家和工程师。在中国最高领导人中，邓小平是最热衷于扩大与西方教育交流的倡导者。西方教育机构和基金会，特别是美国的机构和基金会，为中国学生提供了慷慨的资助，因为大多数中国学生无力承担在西方的学费和生活费。中国留学生人数迅速增长。毛泽东时代末期，出国留学的中国学生寥寥无几。但到1988年，仅美国就接纳了超过2.8万名中国留学生和学者。随着中国进一步开放，富裕的中国人有能力自费送子女出国留学，这股中国留学生的涓涓细流在后来的几年里汇成滔滔洪流。中国官方数据显示，1979年至2021年间，约有800万中国学生和研究人员在160多个国家学习和学习。25 人力资本的注入给中国经济现代化带来的益处是无法估量的。





Crafting a New Grand Strategy





制定新的大战略


In the 1980s Deng accomplished most of his priority foreign policy objectives. The normalization of relations with the United States opened access to American capital and technology as well as the US market. Washington's embrace of Deng's "reform and opening" encouraged its allies to adopt similar friendly policies toward Beijing. A relationship of quasi-alliance between the United States and China was also forged during this decade, resulting in frequent high-level visits and close cooperation in national security, education, science and technology, and commerce. China's relationship with its most important Asian neighbor, Japan, reached an unprecedented level of warmth and delivered rich economic benefits to Deng's modernization program. In the rest of Asia, with the exception of Vietnam, China could boast friendly, or vastly improved, ties. Most remarkably, China and the Soviet Union, its primary geopolitical adversary since the late 1960s, had reached a rapprochement. Beginning in late 1982, both Moscow and Beijing began to explore a path forward to lower tensions. The initial pace was slow, but when Mikhail Gorbachev became Soviet leader in March 1985, he immediately expressed greater openness to repairing Soviet-Chinese ties, and he later followed up with a series of unilateral concessions that Beijing positively received.26 The event marking full normalization of bilateral state relations was Gorbachev's summit with Deng, held in Beijing on May 16, 1989.

20世纪80年代，邓小平实现了其外交政策的大部分优先目标。中美关系正常化使中国得以获得美国资本和技术，并进入美国市场。华盛顿对邓小平“改革开放”的拥护，鼓励其盟友对北京采取类似的友好政策。中美之间也在这一时期建立了准联盟关系，促成了频繁的高层互访，并在国家安全、教育、科技和商业等领域开展密切合作。中国与其最重要的亚洲邻国日本的关系达到了前所未有的高度，并为邓小平的现代化计划带来了丰厚的经济利益。除越南外，中国与亚洲其他地区的关系也十分友好，或显著改善。尤其值得一提的是，自20世纪60年代末以来一直是中国主要地缘政治对手的苏联，也实现了关系缓和。从1982年末开始，莫斯科和北京都开始探索降低紧张局势的途径。初期进展缓慢，但1985年3月米哈伊尔·戈尔巴乔夫就任苏联领导人后，立即表示对修复苏中关系持更加开放的态度，随后又做出了一系列单方面让步，北京方面对此表示欢迎。标志着双边国家关系全面正常化的事件是1989年5月16日戈尔巴乔夫与邓小平在北京举行的峰会。

This "golden era" was cut short on June 4, 1989, when Deng ordered the PLA to crush the prodemocracy movement in Tiananmen Square. Just as the Tiananmen crackdown irrevocably altered China's domestic political trajectory in the post-Mao era, it had a comparable impact on relations with the West, and it exposed the previously somewhat hidden but unbridgeable ideological chasm between China's Leninist regime and the Western democracies that would become a major source of friction in the post-Tiananmen era. Before the tanks of the PLA rolled into Tiananmen Square, China's human rights record was a troubling, but not dominant, issue for the West. Confronting the existential security threat of the Soviet Union took precedence. Additionally, largely due to the policies of liberal reformers like Hu Yaobang and Zhao Ziyang, China's human rights conditions were improving substantially in the 1980s, despite periodic but short-lived conservative backlashes in the ideological arena.

1989年6月4日，邓小平下令解放军镇压天安门广场的民主运动，中国“黄金时代”戛然而止。正如天安门事件不可逆转地改变了后毛泽东时代中国的国内政治走向一样，它也对中西方关系产生了类似的影响，并暴露了中国列宁主义政权与西方民主国家之间此前虽已隐蔽但却无法逾越的意识形态鸿沟，而这在后天安门时代将成为中西方摩擦的主要根源。在解放军坦克开进天安门广场之前，中国的人权状况对西方而言虽令人担忧，但并非主要问题。应对苏联带来的生存安全威胁才是当务之急。此外，尽管在意识形态领域不时出现短暂的保守主义反弹，但由于胡耀邦和赵紫阳等自由派改革者的政策，中国的人权状况在20世纪80年代已显著改善。

But all this changed after June 4, 1989. Although Deng was directly responsible for the Tiananmen crackdown, the paramount leader himself was infuriated by the sanctions imposed by the United States and its allies, and his attitude toward the West underwent a profound change. Prior to the Tiananmen crackdown, Deng consistently emphasized the West's indispensable role in Chinese economic modernization, and he downplayed its potential ideological threat to CCP rule. But after June 4, Deng saw the West as an implacable ideological adversary. The phrase "peaceful evolution," party shorthand for the West's plot to subvert the Chinese regime through economic and political engagement, never appeared in any of his speeches prior to June 1989. Indeed, it was seldom used in official publications. A search of China National Knowledge Infrastructure (CNKI) shows that the phrase appeared only twelve times between January 1, 1979, and April 20, 1989 (the Tiananmen protests began on April 15). But it ominously resurfaced in Deng's speech in September 1989.27 Apparently to underscore Deng's warning, the compilers of his Selected Works titled a conversation between Deng and a visiting foreign leader in November 1989 "We Must Adhere to Socialism and Prevent Peaceful Evolution Towards Capitalism."28 (The frequency of the appearance of the term "peaceful evolution" rose dramatically after June 4. A search of this phrase on CNKI shows that it appeared 2,889 times in official journals between June 5, 1989, and December 1, 1999.)

但这一切在1989年6月4日之后发生了改变。尽管邓小平直接下令镇压天安门事件，但这位最高领导人本人却对美国及其盟友实施的制裁感到愤怒，他对西方的态度也发生了深刻的转变。在天安门事件之前，邓小平一直强调西方在中国经济现代化进程中不可或缺的作用，并淡化了西方对中共统治可能构成的意识形态威胁。但6月4日之后，邓小平将西方视为不共戴天的意识形态对手。“和平演进”一词——中共用来指代西方企图通过经济和政治接触颠覆中国政权的委婉说法——在1989年6月之前从未出现在他的任何讲话中。事实上，在官方出版物中也鲜少出现这个词。中国知网（CNKI）的检索结果显示，从1979年1月1日至1989年4月20日（天安门事件始于4月15日），“和平演进”一词仅出现过12次。但它却在邓小平1989年9月的讲话中再次出现，令人感到不安。27 显然是为了强调邓小平的警告，《邓小平选集》的编者将邓小平1989年11月与一位来访外国领导人的谈话命名为《我们必须坚持社会主义，防止向资本主义和平演进》。28 （“和平演进”一词在6月4日之后出现的频率急剧上升。在CNKI上检索该词组显示，从1989年6月5日至1999年12月1日，该词组在官方期刊中出现了2889次。）

If anything, by late 1989, as the Soviet bloc was teetering on a complete meltdown, Deng had grounds to suspect that China would be the next target of the NCW. Indeed, he openly sounded the warning of an NCW shortly after the fall of the Berlin War in November 1989: "It seems that one Cold War has come to an end," Deng warned, "but that two others have already begun: One is being waged against all countries of the South and the Third World, and the other against socialism. The Western countries . . . want to bring about the peaceful evolution of the socialist countries."29

如果说有什么迹象表明这一点，那就是到了1989年末，随着苏联集团濒临崩溃，邓小平有理由怀疑中国将成为冷战的下一个目标。事实上，在1989年11月柏林战争结束后不久，他就公开发出了冷战的警告：“一场冷战似乎结束了，”邓小平警告说，“但另外两场冷战已经开始了：一场是针对所有南方国家和第三世界国家的，另一场是针对社会主义国家的。西方国家……想要促成社会主义国家的和平转型。”

However, despite his dim view of the West's intentions and the danger of "peaceful evolution," Deng remained convinced that a major new war was unlikely and believed that China needed to gain as much time as possible to make itself stronger. To be sure, he saw the post-Cold War international order, centering on American unipolarity ("hegemonism and great power politics" in Chinese official rhetoric), as fundamentally unjust, hence something that had to be changed. But he was also realistic enough to know that China lacked the power to make such a change happen, and any attempt to do so would be against Chinese interests.30

然而，尽管邓小平对西方的意图以及“和平演进”的危险性持悲观态度，但他仍然坚信爆发大规模新战争的可能性不大，并认为中国需要尽可能争取时间来增强自身实力。诚然，他认为以美国单极世界（中国官方称之为“霸权主义和大国政治”）为中心的后冷战国际秩序从根本上来说是不公正的，因此必须改变。但他同时也足够现实地认识到，中国缺乏实现这种改变的能力，任何试图改变现状的举动都将损害中国的利益。

In a series of speeches to top party leaders between late 1989 and the end of 1990, Deng spelled out the core tenets of a new grand strategy for the post-Cold War era. China's long-term strategic mission and objective would include "opposing hegemonism and power politics" and "working to establish a new international political order and a new international economic order."31 At the same time, despite the upheaval in some socialist countries, Deng still saw the possibility of China doubling its GNP in real terms for the second time, according to plan.32

在1989年末至1990年末的一系列面向党内高层领导人的讲话中，邓小平阐述了后冷战时代新大战略的核心原则。中国的长期战略使命和目标包括“反对霸权主义和强权政治”以及“致力于建立新的国际政治秩序和新的国际经济秩序”。与此同时，尽管一些社会主义国家动荡不安，邓小平仍然认为中国有可能按照计划实现国民生产总值实际翻番。

In September 1989 he coined three phrases, consisting of twelve Chinese characters that would become the guiding principle of Chinese foreign policy in the post-Tiananmen era. Translated as "Observe the situation coolly, hold our ground, and act calmly," this policy was cautious, reactive, and centered on self-preservation. In December 1990 Deng added another element: "Make a contribution."33

1989年9月，他提出了三个短语，共十二个汉字，这三个短语后来成为后天安门时代中国外交政策的指导原则。这三个短语翻译过来就是“冷静观察形势，坚守阵地，沉着应对”，其政策谨慎、被动，以自保为中心。1990年12月，邓小平又增加了一个要素：“做出贡献”。

Deng was making it crystal clear that the goal of this risk-averse foreign policy was to gain time to build up strength, as summarized by the phrase taoguang yanhui (hiding your brightness and building up strength), which Deng invoked in April 1992. The aging leader, who had just returned from his history-bending southern tour, told his staff, "We will become a more significant political power if only we taoguang yanhui for a few years. The weight of China's voice on the global stage will be different."34 A consummate realist, Deng knew that a successful strategy of taoguang yanhui would nevertheless instill anxiety about Chinese power in the West. The best response Deng prescribed was not open confrontation but rather maintaining cooperation, accompanied, at the same time, by vigilance. Despite the West's suspicions or nefarious design for China, Deng urged his successors to avoid conflict. "We should keep them as friends but also have a clear understanding of what they are doing."35

邓小平明确表示，这种规避风险的外交政策的目标是争取时间积蓄力量，正如他在1992年4月提出的“拖光积强”策略所概括的那样。这位刚刚结束改变历史的南方之行的老领导人告诉他的幕僚：“如果我们拖光积强几年，我们就能成为一个更加重要的政治力量。中国在国际舞台上的声音也会有所不同。”作为一位务实的现实主义者，邓小平深知，即使拖光积强策略成功，也必然会在西方引发对中国实力的担忧。邓小平提出的最佳应对措施并非公开对抗，而是在保持合作的同时保持警惕。尽管西方对中国抱有疑虑或别有用心，邓小平仍然敦促他的继任者避免冲突。 “我们应该和他们保持朋友关系，但也要清楚地了解他们在做什么。”

Although Deng presciently laid out the core principles of a foreign policy for the post-Cold War era two years prior to the fall of the Soviet Union, the formal dissolution of the world's erstwhile superpower on December 25, 1991, nevertheless demoralized and worried the Chinese leadership. Ideologically, the fall of the first Communist state, which had inspired the CCP, was yet another confirmation, after the collapse of the Soviet satellites in Eastern Europe in late 1989, that communism had been a complete failure. Geopolitically, China's position drastically worsened overnight. The favorable external environment of the 1980s became history. Conflict over security issues that had largely been frozen but not resolved, such as the status and future of Taiwan and Chinese territorial and maritime disputes with its neighbors, would become far more prominent and, like human rights issues, constitute a major source of tensions between China and the United States in the post-Cold War decades. As its capabilities grew, China's long-term intentions would soon become a top concern of both the United States and its allies. Deng's premonitions about the dynamic of a classical security dilemma would come true, albeit probably later than he had expected. Growing Chinese power did raise the specter of the rise of another Communist behemoth when America's neocons gained power in the administration of George W. Bush in 2001, but their strategic blunder of invading Iraq in 2003 would give China fifteen more years—until Donald Trump launched the 2018 trade war that formally ended the era of engagement between China and the United States.

尽管邓小平在苏联解体两年前就极具远见地阐述了后冷战时代外交政策的核心原则，但1991年12月25日，这个昔日世界超级大国的正式解体仍然令中国领导层士气低落，忧心忡忡。从意识形态上看，作为中共精神的启蒙国家，苏联的垮台，继1989年底苏联在东欧的卫星国解体之后，再次印证了共产主义的彻底失败。从地缘政治上看，中国的处境一夜之间急剧恶化。20世纪80年代有利的外部环境已成为历史。此前大多被冻结但并未得到解决的安全问题，例如台湾的地位和未来，以及中国与其邻国之间的领土和海洋争端，将变得更加突出，并像人权问题一样，成为后冷战时期中美关系紧张的主要根源。随着中国实力的增长，其长远意图很快成为美国及其盟友最为关注的问题。邓小平关于经典安全困境动态的预言最终成真，尽管可能比他预想的要晚一些。2001年，随着美国新保守主义者在小布什政府掌权，中国日益增长的实力确实引发了人们对另一个共产主义庞然大物崛起的担忧，但他们在2003年入侵伊拉克的战略失误却让中国又获得了十五年的发展空间——直到2018年特朗普发动贸易战，正式终结了中美之间的接触时代。

It is not an exaggeration to say that the seeds of the NCW between China and the West that had been sown even before the Cold War was completely over. Given the ideological chasm and clashing visions of the international order, Deng had made it clear that China would never give up its autonomy as a "socialist country" in international affairs. Speaking to several leading members of the Central Committee shortly after the Tiananmen crackdown, Deng vowed: "The Western imperialists are trying to make all socialist countries abandon the socialist road, to bring them in the end under the rule of international monopoly capital. . . . We have to take a clear-cut stand against this adverse current. Because if we did not uphold socialism we would eventually become, at best, a dependency of other countries."36 Deng might not have been aware of his tone at the time, but he was sounding a lot more like Chen Yun. More seriously, Deng's pledge that China would never become part of the West-dominated international system foreshadowed not only future Chinese leaders' resistance to full integration as encouraged by the West through engagement but also the likely clash with this order after China gains sufficient power.

毫不夸张地说，中西之间“新中国战争”的种子早在冷战彻底结束之前就已经埋下。鉴于意识形态上的鸿沟和国际秩序理念的冲突，邓小平明确表示，中国在国际事务中绝不会放弃“社会主义国家”的自主权。在天安门事件后不久，邓小平在与几位中央委员会高级委员的谈话中誓言：“西方帝国主义企图让所有社会主义国家放弃社会主义道路，最终使它们落入国际垄断资本的统治之下……我们必须坚决抵制这种逆流。因为如果我们不坚持社会主义，最终充其量也只能沦为其他国家的附庸。”邓小平当时或许并未意识到自己的语气，但他的言论听起来更像是陈云。更严重的是，邓小平承诺中国永远不会成为西方主导的国际体系的一部分，这不仅预示着未来的中国领导人会抵制西方通过接触所鼓励的全面融合，而且预示着中国获得足够实力后可能会与这一秩序发生冲突。





Biding Time and Building Strength





拖延时间，积蓄力量


Deng may have laid down the broad foreign policy principles for his successors, but translating them into policy was still a challenge in a unipolar world. With a GDP that was about 7.5 percent that of the United States in dollar terms (1992), China was a much weaker power, and it was highly vulnerable to hostile American actions.37 Geopolitically, the "China card" was no longer valuable.38 Ideologically, America's view of China darkened following the Tiananmen crackdown. Bilateral conflict over human rights became a major source of tensions in the 1990s. When Bill Clinton was running for the White House in 1992, he accused his opponent, then-president George H. W. Bush, of "coddling with dictators," and he later pledged to link China's MFN trade status to its human rights record (a policy he had to reverse in 1994).39

邓小平或许为他的继任者奠定了外交政策的总体原则，但在单极世界中，将这些原则转化为具体政策仍然是一项挑战。1992年，中国的GDP按美元计算约为美国的7.5%，实力远逊于美国，极易受到美国敌对行动的影响。地缘政治上，“中国牌”已不再具有价值。意识形态上，天安门事件后，美国对中国的看法变得更加负面。20世纪90年代，两国在人权问题上的冲突成为紧张局势的主要根源。1992年，比尔·克林顿竞选总统时，指责他的对手、时任总统乔治·H·W·布什“纵容独裁者”，后来他还承诺将中国的最惠国待遇与其人权记录挂钩（但这一政策在1994年不得不被撤销）。

Most ominously for the post-Deng leadership, powerful groups in the United States, encompassing labor and human rights advocates on the left and national security hawks and the religious right at the other end of the ideological spectrum, all viewed China as an enemy that had to be confronted before it grew too powerful.40

对后邓小平时代的美国领导层而言，最不祥的是，美国国内一些强大的团体，包括左翼的劳工和人权倡导者，以及意识形态光谱另一端的国家安全鹰派和宗教右翼，都将中国视为必须在其变得过于强大之前予以遏制的敌人。

Influential media figures as well as some academics eloquently made the case for containing China. A common thread ran through their warnings about China: The United States and China have irreconcilable ideological differences and clashing geopolitical interests, and should China gain enough power, conflict between the two countries will become inevitable.41

一些有影响力的媒体人士和学者雄辩地论证了遏制中国的必要性。他们对中国的警告中贯穿着一个共同的主题：美国和中国存在不可调和的意识形态分歧和地缘政治利益冲突，如果中国获得足够的实力，两国之间的冲突将不可避免。

Such calls for a preemptive containment strategy may seem prescient in hindsight, but they did not become American policy in the 1990s, most likely because there was no broad-based support for an offensive policy against a country whose rapid rise was hardly guaranteed. Indeed, few in Washington, or in China itself, foresaw the supercharged growth of Chinese power in the subsequent two decades that would turn Beijing into a near-peer rival. Those advocating an alternative strategy could also muster powerful counterarguments. Among other things, critics of a preemptive containment strategy pointed to the near certainty of an otherwise avoidable dangerous clash between the United States and China, the lack of support from allies in the event of such a conflict, and the weakness of Chinese power and an exaggeration of its threat to American interests in East Asia.42 The framework of such an alternative strategy has since been given various labels, such as "conditional engagement" or "strategic hedging." Its essence is a finely balanced strategy mixing deterrence and engagement. Specifically, instead of hard containment, Washington would place greater emphasis on economic and diplomatic engagement with Beijing through expansion of trade and investment and high-level exchanges. However, to hedge against potential Chinese threats to American interests in East Asia, the United States would maintain and strengthen its alliance networks, continue forward military deployment, and impose restrictions on transfers of advanced technologies (such as semiconductors) to China.43 The evolution of this strategy took some time and did not garner sufficient political support in Washington until bilateral relations were stabilized with Jiang Zemin's 1997 state visit to the United States.44

事后看来，这种先发制人的遏制战略的呼吁或许颇具先见之明，但在上世纪90年代，它并未成为美国的政策，很可能是因为当时并没有广泛的支持来对抗一个迅速崛起且几乎无法保证的国家。事实上，无论是华盛顿还是中国自身，都很少有人预料到中国在接下来的二十年里会以惊人的速度发展，最终使北京成为几乎势均力敌的对手。那些倡导替代战略的人也提出了强有力的反驳论点。除其他外，先发制人遏制战略的批评者指出，美中之间几乎必然会发生一场原本可以避免的危险冲突，一旦发生冲突，盟友将缺乏支持，而且中国实力较弱，其对美国在东亚利益的威胁也被夸大了。这种替代战略的框架后来被赋予了各种名称，例如“有条件接触”或“战略对冲”。其本质是一种巧妙平衡的战略，融合了威慑和接触。具体而言，华盛顿不再采取强硬遏制政策，而是更加重视通过扩大贸易投资和高层交流来加强与北京的经济和外交接触。然而，为了防范中国对美国在东亚利益的潜在威胁，美国将维持并加强其联盟网络，继续前沿部署军事力量，并限制向中国转让先进技术（例如半导体）。这一战略的演变历经一段时间，直到1997年江泽民对美国进行国事访问，双边关系趋于稳定后，才在华盛顿获得足够的政治支持。

To the post-Deng leaders, America's "strategic hedging" was preferable to full-fledged containment. But at the same time, they were not blind to its components that smacked of "containment." In a foreign policy speech in 1993, Jiang Zemin laid out the dilemma China faced in dealing with the United States. On the one hand, he pointed out that "peaceful evolution" remained the long-term goal of "some Americans" who did not want to see a stronger reunified China and would continue to pressure China on human rights, trade, and Taiwan. On the other hand, the United States was the world's most powerful country, an important export market, and a source of capital and technology for China. The best strategy was to be "both combative and conciliatory, . . . improving relations between China and the U.S. . . . to put our relations on a more stable course."45

对于邓小平之后的领导人而言，美国的“战略对冲”比全面遏制更为可取。但与此同时，他们也并非对其中带有“遏制”色彩的成分视而不见。1993年，江泽民在一次外交政策演讲中阐述了中国在对美关系中面临的困境。一方面，他指出，“和平演进”仍然是“一些美国人”的长期目标，这些人不希望看到一个更加强大的统一中国，并将继续在人权、贸易和台湾问题上向中国施压。另一方面，美国是世界上最强大的国家，是中国重要的出口市场，也是中国资金和技术的来源地。最佳策略是“兼具对抗性和和解性……改善中美关系……使我们的关系走上更加稳定的轨道”。

Even after Sino-American relations had fully stabilized in 1998 after a rocky period, Jiang made a similar warning in a speech. He said there are people in America whose "underlying goal is . . . to change China's socialist system and eventually incorporate China into the Western capitalist system. This is a long and complex struggle."46 In the face of this challenge, the best counterstrategy was "to use a two-pronged approach against their two-sided policy." America's "two sides" here obviously refer to engagement (one side) and containment (the other side). China's counterstrategy in response, according to Jiang, was both to "cooperate" (one side) and "confront" (the other side) by "adhering to principles without losing flexibility."47

即使在1998年中美关系经历了一段动荡时期后完全稳定下来之后，江泽民在一次讲话中也发出了类似的警告。他说，美国有些人“其根本目标是……改变中国的社会主义制度，最终将中国纳入西方资本主义制度。这是一场漫长而复杂的斗争。”面对这一挑战，最佳应对策略是“对美国的两面派政策采取双管齐下的策略”。美国的“两面派”显然指的是接触（一方面）和遏制（另一方面）。江泽民认为，中国的应对策略是“坚持原则，不失灵活性”，既要“合作”（一方面），也要“对抗”（另一方面）。

To be sure, this pragmatic strategy was designed to avoid a frontal collision from a position of structural vulnerability with the world's sole superpower in the post-Cold War era. By the 1990s, China had grown significantly dependent on access to the US market and American technologies, and a sudden rupture of ties with the United States could derail economic modernization.48 However difficult it might have been for Jiang and his colleagues to endure what they saw as bullying acts of "American hegemonism," the harsh reality of a lopsided balance of power unfavorable to China counseled prudence and patience.49 In the same speech, Jiang made it clear that Beijing desired a multipolar world and a new "just and equitable new international political and economic order."50 It was a refrain that Chinese leaders would invoke repeatedly, even at the risk of antagonizing the United States, the architect and primary defender of the order that China viewed as unjust and unreasonable. Nevertheless, Jiang emphasized that China had to act with calm and avoid taking the lead to confront the United States and its allies. Repeating Deng's dictum of taoguang yanhui, he added three additional strategic principles: shoulian fengmang (exercise restraint), baocun ziji (preserve ourselves), and xutu fazhan (develop gradually).51 In essence, Jiang was prescribing Deng's strategy of buying time and avoiding conflict to cope with American dominance in the post-Cold War era.

可以肯定的是，这一务实的战略旨在避免在后冷战时代，从结构脆弱的位置与世界唯一的超级大国发生正面冲突。到了20世纪90年代，中国对美国市场和技术的依赖程度日益加深，与美国关系的突然破裂可能会阻碍经济现代化进程。尽管江泽民及其同僚难以忍受他们眼中的“美国霸权主义”的欺凌行为，但对中国不利的权力失衡的残酷现实迫使他们保持谨慎和耐心。在同一次讲话中，江泽民明确表示，北京渴望建立一个多极世界和一个“公正公平的国际政治经济新秩序”。这句口号被中国领导人反复提及，即便冒着激怒美国的风险——美国正是中国眼中不公正、不合理的秩序的缔造者和主要捍卫者。然而，江泽民强调，中国必须保持冷静，避免率先与美国及其盟友对抗。他重申了邓小平“道光延汇”的原则，并补充了三个战略原则：守廉风莽、保村自基、步走发站。本质上，江泽民是在沿用邓小平争取时间、避免冲突的战略，以应对后冷战时代美国的主导地位。





Reorienting Security Strategy





重新调整安全战略


In the 1980s Deng's assessment that a great power war was unlikely led to a cut of one million PLA soldiers and the starving of the military of funding and investments. But the party's prioritization of butter over guns created its own problems, such as corruption in the military as the PLA was allowed to operate for-profit businesses to generate off-the-books income (a practice the party ended in 1998).52 In the 1990s China also began to implement a sustained program of modernizing its outdated military. The impetus was not a sudden change in its assessment of the likelihood of a world war. In fact, during his tenure in office, Jiang Zemin consistently maintained that the external environment was favorable and a new world war was unlikely.53 Instead, the initial direct trigger for Chinese military modernization in the post-Cold War era was the awesome demonstration of America's high-tech military during the first Gulf War of 1990-1991, when a US-led coalition routed the Iraqi army. Jiang personally attended three seminars on the Gulf War in June 1991, and thereafter he gave a series of speeches on military strategy and technology that underscored the need to increase defense "appropriately" and to develop indigenous defense technologies.54 After intense deliberations, the Central Military Commission formulated a new defense doctrine in 1993 that emphasized "winning local wars under modern technological conditions."55 Implementation of this doctrine would drive military modernization during the following two decades.

20世纪80年代，邓小平认为大国战争不太可能爆发，导致解放军裁减了一百万士兵，并削减了军队的经费和投资。但中共优先发展军民两方面的政策也带来了自身的问题，例如军队内部的腐败，因为解放军被允许经营营利性企业以获取账外收入（这一做法在1998年被中共终止）。20世纪90年代，中国也开始实施一项持续的军队现代化计划。推动这一计划的并非是对世界大战可能性评估的突然转变。事实上，江泽民在任期间始终坚持认为外部环境有利，爆发新一轮世界大战的可能性不大。53 然而，冷战后中国军事现代化的直接导火索是1990-1991年第一次海湾战争中美国高科技军事力量的惊人展现，当时以美国为首的联军击溃了伊拉克军队。江泽民于1991年6月亲自参加了三次海湾战争研讨会，此后发表了一系列关于军事战略和技术的讲话，强调需要“适当”加强国防建设，发展自主国防技术。54 经过深入讨论，中央军委于1993年制定了新的国防理论，强调“在现代技术条件下打赢局部战争”。55 这一理论的实施推动了此后二十年的军事现代化进程。

The task of building a high-tech military force gained greater urgency after the ascendance of pro-independence political forces in Taiwan in the mid-1990s. Chinese leaders realized that they required credible military options to deter both Taiwanese independence and potential American military intervention. Starting in the mid-1990s, China's military modernization program focused largely on possible Taiwan contingencies, thus unleashing the dynamics of an escalating security dilemma with the United States and its East Asian ally, Japan, in the subsequent two decades.56

20世纪90年代中期台湾独立势力崛起后，建设高科技军事力量的任务变得更加紧迫。中国领导人意识到，他们需要可靠的军事选项来遏制台湾独立和美国潜在的军事干预。从20世纪90年代中期开始，中国的军事现代化计划主要集中于应对可能发生的台湾危机，从而引发了随后二十年间与美国及其东亚盟友日本之间日益加剧的安全困境。

Based on official data, defense spending began its sustained rise in 1991 (see table 8.1). In nominal terms, China's military budget quadrupled between 1990 and 2000, or doubled after adjusting for inflation.57 Buoyed by the fast-growing economy, China accelerated investments in its military capabilities in the 2000s, with defense spending in real terms rising at an average of 12.5 percent per annum, significantly higher than the 7.8 percent per annum in the 1990s.58 By 2012, China's defense budget would reach ￥157 billion, second only to America's $684 billion.59 Whether official data truly reflect China's defense budget is hotly debated. Highly reputable research organizations and scholars have arrived at different estimates, most of which are higher than the official Chinese data.60 What is not in dispute, however, is that within two decades, Chinese military modernization achieved a level of progress few had anticipated. By the end of the post-Tiananmen era, the PLA had been transformed into a technologically advanced fighting force due to imports of advanced Russian weapons systems, such as Sukhoi jetfighters, Sovremennyy-class destroyers, supersonic antiship missiles, and indigenously produced high-tech weapons. As China's focus was on developing anti-access/area denial (A2/AD) capabilities to deter potential US intervention in a war with Taiwan, improvements in the Chinese navy and air force were especially rapid and significant.61

根据官方数据，国防开支自1991年开始持续增长（见表8.1）。按名义值计算，中国军费预算在1990年至2000年间增长了四倍，经通胀调整后增长了一倍。在经济快速增长的推动下，中国在21世纪初加快了对军事能力的投资，国防开支实际年均增长率达到12.5%，远高于1990年代的7.8%。到2012年，中国国防预算将达到1570亿元人民币，仅次于美国的6840亿美元。官方数据是否真实反映了中国的国防预算，目前仍存在激烈争论。众多权威研究机构和学者得出了不同的估算结果，其中大多数高于中国官方数据。然而，无可争议的是，在短短二十年间，中国军事现代化取得了远超预期的成就。到后天安门时代末期，解放军已转型为一支技术先进的作战力量，这得益于苏霍伊战斗机、现代级驱逐舰、超音速反舰导弹等先进俄制武器系统的引进，以及国产高科技武器的研制。由于中国当时的重点是发展反介入/区域拒止（A2/AD）能力，以遏制美国可能对台湾发动的战争，因此中国海军和空军的进步尤为迅速和显著。

Accompanying military modernization was a comprehensive reorientation of China's security and foreign policies to improve relations with its neighbors, in particular Russia and the Southeast Asian countries. As Chinese leaders reevaluated potential security threats, it became obvious that maritime threats, mainly Taiwan-related contingencies, had supplanted any danger of a land invasion from the former Soviet Union during the Cold War.62 Accordingly, China took dramatic steps to elevate ties with Russia in the immediate wake of the Cold War. The two countries reached an agreement on their eastern border in 1991 and a similar agreement on their western border three years later. In 1996 Jiang Zemin and President Boris Yeltsin announced establishment of a "strategic partnership." Bilateral defense cooperation greatly expanded the transfer of advanced weapons to China. Although the Sino-Russian "strategic partnership" at that time had serious limits, it vastly improved China's security situation in the north, allowing it to focus on its east and south maritime flanks.63 Beijing and Moscow would upgrade their defense cooperation in 2001 when, based on a Chinese initiative, they became the main sponsors of the Shanghai Cooperation Organization (SCO), which initially consisted of China, Russia, Kazakhstan, Kyrgyzstan, and Tajikistan but would later grow to include also India, Iran, Pakistan, and Uzbekistan, turning it into a regional multilateral security forum.64

伴随军事现代化而来的是中国安全和外交政策的全面调整，旨在改善与邻国，特别是俄罗斯和东南亚国家的关系。随着中国领导人重新评估潜在的安全威胁，很明显，海上威胁（主要是与台湾相关的突发事件）已经取代了冷战时期来自前苏联的陆地入侵威胁。因此，冷战结束后，中国立即采取了一系列有力措施来提升与俄罗斯的关系。两国于1991年就东部边界达成协议，三年后又就西部边界达成类似协议。1996年，江泽民和叶利钦总统宣布建立“战略伙伴关系”。双边防务合作极大地促进了先进武器向中国的转让。尽管当时的俄中“战略伙伴关系”存在诸多局限，但它极大地改善了中国北方的安全形势，使其能够集中精力应对东部和南部的海上威胁。2001年，在中国的倡议下，北京和莫斯科成为上海合作组织（上合组织）的主要发起国，从而提升了双方的防务合作。上合组织最初由中国、俄罗斯、哈萨克斯坦、吉尔吉斯斯坦和塔吉克斯坦组成，后来又吸纳了印度、伊朗、巴基斯坦和乌兹别克斯坦，使其成为一个区域性多边安全论坛。

China made significant strides in Southeast Asia as well. In 1991 China normalized relations with Vietnam, which it had invaded in 1979. The two countries also signed an agreement demarcating their land borders in 1999. Throughout the 1990s, Beijing launched a charm offensive to reassure the Southeast Asian nations of its benign intentions. Its activities included more frequent visits to the region by top Chinese leaders and expansion of trade and cultural exchanges. Although China's seizure of the disputed Mischief Reef in 1995 momentarily damaged Beijing's credibility, its subsequent restraint calmed tensions. During the Asian financial crisis of 1997-1998, China raised its standing considerably in Southeast Asia by coming to the aid of Thailand, one of the hardest-hit countries, while Washington chose to take a pass.65

中国在东南亚也取得了显著进展。1991年，中国与越南实现了关系正常化，而中国曾在1979年入侵越南。两国还于1999年签署了划定陆地边界的协议。整个20世纪90年代，北京发起了一场魅力攻势，以消除东南亚国家的疑虑，让他们相信中国是善意的。其举措包括中国高级领导人更频繁地访问该地区，以及扩大贸易和文化交流。尽管中国在1995年占领了有争议的美济礁，一度损害了北京的信誉，但其随后的克制缓和了紧张局势。在1997-1998年亚洲金融危机期间，中国向受灾最严重的国家之一泰国伸出援手，而华盛顿却选择袖手旁观，这大大提升了中国在东南亚的地位。

Elsewhere in Asia, Chinese progress was more mixed. Relations with India warmed with exchange of visits by top leaders and a steady increase in trade, but negotiations over their long-disputed border made little progress and their geopolitical rivalries continued, albeit in a more subdued form.66 In Northeast Asia, China's greatest gain was the rapid development of ties with South Korea, with which China had established diplomatic relations in 1992. But ties with Japan deteriorated further in the 1990s as the result of disputes over sovereignty of the Senkaku/Diaoyu Islands (an issue Chinese leaders had wisely shelved in the 1980s), history, Chinese military modernization, and Taiwan.67

在亚洲其他地区，中国的发展则喜忧参半。中印关系随着两国高层互访和贸易稳步增长而升温，但双方就长期存在争议的边界问题进行的谈判进展甚微，地缘政治竞争依然存在，尽管有所缓和。在东北亚，中国最大的收获是与韩国关系的迅速发展，两国于1992年建交。但20世纪90年代，由于在钓鱼岛/尖阁诸岛主权问题（中国领导人在20世纪80年代明智地搁置了这一问题）、历史遗留问题、中国军事现代化以及台湾问题上的分歧，中日关系进一步恶化。





Confronting the Taiwan Challenge





应对台湾挑战


Except for the US-China dispute over arms sales, Taiwan did not present much of a foreign policy challenge to the mainland in the 1980s. Militarily, China lacked the capabilities to reunify with the island, to which the Nationalists (Kuomintang, KMT) retreated after losing the civil war to the Communists in 1949. Deng's top priority—economic modernization in a peaceful external environment—relegated reunification to the back burner. The government of the Republic of China (Taiwan's official name), then dominated by KMT elders, was not seeking de jure independence even as it began to liberalize the island's political system and open the door to political forces with a strong Taiwanese identity. Above all, stable and cooperative Sino-American relations throughout the decade bolstered mutual trust and restraint.

除了中美在军售问题上的分歧外，20世纪80年代台湾并未对中国大陆构成太大的外交挑战。在军事上，中国缺乏统一台湾的能力。国民党在1949年内战败给共产党后，便退守台湾。邓小平的首要任务是在和平的外部环境下实现经济现代化，这使得统一问题被搁置。当时由国民党元老主导的中华民国政府（台湾的正式名称）虽然开始推进政治体制的自由化，并向具有强烈台湾认同感的政治力量敞开大门，但并未寻求法理上的独立。最重要的是，整个80年代稳定且合作的中美关系增强了双方的互信和克制。

All this would change in the post-Cold War era. To be sure, relations between the mainland and Taiwan initially appeared to be headed for a breakthrough. In 1992 the PRC and ROC reached a critical formula, the so-called 92 Consensus, that basically papered over their differences over the definition of "one China." The 92 Consensus allowed each side to interpret or define its own meaning of one China while ostensibly accepting the concept of "one China."68 As China insisted on acceptance of its "one-China principle" as a precondition for dialogue across the Taiwan Strait, the 92 Consensus allowed Beijing and Taipei to explore a new modus vivendi despite the vast gulf existing between them. By the early 1990s, the mainland had also become an important trading partner and investment destination for Taiwan business. Taiwan's direct investments in China totaled $3.9 billion by 1994 and two-way trade in goods reached $16.3 billion, with Taiwan recording a large surplus of nearly $12 billion.69

这一切在后冷战时代都将发生改变。诚然，大陆与台湾的关系最初似乎正朝着突破的方向发展。1992年，中华人民共和国和中华民国达成了一项关键协议，即所谓的“九二共识”，该共识基本上掩盖了双方在“一个中国”定义上的分歧。“九二共识”允许双方各自诠释或定义“一个中国”的含义，同时表面上接受“一个中国”的概念。由于中国坚持将接受“一个中国原则”作为台海对话的前提条件，“九二共识”使得北京和台北得以探索一种新的共存模式，尽管双方之间存在着巨大的鸿沟。到20世纪90年代初，大陆也已成为台湾企业重要的贸易伙伴和投资目的地。截至1994年，台湾对中国大陆的直接投资总额达39亿美元，双边货物贸易额达163亿美元，其中台湾录得近120亿美元的巨额贸易顺差。

In spite of their growing commercial ties, however, cross-strait relations would undergo a radical change beginning in 1995. As the democratization process accelerated on the island of Taiwan in the late 1980s, especially after establishment of Taiwan's Democratic Progressive Party (DPP), which openly advocated independence, the political landscape experienced a dramatic transformation. Lee Teng-hui, the first native Taiwanese to hold the presidency of the ROC, who had assumed office after Chiang Ching-kuo died in January 1988, initially displayed an openness to dialogue with Beijing, as evidenced by the 92 Consensus. But Lee's mainland policy took a 180-degree turn in 1995 when he became a champion of Taiwanese sovereignty and identity—a change that not only prompted Beijing to label him a separatist but also led to a series of crises in cross-strait relations.

尽管两岸经贸联系日益紧密，但自1995年起，两岸关系发生了根本性的变化。20世纪80年代末，台湾民主化进程加速，尤其是在公开主张独立的民进党成立后，政治格局发生了剧烈的转变。李登辉是首位担任中华民国总统的台湾人，他在蒋经国于1988年1月去世后继任。李登辉最初展现出与北京对话的开放态度，这体现在“九二共识”中。然而，1995年，李登辉的对陆政策来了个180度大转弯，他转而支持台湾主权和身份认同——这一转变不仅招致北京对其“分裂分子”的指责，也引发了一系列两岸关系危机。

The first crisis, now called the "Third Taiwan Strait Crisis," began when Taiwan supporters in the United States successfully pressured the administration of Bill Clinton to issue an unprecedented visa to President Lee so he could travel to the United States and deliver the alumni reunion speech at his alma mater, Cornell University. In his speech, titled "Always in My Heart," Lee made remarks that mainland Chinese leaders saw as an open challenge to Beijing. In response, Beijing ordered the PLA to conduct a series of military exercises in the summer of 1995 that would culminate in the largest military drill in the Taiwan Strait in March 1996, around the time of the first popular presidential election held on the island that delivered to Lee a landslide victory. China's military intimidation against Taiwan, which included firing missiles close to the island, prompted US intervention. Clinton dispatched two carrier battle groups to the waters around Taiwan.
