Although the crisis ended without incident, this would be a powerful motivator for China to accelerate its military modernization and acquire capabilities to deal with future Taiwan-related contingencies.70

第一次危机，即如今所谓的“第三次台海危机”，始于美国支持台湾的人士成功向比尔·克林顿政府施压，促使其史无前例地向李登辉总统发放签证，使其得以赴美在其母校康奈尔大学发表校友返校演讲。李登辉在题为《永远在我心中》的演讲中发表了一些被中国大陆领导人视为对北京的公开挑战的言论。作为回应，北京命令解放军在1995年夏季举行一系列军事演习，最终在1996年3月举行了台海地区规模最大的军事演习。当时正值台湾举行首次全民总统选举，李登辉以压倒性优势获胜。中国对台湾的军事威慑，包括向台湾附近海域发射导弹，促使美国介入。克林顿派遣了两个航母战斗群前往台湾附近海域。尽管危机最终和平结束，但这无疑会极大地激励中国加快军事现代化进程，并提升应对未来涉台突发事件的能力。

But the 1995-1996 crisis was merely the beginning of more than a decade of escalating tensions. Lee continued to contest Beijing's claim of sovereignty over Taiwan. In July 1999 he publicly redefined the nature of cross-strait relations as "special state-to-state" relations, directly challenging Beijing's "one-China principle." Fortunately, even though Lee's rhetoric of "state-to-state" relations nearly touched China's red line, he did not take any legal action, such as amending the constitution or changing the national flag, to formalize his "two-state theory." China reacted angrily and issued threats, but it took no military actions, most likely because it did not want to derail its negotiations with the United States on WTO entry or precipitate a new confrontation with Washington right after the accidental NATO bombing of the Chinese Embassy in Belgrade in May of that year.

但1995-1996年的危机仅仅是长达十余年紧张局势升级的开端。李登辉继续挑战北京对台湾的主权声索。1999年7月，他公开将两岸关系重新定义为“特殊的国家间关系”，直接挑战北京的“一个中国原则”。幸运的是，尽管李登辉关于“国家间关系”的言论几乎触及了中国的红线，但他并未采取任何法律行动，例如修改宪法或更换国旗，来正式确立其“两国论”。中国对此反应强烈，并发出威胁，但并未采取任何军事行动，这很可能是因为中国不愿破坏其与美国就加入世贸组织进行的谈判，也不愿在同年5月北约误炸中国驻贝尔格莱德大使馆后，立即引发与华盛顿的新一轮对抗。

Tensions with Taiwan persisted after the election of Chen Shui-bian of the DPP as president in 2000. The rise of the DPP represented a sea change in Taiwan's political landscape, brought about by the island's transition to democracy and growth of a distinct Taiwanese identity separate from that of China. Fortunately for China, US-China relations stabilized after 9/11. As a result, the Chen government did not move further than Lee had in redefining cross-strait relations—except for an unsuccessful attempt to pass a referendum on Taiwan's self-defense and dialogue with the mainland (Chen had to water down the language due to American pressure).71 Although cross-strait relations stabilized after the KMT recaptured the presidency in 2008, the island's status and future would become a central point of contention between China and the United States. Even prior to the Xi Jinping era, as the rise of Taiwanese identity greatly dimmed prospects of peaceful reunification, Chinese leaders grew increasingly aware that only strong military capabilities could deter Taiwan and its foreign (mainly American) supporters from "acting rashly," as described by Jiang Zemin in summarizing the accomplishments of the PLA in the 1990s.72 With Taiwan assuming China's foremost national security priority and driving its military modernization program, the dynamics for exacerbating the US-China security dilemma ensued. The capabilities China was seeking to make its military options more credible would also erode America's unstated but nevertheless clear deterrence against this very option, thus triggering countermeasures. If the United States did not have to seriously worry about China's military strength in the early 1990s, this was no longer the case by the end of the post-Tiananmen era.

2000年民进党候选人陈水扁当选总统后，中台关系持续紧张。民进党的崛起标志着台湾政治格局的巨变，这源于台湾向民主转型以及与中国大陆截然不同的台湾身份认同的形成。幸运的是，9·11事件后中美关系趋于稳定。因此，陈水扁政府在重新定义两岸关系方面并未超越李登辉政府——除了曾试图就台湾自卫权和与大陆对话进行全民公投但最终失败（由于美国的压力，陈水扁不得不淡化措辞）。尽管国民党在2008年重新执政后两岸关系趋于稳定，但台湾的地位和未来仍成为中美之间争论的焦点。早在习近平时代之前，随着台湾认同感的增强，和平统一的前景变得黯淡，中国领导人日益意识到，只有强大的军事能力才能阻止台湾及其外国（主要是美国）支持者“鲁莽行事”，正如江泽民在总结解放军20世纪90年代的成就时所描述的那样。随着台湾成为中国国家安全首要关注点并推动其军事现代化进程，加剧中美安全困境的因素也随之出现。中国为增强其军事选项的可信度而寻求的能力，也将削弱美国虽未明言但却清晰可见的威慑力，从而引发美国的反制措施。如果说美国在20世纪90年代初不必对中国的军事实力感到担忧，那么到了后天安门时代末期，情况就截然不同了。





Embracing Globalization





拥抱全球化


A novel challenge that Deng did not anticipate but that Jiang Zemin had to confront was globalization—the rapid expansion of trade and investment flows across borders unleashed by the end of the Cold War. As geopolitical barriers fell and economic reforms in China and India accelerated in the 1990s, previously closed markets opened up, and a huge pool of workers in the developing countries became available for companies searching for low-cost labor.73 As noted by Jiang in a speech on foreign policy in 1998, for China, globalization represented both opportunities and challenges. Because the West possessed advantages in capital, technology, talent, finance, and nearly all other domains of globalization, it was poised to be the greatest beneficiary. According to Jiang, the developing countries, on the whole, would be disadvantaged; China could gain from globalization by acquiring more foreign capital, advanced technologies, and access to markets, even though it lacked overall economic competitiveness and it was the West that had made the rules of globalization and controlled international financial institutions. As no country could be immune from globalization, Jiang argued, China had to adapt to its trends and actively participate in international economic cooperation and competition. The overall strategic framework Jiang laid out in his 1998 speech was to be “clearly aware of the risks that economic globalization brings, maintain our independence and initiative, increase our level of vigilance, and become better able to fend off and defuse risks in order to effectively safeguard our country’s economic security.”74

邓小平未曾预料到，但江泽民必须面对的一个全新挑战是全球化——冷战结束后，跨境贸易和投资流动迅速扩张。随着地缘政治壁垒的瓦解，以及中印两国在20世纪90年代加速推进经济改革，此前封闭的市场逐渐开放，发展中国家庞大的劳动力资源也为寻求低成本劳动力的企业提供了机会。正如江泽民在1998年的一次外交政策演讲中所指出的，对中国而言，全球化既是机遇也是挑战。由于西方在资本、技术、人才、金融以及几乎所有其他全球化领域都拥有优势，因此它注定成为最大的受益者。江泽民认为，发展中国家总体上将处于劣势；中国虽然缺乏整体经济竞争力，而且全球化的规则和国际金融机构都由西方制定，但它仍然可以通过获得更多外国资本、先进技术和市场准入来从全球化中获益。江泽民认为，没有哪个国家能够置身全球化之外，中国必须顺应全球化趋势，积极参与国际经济合作与竞争。他在1998年的讲话中提出的总体战略框架是：“要充分认识到经济全球化带来的风险，保持自主性和主动性，提高警惕性，增强抵御和化解风险的能力，从而切实维护国家经济安全。”

This strategy to maximize the upsides of economic globalization and mitigate its risks guided China's international economic policy during the post-Tiananmen period. On the one hand, China aggressively courted international capital and technology and vigorously competed for market share in manufactured goods, leveraging the cost advantage of its immense labor force and unrivaled economies of scale. The most important step it took was to secure accession to the WTO in 2001. On the other hand, China also maintained protectionist measures and implemented an industrial policy to limit foreign competition in its domestic market and to overcome its disadvantages in more technology-intensive or emerging sectors, such as renewable energy.75

在后天安门时代，中国奉行的国际经济政策以最大限度地发挥经济全球化的优势并降低其风险为指导。一方面，中国积极吸引国际资本和技术，并凭借其庞大的劳动力成本优势和无可比拟的规模经济，在制成品领域展开激烈的市场份额竞争。其中最重要的一步是于2001年加入世界贸易组织。另一方面，中国也维持了贸易保护主义措施，并实施产业政策，以限制外国竞争进入国内市场，并克服其在技术密集型或新兴领域（例如可再生能源）的劣势。

Judging by the colossal gains of Chinese exports, the strategy laid out by Jiang was an unqualified success. In the year before its formal accession to the WTO on December 11, 2001, China's total merchandise exports totaled $226 billion, and it had a trade surplus of $22.5 billion. In 2012, the end of the post-Tiananmen period, China was exporting $2.04 trillion in goods and reporting a trade surplus of $230 billion.76 Paradoxically, however, the success of China's strategy of both embracing and safeguarding against globalization at the same time would damage trade ties with its Western partners, which likely did not anticipate the surge in Chinese exports after its accession to the WTO. At the same time, Chinese protectionism and industrial policies frustrated Western partners' efforts to gain access to its growing domestic markets and to compete with China on a level playing field. Although it would take two more decades for the West to start "decoupling" from China, the source of the breakdown was created by the successful, self-interested, but ultimately unsustainable strategy that Chinese leaders adopted in response to globalization.

从中国出口的巨大增长来看，江泽民制定的战略无疑取得了成功。在2001年12月11日正式加入世贸组织之前的一年，中国商品出口总额为2260亿美元，贸易顺差为225亿美元。到了2012年，即后天安门时代结束之际，中国商品出口额达到2.04万亿美元，贸易顺差为2300亿美元。然而，矛盾的是，中国既拥抱全球化又防范全球化的战略虽然成功，却损害了与西方伙伴的贸易关系，因为西方伙伴可能并未预料到中国加入世贸组织后出口的激增。与此同时，中国的保护主义和产业政策也阻碍了西方伙伴进入其不断增长的国内市场以及与中国公平竞争的努力。尽管西方还需要二十年时间才能开始与中国“脱钩”，但造成这种局面的根源在于中国领导人为应对全球化而采取的、成功的、自私的，但最终是不可持续的战略。





End of Hide-and-Bide





躲藏策略结束


Chinese foreign policy during the Jiang era was not without its moments of scares. In particular, Sino-American relations were severely tested by a series of crises, such as the Taiwan crisis of 1995-1996, the accidental NATO bombing of the Chinese Embassy in Belgrade in May 1999, and the midair collision of a Chinese jetfighter and a US reconnaissance plane in April 2001. Fortunately, in each case restraint and diplomacy enabled both sides to defuse tensions. If there was one pivotal moment when China's grand strategy of tao-guang yanghui was seriously imperiled, it was the election of George W. Bush in 2000, which was accompanied by entry into the US administration of national security hawks who had grown increasingly alarmed by the sustained growth of Chinese power in the 1990s. Chinese GDP measured in US dollars had risen from 7.5 percent of US GDP in 1992 to nearly 12 percent in 2000.77 Although the size of the Chinese economy was still a fraction of that of the American economy and smaller than the economies of Japan, Germany, and the United Kingdom, China was obviously catching up at a rapid pace. It should have come as no surprise that the Bush administration would designate China not as a "strategic partner" but as a "strategic competitor."78 Indeed, in the early months of the Bush administration, and particularly after the plane collision in 2001, Washington adopted a hard-line China policy, especially on the most sensitive issue of Taiwan (by allowing President Chen Shui-bian, leader of Taiwan's pro-independence DPP, to make an unprecedented, high-profile "transit visit" to New York).

江泽民时代的中国外交政策并非一帆风顺。特别是中美关系，经历了一系列危机的严峻考验，例如1995-1996年的台湾危机、1999年5月北约误炸中国驻贝尔格莱德大使馆事件以及2001年4月中国战斗机与美国侦察机空中相撞事故。所幸的是，在每起事件中，双方都凭借克制和外交手段化解了紧张局势。如果说中国“道光扬辉”大战略曾面临过一次真正的危机，那就是2000年乔治·W·布什当选总统。与此同时，一些鹰派人士进入美国政府，他们对中国在20世纪90年代的持续崛起日益感到担忧。以美元计价的中国GDP占美国GDP的比例从1992年的7.5%上升到2000年的近12%。尽管中国经济规模仍然远不及美国，也小于日本、德国和英国的经济规模，但中国显然正在快速追赶。因此，布什政府将中国列为“战略竞争对手”而非“战略伙伴”也就不足为奇了。事实上，在布什政府执政初期，尤其是在2001年空难之后，华盛顿采取了强硬的对华政策，尤其是在最敏感的台湾问题上（允许台湾民进党领导人陈水扁史无前例地高调“过境访问”纽约）。

Had 9/11 not occurred, it is highly likely that Sino-American relations would have continued their downward spiral, precipitating the full-fledged confrontation that was to occur two decades later. But the terrorist attacks on September 11, 2001, changed the course of history. Bush's global war on terror immediately refocused America's strategic attention from China, a traditional strategic competitor, to a nonstate terrorist network, Al-Qaeda, and the war in Afghanistan that the United States launched less than a month after 9/11. Tensions between Beijing and Washington quickly subsided in the wake of 9/11. The Bush administration committed a much worse strategic blunder in March 2003 when it invaded Iraq on false pretenses, plunging the United States into a quagmire and extending China's strategic window of opportunity.79

如果没有发生9/11事件，中美关系很可能继续下滑，最终导致二十年后全面对抗的爆发。但2001年9月11日的恐怖袭击改变了历史进程。布什发起的全球反恐战争立即将美国的战略注意力从传统的战略竞争对手中国转移到非国家恐怖组织“基地”组织，以及美国在9/11事件发生不到一个月后发动的阿富汗战争。9/11事件后，北京和华盛顿之间的紧张关系迅速缓和。然而，布什政府在2003年3月犯下了一个更为严重的战略错误，即以虚假借口入侵伊拉克，使美国陷入泥潭，并延长了中国的战略机遇窗口。

When Hu Jintao took over from Jiang at the end of 2002, he inherited perhaps China's most favorable external environment of the post-Cold War era. Nevertheless, even with a distracted hegemon, Hu faced two new challenges that had not existed under Jiang. The first challenge was to counter the "China threat theory" that was gaining credence as a result of the rise of Chinese power during the Jiang period. This would require strategic reassurances through rhetoric and action. But at the same time, efforts to ease fears of China by its Asian neighbors, the United States, and its Western allies were likely made less credible by the measures China took to protect its expanding overseas interests, hence the second challenge. The new geopolitical reality, created in no small part by the very success of Deng's strategy of prioritizing domestic development and avoiding conflict with the West, meant that it would become increasingly difficult to adhere to taoguang yanghui. As Hu pointed out in a 2006 foreign policy speech, "the more developmental success" that China achieved, the more likely it would "encounter challenges of external resistance and risks," especially at a time when its overseas economic interests and emerging new opportunities demanded a more activist foreign policy.80

2002年底胡锦涛接替江泽民执政时，他或许继承了后冷战时代中国最为有利的外部环境。然而，即便面对的是一位注意力分散的霸权人物，胡锦涛也面临着江泽民时期从未出现过的两项新挑战。首先，要应对江泽民时期随着中国实力崛起而日益盛行的“中国威胁论”。这需要通过言辞和行动来安抚各方，以示战略上的安抚。但与此同时，中国为维护其不断扩大的海外利益而采取的措施，可能会削弱其安抚亚洲邻国、美国及其西方盟友对中国担忧的努力的可信度，这便是第二项挑战。新的地缘政治现实，很大程度上源于邓小平优先发展国内经济、避免与西方冲突的战略的成功，这意味着坚持“道光扬辉”的原则将变得越来越困难。正如胡锦涛在2006年的一次外交政策演讲中所指出的，中国取得的发展成就越多，就越有可能“遭遇外部阻力和风险的挑战”，尤其是在其海外经济利益和新兴机遇需要采取更加积极的外交政策之际。

To assuage fears of a rising China, Hu relied mainly on a rhetorical campaign emphasizing China's peaceful intentions. The "peaceful rise" narrative, energetically promoted by one of Hu's advisers in 2003, sought to project a benign image and to dispel any fears that the growth of Chinese power would lead to conflict and war. However, judging by the lukewarm, if not skeptical, foreign reaction to the "peaceful rise" rhetoric, this initiative apparently failed. Even worse, Hu Jintao did not appear to have gained enough political support within the party for using the phrase "peaceful rise" to frame the party's strategic reassurance efforts. Officially, the party preferred "peaceful development," thus incorporating it in Hu's speeches and official documents as a standard declaration of strategic intentions. The campaign to promote the "peaceful rise" rhetoric quickly fizzled out.81

为了消除外界对中国崛起的担忧，胡锦涛主要依靠强调中国和平意图的宣传攻势。2003年，胡锦涛的一位顾问大力推广“和平崛起”的叙事，旨在塑造一个温和的形象，消除外界对中国实力增长会导致冲突和战争的担忧。然而，从国际社会对“和平崛起”论调冷淡甚至怀疑的反应来看，这一举措显然失败了。更糟糕的是，胡锦涛似乎并未在党内获得足够的政治支持，以使用“和平崛起”这一措辞来构建党的战略安抚体系。官方层面，党更倾向于使用“和平发展”，并将其作为战略意图的标准表述写入胡锦涛的讲话和官方文件中。推广“和平崛起”论调的运动很快就偃旗息鼓了。

Hu's record in handling the second challenge was mixed. He highlighted the new strategic dilemma in a speech on foreign policy in August 2003. Unlike Jiang, who continued to reiterate Deng's dictum of taoguang yanghui when speaking on foreign policy, Hu highlighted the challenge of balancing taoguang yanghui and yousuo zuowei (making a contribution), a secondary guiding foreign policy principle that Deng had added in December 1990.82 Although Hu declared that China would adhere to Deng's caution against foreign entanglements, circumstances had changed and foreign policy decisions needed to be tailored to specific circumstances.83

胡锦涛在应对第二个挑战方面表现不一。他在2003年8月的外交政策讲话中强调了这一新的战略困境。与江泽民在谈外交政策时继续重申邓小平“道光扬辉”的原则不同，胡锦涛强调了平衡“道光扬辉”和“有索作威”（邓小平于1990年12月提出的外交政策第二原则）的挑战。尽管胡锦涛宣称中国将遵循邓小平避免卷入外部纷争的告诫，但形势已经发生变化，外交政策决策需要根据具体情况进行调整。

In terms of actual Chinese policy, the subtle revision of taoguang yanghui as revealed in Hu's speech in 2003, did not have an immediate impact. During his first term (2002-2007), Chinese foreign policy essentially followed the path laid out by Deng in 1990. This period saw marked improvement and stability in Sino-American relations. In August 2003, China sponsored the "six-party talks," including the United States, Japan, and South Korea, to seek a diplomatic solution to North Korea's development of nuclear weapons. (The talks yielded no results.) China's relations with most of its neighbors remained friendly. Ties with Europe warmed to such an extent that, in 2005, the European Union was mulling over lifting the arms embargo against China that it had imposed after the Tiananmen crackdown in 1989. (The idea was abandoned in face of fierce American opposition.)84

就中国实际政策而言，胡锦涛2003年讲话中对“道光扬晖”的微妙修正并未立即产生影响。在他第一个任期（2002-2007年）内，中国外交政策基本沿袭了邓小平1990年制定的路线。这一时期，中美关系显著改善并趋于稳定。2003年8月，中国发起包括美国、日本和韩国在内的“六方会谈”，寻求以外交途径解决朝鲜发展核武器的问题。（会谈未取得任何成果。）中国与大多数邻国的关系保持友好。中欧关系升温，以至于2005年，欧盟曾考虑解除1989年天安门事件后对中国实施的武器禁运。（但由于美国的强烈反对，这一想法最终被放弃。）

Chinese restraint during this period was likely the result of a combination of factors. Most importantly, this was because Jiang retained enormous influence through his proxies on the PSC and because Hu Jintao, in addition to his risk-averse personality, lacked foreign policy experience and political heft to "make a contribution." Tensions with Taiwan remained high because the proindependence DPP controlled the presidency until 2008, when the more mainland friendly KMT returned to power. An assertive foreign policy would have been ill-advised when China needed all the international goodwill it could get to isolate Taiwan. Despite waging two costly wars, in Iraq and Afghanistan, and risking a long-term quagmire, there were no signs of an imminent American decline. Instead, the epic real estate bubble in the United States produced a booming economy.

中国在这一时期的克制很可能是多种因素共同作用的结果。最重要的是，江泽民通过其在中华人民共和国政府中的代理人保持着巨大的影响力，而胡锦涛除了性格保守、规避风险外，也缺乏外交经验和政治影响力，难以“有所作为”。由于支持台独的民进党一直把持台湾总统职位直到2008年，之后亲大陆的国民党重新掌权，中台关系依然紧张。在当时中国需要尽可能争取国际支持以孤立台湾的情况下，采取强硬的外交政策显然是不明智的。尽管美国发动了伊拉克和阿富汗两场代价高昂的战争，并面临长期陷入泥潭的风险，但当时并没有迹象表明美国即将衰落。相反，美国房地产泡沫的膨胀反而推动了经济的蓬勃发展。

But things changed dramatically after 2008. China's successful hosting of the Summer Olympics in Beijing in August of that year delivered a powerful psychological boost to the Chinese leadership and symbolically marked the arrival of China as a great power on the global stage. Even more importantly, the GFC that began the spring of 2008 and culminated in the collapse of the giant American investment bank Lehman Brothers in September of that year threatened to plunge the United States and its key European allies into the worst financial crisis since the Great Depression. Chinese leaders' confidence was further bolstered by the stellar performance of the Chinese economy after they rolled out a huge credit-fueled stimulus package at the end of 2008.

但2008年后，情况发生了巨大变化。当年8月，中国在北京成功举办夏季奥运会，这极大地鼓舞了中国领导层的士气，也象征性地标志着中国正式跻身世界强国之列。更重要的是，始于2008年春季、最终导致美国巨型投资银行雷曼兄弟于同年9月倒闭的全球金融危机，几乎将美国及其主要欧洲盟友拖入自大萧条以来最严重的金融危机。2008年底，中国推出了一项规模庞大的信贷刺激计划，此后中国经济的强劲表现进一步增强了中国领导人的信心。

It was in this context that Hu Jintao signaled the most consequential change of direction in Chinese foreign policy in the post-Tiananmen era.85 In a speech to Chinese ambassadors in July 2009, Hu unveiled a new foreign policy principle of jianchi taoguang yanghui, jiji yousuo zuowei—continuing to keep a low profile and actively making a contribution. The addition of "actively" is no mere wordplay. As Hu elaborated, it was necessary to maintain a low profile and avoid conflict as China remained a developing country despite its recent progress. However, its growing external interests, rising "comprehensive national power," and international status required that it also take greater initiatives in foreign affairs and "actively push the development of the international political and economic order in a more just and reasonable direction." However, a more active foreign policy, Hu clarified, did not mean that China would bear any global responsibilities beyond its capabilities, despite Westerners calling on Beijing to become a "responsible stakeholder," thereby implying that China would become more active only to further its national interests.86

正是在这种背景下，胡锦涛标志着后天安门时代中国外交政策方向的重大转变。2009年7月，胡锦涛在对各国大使的讲话中提出了“保持低调，积极贡献”的新外交政策原则。其中“积极”二字绝非玩笑。正如胡锦涛所阐述的，尽管中国近年来取得了长足进步，但作为一个发展中国家，保持低调、避免冲突是必要的。然而，日益增长的外部利益、不断增强的“综合国力”和国际地位要求中国在外交事务中采取更大的主动性，“积极推动国际政治经济秩序朝着更加公正合理的方向发展”。然而，胡锦涛澄清说，更积极的外交政策并不意味着中国将承担超出其能力范围的全球责任，尽管西方呼吁北京成为“负责任的利益攸关方”，暗示中国更加积极地参与外交事务只是为了推进其国家利益。

Although Hu's version of foreign policy activism lacked the ambition, aggressiveness, and strategic coherence of the policy adopted by Xi Jinping after 2012, it marked the beginning of the end of Deng's strategy of "keeping a low profile." In practice, the shift was most pronounced in the expansion of Chinese external economic footprint through investment, loans, and aid, the projection of Chinese "soft power" through the establishment of Chinese language schools (the Confucius Institutes) and media outlets tasked with improving the country's image, and confrontational tactics in asserting Chinese maritime claims in the South China Sea and over the Senkaku Islands.

尽管胡锦涛的外交政策积极性不如习近平2012年后推行的政策那样雄心勃勃、咄咄逼人且具有战略连贯性，但它标志着邓小平“低调行事”战略走向终结。在实践中，这一转变最显著地体现在以下几个方面：中国通过投资、贷款和援助扩大其对外经济影响力；通过建立汉语学校（孔子学院）和旨在提升国家形象的媒体机构来展现中国的“软实力”；以及在南海和钓鱼岛等海域主张问题上采取对抗性策略。

Chinese foreign aid measured in concessional and nonconcessional loans averaged $7.6 billion between 2000 and 2008, but in the last four years of Hu's tenure (2009-2012), it averaged more than five times that, at $38.2 billion a year.87 In early 2009 China established a special $7.25 billion program to expand its overseas propaganda activities. Consequently, the presence of official Chinese media organizations, such as China Central Television, Xinhua, and Global Times, gained much higher visibility outside of China.88 Beijing also began to press its maritime claims more confrontationally. After a Chinese fishing crawler collided with two Japanese Coast Guard patrol boats in the waters near the disputed Senkaku/Diaoyu Islands in September 2010, Beijing chose to escalate, instead of defusing, the tensions with Tokyo. It also overreacted to Japan's plan to "nationalize" the same disputed islands (to prevent an ultra-nationalist from purchasing them), triggering the worst crisis in Sino-Japanese relations in the post-Mao period.89 In the South China Sea, China began harassing US naval vessels that were conducting freedom of navigation operations in China-claimed waters, and, in both 2009 and 2010, it imposed a unilateral three-month moratorium on fishing in the disputed areas that were also claimed by Vietnam.90

2000年至2008年间，中国对外援助（包括优惠贷款和非优惠贷款）平均为76亿美元，但在胡锦涛执政的最后四年（2009-2012年），平均每年达到382亿美元，是之前的五倍多。2009年初，中国设立了一项72.5亿美元的专项计划，旨在扩大其海外宣传活动。因此，中国中央电视台、新华社和《环球时报》等官方媒体机构在海外的影响力显著提升。北京也开始以更具对抗性的方式推进其海洋权益主张。2010年9月，一艘中国渔船在有争议的钓鱼岛/尖阁诸岛附近海域与两艘日本海上保安厅巡逻艇相撞后，北京选择升级而非缓和与东京的紧张关系。中国对日本“国有化”这些争议岛屿（以防止极端民族主义者购买这些岛屿）的计划反应过度，引发了后毛泽东时代中日关系最严重的危机。在南海，中国开始骚扰在声称拥有主权的海域进行航行自由行动的美国海军舰艇，并在2009年和2010年两次单方面对越南也声称拥有主权的争议海域实施了为期三个月的禁渔令。

Such muscle-flexing immediately alarmed some strategic analysts. In a prescient essay, initially published online in 2009, Li-tai Xue was the first to warn that China's hubris would inevitably lead to confrontation with the United States.91 Indeed, China's newfound activism actually had a perverse effect, discrediting Beijing's pledge of "peaceful development" and pushing its worried neighbors into the arms of Washington.92 It did not take long for the United States to seize this opportunity and begin to reassess its approach to Beijing. In November 2011 Secretary of State Hillary Clinton announced a new strategy, "Pivot to Asia," which would redirect American diplomatic, military, and economic resources to the region to counter China's growing influence.93

这种炫耀武力的行为立即引起了一些战略分析家的警觉。早在2009年，薛立泰就发表了一篇极具前瞻性的文章，率先警告说，中国的傲慢自大终将导致与美国的对抗。事实上，中国新近展现出的积极姿态反而产生了适得其反的效果，使北京“和平发展”的承诺失去了可信度，并促使其忧心忡忡的邻国转向华盛顿的怀抱。美国很快抓住这一机会，开始重新评估其对华政策。2011年11月，国务卿希拉里·克林顿宣布了一项名为“重返亚洲”的新战略，旨在将美国的外交、军事和经济资源重新投入该地区，以应对中国日益增长的影响力。

China's own pivot to "actively make a contribution," starting in Hu Jintao's second term, and America's response shortly thereafter would mark the beginning of the fraying of engagement between the two countries. To be sure, the collapse of relations would have to wait until Donald Trump and his China hawks launched their trade war in early 2018. But like the neo-authoritarian political order and the Chinese economic miracle at the end of the Hu Jintao era, the writing was clearly on the wall for a foreign policy that had served the party well—perhaps a bit too well for its own good—in the post-Tiananmen era.

中国在胡锦涛第二任期内转向“积极作出贡献”，以及美国随后作出的回应，标志着中美关系开始出现裂痕。诚然，两国关系的彻底破裂要等到2018年初唐纳德·特朗普及其对华鹰派发动贸易战之后才会发生。但正如胡锦涛时代末期新威权政治秩序和中国经济奇迹的出现一样，在后天安门时代，曾经为党服务良多——或许是过于有利——的外交政策的衰落已是显而易见。





A New Cold War





新冷战


Xi Jinping took huge and risky steps to exploit what he deemed to be unprecedented opportunities immediately after he ascended to top leader at the end of 2012. Notably, Hu Jintao at least had attempted to strike a delicate balance between strategic caution and assertiveness. He used taoguang yanhui in his foreign policy speeches to underscore the importance of strategic caution. Xi, however, did not even attempt to strike this balance. Indeed, if the invocation of taoguang yanhui is to be used as a rhetorical marker of strategic caution, it did not appear even once in Xi's many published speeches on foreign policy.

习近平在2012年底登上最高领导宝座后，立即采取了一系列大胆而冒险的举措，以利用他认为前所未有的机遇。值得注意的是，胡锦涛至少还试图在战略谨慎与果断之间寻求微妙的平衡。他在外交政策讲话中运用“审慎”一词来强调战略谨慎的重要性。然而，习近平甚至没有尝试寻求这种平衡。事实上，如果将“审慎”一词作为战略谨慎的修辞标志，那么在习近平发表的众多外交政策讲话中，它一次也没有出现过。

Instead, Xi characterized his early foreign policy moves as "proactive planning, striving for progress and gains" (zhudong mohua, nuli jinqu), as he put it in his speech at the party work conference on foreign policy in November 2014. The backdrop of his shift toward a more proactive foreign policy was the opportunity created by favorable changes in the world, which he characterized as "a world in which the international system and the international order are undergoing profound adjustments and . . . the international balance of power is undergoing profound changes and moving in a direction favorable to peace and development."94 Less than two years later, Xi was apparently pleased with this shift. Rephrasing it as "seizing opportunities and taking initiatives" (zhuazhu jiyu, zhudong zuowei), as he told the Politburo in September 2016, he cited a series of strategic initiatives, such as the Belt and Road Initiative (BRI), the Asian Infrastructure Investment Bank, and other efforts to promote "reform of unfair and unreasonable arrangements in the global governance system." These bold actions were justified because "as the relative international balance of power changes and global challenges rise, strengthening global governance and promoting reform of the system of global governance is an irresistible trend."95

相反，习近平将他早期的外交政策举措描述为“积极规划，争取进步和成果”（zhudong mohua, nuli jinqu），正如他在2014年11月召开的党的外交工作会议上所说。他转向更加积极主动的外交政策的背景是世界形势的有利变化所带来的机遇，他将其描述为“国际体系和国际秩序正在发生深刻调整，国际力量平衡正在发生深刻变化，并朝着有利于和平与发展的方向发展”。不到两年后，习近平显然对这一转变感到满意。他将其重新表述为“抓住机遇，采取主动”，正如他在2016年9月向政治局所言，并列举了一系列战略举措，例如“一带一路”倡议、亚洲基础设施投资银行以及其他旨在推动“改革全球治理体系中不公平、不合理安排”的努力。这些大胆行动的理由是，“随着国际力量相对平衡的变化和全球挑战的加剧，加强全球治理、推动全球治理体系改革已成为不可阻挡的趋势。”

Although the phrase "the East is rising and the West is declining" (dongsheng xijiang) cannot be found in any of his published speeches, Xi appeared convinced that the balance of power had evolved in favor of those countries or forces seeking a fundamental restructuring of the West-led political and economic order. He spelled out his analysis comprehensively at a January 2016 seminar for provincial leaders and ministers. Describing "unprecedented positive changes in the balance of power in the world," Xi listed the "rise of emerging markets and developing countries, the trends of multi-polarity and democratization of international relations, and emerging signs of changes in the West-led global governance system, ... the rapid rise of China's weight in the global economy and governance, and China's entry into a more balanced period in opening to the outside world" (which implied that China no longer needed the outside world as much as it used to). However, Xi did not allow his upbeat assessment of favorable global trends to ignore the challenges and obstacles. He cautioned that "the West's economic, technological, political, and military superiorities have yet to change."96

尽管习近平在其公开讲话中并未提及“东方崛起，西方衰落”的说法，但他似乎确信，权力平衡已经向那些寻求从根本上重塑西方主导的政治经济秩序的国家或势力倾斜。2016年1月，他在一次省级领导和部长级研讨会上详细阐述了自己的分析。习近平在描述“世界权力平衡前所未有的积极变化”时，列举了“新兴市场和发展中国家的崛起、国际关系多极化和民主化的趋势、西方主导的全球治理体系变革的迹象、……中国在全球经济和治理中的影响力迅速提升、中国对外开放进入更加平衡的时期”（这暗示着中国不再像过去那样依赖外部世界）。然而，习近平并没有因为对全球有利趋势的乐观评估而忽视挑战和障碍。他警告说，“西方在经济、技术、政治和军事方面的优势尚未改变。”

In addition to his reassessment of the changing balance of power, Xi was also motivated by his ideological antipathy toward the West and his grim view of America's security role in Asia, which China had consistently regarded as an instrument of containment. Perhaps the most explicit expression of Xi's ideological opposition to the West-led order can be found in his March 2013 speech in Moscow. "No country or group of countries can dominate world affairs single-handedly," Xi told his audience. There has been "an apparent upsurge of . . . rising hegemonism, power politics and neo-interventionism are gaining some momentum. . . . [the West] cannot live in the twenty-first century while thinking in the old fashion, lingering in the age of colonial expansion or with the zero-sum mentality of the Cold War. . . . Only the people can best tell if the development path they have chosen for their country suits or not."97

除了重新评估不断变化的力量平衡之外，习近平的行动也源于他对西方意识形态上的反感，以及他对美国在亚洲安全角色的悲观看法——中国一直将美国视为遏制的工具。或许，习近平对西方主导秩序意识形态上最明确的反对体现在他2013年3月在莫斯科的讲话中。习近平告诉听众：“没有任何一个国家或国家集团能够单枪匹马地主导世界事务。”他指出，“霸权主义、强权政治和新干涉主义的抬头势头明显……西方不能在21世纪还固守旧思维，沉湎于殖民扩张时代或冷战零和博弈的思维模式……只有人民自己才能判断他们为国家选择的发展道路是否合适。”

Like his predecessors, Xi accused unnamed "hostile forces at home and abroad" of attempting to bring about regime change in China. But he went beyond the boilerplate language of blaming the West for causing chaos through its interventionism. "Since the end of the Cold War," he said in a December 2015 speech, "some countries have been turned into a total mess because of the encouragement of Western values . . . some splintered, some engulfed in the flames of war, and some in persistent chaos. . . . If we use Western values to evaluate our development . . . the consequences are unthinkable. In the end, we either have to follow [the West] step by step or become objects of verbal abuse."98

与他的前任一样，习近平指责国内外“敌对势力”企图在中国进行政权更迭，但他并没有老生常谈地指责西方干涉主义造成混乱。他在2015年12月的一次讲话中说：“冷战结束以来，一些国家因为受到西方价值观的鼓吹而陷入混乱……有的国家四分五裂，有的国家战火纷飞，有的国家长期处于混乱之中……如果我们用西方价值观来衡量自身的发展……后果不堪设想。最终，我们要么一步步跟随西方，要么沦为被西方口诛笔伐的对象。”

While neither Jiang Zemin nor Hu Jintao made public their opposition to the role played by the United States in Asian security, Xi broke the taboo in May 2014 when he spoke at a high-profile regional security forum held in Shanghai. Without naming the United States, Xi declared, "In the final analysis, let the people of Asia run the affairs of Asia, solve the problems of Asia and uphold the security of Asia."99 Although he did not invoke "Asia for Asians," the phrase used by Japan in the 1930s, the implicit meaning of this statement came too close for Washington's comfort.

尽管江泽民和胡锦涛都没有公开反对美国在亚洲安全领域扮演的角色，但习近平在2014年5月于上海举行的一次高规格区域安全论坛上打破了这一禁忌。习近平没有点名美国，而是宣称：“归根结底，让亚洲人民管理亚洲事务，解决亚洲问题，维护亚洲安全。”尽管他没有引用日本在20世纪30年代使用的“亚洲人的亚洲”这一口号，但这句话的隐含意义却令华盛顿感到不安。





Strategic Initiatives to Remake the World Order





重塑世界秩序的战略举措


Xi's assessment of favorable global trends, in particular the rapid gains in Chinese power relative to that of the United States, was not delusional thinking. The Chinese economy was growing, on average, 9 percent per year between 2009 and 2013. By comparison, US growth during the same period averaged only 1.14 percent, largely due to the lingering effects of the global financial crisis. The euro area recorded, on average, negative growth of 0.3 percent per annum, and the Japanese economy barely grew during this period.100 What likely encouraged Xi the most was the size of the Chinese economy relative to that of the United States. When Hu told his colleagues to strike a balance between caution and activism in 2009, China's GDP was one-third that of the United States in dollar terms. By 2012, China's GDP had risen to $8.53 trillion, about half of America's $16.25 trillion. Under his watch, the gap would close further: when the US-China trade war broke out in 2018, Chinese economic output would reach $13.89 trillion, or 68 percent of America's $20.53 trillion.101 In terms of purchasing power, China reached parity with the United States in 2016, and it surpassed the United States as the world's largest economy in 2017.102

习近平对有利的全球趋势，特别是中国相对于美国实力的快速增长的评估，并非妄想。2009年至2013年间，中国经济年均增长9%。相比之下，同期美国经济年均增长率仅为1.14%，这主要是由于全球金融危机的持续影响。欧元区年均负增长0.3%，而日本经济在此期间几乎没有增长。最令习近平感到鼓舞的，或许是中国经济相对于美国的规模。2009年，胡锦涛要求其同事在谨慎与积极之间取得平衡时，中国GDP按美元计算仅为美国的三分之一。到2012年，中国GDP已增长至8.53万亿美元，约为美国16.25万亿美元的一半。在他的领导下，这一差距将进一步缩小：2018年中美贸易战爆发时，中国经济产出将达到13.89万亿美元，占美国20.53万亿美元的68%。101 按购买力平价计算，中国在2016年就与美国持平，并在2017年超越美国成为世界最大经济体。102

Militarily, even after President Barack Obama withdrew all American forces from Iraq in 2011, the United States was still bogged down in Afghanistan. The two wars had cost Washington trillions of dollars. The Pentagon has reported that it had spent $1.7 trillion on military operations in the Middle East and Afghanistan in the two decades following 9/11.103 Nongovernmental analysts estimate that the Afghanistan war alone drained $2.3 trillion from American coffers between 2001 and 2022.104

军事上，即使在奥巴马总统于2011年将所有美军撤出伊拉克之后，美国仍然深陷阿富汗战争泥潭。这两场战争耗费了华盛顿数万亿美元。五角大楼报告称，在9·11事件后的二十年里，美国在中东和阿富汗的军事行动中花费了1.7万亿美元。非政府分析人士估计，仅阿富汗战争一项，在2001年至2022年间就从美国国库中抽走了2.3万亿美元。

The erosion of American power not only threatened the durability of the US-led order but also encouraged its geopolitical rivals, such as Russia, to exploit those opportunities that a more disorderly world might offer. As for Xi, Russia's pivot away from the West since 2007, when Vladimir Putin delivered a bellicose speech denouncing the West at the Munich Security Conference, probably presented a historic opportunity to promote the shift from a unipolar world to a multipolar would—a goal shared by Beijing and Moscow.105

美国实力的削弱不仅威胁到美国主导的世界秩序的持久性，也促使其地缘政治对手，例如俄罗斯，去利用一个更加混乱的世界可能带来的机遇。至于习近平，自2007年弗拉基米尔·普京在慕尼黑安全会议上发表措辞强硬、谴责西方的演讲以来，俄罗斯逐渐疏远西方，这或许为推动世界从单极格局向多极格局转变提供了一个历史性的契机——而这正是北京和莫斯科的共同目标。

Although Xi's unveiling of the BRI in September 2013 is commonly regarded as one of China's most consequential steps signaling a decisive break with Deng's dictum of taoguang yanhui, his selection of Moscow as the destination for his first foreign trip after assuming the presidency in March 2013 probably represented an even more important change in Chinese post-Tiananmen foreign policy. As Moscow drifted farther away from the West, the forging of a close partnership with Vladimir Putin promised to instantly strengthen Xi's hand in dealing with the United States. Indeed, Xi's bet on Putin yielded quick dividends: After Russia seized Crimea and instigated a proxy war in eastern Ukraine in 2014, Moscow became firmly anchored inside Beijing's orbit, as reflected by the frequent summits, expansion of defense cooperation, and near-quadrupling of trade between 2012 and 2023.106

尽管习近平在2013年9月提出的“一带一路”倡议被普遍认为是中国历史上最具影响力的举措之一，标志着中国与邓小平“道光拒还”的理念决裂，但他在2013年3月就任国家主席后选择莫斯科作为首次出访目的地，或许代表了后天安门时代中国外交政策更为重要的转变。随着莫斯科与西方渐行渐远，与弗拉基米尔·普京建立紧密伙伴关系，有望立即增强习近平在与美国打交道时的筹码。事实上，习近平押注普京很快就获得了回报：在俄罗斯于2014年吞并克里米亚并在乌克兰东部挑起代理人战争后，莫斯科牢牢地被纳入北京的势力范围，这体现在频繁的峰会、不断扩大的防务合作以及2012年至2023年间近乎四倍的贸易额增长。

Immediately after his outreach to Putin, Xi launched a series of strategic initiatives at dizzying speed. The $1 trillion One-Belt, One-Road (later renamed the Belt and Road Initiative, or BRI) was launched in late 2013 to finance infrastructure such as ports, railways, highways, and power plants throughout the world. Although the intent, merits, and feasibility of this ambitious venture have since been hotly debated, the only uncontroversial fact about it is that the BRI represents China's most expensive effort ever to increase its global influence through economic means.107 To establish a financing vehicle, in November 2014 Xi announced the Silk Road Fund, which was to be launched with $40 billion from Chinese state-owned financial entities.

在与普京接触后，习近平立即以惊人的速度推出了一系列战略举措。2013年底，一项耗资1万亿美元的“一带一路”倡议（后更名为“一带一路”倡议，简称“BRI”）启动，旨在为全球港口、铁路、公路和电厂等基础设施建设提供资金。尽管这项雄心勃勃的计划的意图、价值和可行性此后一直备受争议，但唯一无可争议的事实是，“一带一路”是中国迄今为止通过经济手段提升其全球影响力的最昂贵举措。为了建立融资机制，习近平于2014年11月宣布成立丝路基金，该基金将由中国国有金融机构出资400亿美元。

As a direct but subtle challenge to the West-led World Bank and International Monetary Fund, China set up the Asian Infrastructure Investment Bank in 2016, a Shanghai-based new multilateral international financial institution, with China as the largest shareholder. China also embraced the idea of a new development bank, initially proposed by India at a summit of the BRICS (Brazil, Russia, India, China, and South Africa) in March 2012. This bank, named the New Development Bank and headquartered in Shanghai, was formally launched in July 2014. China and the other BRICS each held a 20 percent share of the bank, which had initial authorized capital of $100 billion.108

为了直接而巧妙地挑战西方主导的世界银行和国际货币基金组织，中国于2016年成立了亚洲基础设施投资银行（AIIB），这是一家总部位于上海的新型多边国际金融机构，中国是其最大股东。此外，中国还采纳了印度在2012年3月金砖国家（巴西、俄罗斯、印度、中国和南非）峰会上提出的建立新开发银行的构想。这家名为新开发银行、总部设在上海的银行于2014年7月正式成立。中国和其他金砖国家各持有该银行20%的股份，其初始授权资本为1000亿美元。

In addition to flexing China's financial muscle to promote a new multipolar global economic order, Xi began to test the boundaries of the American security order in East Asia. The first step he took was the announcement of the East China Sea Air Defense Identification Zone (ADIZ), in November 2013. Many countries, including the United States and Japan, have set up such zones, which require aircraft entering airspace within them to identify themselves and report their course and destination to air traffic control authorities. But China's new ADIZ was seen as provocative because it covers the airspace over the disputed Senkaku/Diaoyu Islands.109

除了展现中国的经济实力以推动新的多极全球经济秩序外，习近平还开始试探美国在东亚安全秩序的边界。他采取的第一步是于2013年11月宣布设立东海防空识别区（ADIZ）。包括美国和日本在内的许多国家都设立了类似的区域，要求进入这些区域空域的飞机必须表明身份，并向空中交通管制部门报告其航线和目的地。但中国的新防空识别区被视为挑衅之举，因为它涵盖了存在争议的钓鱼岛/尖阁诸岛上空的空域。

An even more aggressive step taken by Xi was his decision to begin building large artificial islands on the reefs controlled by China in the South China Sea in December 2013. This gray zone move was designed to simultaneously accomplish several strategic objectives: By solidifying physical control of these areas contested by the Philippines and Vietnam, China hoped to strengthen its claims of sovereignty over most of the South China Sea without engaging in war. Since the Philippines and Vietnam are too weak to push back, China could also, theoretically at least, take additional gray zone steps, such as enforcing its maritime regulations on ships and aircraft transiting the waters and the airspace over the South China Sea, to assert its claims.

习近平采取的更具侵略性的举措是，他于2013年12月决定开始在南海中国控制的礁石上建造大型人工岛。这一灰色地带的举动旨在同时实现几个战略目标：通过巩固对菲律宾和越南存在争议的这些区域的实际控制，中国希望在不发动战争的情况下加强其对南海大部分地区的主权声索。由于菲律宾和越南实力不足以进行反击，中国至少在理论上还可以采取其他灰色地带的措施，例如对途经南海水域和空域的船舶和飞机强制执行其海上法规，以维护其主权声索。

An implicit but equally important strategic goal is to test US credibility as defender of the security order in East Asia. Although the United States has maintained neutrality in the maritime disputes in the South China Sea, a coercive move such as building large artificial islands would directly challenge the US role as provider of security in East Asia. A confrontation with China over its artificial islands could potentially escalate into a great power conflict. But acquiescing to Chinese aggression in this instance risked undermining the region's confidence in America's resolve when challenged by a great power.110 On the surface, it appears that it was Xi who took the strategic initiative to build the artificial islands. In all likelihood, this option must have been weighed seriously, if not approved, by the prior top leadership because the logistics for constructing these large artificial islands, such as building specialized ships for dredging and acquiring special materials, would have required years of planning and preparation. In this sense, Xi merely pulled the proverbial trigger of a loaded gun.

一个隐含但同样重要的战略目标是检验美国作为东亚安全秩序捍卫者的信誉。尽管美国在南海争端中保持中立，但建造大型人工岛等胁迫性举措将直接挑战美国作为东亚安全提供者的角色。与中国就其人工岛问题发生对抗，有可能升级为大国冲突。然而，在这种情况下默许中国的侵略行为，可能会削弱该地区对美国在面对大国挑战时的决心的信心。表面上看，似乎是习近平主动发起了建造人工岛的战略行动。但实际上，这一方案很可能经过了前任最高领导层的认真考虑，甚至可能得到了他们的批准，因为建造这些大型人工岛的后勤保障，例如建造用于疏浚的专用船舶和获取特殊材料，需要数年的规划和准备。从这个意义上讲，习近平只不过是扣动了一颗已经上膛的子弹的扳机而已。

The fateful initiatives Xi took immediately after his rise—in combination with his turn toward neo-Stalinist rule domestically—fundamentally altered the nature of the relationship between China and the West, in particular the United States, triggering a series of reactions that would later escalate into a new cold war.111

习近平上台后立即采取的一系列影响深远的举措，加上其在国内转向新斯大林主义统治，从根本上改变了中国与西方，特别是与美国的关系，引发了一系列反应，最终演变为一场新的冷战。





How Engagement Ended in a New Cold War





参战如何演变成一场新的冷战


The backlash against China's turn toward an assertive foreign policy that started in 2009 was initially muted. Under President Barack Obama, in response the United States began to implement its "pivot to Asia" policy centered on two pillars: strengthening military deterrence and creating a new free trade zone—the Trans-Pacific Partnership (TPP)—that would include most of China's neighbors but exclude China. Although the pace of reorienting the US defense posture toward East Asia was relatively slow, Washington's leadership of a new free trade agreement bore fruit quickly. Trade ministers from twelve countries inked the deal in October 2015.112

2009年中国转向强硬外交政策之初，外界对其的反弹并不强烈。在奥巴马总统的领导下，美国开始实施以“重返亚洲”为核心的战略，该战略围绕两大支柱展开：加强军事威慑和建立新的自由贸易区——跨太平洋伙伴关系协定（TPP），该协定涵盖中国的大部分邻国，但将中国排除在外。尽管美国将防务重心转向东亚的步伐相对缓慢，但华盛顿主导的新自由贸易协定却迅速取得了成果。2015年10月，来自12个国家的贸易部长签署了该协定。

Despite warnings from seasoned observers that US-China relations were on the brink of collapse, the NCW did not formally start until the arrival of Donald Trump in the White House in January 2017.113 Judging by the formal designation of China as a "revisionist power" seeking to "displace the United States in the Indo-Pacific region," the US "National Security Strategy" released in December 2017 signaled a fundamental shift in US policy toward China.114 Although Trump is credited with ending America's decades-long policy of engagement with China, his initial motivation was probably not geopolitical. A trade protectionist pandering to crucial battleground state workers who blamed China for losses of manufacturing jobs, the former real estate tycoon immediately withdrew the United States from the TPP and, one year later, launched a trade war with China. Xi's retaliation led to Trump escalating that war and, in May 2019, imposing sanctions on Chinese tech companies—most important, Huawei, the national telecom champion.

尽管资深观察人士曾警告美中关系濒临崩溃，但直到2017年1月唐纳德·特朗普入主白宫后，中美关系才正式恶化。美国于2017年12月发布的《国家安全战略》将中国正式列为“修正主义大国”，并指责其试图“取代美国在印太地区的地位”，这标志着美国对华政策发生了根本性转变。尽管特朗普被认为是终结美国长达数十年的对华接触政策的罪魁祸首，但他最初的动机可能并非出于地缘政治考量。这位前房地产大亨为了迎合那些指责中国导致制造业岗位流失的关键摇摆州的工人，采取了贸易保护主义立场，立即让美国退出了跨太平洋伙伴关系协定（TPP），并在一年后对中国发动了贸易战。习近平的报复导致特朗普升级了这场战争，并在 2019 年 5 月对中国科技公司实施制裁——其中最重要的是中国电信巨头华为。

US-China relations went into a free fall after the outbreak of Covid-19 in early 2020.115 Worried about the potential damage to his reelection bid, Trump blamed—and punished—China for unleashing the deadly virus. He ordered the closure of the Chinese consulate in Houston and expelled its diplomats (China retaliated by shutting down America's consulate in Chengdu). The victory of Joe Biden in November 2020 did not end the downward spiral. If anything, the US-China cold war entered a new and more complex phase. Unlike the erratic Trump administration, Biden's foreign policy team crafted a more sophisticated containment strategy. As spelled out by the key players on Biden's national security team, the new China policy rested on four pillars: building up economic capacities at home to strengthen US competitiveness, contesting Chinese power in all domains, strengthening alliances, and establishing safeguards to avoid a calamitous conflict.116

2020年初新冠疫情爆发后，美中关系急剧恶化。特朗普担心疫情可能影响其连任，因此指责中国释放了这种致命病毒，并对其进行了惩罚。他下令关闭中国驻休斯顿总领事馆，并驱逐了中国外交官（中国随即关闭了美国驻成都总领事馆作为报复）。2020年11月拜登的胜选并未结束这一恶性循环。相反，美中冷战进入了一个更加复杂的新阶段。与反复无常的特朗普政府不同，拜登的外交政策团队制定了一项更为精细的遏制战略。正如拜登国家安全团队的关键成员所阐述的那样，新的对华政策基于四大支柱：增强国内经济实力以提升美国竞争力；在各个领域与中国抗衡；加强盟友关系；以及建立保障机制以避免灾难性冲突。

To counter the United States, Xi decided to elevate China's strategic partnership with Russia in the belief that the overall geopolitical interests of Moscow and Beijing—fear and resentment of US power—were identical. But a few weeks after Xi and Putin announced their "no-limit friendship" in Beijing in early February 2022, Russia invaded its neighbor, Ukraine, launching the largest and bloodiest war on continental Europe since the end of World War II. Europe saw China as Russia's accomplice and began to adopt a more hawkish China policy, closely aligned with that of the United States.

为了对抗美国，习近平决定提升中俄战略伙伴关系，他认为莫斯科和北京的整体地缘政治利益——对美国实力的恐惧和不满——是一致的。然而，就在习近平和普京于2022年2月初在北京宣布“无限友谊”几周后，俄罗斯入侵邻国乌克兰，发动了二战结束以来欧洲大陆规模最大、伤亡最惨重的战争。欧洲将中国视为俄罗斯的帮凶，并开始采取与美国更为强硬的对华政策。

Speaking to the delegates at the annual session of the Chinese People's Political Consultative Conference on March 6, 2023, Xi acknowledged the obvious. Although he avoided the term "cold war," he formally accused the United States of leading its allies to implement "all-round containment, encirclement, and suppression of China."117 He did not bother to explain what had caused this NCW. It is highly unlikely that he would have attributed his own actions as a possible cause of the hostile and dangerous Sino-US confrontation—a great power conflict expected to last for decades and to make his dream of the "great rejuvenation of the Chinese nation" an unachievable goal.

2023年3月6日，习近平在全国政协年度会议上向与会代表发表讲话，承认了显而易见的事实。尽管他避免使用“冷战”一词，但他正式指责美国及其盟友对中国实施“全方位遏制、包围、压制”。他没有解释这场冷战的起因。他极不可能将自己的行为归咎于中美之间敌对且危险的对抗——这场预计将持续数十年、并使他“中华民族伟大复兴”的梦想成为遥不可及的目标的大国冲突。





Conclusion





结论


THIS ACCOUNT of political and economic developments in post-Mao China explores the factors that likely have prevented the country from moving in the direction of becoming a more open, liberal, and democratic society. Instead, they have facilitated the revival of totalitarian rule in spite of more than four decades of sustained rapid economic development. In the 1980s the CCP leadership agreed that the Maoism that had impoverished the country, traumatized the party, and discredited the Communist ideology should be brought to an end. But the leadership was deeply divided about reforming the country's economic and political systems. Pragmatic Leninists represented by Deng Xiaoping and hardcore conservatives led by Chen Yun clashed over the direction and scope of economic reforms. Deng aggressively pushed market-oriented reforms and integration with the capitalist West because he believed that this strategy would deliver favorable economic outcomes and ensure the survival of the party and the rise of China as a great power. In contrast, Chen and his followers resisted such reforms and sought to repair and restore the command economy as a safer strategy to salvage the party. Nevertheless, despite their differences over economic policy, these two groups that dominated the elite political scene in the 1980s shared an identical objective of preserving the party's political monopoly. A third group of leaders were liberal reformers who sought both economic and political liberalization. But due to their political weakness, their success critically depended on support from Deng.

本文对后毛泽东时代中国的政治经济发展进行了分析，探讨了可能阻碍中国走向更加开放、自由和民主社会的因素。相反，尽管经历了四十多年的持续快速经济发展，这些因素却促成了极权统治的复兴。上世纪80年代，中共领导层一致认为，必须终结使国家贫困、给党造成创伤、并使共产主义意识形态蒙羞的毛泽东思想。然而，领导层在改革国家经济和政治体制方面存在严重分歧。以邓小平为代表的务实列宁主义者和以陈云为首的强硬保守派在经济改革的方向和范围上存在冲突。邓小平积极推动市场化改革和与资本主义西方的融合，因为他相信这一战略能够带来良好的经济成果，确保党的生存和中国崛起为世界强国。与此相反，陈及其追随者抵制此类改革，并试图修复和恢复计划经济体制，认为这是挽救党的更稳妥策略。然而，尽管在经济政策上存在分歧，但主导20世纪80年代政治精英的这两派却有着相同的目标：维护党的政治垄断地位。第三派领导人是自由派改革者，他们寻求经济和政治的双重自由化。但由于政治上的弱势，他们的成功在很大程度上依赖于邓小平的支持。

When Deng needed the liberals to advance his economic agenda, this coalition could overcome the resistance of the hard-liners and make progress in implementing market reforms. But the political reform agenda promoted by the liberals was anathema to both the pragmatic Leninists and the hardcore conservatives. Whenever the top leadership confronted the issue of political liberalization in the 1980s, Deng not only would form an ad hoc coalition with the hard-liners but also would take the lead in opposing liberalization. The combination of Deng's staunch antiliberal stance and the power of the other hard-liners thus precluded any meaningful political reform. Consequently, Maoism as a set of policies and practices might have ended, but the underlying totalitarian institutions that had made it possible and potentially revivable were preserved.

当邓小平需要自由派人士推进其经济议程时，这个联盟能够克服强硬派的阻力，并在市场改革方面取得进展。但自由派人士所倡导的政治改革议程，却令务实的列宁主义者和顽固的保守派都深恶痛绝。20世纪80年代，每当最高领导层面临政治自由化问题时，邓小平不仅会与强硬派临时结成联盟，还会带头反对自由化。邓小平坚定的反自由主义立场，加上其他强硬派的势力，使得任何有意义的政治改革都无从谈起。因此，毛泽东思想作为一套政策和实践或许已经终结，但使其得以存在并可能复兴的极权主义制度却得以保留。

The crackdown on the prodemocracy protests in June 1989 resulted in a complete purge of the liberal reformers represented by Zhao Ziyang and their replacement by politically conservative technocrats. Although Deng's "reform and opening" appeared all but dead immediately after the crackdown, paradoxically the collapse of the Soviet Union in December 1991 enabled Deng to rally a thoroughly demoralized party behind his neo-authoritarian developmentalism as the only feasible survival strategy in a world in which liberal capitalist democracies had won a decisive victory over communism.

1989年6月对民主运动的镇压导致以赵紫阳为代表的自由派改革者被彻底清洗，取而代之的是政治保守的技术官僚。尽管邓小平的“改革开放”在镇压后几乎宣告失败，但矛盾的是，1991年12月苏联的解体却使邓小平得以将士气低落的党团结在他的新威权发展主义战略之下，因为在自由资本主义民主国家已经取得对共产主义决定性胜利的世界中，这似乎是唯一可行的生存策略。

During the post-Tiananmen neo-authoritarian period (1992-2012), the party under the leadership of Jiang Zemin and Hu Jintao put Deng's vision into practice, largely through experimentation and adaption. With the party solidly behind the neo-authoritarian developmental consensus, Chinese leaders were able to implement more radical economic reforms, maintain domestic stability through a mix of performance legitimacy, nationalism, soft repression, and co-optation, and pursue a cautious foreign policy to stabilize ties with the West—China's most important external source of capital, demand, and technology. A fragile balance of power, produced mainly by accidental factors (the transfer of power from the revolutionary titans to relatively weak leaders in the 1990s), sustained a collective leadership. Although socioeconomic modernization produced some forces that challenged party power, such as the information revolution, social unrest, and the growing civil society, the regime had no difficulty containing these emerging threats.

在后天安门时代的新威权时期（1992-2012年），在江泽民和胡锦涛的领导下，中共将邓小平的构想付诸实践，主要通过试验和调整来实现。由于党坚定地支持新威权主义的发展共识，中国领导人得以推行更为激进的经济改革，通过政绩合法性、民族主义、软性镇压和拉拢等手段维护国内稳定，并奉行谨慎的外交政策以稳定与西方——中国最重要的外部资本、需求和技术来源——的关系。一种主要由偶然因素（20世纪90年代革命巨擘向相对弱势的领导人转移权力）造成的脆弱权力平衡，维系着集体领导。尽管社会经济现代化催生了一些挑战党权的因素，例如信息革命、社会动荡和日益壮大的公民社会，但政权能够轻松遏制这些新出现的威胁。

But the post-Tiananmen order began to crack even before the rise of Xi Jinping. During the second half of Hu Jintao's rule (2007-2012), the economy started losing momentum. The lack of deeper reform during Hu's first term (2003-2007) resulted in a less dynamic economy. Only a massive injection of credit into the economy, which in turn inflated a colossal real estate bubble, kept the economy on track. At the same time, a succession struggle began to intensify, triggering a new round of elite conflicts that ended with the most sordid scandal in post-Mao history and installed an unknown princeling who was thought to be a "safe" choice to take over from Hu Jintao. On the foreign policy front, Chinese leaders, bolstered by the rapid change in the relative balance of power between China and the West due to the global financial crisis and America's "forever wars" in the Middle East and Afghanistan, more aggressively pursued China's global interests.

但天安门事件后的秩序早在习近平上台之前就开始出现裂痕。在胡锦涛执政的后半期（2007-2012年），经济增长开始放缓。胡锦涛第一任期（2003-2007年）缺乏深层次的改革，导致经济活力不足。只有向经济注入大量信贷，进而催生出巨大的房地产泡沫，才勉强维持了经济的运转。与此同时，权力交接之争愈演愈烈，引发了新一轮的精英冲突，最终以毛泽东时代之后最丑闻缠身的丑闻告终，并扶植了一位名不见经传的“太子党”，此人被认为是接替胡锦涛的“稳妥之选”。在外交政策方面，受全球金融危机以及美国在中东和阿富汗的“旷日持久的战争”的影响，中西方力量对比迅速发生变化，中国领导人更加积极地维护中国的全球利益。

The waning of neo-authoritarian developmentalism toward the end of the Hu Jintao era should not have made the return of totalitarian rule inevitable. The regime conceivably could have muddled through in the same way as Hu had during his decade in power. But the combination of accidental and institutional factors would produce a great leap backward few had seen coming. Specifically, the choice of Xi Jinping as Hu Jintao's successor was an accident—a disastrous mistake made by those who had selected him almost certainly in full ignorance of his ambition and ruthlessness. Until he became the party chief of Shanghai in March 2007, Xi had been a plausible but not inevitable successor to Hu. His eventual selection as the party's future leader in November 2007 was the outcome of a power struggle between two unrelated factions.

胡锦涛时代末期新威权发展主义的衰落本不应导致极权统治的回归不可避免。该政权或许可以像胡锦涛执政十年那样勉强维持下去。然而，一系列偶然因素和制度性因素的叠加，导致了一次几乎无人预料的巨大倒退。具体而言，选择习近平作为胡锦涛的接班人纯属偶然——这是那些几乎肯定完全不了解他的野心和冷酷无情的人犯下的一个灾难性错误。在2007年3月担任上海市委书记之前，习近平一直是胡锦涛的可能接班人，但并非必然。他最终在2007年11月当选为中共未来领导人，是两个互不相干的派系之间权力斗争的结果。

But once he gained the top position in November 2012, there were few obstacles preventing him from amassing power and re instituting totalitarianism. The rules on collective leadership that Deng had established were too weak to stop Xi. Furthermore, Xi's weaponization of anticorruption prosecution gave him terrifying leverage over any rivals daring to challenge his power. Meanwhile, well-preserved totalitarian institutions, in particular the Leninist party-state and the regime's total control of the means of violence, enabled him to reimpose tight organizational discipline on the party and to reestablish the rule of fear over society. In all likelihood, Xi might not have anticipated the ease with which he could, almost single-handedly, dismantle the post-Tiananmen order and restore personalistic rule. In retrospect, he probably underappreciates how much he owes his rise and subsequent success to Deng Xiaoping and his policies.

但习近平在2012年11月登上权力巅峰后，几乎没有什么能阻止他攫取权力、重建极权统治。邓小平建立的集体领导规则过于薄弱，无法阻止习近平。此外，习近平将反腐斗争武器化，使他拥有了足以震慑任何胆敢挑战其权力的对手的强大力量。与此同时，保存完好的极权制度，特别是列宁主义的党国体制以及政权对暴力手段的全面掌控，使他能够重新对党内实施严格的组织纪律，并恢复对社会的恐惧统治。习近平或许并未预料到，他几乎凭借一己之力就能如此轻易地瓦解天安门事件后的秩序，恢复个人统治。事后看来，他可能低估了邓小平及其政策对他的崛起和后续成功所起的作用。





Limitations of Deng Xiaoping and Dengism





邓小平和邓主义的局限性


Our examination of party politics in the 1980s and the long-term consequences of Deng Xiaoping's policies raises questions both about Deng's political leadership and about the limitations of Deng's neo-authoritarian developmentalism. To be sure, it is unreasonable to expect Deng, a veteran of the Chinese revolution emotionally committed to the preservation of the CCP, to have acted like a liberal democrat. Additionally, Deng's personal contribution to Chinese economic modernization is beyond dispute because of his outsized role in launching "reform and opening" in 1979. But in retrospect, Deng was also a flawed leader with a distorted vision of modernization. His shortcomings as a political leader severely limited what he could achieve during the 1980s and, even more important, created conditions for a reversal of many of the policies he had crafted to achieve economic modernization.

我们对20世纪80年代党内政治以及邓小平政策长期后果的考察，引发了人们对邓小平政治领导能力以及其新威权发展主义局限性的质疑。诚然，指望一位对维护中共抱有强烈情感的中国革命老将邓小平像一位自由民主主义者那样行事是不合理的。此外，邓小平对中国经济现代化的个人贡献毋庸置疑，因为他在1979年启动“改革开放”中发挥了举足轻重的作用。但回望过去，邓小平也是一位有缺陷的领导人，他对现代化的理解存在偏差。他作为政治领导人的不足严重限制了他在20世纪80年代的成就，更重要的是，这些不足为他为实现经济现代化而制定的许多政策的倒退埋下了隐患。

Ideologically, Deng's visceral hostility to liberal democracy unavoidably undercut his effectiveness in pushing through his economic reform agenda and led to the purge of those liberal leaders who had been indispensable to the success of his reforms. After he dismissed Hu Yaobang in January 1987, Deng was unable to restore the momentum of his economic reforms. His decision to order the military to crush the prodemocracy protests in June 1989 and his purge of Zhao Ziyang, the liberal party chief who had been instrumental in launching Deng's economic reform agenda, not only tarnished his own personal legacy but also deprived him of the only remaining partner at the top of the regime who could have helped advance his "reform and opening." In fact, Deng's modernization project was all but dead in the immediate aftermath of the Tiananmen crackdown in June 1989. But he managed to breathe new life into it after the fall of the Soviet Union in December 1991 so shocked and demoralized the hard-liners that they reluctantly rallied behind his neo-authoritarian survival strategy.

从意识形态上看，邓小平对自由民主的根深蒂固的敌意不可避免地削弱了他推行经济改革的效力，并导致那些对其改革成功至关重要的自由派领导人遭到清洗。1987年1月解职胡耀邦后，邓小平再也无法重振经济改革的势头。1989年6月，他下令军队镇压民主运动，并清洗了曾为邓小平经济改革做出重要贡献的自由派党总书记赵紫阳，这不仅损害了他个人的政治遗产，也使他失去了政权高层中唯一一位能够帮助他推进“改革开放”的伙伴。事实上，邓小平的现代化工程在1989年6月天安门事件后几乎就此夭折。但1991年12月苏联解体后，强硬派深受打击，士气低落，邓小平设法使现代化工程重获新生，他们不情愿地团结在他的新威权主义生存战略之下。

Deng's neo-authoritarian developmentalism—unreserved embrace of capitalism and globalization as a means of economic modernization under one-party rule—initially achieved spectacular results in the post-Tiananmen era. But over time, the flaws in this strategy became visible. The logic of the partial reform trap reduced the incentives for the post-Deng leadership to adopt more politically difficult economic reforms, while the hybrid economy bred voracious crony capitalism and fueled rising social tensions.

邓小平的新威权发展主义——在党的统治下，无条件地拥抱资本主义和全球化，以此作为经济现代化的手段——在后天安门时代初期取得了显著成效。但随着时间的推移，这一战略的缺陷逐渐显现。局部改革陷阱的逻辑削弱了后邓小平时代领导层推行更具政治难度的经济改革的动力，而混合经济模式则滋生了贪婪的裙带资本主义，并加剧了日益紧张的社会局势。

The pervasive corruption and the stalled reforms created favorable conditions for the return of a strongman leader who could capitalize on both popular dissatisfaction and the festering rot within the regime to reestablish political dominance. Had Deng erected solid institutional and political guardrails in the 1980s to prevent the future return of a Mao-like figure, Xi Jinping likely would have encountered greater obstacles in his attempts to restore totalitarianism.

普遍存在的腐败和停滞不前的改革为强人领导人的回归创造了有利条件，他可以利用民众的不满和政权内部的腐败，重新确立政治统治地位。如果邓小平在20世纪80年代建立了坚实的制度和政治保障措施，以防止毛泽东式人物的再次出现，那么习近平在试图恢复极权主义的过程中很可能会遇到更大的阻力。

The truth is that the steps Deng took in the 1980s were only partial and, in the end, ineffective in enforcing the party's own rules against lifetime tenure, the concentration of power in one man, and the revival of a personality cult. Technically, the rules on term limits, collective leadership, and a personality cult that Deng had stipulated in the early 1980s were vague and unenforceable. Due to his antipathy toward democracy, he did not allow any political forces to exist outside the party, thus making the party (specifically its top leaders) the sole enforcer of its rules. When power was evenly distributed among the top leaders and their factions, as it had been between 1992 and 2012, these rules could be enforced. But when this fragile balance of power disappeared after the rise of Xi in late 2012, the edifice of collective leadership collapsed like a house of cards.

事实上，邓小平在20世纪80年代采取的措施只是部分性的，最终未能有效执行党内自身制定的反对终身制、权力集中于一人以及个人崇拜复兴的规则。从技术层面讲，邓小平在20世纪80年代初制定的关于任期限制、集体领导和个人崇拜的规则模糊不清，难以执行。由于他对民主的反感，他不允许任何政治力量存在于党外，从而使党（特别是其最高领导人）成为规则的唯一执行者。当权力在最高领导人及其派系之间平均分配时，例如在1992年至2012年期间，这些规则是可以得到执行的。但是，随着习近平在2012年底的崛起，这种脆弱的权力平衡消失了，集体领导的体系也像纸牌屋一样轰然倒塌。

Given the systematic reversal of Deng's foreign and domestic policies under Xi's rule, it is tempting to conclude that Xi's regime represents a fundamental break with Deng's regime. This assessment is true when it comes to the differences in tactics and the key strategic assumptions (such as the main source of threats to the party's survival and the balance of geopolitical power). Xi, a dogmatic Leninist, is the opposite of Deng, who was a pragmatic Leninist. But if we look at what these two leaders have in common, perhaps we will find that the discontinuities are superficial and the continuities between the two are fundamental. Both are hardcore Leninists who regard preservation of the party's monopoly of power as the overriding objective of their rule. They achieved this objective regardless of the costs: Deng would order a brutal suppression of the peaceful protests and would purge the leaders who did the most to help him launch his "reform and opening," while Xi would resort to totalitarian practices to neutralize all threats, real or imagined, to party rule. Both have a strong ideological antipathy to liberal democracy; both believe that only hard power can protect China from Western domination; both see the liberal West as an existential threat to one-party rule; and both regard the US-led international order as illegitimate and unjust. The answer to why Xi would adopt policies and tactics that Deng almost certainly would not have approved must be sought in their respective calculations of Chinese power and the costs of a given course of action. Deng had a far more realistic and astute assessment of Chinese power and a better understanding of the costs of his policies. In contrast, Xi has demonstrated a tendency to overestimate Chinese power and to underestimate the costs of his policies.

鉴于习近平执政期间邓小平内外政策的系统性逆转，人们很容易得出这样的结论：习近平政权与邓小平政权存在根本性的决裂。这种评估在策略差异和关键战略假设（例如党的生存面临的主要威胁来源和地缘政治力量平衡）方面确实成立。习近平是一位教条的列宁主义者，与务实的列宁主义者邓小平截然相反。但如果我们审视这两位领导人的共同之处，或许会发现，他们之间的差异只是表面上的，而本质上的延续才是关键。他们都是坚定的列宁主义者，都将维护党的权力垄断视为其统治的首要目标。为了实现这一目标，他们不惜一切代价：邓小平会下令残酷镇压和平抗议，并清洗那些为他推行“改革开放”做出最大贡献的领导人；而习近平则会诉诸极权主义手段，消除一切对党的统治构成威胁的因素，无论这些威胁是真实存在的还是臆想出来的。两人都对自由民主抱有强烈的意识形态反感；两人都认为只有硬实力才能保护中国免受西方主导；两人都视自由主义的西方为对一党专政的生存威胁；两人都认为美国主导的国际秩序是不合法且不公正的。习近平为何会采取邓小平几乎肯定不会赞同的政策和策略，其原因必须从他们各自对中国实力和特定行动成本的考量中寻找答案。邓小平对中国实力的评估更为现实和敏锐，对自身政策的成本也有更深刻的理解。相比之下，习近平则表现出高估中国实力、低估自身政策成本的倾向。





An Inevitable New Cold War?





新冷战不可避免？


The NCW between China and the United States that began toward the end of the 2010s and escalated after Russia's invasion of Ukraine in 2022 has plunged the world into another dark era of great power confrontation and has resurrected the specter of war between nuclear-armed adversaries. Future historians will undoubtedly debate the causes of the NCW. Our account of China's political and economic developments in the post-Mao era reaches a more nuanced conclusion regarding whether the NCW was inevitable. On the one hand, the odds of integrating China into a West-led international order were evidently poor because Chinese leaders themselves consistently viewed this order as illegitimate and unjust. The nature of the one-party regime also meant that it would be nearly impossible to fully integrate a CCP-ruled China into the West-dominated international order due to the ideological incompatibility between autocracy and democracy. Finally, the enormous power China had acquired in the post-Mao era thoroughly disrupted the military balance, commerce, and international governance. Even if China were a democracy, it would likely pursue self-interested policies that conflict with those of the West on many issues, as we have seen in the cases of India, Brazil, and South Africa.

始于2010年代末期、并在2022年俄罗斯入侵乌克兰后升级的中美“核战争”，将世界拖入了大国对抗的又一个黑暗时代，并重新唤起了拥有核武器的敌对双方之间战争的阴影。未来的历史学家无疑会就“核战争”的起因展开辩论。我们对后毛泽东时代中国政治经济发展的分析，对“核战争”是否不可避免提出了更为细致的结论。一方面，中国融入西方主导的国际秩序的可能性显然很小，因为中国领导人始终认为这种秩序不合法、不公正。一党专政的性质也意味着，由于专制与民主在意识形态上的不相容性，将一个由中共统治的中国完全融入西方主导的国际秩序几乎是不可能的。最后，中国在后毛泽东时代获得的巨大实力彻底扰乱了军事平衡、贸易和国际治理格局。即使中国是一个民主国家，它也可能会在许多问题上奉行与西方相冲突的利己政策，正如我们在印度、巴西和南非的例子中看到的那样。

Although the rise of China as a superpower would almost certainly result in unprecedented geopolitical and economic disruptions, it would be an exaggeration to say that China's arrival as the world's new superpower would trigger a NCW. Human agency—specifically individual leaders and their policies—also played a critical role in starting the NCW. Most crucially, Xi Jinping's aggressive foreign policy made the West's engagement with China untenable. Had a different Chinese leader succeeded Hu Jintao, the country's foreign policy might have continued to be assertive, but it unlikely would have been as reckless, risky, and confrontational as the foreign policy adopted by Xi during his first term. On the side of the West, the rise of America's far-right populist leader Donald Trump and the trade war he launched also helped set off a new cold war. Had Hillary Clinton won the US presidential election in 2016, Washington would almost certainly have adopted a tougher China policy, but a precipitous descent into an NCW would have been much less likely as her administration would most probably have pursued a more incremental policy of strategic competition, leaving room for de-escalation and compromise. Furthermore, Trump's escalation of confrontation with China in 2020 after the outbreak of the Covid-19 pandemic created a new political reality and virtually eliminated any possibility of building a new foundation for US-China relations to reverse the course of a new cold war.

尽管中国崛起为超级大国几乎必然会导致前所未有的地缘政治和经济动荡，但若说中国成为世界新超级大国会引发新冷战则未免言过其实。人为因素——特别是个别领导人及其政策——在新冷战的爆发中也发挥了关键作用。其中最关键的是，习近平咄咄逼人的外交政策使得西方与中国的关系难以维系。如果胡锦涛之后是另一位中国领导人，中国的外交政策或许仍会保持强硬姿态，但不太可能像习近平第一任期内那样鲁莽、冒险且充满对抗性。在西方方面，美国极右翼民粹主义领导人唐纳德·特朗普的崛起及其发起的贸易战也助长了新冷战的爆发。如果希拉里·克林顿在2016年赢得美国总统大选，华盛顿几乎肯定会采取更强硬的对华政策，但迅速陷入新冷战的可能性要小得多，因为她的政府很可能会奉行更为渐进的战略竞争政策，为缓和局势和达成妥协留出空间。此外，特朗普在2020年新冠疫情爆发后升级对华对抗，创造了新的政治现实，几乎彻底断绝了美中关系重建、扭转新冷战局面的任何可能性。





The End of the China Dream





中国梦的终结


Immediately after he became CCP chief in November 2012, Xi Jinping revived the decade-old party slogan "the great rejuvenation of the Chinese nation" and relabeled it as the "China dream." Although he has frequently invoked the "China dream" in his speeches, he has never precisely defined its meaning.1

习近平于2012年11月就任中共中央总书记后，立即重拾了十年前的党纲“中华民族伟大复兴”，并将其重新命名为“中国梦”。尽管他经常在讲话中提及“中国梦”，但他从未对其含义做出过明确的定义。

Judging by his post-2012 policies to realize his vision, it is reasonable to conclude that Xi's dream is to turn a CCP-led China into a global superpower on an equal footing with the United States. His record in fulfilling this dream after more than a decade in power, however, shows that he is failing more than he is succeeding. Despite his political ruthlessness and his success in amassing power and making himself the most powerful ruler since Mao Zedong, Xi's policies have put his "China dream" into serious long-term jeopardy. At home, he has all but ensured a destabilizing succession struggle after he departs from the political scene. His personalistic rule has made policymaking both over-centralized and prone to costly errors (as revealed most prominently in the case of his zero-Covid policy in 2022). The revival of the permanent purge is terrorizing the party and most likely traumatizing and alienating those elites who do not have any direct personal connections to Xi or to his faction. Similarly, his crackdown on the private sector has estranged and disillusioned China's private entrepreneurs, the group the party had previously courted. Economically, stagnation looms on the horizon. With the bursting of the real estate bubble, the record-high debt burden, and the demographic catastrophe for which the CCP's "one-child policy" is largely responsible, in the foreseeable future the Chinese economy will be struggling to regain its former dynamism. The decoupling of trade and investment from the West, a process initiated by the United States but later reinforced by Xi's agenda of securitizing the Chinese economy, will significantly hurt China's economic development as the country loses access to Western markets, capital, and advanced technology. Geopolitically, the NCW has sparked an open-ended and dangerous confrontation between China and the United States, endangering not only China's national security but also the CCP's own survival.

从习近平2012年之后为实现其愿景而推行的政策来看，他的梦想是将中共领导下的中国打造成为与美国平起平坐的全球超级大国，这一结论不无道理。然而，执政十余年后，他在实现这一梦想方面的表现却表明，他失败的次数远多于成功的次数。尽管习近平政治手段强硬，成功攫取权力，成为毛泽东以来最有权势的统治者，但他的政策却使他的“中国梦”面临严重的长期风险。在国内，他几乎已经确保了自己卸任后将面临一场破坏稳定的权力交接斗争。他的个人主义统治使得政策制定过度集中，且极易犯下代价高昂的错误（2022年他推行的“零新冠”政策便是最好的例证）。永久清洗的复兴令党内士气低落，并很可能给那些与习近平或其派系没有直接私人关系的精英阶层造成创伤和疏离。同样，他对私营部门的打压疏远并令中国民营企业家感到失望，而这原本是中共曾极力争取支持的群体。经济方面，停滞的阴影正在逼近。随着房地产泡沫破裂、创纪录的债务负担以及中共“独生子女政策”造成的人口灾难，在可预见的未来，中国经济将难以重拾昔日活力。贸易和投资与西方脱钩——这一进程最初由美国发起，后因习近平推行的中国经济证券化政策而得到强化——将严重损害中国经济发展，因为中国将失去进入西方市场、获取资本和先进技术的渠道。地缘政治方面，新一轮战争引发了中美之间旷日持久且危险的对抗，不仅危及中国的国家安全，也威胁着中共自身的生存。

Few should lament that Xi's version of a "China dream" will not be fulfilled. The tragedy brought about by the return to totalitarian rule and the outbreak of the new cold war under his rule is that the real China dream—an economically prosperous and politically liberal and open China—will be beyond the reach of its people for at least another generation.

很少有人会为习近平版本的“中国梦”无法实现而感到惋惜。在他统治下，中国回归极权统治并爆发新冷战，这带来的悲剧在于，真正的中国梦——一个经济繁荣、政治自由开放的中国——至少在未来一代人的时间内，都将遥不可及。





ACKNOWLEDGMENTS





致谢


THE BROKEN China Dream is a brief account of political and economic developments in post-Mao China. It is also a compressed intellectual journey of its author. China opened its door to the outside world when I was a college student in Shanghai. The US-China engagement that began with the normalization of relations in 1979 made it possible for me to come to the United States and study political science. My first book, From Reform to Revolution: The Demise of Communism in China and the Soviet Union (1994), was an optimistic assessment of Deng Xiaoping's reform. Its key theoretical assumption, based on the modernization theory, was that capitalist economic development could undermine the power of the Chinese Communist Party and create favorable conditions for a potential democratic transition. But as I gained greater intellectual maturity and a deeper understanding of the predatory nature of autocracy, I came to realize that Deng's neo-authoritarian developmentalism would be a dead end. This intellectual awakening inspired my second book, China's Trapped Transition: The Limits of Developmental Autocracy (2006). Published ahead of its time, this book laid out the logic of a "trapped transition," arguing that the CCP would lose incentives to pursue fundamental economic reforms and preside over a stagnating economy in the foreseeable future. My third book, China's Crony Capitalism: The Dynamics of Regime Decay (2016), details the pathologies of neo-authoritarian rule in the post-Tiananmen era. The Broken China Dream thus represents a synthesis of my research on post-Mao China over the last three decades.

《破碎的中国梦》简要记述了后毛泽东时代中国的政治和经济发展，同时也是作者个人思想历程的浓缩。我在上海读大学时，中国向世界敞开了大门。1979年中美关系正常化后，两国关系的密切接触使我得以赴美学习政治学。我的第一本书《从改革到革命：中国和苏联共产主义的终结》（1994）对邓小平的改革持乐观态度。其核心理论假设基于现代化理论，认为资本主义经济发展可以削弱中国共产党的权力，并为潜在的民主转型创造有利条件。但随着我思想日渐成熟，对专制统治的掠夺性本质有了更深刻的理解，我逐渐意识到邓小平的新威权发展主义是一条死路。这种思想觉醒促成了我的第二本书《中国转型困境：发展型专制的局限性》（2006）的出版。本书出版于时代之前，阐述了“转型困境”的逻辑，认为中共将失去推行根本性经济改革的动力，并在可预见的未来维持经济停滞。我的第三本书《中国的裙带资本主义：政权衰败的动力》（2016）详细分析了后天安门时代新威权统治的弊病。《破碎的中国梦》因此成为我过去三十年来对后毛泽东时代中国研究的综合之作。

I am deeply indebted to many colleagues in writing this book. Bridget Flannery-McCoy and Eric Crahan at Princeton University Press first planted the idea for this book in 2020 and provided invaluable advice and encouragement. A grant from the Smith Richardson Foundation enabled me to take a sabbatical to write the first draft in 2022-2023. I am especially grateful to the support of Marin Strmecki and Allan Song of the foundation for their enthusiasm for the project. I want to thank Hilary Appel for giving me a book subvention grant from the Keck Center for International and Strategic Studies at Claremont McKenna College. Nancy Hearst proofread and polished the manuscript with unrivaled editing skills.

在本书的写作过程中，我衷心感谢众多同事的帮助。普林斯顿大学出版社的布里奇特·弗兰纳里-麦考伊和埃里克·克拉汉于2020年首次提出本书的构想，并给予了我宝贵的建议和鼓励。史密斯·理查森基金会的资助使我得以在2022-2023年间休假，完成初稿。我尤其感谢基金会的马林·斯特梅基和艾伦·宋对本项目的热情支持。我还要感谢克莱蒙特麦肯纳学院凯克国际与战略研究中心的希拉里·阿佩尔女士为我提供的图书资助。南希·赫斯特女士以其精湛的编辑技艺对书稿进行了校对和润色。

Andy Walder, Guoguang Wu, and Patricia Thornton read the drafts of the book and offered helpful guidance. I also benefited from the constructive comments of two anonymous readers. Celine Wang, my able and diligent research assistant, deserves the credit for checking and standardizing the notes.

Andy Walder、吴国光和Patricia Thornton审阅了本书的草稿，并提供了宝贵的指导。两位匿名读者的建设性意见也让我受益匪浅。我勤奋能干的研究助理Celine Wang功不可没，她负责检查和整理笔记。

This book is dedicated to Larry Diamond, a dear friend and generous mentor who has been a source of intellectual inspiration for more than three decades.

本书献给拉里·戴蒙德，他是一位亲爱的朋友和慷慨的导师，三十多年来一直是我的精神支柱。

33 "Neo-authoritarianism" here refers to a unique variety of autocracy that seeks to accelerate economic development under authoritarian rule. Historically, South Korea, Taiwan, Singapore, and Chile under Pinochet are classical examples of this type of regime. Deng Xiaoping's vision of economic modernization is, in essence, neo-authoritarian. "Neo-Stalinism" can be defined as a form of totalitarianism that adopts the institutional and political practices characteristic of Stalinist Soviet Union, such as the dominance of an individual dictator, a cult of personality, the use of purges to terrorize the party, conformity to an official ideology, and strict social control. This form of totalitarianism differs from Maoist mass totalitarianism in the dictator's preferred instrument of terror. Neo-Stalinist regimes rely on the coercive apparatus of the state to maintain the rule of fear while Maoist regimes prefer the mobilization of the masses to carry out terror campaigns.

33 此处的“新威权主义”指的是一种独特的专制政体，它试图在威权统治下加速经济发展。历史上，韩国、台湾、新加坡以及皮诺切特统治下的智利都是此类政权的典型例子。邓小平的经济现代化愿景本质上也是新威权主义的。“新斯大林主义”可以定义为一种极权主义形式，它采纳了斯大林时期苏联的制度和政治实践，例如个人独裁者的统治、个人崇拜、利用清洗来恐吓党员、对官方意识形态的服从以及严格的社会控制。这种极权主义与毛泽东时代的群众极权主义的区别在于独裁者所偏好的恐怖手段。新斯大林主义政权依靠国家强制机器来维持恐惧统治，而毛泽东政权则倾向于动员群众来实施恐怖运动。
